When will I start getting leads for buyer lead gen?
For Google ads, leads can be expected within 12-48 hours because the algorithm needs time to accumulate data. Both Google and Facebook must complete a learning phase which is the most important part for campaign initialization.
Why are there other agents' listings on my Facebook Dynamic Ads?
For Facebook Dynamic Ads, all the available listings will be uploaded from your Lofty-built website via a catalog. If you only want to show listings based on specific criteria (including only your own listings), please let our team know. Enough listings to generate a catalog must be available to run Facebook Dynamic Ads.
It's important to note that the Facebook Dynamic Ads will show the agent and brokerage name for the listings on the headline of the ad to ensure MLS compliance.
Can I see an overview of my advertising plan?
Yes, a report can be generated to show you marketing performance and average CPL, etc. in your Lofty account Marketing page. Reach out to a DMA or Lofty Support (
support@lofty.com (mailto:support@chimeinc.com)
) for more assistance.
Can I put my logo and/or team picture on ads?
This is not done by default. Technically speaking, it is possible with
Display
and
Video
ads. This could be a useful tool to take advantage of when doing retargeting ads to build brand awareness. Talk to one of our representatives to inform them of how you might like to do this and they will help to start that discussion with the Lofty Ads Team.
Keep in mind that your ads on Facebook are also configured to run from your Facebook Business Page when possible so your brand is represented there as well.
Can I switch my target areas? And is there a specific time of the month that is best to do so?
Yes, you can change your target areas. It is best to make this type of change before the third week of the month because the algorithm needs a few days to learn. It would also be useful to review your ad performance data to make sure this is the best decision for you to take.
Where can I check my results for retargeting ads?
Retargeting is built into campaigns when possible and thus the data is also available, to some extent, in your
CRM
>
Marketing
>
Lead Generation
. There is no dedicated section in that report for retargeting specifically, but we do provide the retargeting ad total engagement - that is, how many leads clicked the retargeting ad.
Can I have tags added to leads from ads campaigns?
Yes, this is possible. You can add a location tag to distinguish which location the lead comes from. If you have other scenarios that you would like to consider, please contact your Lofty representative to discuss further.
Why am I receiving leads without a phone number?
If you received leads without a phone number, these are email-only leads which means a lead only entered their email address but did not provide any information. They backed out of the registration process before finalizing but continued far enough that their email was captured. To learn more, see
Registration Pop-up Style & Settings > Email-Only Lead Registration (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056629652#h_01F01X3SWYR57CWQCDJ5R69GFH)
.
Can I change my ads by myself?
No, there is no easy interface for you to change your ads by yourself. However, our DMAs (Digital Marketing Analysts) will gladly make the necessary adjustments. Please provide feedback by reaching out to your Lofty representative or by navigating to
CRM
>
Marketing
>
Buyer Lead Gen/Seller Lead Gen
>
Click on a specific campaign
>
Leave a comment
. This feedback will be received directly by the Lofty Ads Team for review.
What should I do with new leads once they are captured in my CRM?
When you start getting leads in your Lofty CRM, our Lead Gen AI assistant will contact them automatically (enabled by default for lead gen packages) to qualify them and get more information about them. Learn more about the AI Assistant
here (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056322172)
. You will be notified when a lead has been qualified, or you can monitor ongoing conversations and reach out to the lead to take it to the next step. There are numerous other tools built into the Lofty platform (consider
Smart Plans (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419016941083)
) that can be utilized to nurture and keep your leads engaged.
Can I get an Ad review/summary at the end of each month?
Yes, this is possible. The Lofty Ads Team can provide an
Ad Performance Report
at the end of each month and a representative from Lofty can discuss this with you regularly as well. This is a great way to explore performance and consider potential changes or optimizations that might be worth considering for higher conversion rates, etc.
Cancellation
What should I do if I want to cancel my ads? (#h_01F8GQ5DM9M1H50AHDB0PW9FXZ)
Can I get a refund for my remaining Ads budget? (#h_01GG8MM78AWF9EQ6V2TTERFZMP)
What should I do if I want to cancel my ads?
If you would like to cancel your Lofty Lead Generation Campaign, a 30-day notice via Lofty Support (support@lofty.com) is required.
Can I get a refund for my remaining Ads budget?
No, the remaining ads budget is allocated for each month and ads will be running until the end of the current month. If you cancel your lead generation campaigns, the next month will not continue with ads, but the budget for the current month will be utilized until the budget is spent.

Facebook Lead Generation
What is D.A.R.E?
Dynamic Lead Form Campaign or Dynamic Catalog Sales Campaign
The ads will show the listings under the Lofty account’s catalog, which are pulled from the MLS. These ads will rotate (moving and changing) depending on who sees them. Special requests can be made to customize the catalog if needed.
The campaign will have different ad sets depending on the locations targeted
The audience will be based on different criteria (focused on people who are looking to purchase a house or are likely to purchase one based on their interests and demographics)
Ads will be shown on the target audience's Facebook newsfeeds
Due to Facebook’s recent policy changes, how can Lofty make sure that we will be able to target people who are interested in purchasing a house?
Even though "out of target leads" is an ongoing issue under current Facebook ad policies, Lofty will do our best to make sure to target the right people by modifying the language and targeting detailed interests.
How does Lofty target those who want to sell their homes?
Lofty can help to target the right audience by grouping people who show interest in selling their homes. In other words, the more precise of an audience that can be determined, the lower the cost per lead.
Google Lead Generation
How do Google ads work? Are they the same as Facebook advertising?
Google ads primarily target leads when they are actively searching for something. Google Ads are based on intent, you search for something and Google shows ads that are relevant to that search.
Facebook ads target leads based on their behaviors, interests, and demographics. Facebook Ads are all about pushing content to you based on what you like, share, and engage with, rather than actively searching for something.
I’ve done Google ads before with a marketing agency and it did not work well for me. If I advertise with Lofty now, what would be the advantages and differences?
Aside from dedicated work on keyword optimization, Lofty also sets keyword lists for Property Features, Top Areas, and Neighborhoods. This helps the agent to find leads from niche markets. In this way, Lofty can help you achieve a lower CPL by having the right keywords in the right markets.
What is your optimization strategy to lower costs and increase the number of leads generated from ads?
Choosing the correct PPC keyword match type is an important aspect of our PPC strategy. As for matching the types of keywords, Lofty recommends using broad or phrase match first. In order to maximize our ROI, we will add other types of keywords based on ad performance.
Optimizations on keywords and ad copy are very important with Google PPC ads. Keywords will be expanded from search terms on a regular basis. Bids will be adjusted frequently to obtain a lower cost per lead. Ad copies will be modified to match lead search habits when running long-term ads.
Pre-Lofty Ads Onboarding Questions
Facebook Lead Generation
Can I use my existing leads for retargeting?
Yes. As long as the existing lead data meets the promotion requirements of the Facebook ad policy (i.e. file size and format).
Can I use my own ads account and Facebook Pixel for advertising?
No. Lofty has to link your Facebook Business page to Lofty Business Manager and then manage the ads on your behalf. The same goes for the Facebook Pixel. Lofty has to use the Lofty Pixel to import leads into the Lofty CRM.
How do you target the ad's audience?
The audience can be selected by the different areas, languages, and interests. We will update the most relevant potential leads as the target audience for you.
How do you target those who want to sell their homes?
Lofty can help to target the right audience by grouping people who show interest in selling their homes. In other words, the more precise of an audience that can be determined, the lower the cost per lead.
How much of the budget is allocated for retargeting?
Usually, we suggest that you as the client allocate 10-20% of your total budget to retargeting ads. However, the budget is not fixed for each client. We can adjust the budget allocation when necessary at any point in time.
Can you create ads focused solely on retargeting?
Yes, we can. We can only create the retargeting ads campaign for you with the condition that a qualified existing leads file is provided.
Can I use my own images and videos in the ads?
Absolutely. However, on occasion, the ad may not be performing as well as we expect when using customized ad creatives. We need to replace the images or videos when the ads are not producing results.
Google Lead Generation
Why can I not advertise with a budget lower than $600?
Based on our past experience, ad performance will be severely limited if a budget is below $600 when using Google. We suggest you target no more than 2 cities with this budget to maximize the cost-efficiency.
Can I do retargeting ads on Google?
It will be very hard to do retargeting ads on Google because we cannot capture the second or duplicate search behavior of the same group of people. Facebook retargeting ads would be a perfect solution for this kind of request.
Can you access my Google Ads account and use it for advertising?
No. All the ads Lofty is managing will be under the Lofty advertising account to facilitate quality assurance and budget control.
Can I send a list of my own keywords and have them used in the ads?
Yes, you can. You can send us the long-tail keywords you have used in past advertising activities. We will add them to the Lofty keywords list to help improve the ad performance.
Active Ads with Lofty
Facebook Lead Generation
How do you make sure that you will not overspend on the budget?
We have an auto budget calculation system in place to help allocate the budget for each client correctly. Our ads specialists are also monitoring account performance closely. Most importantly, we will pay for every cent if your ads campaigns overspend.
Can I have access to the ads?
Unfortunately, you will not be able to edit your ads when they are under Lofty's ads account. This helps to avoid conflicts of operation over one ad account. You are always welcome to contact a DMA if you need to adjust your ads. Or, you can send us a notification by submitting feedback through
Campaigns
>
Lead Engine
>
Buyer Lead Gen / Seller Lead Gen
.
I want to target a very specific location and a group of people. Can you do that with Dynamic Ads?
Under the current Facebook real estate ads policy, we are limited and must apply a 15-mile radius to each city/address we are targeting.
Where are leads routed to when they click on ads?
To answer this question, it is important to consider Facebook ads objectives:
For the objectives of "Conversion," "Web click," and "Catalog Sales," leads will be routed to a specific website to complete the registration process on that website.
For the "Lead form Ads," leads will be asked to submit their info right after clicking the ads and then they will be directed to your website.
Can I have my landing page used in the ads instead of the Sell My Home page?
Technically, yes you can. However, you have to place your Lofty Pixel on your website so that we can route the leads into your Lofty CRM.
Why is the estimated number of leads lower for Seller in the CPL report?
In rare cases, the actual results will be less than the estimated amount in the CPL report. The main reasons include market trends changing and customized ad requirements that cause limitations (i.e. targeting a small group of people).
Google Lead Generation
How often can I make changes to the ads?
You are welcome to contact a DMA whenever you want to adjust your ads or discuss ad performance. Adjustments can be made including location rotation, budget adjustments, etc.
Can I search for my ads in Google?
You can search for your ads, yes. However, they may not show 100% of the time because our ad audience settings are focusing on people who need to buy homes in a short time.
Increasing Conversion Rates
How can you make sure that the leads will convert into a sale?
Loft support can help you to learn Lofty  CRM best practices including building Smart Plans in the CRM that can help you to qualify and nurture your leads.
Always making sure to contact your leads quickly and with the information they cannot get from other places will always set you apart from the competition and bring you closer to a successful deal.
Lofty also offers an AI Assistant that might be of interest. Reference this article for more information on how it works:
Lofty AI Assistant / Chatbot (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360036957691)
.
How can lead quality be increased?
Change ads objective to "Website Registration".
Change ads platform from Facebook to Google.

New Add-On Service Details
If you purchase a Buyer Lead Gen, Seller Lead Gen, or Re-marketing Ads, and are currently not subscribed to this phone verification service, you will see this add-on option.

Lead Registration Process

### Section: Lead Import & Export

#### Article 233: Lead Export

- Article ID: `360011616892`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Lead Import & Export`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T06:22:15Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360011616892-Lead-Export

Introduction
Lofty provides a built-in export feature that allows you to export a CSV copy of the leads and contacts in your Lofty database.
Please note that exporting the leads from the CRM does not mean you are erasing them from your database, you are technically just securing a copy of the contacts.
*This feature can only be used by those who have been given access. For more information regarding permission, please reference this Help Center article:
Permission Profiles (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4407530443291)
.
Summary
How to Export (#h_01EJH1Q4SJ92PBNYV8AERRV2ZB)
Exporting Personal Leads (#h_01EJH1SYJZ417RZSWKZ0E52QP1)
Sample Export File (#h_01EJH1T2DKHYK6ZHHJQKMC929E)
How to Export
After selecting the leads to export. Navigate to
People
>
click the 3 dots beside the Add Lead button
>
Lead Export.
After clicking on the "Export" button in the bottom right, you will receive an email when the export CSV file is ready. There is a hyperlink in the export email that can be clicked to actually download the CSV. Make sure to click the link in order to obtain the document as the CSV will
not
be attached to the email itself.
If you do not immediately receive the email, consider checking your spam folder and wait 10-15 minutes. Depending on the size of the export, the file might take longer to deliver.
In the CRM, you will find it in the
Notification
window under
Leads Alert
.
Exporting Personal Leads
Agents who own Personal Leads (see
Lead Privacy: Team Leads vs. Personal Leads (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003544406)
)
do
have the ability to export these via CSV as long as they are the owner. An agent cannot see nor export private leads that belong to someone else.
Sample Export File
A sample export CSV file can be found at the bottom of this document. No data is shown in the file, but the column names will be the same when you request your export.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: lead export, export, download leads, extract, personal leads

- Article ID: `360001710831`

Introduction
Unless you are brand new to the world of real estate, you will likely have people you are already working with before joining Lofty. With that in mind, here is a brief description of how to import leads into the Lofty CRM.
We recommend using the sample file
linked at the bottom of the article
to configure your leads before uploading.
Summary
Important Notes & Suggestions (#h_01EC8FNANKEABTFMF6G7HHVMN6)
CSV/Spreadsheet Import Steps (#h_01EC8FNGTTC524NT0P8SZZQ3NZ)
Supported Fields (#h_01HN3JP7BSQZX4C1T8FQZYCVRS)
Reverse Option (#h_159499aa-3246-45ba-824a-a41322b85446)
Import History (#h_01EC8FP20P7H26PXVD6KJH384S)
Importing to Lead Pond (#h_01EC8FPA8NKQCTFEH57PD3K6Q9)
Email Verification (#h_01F9M798DX0363P0A59VG1KYY6)
Opt-In Probationary Period (#h_01F9M75WEJ6SHEP4NWBBQAKQE6)
Google Contacts Import (#h_01EC8FNNBNSG4RNJ3WAFC2Y6S4)
Import from Contacts (Lofty App) (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001710831)
Important Notes & Best Practices
It is usually best practice to wait to upload your leads until after your Lofty website is live and working, in case you want to send a welcome email (see
Set Up the Welcome Email (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360022134491)
) or set these leads up on auto property alerts (see
Setting Up and Using Auto-Property Alerts (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002891271)
). Without the website having the MLS data fully integrated, neither of those two options is possible.
Supported Sources:
Google Contacts
Spreadsheets in CSV, XLS, and XLSX (MS Excel) format
It is recommended to do a test import of 2-5 leads as you begin to use this tool so that you can make sure they import correctly before importing a large number of leads
If your spreadsheet has more than 10,000 rows, you will need to split the file and import it separately. Keep in mind that the bigger the file, the longer it will take to import.
There is no limit to how many leads you can have in Lofty, but you can only import 10,000 rows at a time. If you have more than 50,000 leads to import, we recommend reaching out to
support@lofty.com (mailto:support@lofty.com)
to request advanced import assistance.
If you try to upload the leads once but the import did not work correctly, you must go through and delete them all before trying again. To do so, go to the
People Page
select the leads to be deleted, choose "Delete" from the menu on the left, and then confirm. Then, you will need to go into the "Deleted Leads" section at the top of the
People Page
(this is like a "recycle bin"), to make sure they are completely removed from the system. If you do not erase them completely from the "Deleted Leads" section, new imports will merge or skip based on leads that exist there.
Admin/ Owner
must
create the pipelines prior to import for easier mapping later in the process. If a Pipeline is not similar to the one found in the import file it will be imported as a tag.
If you want to move more than 5000 leads at a time from one agent to another, kindly reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.
CSV/Spreadsheet Import Steps
First, follow these steps to get to the right section in the CRM:
Navigate to your
Personal
Settings
Select
Lead Import
under the
Lead Settings
section
Drag and drop your file or click
Upload File
to begin the import process
We simplify the import process and support the selection of different competing products. After selection, the competing product and Lofty fields will be matched automatically.
By default, the system will attempt to match the column names from the spreadsheet with the fields where the data belongs in Lofty. Typically, however, you will need to tell the data where to go in Lofty. You will do this by (a) referencing the column name and samples of the file which are available on the right side, and then (b) clicking on the "edit" option in the "Lofty Field Name" column to designate the destination of that data in Lofty. For example, you would want to make sure "Lead Type" matches with "Lead Type" in Lofty.
Repeat the above process until all the columns from the document are matched to fields in Lofty. Even if all the fields show as "matched," you will want to review them to make sure they import correctly. When you come across a situation where no field in Lofty matches the data you are attempting to import, you have two options:
1. Import directly to a custom field. You can only create 50 custom fields that are either "Date" or "Text." See
Custom Fields (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360054872212)
.
2. Import the data as a note. This will bring the column name into the note along with the data itself. This will then be saved to a lead profile for future reference. This information is
not
searchable.

If unsubscribed, the corresponding lead will keep automated emails (Smart Plan emails, property alerts, market snapshots, and market reports) from being sent to the lead. However, this does
not
affect text messages sent (see "Phone DNC Status" below for options there).

not

Once you have matched up all of the columns and have everything mapped to the desired location in Lofty, click on the "Next" button in the bottom right.
You will be presented with the following options to choose from.
Select the ownership level. Leads can be imported as your
Personal
leads or to a
Company
or
Office
that you are a part of.

Segment
.

A
gent
or
Lead Pond
.

L
ender
.
Choose to
M
erge or Skip
duplicate leads.
If merged, the incoming data will merge and be saved as a note on that lead profile.
For the logic on merging, please reference
Duplicate Leads + Merging Duplicates (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360054872172)
.
If skipped, the duplicate lead data will not be imported.
Decide whether to send
Welcome Emails
to these imported leads or not. If you choose yes, you will want to make sure your IDX Website is up and ready with MLS data, etc. This will send out an email with that lead's login information so that they can connect to your Lofty IDX website and begin browsing listings.
Choose to apply
Auto Property Alerts
if so desired. These will be based on any property information that comes in during the import.
When you are ready, you can select "Confirm." The file will then begin importing. If it is a large document, it might take some time to complete. You will receive a notification via email and a web push notification letting you know the file import has been completed.
Reverse Option
When importing leads, there is often a need to reverse the import and remove the leads that were created because the import was done incorrectly, etc. Lofty allows users to reverse their import after one has already been processed
as long as it is within 30 days of actually importing the leads
. This option is available under
Personal
Settings
>
Lead Settings
>
Lead Import
>
Import History
>
Reverse
.
This will work regardless of whether the leads have been contacted, etc. The option will no longer be available after 24 hours of processing the import. The leads will be deleted completely from the system with this option--meaning they will
not
be sent to the "Deleted Leads" section of the
People
page.
*For merged leads, they will stay in the system just as imported--the data imported/merged cannot be reversed if it was merged to an existing lead.
Import History
You can review all leads that failed to import by navigating to
Settings
>
Lead Import
and then selecting the "Details" hyperlink next to the file that you want to download a report on. This is a great way to make sure that everything makes its way into Lofty correctly.
Email Verification
If the lead was imported in a CSV file, the Lofty system will call a third-party API to determine the validity of the lead's email address. We will mark the lead's email status as "Bounced" if the results provided by the third party indicate that it is an "invalid email." The accuracy level of this third-party API is typically between 90% - 97%.
Opt-In Probationary Period
If, when importing leads, you see an option to "Send opt-in emails to the leads" under the
Lead Import Settings
options before finalizing the import, this is due to a high email bounce rate and an opt-in probationary period being triggered. You can learn more about this process
here. (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4403048145307#h_01FMSYMKREB8WBVMKRAZ1SEHM3)
Google Contacts Import
Please reference the following article:
Lead Import (via Google Contacts) (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360049874951)
.
Import from Contacts (Lofty App)
Another import option is made available through the CRM app. Below are the steps you can follow.
1. Click the People icon in the mobile app> hit the plus sign in the upper right-hand corner.
2. Click the import from contacts button.
3. Select using the search button on top of the radio button on the right side of the contact then click. Refresh your people page to see the newly added contacts.
Note:
Currently, there is no select all option for this feature.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.
Related terms: email verification, lead import, import reversal, opt-out

#### Article 235: Lead Import (via Google Contacts)

- Article ID: `360049874951`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Lead Import & Export`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T06:22:25Z`

Introduction
Unless you are brand new to the world of real estate, you will likely have people you are already working with before joining Lofty. With that in mind, here is a brief description of how to import leads into the Lofty CRM from Google Contacts.
*IMPORTANT
:
To learn how to import leads from a spreadsheet/CSV, please take a look at the following article:
Lead Import (via CSV/Spreadsheet) (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001710831)
.
This Integration with Google Contacts allows for manually pulling the data from Google Contacts, but is not intended to be a two-way sync. In other words, if you add a person's information on Lofty/Google Contacts, it will not automatically appear on the other platform. If you are interested in exploring a two-way sync, consider using products such as Zapier.
It is usually best practice to wait to upload your leads until after your Lofty website is live and working in case you want to send a welcome email (see
Set Up the Welcome Email (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360022134491)
) or set these leads up on auto property alerts (see
Setting Up and Using Auto-Property Alerts (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002891271)
). Without the website having the MLS data fully integrated, neither of those two options is possible.
If you want to move more than 200 leads at a time from one agent to another, kindly reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.
Steps
There are two entrances in getting to the Lead Import page.
1.
People Page
> click the
+ Add Lead
then choose
Import Lead
.
2. Navigate to
Settings
>
Lead Import
>
From Google Contacts
:
If you have not already done so, you will be prompted to integrate your Google Contacts accounts.
You will select the account you want to use from Google:
You will need to give Lofty all the necessary permissions:
Now that Google Contacts is integrated, you will want to click on the "Connect your Google Contacts" button again:
You will be prompted to choose "All" or a specific set of labels:
Tip:
The label is different from the columns when imported via CSV. You can see in the image below that the label can be understood as the tag or segment of contacts. The label is used to separate different Google contacts, so if you also want to sync the label, choose a segment for a different label.
Finally, you will need to choose from all of the options below and then click the blue "Import" button, and then "Confirm" on the last prompt:
Depending on the number of leads, your import should process quickly, and you will have access to your clients in Lofty.
Remember, any changes on Lofty will not be reflected in Google Contacts, and any changes in Google Contacts will not be reflected in Lofty.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.

The Boost Post is a social media ad
based on social post content
.
Compared to other forms of advertising, they can be a more affordable way to expand your brand awareness, starting at $30. This is available to all AI Marketer users.

Benefits
Lofty runs the Boost Post (Sponsored) for you by using your Facebook or Instagram original post as ad creatives. Boosted posts differ from ads on Facebook because while they are not created in Meta Ads Manager and don't have all of the same customization features, you get a wider choice of the goals of the ad not only the general 'Traffic' but more leads converted.
Choosing the right audience for your market
Targeting both PC and Mobile users
Accelerate your Post to deliver to a larger amount of audience
Optimizing for link clicks, so there will be more landing page visitors
Conditions and Settings
Boost Posts must include an image or video. Facebook and Instagram are the only channels that support Boost Post, at this time. The option to boost a post is available in multiple areas of the Social Studio:

Boosted Post
The source of any
new
captured lead will be
social_studio
A notification will be triggered when an existing lead engages with a boosted post. You can control this setting here:
Ad Previews
Instagram:
Facebook:
Notification
This is located in Settings → Notifications:
When this is enabled, you will receive an email notification when their social media post has a below-average impression score:

Introduction
Listing Blast (formerly Listing Promotion Ads) is a tool designed to save time and simplify your digital marketing efforts--all directly in the Lofty platform. This tool is designed to promote your listings on Facebook and Instagram. With this tool, you can:
Capture buyer and seller leads
Create beautiful, optimized Facebook Lead Ad campaigns on your own
Change ad creatives and content whenever you want
Run an auto-promotion campaign that will automatically adjust the ad as the listing status changes
Stay in total control of your listing blast ads
If you have any listings that come to mind that you would like to promote on Facebook, try the Listing Ads tool which you can access via
Lofty > Marketplace > Listing Ads (https://crm.lofty.com/admin/home/marketPlace)
or in the
Marketing (https://crm.lofty.com/admin/home#/campaigns/listingAds)
tab.
Summary
Start a Campaign (#h_01EWKNDVFPT922HW7GTSF5W1TA)
Choose a Listing (#h_01HZ57FH3ZCZWZBB922Y7VMWSH)
Choose the Duration (#h_01EWKNDZTSVX0CMY7FMNCVMCHG)

Start a Campaign
To start a listing ads campaign, navigate to
Marketing

Lead Generation
>

>

Confirm your Listing
Select a listing to promote. The listing may be either a listing on the MLS or a manual listing, but you cannot create a promotion if it is not one of those two. Your active listings will be provided here.
*IMPORTANT
:
To promote this listing, you must be the listing agent or have permission from the listing agent to do so.
Choose a Duration
Select the number of weeks that you want to promote the listing:
Auto Promotion
allows listings in different statuses to have different ad content and will automatically switch the ad content based on the change in the status of the listing.
The default price for this package is $79 per week but you can input a custom budget.
The minimum allowed price is $69 per week.
You must have a Lofty IDX website to select this package
Unable to promote manual listings (formerly known as pocket listing)
The higher the ad spend budget, the more ads will be viewed. You will see the
estimated
number of views calculated based on the budget provided.
The
Duration
is set to four weeks by default, but can run from one to four weeks.
If the duration is too long for the ad spend specified, more ad spend will have to be added and the system will prompt you. Lofty recommends at least $5/day for effective advertising
Confirm Payment Information and "Checkout"
If you are ready to proceed and purchase this promotion, review (or add) your payment information and then click on the "Checkout" button:
Connect Facebook Business Page
First of all, you will want to make sure your Facebook Business page is connected to run the promotions. Do so by clicking on the "Select Page" button and following the provided steps:
Choose Ad Copy and Images
After choosing the listing, AI will attempt to choose images automatically (you can override it if you would like) that include swimming pools, living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, etc.).
Once images are selected, you can choose the copy used. You will see that you can choose the copy that will be advertised at each stage of the listing (and will change automatically).
To choose images, click on the "Select Images" button:
A new window will then appear, where you will first choose the images you would like to use from the MLS, or you can upload better images from your computer if you prefer. If you are uploading images, here are the technical rules and recommendations:
Image File Type
: JPG or PNG

: 1.91:1 to 1:1

: 1 to 10
Image Maximum File Size
: 30MB

: 600 pixels
After having the images selected, you can then choose the headline and description for each image used:
And finally, you can choose what the CTA (Call To Action) button will display as by clicking the dropdown menu:
Define Lead Capture Settings
Finally, you will define the lead capture settings:

)

When you are ready to finalize the setup, click "Submit":
Review Website Registration Settings
Keep in mind that leads that register via Listing Ads will only do so if your website-forced registration is configured to capture their information. In other words, when a lead registers from a listing ad, they will be redirected to your website. So, check your Registration settings to make sure that they are set up for this type of campaign and will trigger a forced registration if that is your goal.
To find this setting, navigate to
CMS
>
Settings
>
Lead Capture
>

and
Pop-up Style & Settings
:
Review Ad Performance
Under
Marketing
>
Lead Generation
>
Listing Blast,
you will see the performance for any listing ads that are running:
A summary of all listing ads is provided at the top:
Choose from the different campaign statuses to find your campaigns:
Active
. Listing Ads that are active and running.
Pending
. Listing Ads that are scheduled to run on a future date.
Completed
. Listing Ads that have finished their scheduled run time.
Clicking on one specific Listing Ad campaign will show the performance of that campaign as well as a history of leads that are engaged. An "Engaged Lead" is anyone who goes to the landing page or detail page through this ad and fills out certain information to create a lead in the CRM:
Click the
Edit
button to edit the ad that is live if you would like to make any changes. This includes editing the copy as well as editing the images used:
Upgrade Your Budget (Optional)
You can choose to upgrade your budget after the payment.
You may upgrade your budget after the purchase payment, but before setting up the listing ads. By expanding the "Quickly Upgrade Your Budget" module, you can upgrade your budget. The difference between your old budget and the new budget will be deducted.
You can also choose to upgrade your budget when the ad is active.
By clicking the editing icon, you can upgrade your budget in the pop-up window. The difference between your old budget and the new budget will be deducted and allocated to your ads.
How to Cancel
To cancel your listing ads, navigate to
Marketing
>
Lead Generation
>
Listing Blast
and find the campaign that you want to cancel. Click the
[...]
icon and select
Cancel
.
A pop-up will confirm that you want to cancel the listing ad. Here, you can change your mind and keep the ad running or continue to cancel the ad.
If you cancel the ad, the remaining ad budget will be moved to your listing budget wallet to use on another advertising option.
Note:
It will take one business day for the budget to be moved to your wallet.
FAQs
How long does it take for an ad to be created and/or edited? (#h_01EWKPB2CZME79EKRRHHZJS036)
If I pay for a Listing Ad but do not finish the setup process, what happens? (#h_01EWKPB6YRCEPC6BSQM74C0E0G)
Can ads be run for properties that are not on the MLS or manual listings? (#h_01EWKPBBMEF2PN281MCJDT7VTZ)
What type of targeting is in place with these ads? (#h_01EWKPBG6HC0SZMVPE0TMR5D6Z)
Is this accessible to all users on an account? (#h_01EWKPBXYEE0CZPRN0QEVXRN50)
Which packages can access this feature? (#h_01EWKPC2BKDKE5ZW6M6WP77R81)
Can the "Auto Promotion" package be run with a Manual Listing? (#h_01EWKPC5ZNTYHXSR2KJQ3QETAV)
How long does it take for an ad to be created and/or edited?
Typically, a 30-minute delay should be expected. While it is still not live, it will display under the "Pending" tab:
If I pay for a Listing Ad but do not finish the setup process, what happens?
The promotion will be saved under the "Pending" tab, where you can click edit to continue configuration:
Can ads be run for properties that are not on the MLS or manual listings?
No. The listing must either be a Manual Listing or one fed into Lofty via MLS data. This ad type is specifically for promoting listings, not running other types of Facebook ads. A listing must have a listing details page to have an associated ad.
What type of targeting is in place with these ads?
The Lofty Ads Team will manage to target based on a combination of criteria used to generate buyer leads. We do not support the ability of users to configure their audiences.
Is this accessible to all users on an account?
Yes. All users on an account with access to this feature can run Listing Ads. This includes Team Owners/Admins as well as individual team members/agents. The Basic Promotion can be run by anyone, but the Auto Promotion requires an IDX website (Team Website, Agent Subdomain, or Agent Website).
Can Listing Ads be seen in my Facebook Manager?
Yes. During the setup process for Listing Blast, you have to connect your Facebook Business Page. If you want to see your ads on Facebook, you can access them via your business page as well. All the important reporting leads captured, previews, etc., will be displayed in the Lofty
Marketing
tab for your review, so there is no real need to log in to Facebook to see them there.
What website is used to run the listing ads?
If the Team Owner/Admin runs Listing Ads, they will be connected to the Team Website. If an individual agent runs Listing Ads it will default to their Agent Subdomain or Agent Website, and if neither of those has been created, it will use the Team Website.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/30583453855387-Zip-Code-Blast

Introduction
Zip Code Blast is a self-purchase lead generation option that leverages Facebook Ads to capture buyer and seller leads in a specific zip code. The AI Assistant is included for any leads generated as a result of this package.
Why is Blast awesome?
Cost
Blast is one of our lowest-cost lead generation options. This gives you, our users, an affordable way to find new business opportunities.
Availability
Previously, you needed a specific listing to create a Facebook ad. With Blast, you can generate an ad using a zip code you would like to target. This opens up availability to anyone, regardless of whether you have a listing. It also allows you to target specific areas you may specialize in, or want to specialize in.
Service Type
Availability
Notes
Digital Zip Code Ads
Only available in the U.S.
Target Zip or postal codes for digital ads via the Lofty Blast platform
Start a Campaign
To start a Campaign, go to
Marketing
> Lofty Blast > Zip Code Blast
.
Zip Code Blasts are a
monthly recurring
subscription. Adjust the pricing through
Market Share
. Market Share controls how much of the available audience in a Zip Code your ads are shown to on Facebook. After the purchase charges successfully, a window will appear where you can customize the settings that apply to the leads captured by the ads and create recurring Ad campaigns.
IMPORTANT!
If you do not fill out these settings, we will use the default values. If this window is closed without being completed, you cannot go back and edit them.
Cancellation
To cancel your Zip Code Blast, navigate to
Marketing > Lofty Blast > Zip Code Blast
and find the campaign that you want to cancel. Click the
[...]
icon and select
Cancel
.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

### Section: Listing Alert

### Section: Listing Discovery (Web & App)

#### Article 240: All Listings & Hot Sheets

- Article ID: `360002361751`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Listing Discovery (Web & App)`
- Updated: `2025-11-10T01:20:25Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002361751-All-Listings-Hot-Sheets

Introduction
If you have a Lofty IDX Website (and the website is active), you can enter
Listing Discovery
by clicking the icon next to the CMS Tool (website editor). The red dot on the icon means there are new listings today. We have also made a number of changes that improve the way Listing Discovery works for you, through
Smart Listings (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4410497918107)
.
Summary
All Listings (#h_01EKWWJ5KHXVGQF769V3VEXWN9)
Send to Leads (#h_01EKWWJHW57TCCG5DGCFQ2Q25X)
Hot Sheets (#h_01EKWWJPWYYGBW31WF2028T9S6)
Adding a Hot Sheet (#h_01EKWWK05XMH36E6N1B9DKRYNP)
Default Hot Sheets (#h_01EKWWK484RQXDQVSS7N4VW7NH)
Manage Hot Sheets (#h_01EKWWK94481HK4Z7SP5RYG2F5)
FAQ (#h_01EKWXQCQ8VT0S7WV2B5NMNKM2)
Is there a way to reduce the total number of listings that show up on the Listings Discovery page? (#h_01EKWXQGVG79K7PAMN4HVREP8R)
All Listings
Lofty has integrated all of your MLS databases into the
Listing Discovery
section. Users can view all MLS listings and search for any listings from the MLS:
The first column shows the address, image, bedrooms/bathrooms, type, and square footage. Clicking on the address will take you to your Lofty IDX website and the listing page for that specific property.
The next column shows the "List Price". If the price has increased or decreased, it will be represented with an up/down arrow. The MLS info will show the status of the listing (pending, active, etc.) and, when clicked will display additional details available from the MLS.
Buyer Matching
"Buyer Matching" is one of the most useful columns on Listing Discovery. Based on basic search criteria (beds, baths, price range, etc.) that have been saved by leads registered in your database, leads will be matched with listings showing up on Listing Discovery. In other words, the leads found in "Buyer Matching" are those that would be a good fit for that property based on the search criteria in their lead profile.
Depending on your permissions, these leads can include leads in the Lead Pond or those assigned to your team.
When "View Matched Leads(#)" is clicked, the matched leads will display. Hovering over the "Matching Inquiries" will show which factors have matched the leads for them to show up in this category. You can use this section to send the listing directly to the leads that match.
The "Action" column has the option to send the listing directly to leads (in individual conversations) as represented by the first icon. An option is also available to add a text code for that listing (reference
Text Codes for Lead Capture (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360018862672)
). The final option is for sharing directly on Facebook, Twitter, or LinkedIn.
Send to Leads
You can click
Send to Leads
to send a particular listing to the leads of your choice. Choose the listing that you want to send, and click
Send to Lead.
A popup will appear where you can search for the lead(s) to whom you want to send the listing. You can search for leads with Basic Search (by name, email, or phone), Address Search (by city, county, or zip code), or use Advanced Filters such as Segment, Pipeline, Tag, Price, etc. Once the search results are displayed, select the lead(s) that you want to receive the listing by clicking the checkbox, then click
Email
or
Text
to select how you would like to send the listings.
The listings will be displayed in the email editor in the next step. From here, you can also edit your email subject and email content. After editing your email content, you can preview and click
Send
.
The "Listing Agent" column shows the listing agent for that property. Some MLSs do not provide Lofty with this information. However, when available, users will no longer have to go to the MLS to find contact details for a listing that is on the MLS that they need to set up a tour for, make an offer, etc. If you have a call/text package, you can also trigger a call or a text to be made directly from the available options.
If the Listing Agent's email address is available in Lofty, the Lofty user can send them an email directly through Lofty but this will only work if the Lofty user has their email integrated (Gmail, Exchange, etc.). Clicking on the "email" icon will open up a new email that looks like this:
Finally, the "View" column will show the leads from your CRM database who have (a) viewed, (b) saved, (c) sent a message, or (d) requested a showing on this specific listing. Currently, these fields are
not
clickable. The "Updated Time" column shows the last time the listing details were updated.
Hot Sheets
You can easily filter using desired search criteria and then save it as a hot sheet. This is intended to be a convenient way for you to access the same set of criteria in the future. You can have up to 100 total hot sheets.
*Currently, there is
no
option to share hot sheets with other users on your team.
Adding a Hot Sheet
To add Hot Sheets after narrowing down the results with the option to filter, you can directly save them as a new Hot Sheet by clicking on the disc icon to SAVE Sheet or clicking the button on the left panel to add a sheet. Then, provide a unique name for the new Hot Sheet in the “
CUSTOMIZE HOT SHEET
” pop-up window. You can also choose to delete certain criteria from this pop-up window.
Updating Existing Hot Sheet
If you do not check the box “
Save as New Hot Sheet
”, the change you made to the existing Hot Sheet will replace the previous settings, including the name.
Saving as New Hot Sheet
If you check the box “
Save as New Hot Sheet
”, a separate Hot Sheet with the new name and settings will be created.
Default Hot Sheets
In Listing Discovery, three types of recommended hot sheets are provided by default:
New Listings
: These listings are new to the market and on your site
Price Reduced
: The prices of these listings have been reduced recently
Back on Market
: The status of these listings became “Back on Market” recently. Please note that many MLSs do not provide us with this status in their data--meaning that this may not populate any results.
Manage Hot Sheets
You can edit your hot sheets and manage their order by clicking on the Settings cog-wheel icon to the right of the HOT SHEETS title. From here, you can drag and drop to reorder, edit, and delete.
*The top three Hot Sheets will display on your Dashboard page (see
My Vs. Team Dashboards (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360043278391)
).
FAQ
Is there a way to reduce the total number of listings that show up on the
Listings Discovery
page?
No, there is no way to reduce the total number of listings showing here. This is fed in from all of the MLSs that you have connected to your Team Website. This is the total number of listings in the MLSs for your review. If your MLS connection provides data that is too extensive, consider creating Hot Sheets (see the applicable topic in this article) for specific areas, etc.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 241: REBNY Listing Management Partner

- Article ID: `25385036912411`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Listing Discovery (Web & App)`
- Updated: `2025-11-17T07:00:01Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/25385036912411-REBNY-Listing-Management-Partner

Introduction
The Real Estate Board of New York (REBNY) has added Lofty as a Listing Management Partner (LMP). This feature allows REBNY members to upload a manual listing from Lofty to the MLS.
This is a whitelisted feature. If you are a member of REBNY MLS and would like access, please reach out to
support@lofty.com (mailto:support@lofty.com)
.
In order to access this feature, you must follow these steps:
You must be a member of REBNY MLS. This feature is not available to any other MLSs.
You must request access to this feature by reaching out to Lofty support.
You must sign an agreement with REBNY to switch your LMP to Lofty.
Instructions
To get started, navigate to
Listings
and click
+ Add
Manual Listing
. Learn more about manual listings here:
Manual Listings (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/6586244604699)
Step 1: Basic Information
The first step is to provide the listing address. You have the option to select the Entire Building for the listing. If Entire Building a toggled off, there is a field for the Unit number.
Step 2: Listing Information
The next step is to add the listing information:
Basics:
Listing Type
Listing Status
Active
Coming Soon
Property Type
Agents:
Up to four (4) listing agents may be added
Step 3: More Information
This section contains the detailed information about the property, as well as listing photos:
Building Info
Borough
Neighborhood
Number of Units
Built Year
Unit Info
Ownership Type
Floor of Unit
Bedrooms
Bathrooms
Total Rooms
Sq Ft
Unit Exposure
Unit Condition
Unit View
Sale Info
Listing Price
This includes a toggle for Non-Disclosure
Date Available
CC/Maintenance
RE Taxes
Taxes
Financing
Co-broker Agreement
Exclusive Type
Commission Type
Buyer's Broker Commission
Features
Pet Policy
Apartment Amenities
Building Amenities
Detailed Description
Open House
Option to add Open House information, as well as select 'Broker Only' or 'Appointment Only'
Access Info
Broker Viewing Instructions
First Showing Date
Media
Photos
Video
Virtual Tour link
Syndication:
This is where this listing will be populated. The listing can be added to RLS IDX, RLS Vow, your Lofty built website, or just to the CRM. Multiple options can be selected.
The final step is to click
Launch
. This will publish the listing in the locations selected in the Syndication step.
Coming Soon Listing Upload Rules
Maximum Duration:
Listings may remain in
Coming Soon
for up to
14 calendar days
from submission.
Listings exceeding 14 days in this status are marked
non-compliant
.
Showing Start Date Requirement:
Must be set
within 14 days
of the submission date when uploading the listing.
After the Showing Start Date passes, if the listing remains
Coming Soon
, the system automatically changes its status to
Temporary Off Market (TOM)
.
After Auto-Transition to TOM:
You can edit and
resubmit the listing as Active
when ready for public display.
Remember:
This is a whitelisted feature. If you are a member of REBNY MLS and would like access, please reach out to
support@lofty.com (mailto:support@lofty.com)
.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

### Section: Lofty Present: CMA and Listing Presentation

#### Article 242: How to Create a CMA and Listing Presentation

- Article ID: `26265328610075`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Lofty Present: CMA and Listing Presentation`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T01:21:19Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/26265328610075-How-to-Create-a-CMA-and-Listing-Presentation

Introduction
A Comparative Market Analysis is a tool that is used by real estate agents to get seller business. This is done by providing a report, called a CMA or Listing Presentation, that includes an estimate of the value of a specific property based on comparable listings that have sold, are pending, or are still active on the market. Lofty Present allows agents to use basic search filters in Lofty to find comparable listings and then revise the results using their expertise in their specific real estate market.
Learn how to purchase the Listing Presentation Add-On Here:
How to Purchase the Lofty Present Add-On (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408440387099)
Summary
Introduction to Lofty Present (#h_01J924WF5BZBJGA12F9DA0YB4M)
Create a New Report (#h_01FJCSK16HADKKJHWQFZSPYV23)
Create a CMA (#h_01J924WF5BT0TSRFW74YFPT8ND)
Create a Listing Presentation (#01J9263B0E0SHJGMZN7NV7E19S)
Editing and Deleting a Report (#h_01HZFMFG6TM1HWZ8QYY0G0PDN1)
CMA Identity Verification (#h_01HZFMMVVHJT2WD2E15GFHH9KS)
Introduction to Lofty Present
Lofty Present includes two (2) types of reports that can be created to gain the confidence of your potential clients.
Comparative Market Analysis (CMA)
Free for all Lofty users to create unlimited CMAs
Two (2) CMA options:
Seller CMA
Buyer CMA
Limited customization:
Subject property address
Comparable listings
Estimated costs associated with buying/selling the subject property
Final report that can be emailed or texted to a lead
Listing Presentation
Unlimited Listing Presentations available for $19.99/month
Six (6) default templates and the option to create your templates:
Four (4) Seller presentation templates
One (1) Buyer presentation template
One (1) Agent presentation template
Full Customization:
Subject property address
Comparable listings
Estimated costs associated with buying/selling the subject property
Ability to add, remove, or rearrange the report pages
Final report that can be emailed or texted to a lead or downloaded as a PDF
Create a New Report
Navigate to
Marketing > Tools > Lofty Present
to get started.
We offer two (2) types of presentations:
CMA (Comparative Market Analysis)
Listing Presentation
The primary differences are described above, but basically, the CMA is free for all Lofty users, but is a limited experience. Listing Presentations offer further customizations and create a downloadable PDF, but cost $19.99/month. For both, there is no limit to the number of reports you can create.
Create a CMA
First, let's create a CMA report. Click
CMA
and select the type:
Seller
or
Buyer
.
Whether you are creating a Buyer or Seller CMA, the first step is to select the lead the CMA is being created for and give the CMA report a name. This name will help you find the report easily.
Next, choose the subject property. This property will be used to generate the other data for the report. The fields that are required to create the CMA report will have an
*
.
Featured Image
.
This can be an image of the property or a generic image, depending on what you would like to present.
Address*
. This is the address for the property that is being compared to others to determine an initial selling price.
Location
Point*
. This will auto-generate with the address, but you can use the button on the right to adjust if needed. This will be important in finding nearby listings later.
Property
Type*
Beds
Baths
Living Area
Additional Info
Lot Size
Style
Year Built
Annual Taxes
Note: Due to browser settings in Chrome, some Canadian Lofty users may have issues inputting correct street addresses due to postal codes. Please check this article for more information:
Post Codes Browser Settings - Canadian Users (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/5603805572763)
Click
Continue
to select comparable listings. Apply filters, adjust the radius, or draw a polygon to find listings for the report. These listings should be similar to your subject listing, so the report can provide accurate estimates.
Note: You can only add a
maximum of 30 listings
to be compared to the subject property.
The
Estimate
section provides an estimate of the listing price for the subject property and includes estimated costs of buying or selling this property. These fields are editable. You can also add a custom field if relevant data is not included in the template.
Scroll down to adjust the included comparable listings. Click
Continue
to view the final report.
The final report can be emailed or texted to a lead. This will direct the lead to a landing page created for this report. The CMA does not create a downloadable PDF.
Create a Listing Presentation
Next, we'll create a Listing Presentation. The process is nearly identical to creating a CMA, however, you do have a few more options and customization opportunities. First, click
Listing Presentation
, then select a template or create a new template. Learn more about Listing Presentation Templates here:
How to Create a CMA Template (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/26788172210971)
Regardless of the template selected, the process for creating the Listing Presentation is the same. There are some differences in the customizations within the templates, so please check each template out to find the one you want to use.
After you've selected your template, the first section is to provide the Lead's name, name the report, and select the subject property - this is the same as the CMA report. What is different is that you can see that you have the option to customize the report as well as create a
Quick Presentation.
The quick presentation option fast-tracks the Listing Presentation creation process to select comparable listings for you, set the pricing estimates, and automatically generate the report for you.
To set up the report manually, click
Continue
to select the comparable listings yourself.
Apply filters, adjust the radius, or draw a polygon to find listings for the report. These listings should be similar to your subject listing, so the report can provide accurate estimates.  Check the box next to the property to include it on your report.
Note: You can only add a
maximum of 30 listings
to be compared to the subject property.
Once you are satisfied with the comparable listings, click
Continue
to set up the pricing estimates.
The
Estimate
section provides an estimate of the listing price for the subject property and includes estimated costs of buying or selling this property. These fields are editable. You can also add a custom field if the relevant data is not included in the template.
Click
Continue
to customize the Listing Presentation.
The Customize section is similar to the Lofty website editor. Use the Move icon to reorganize the page order. The
+
icon allows you to add a page. The edit icon allows you to edit the section. The trash can icon will delete the section.
Here, you can adjust how the final report will look. It will already have your specific branding from your Lofty profile. The Listing Presentation can be viewed on desktop, mobile, and PDF. Select each option to view the report in each format.
Once the report is done, click
Continue
to email or text the report directly to the lead or download the PDF. The report can be adjusted and edited anytime.
Agent Presentation
We offer an agent presentation template for Listing Presentations. This report is not lead or property specific.
There are only two (2) sections: Customize and Presentation. The Customized section is edited similarly to the Lofty website and already has your branding from your Lofty profile.
When the report is complete, send the link or download the pdf to anyone you want to present yourself to.
CMAs and Listing Presentations can also be created from the following locations:
Lead detail page
Listing Discovery Page
Editing and Deleting a Report
You can
Edit
,
View
,
Download
, or
Delete
any reports that you have created via
Marketing > Lofty Present
When an edit is made to the following pages, that edit will be saved for the next time that page is utilized in a new report built in the future. Those changes will
not
affect previous reports created or their content.
Title Page
About Company
Agent Resume
Marketing Action Plan
Testimonials
Identity Verification
Identity verification is designed to prevent reports from generating false positives for views. That is, the lead never actually looked at the report, but the notifications were triggering, and timeline logs were being documented incorrectly. Our system will recognize the Lofty user's log-in cookies via the browser, so that when CMA reports are viewed, it will not trigger as a notification event even when logged in as a lead.
If a lead is logged into a Lofty-built IDX website and clicks on a CMA link intended for someone else, they will see a pop-up message informing them that the link is private and they do not have access to view it.
FAQ
Q: Which source does Lofty use for the CMA?
A: Lofty’s provider for CMA (Comparative Market Analysis) data is primarily the MLS (Multiple Listing Service) databases.
Questions
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 243: How to Create a Listing Presentation Template

- Article ID: `26788172210971`

Introduction
A Comparative Market Analysis is a tool that is used by real estate agents to get seller business. This is done by providing a report, called a CMA or Listing Presentation, that includes an estimate of the value of a specific property based on comparable listings that have sold, are pending, or are still active on the market. .

Template Basics (#h_01J0XSE7BQMRYSSCTT7A1JMT8M)

Template Basics
Navigate to
Marketing >
Lofty Present
and select
Listing Presentation

+ New Template
to create a Listing Presentation template. The template options are Seller, Buyer, and Agent Presentation.
My Templates
My Templates are Listing Presentation templates that only you can see. These are only available if you have purchased Lofty Present Personal.
Shared Templates
Shared Templates are Listing Presentation templates that everyone on your Lofty Present Team can see and use. The shared templates can only be edited by the template creator.

...
icon.

#### Article 244: How to Purchase the Lofty Present Add On

- Article ID: `4408440387099`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Lofty Present: CMA and Listing Presentation`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T01:21:43Z`

Introduction
A Comparative Market Analysis is a tool that real estate agents use to get buyers and sellers to do business. This is done by providing a report, called CMA or Listing Presentation, that includes an estimate of the value of a specific property based on comparable listings that have sold, are pending, or are still active on the market.
We have two (2) types of reports that can be created using the Lofty Present Tool:
The
CMA
is a simplified report with just the fundamental listing comparison information. All Lofty users can create an unlimited number of CMA
reports.
The
Listing Presentation
is a fully customizable CMA report, which contains not only the Listing comparison data but also a deep analysis and other customizable content.
Learn how to create a CMA/Listing Presentation here:
How to Create a CMA and Listing Presentation (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/26265328610075)
Summary
Purchasing the Lofty Present Add-On (#h_01FJCSEKV99HYTFR6T960N0FY3)
Lofty Present Team (#h_01JB2K1Q76A7GVA9ZG6CKR8QC2)
Lofty Present Personal (#h_01JB2K47NWPK2YMK24THT9BGRP)
Cancelling the CMA Tool (#h_01HZJPZEHMXR2ZMTHXPBSH8AZD)
FAQ (#h_01HB8Z6QPR0JTXG57J34DW1T76)
Purchasing the Listing Presentation Add-On
Lofty Present includes both the free CMA tool as well as the paid add-on Listing Presentation feature. Lofty Present costs $19.99 per month, pro-rated based on the day of the month purchased and can be purchased in the Lofty Marketplace or via the Marketing page.
Once purchased, you will immediately have access to unlimited Listing Presentations. Learn how to create a Listing Presentation here:
How to Create a CMA and Listing Presentation (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/26265328610075)
There are two (2) Lofty Present options - Team and Personal.
Lofty Present Team
If you are an account or office owner, you will have the option to purchase Lofty Present Team. This version allows you to create Listing Presentation templates for your team members to use and see the reports that your team members are creating. It costs $19.99 per month for each user you invite to your Lofty Present Team.
Account or Office owners can remove members from their Team Space.
Steps to Remove Members:
Add the "Manage" entry to the right list.
Select the members you wish to remove by clicking on their names.
Confirm the removal after selecting the members.
Once confirmed, the selected members will be removed from the team space.
The license will be released.
The existing listing presentation can no longer be edited.
Lofty Present Personal
All Lofty users have the opportunity to purchase Lofty Present Personal. Lofty Present Personal also costs $19.99 per month and allows you to create your Listing Presentation templates and create unlimited listing presentations in your personal space.
Cancelling the Lofty Present
If you would like to cancel this add-on, please reach out to support@lofty.com.
FAQ
Is there a limit to the number of CMAs I can create?
No. All Lofty users can create unlimited CMA reports. Lofty Present allows you to create unlimited Listing Presentations.
Questions?

### Section: LoftyWorks - Property Management

#### Article 245: Sunsetting of LoftyWorks (Property Management Add-On)

- Article ID: `41690402776859`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `LoftyWorks - Property Management`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T01:16:24Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/41690402776859-Sunsetting-of-LoftyWorks-Property-Management-Add-On

Introduction
We’ve made the decision to retire the current version of LoftyWorks, our property management add-on for Lofty users. This change allows us to focus on delivering the best possible experience across our core products and future innovations.
The LoftyWorks Add-On will be sunset by the end of October 2025--meaning that on November 1, 2025 you will no longer have access to this add-on.
What is LoftyWorks?
LoftyWorks is a property management add-on built by Lofty for Lofty users that manage buyers, sellers, AND renters as property managers.
If you purchased this add-on, you would see this entrance in your top-right menu. This entrance will be removed as part of this sunsetting.
Why is the LoftyWorks add-on being retired?
From time to time, we review our products to ensure they meet the needs of our customers and align with our long-term vision. When an add-on no longer fits our strategic roadmap, we may choose to sunset it so we can dedicate resources to building better solutions for you that matter.
What does this mean for you?
LoftyWorks will no longer be available after October 2025.
LoftyWorks is no longer available for purchase as an add-on.
Your Lofty account and other features remain unaffected.
Can I export my data from the LoftyWorks add-on?
You can export properties, contracts, and contacts by navigating (in LoftyWorks) to
Settings
>
Import / Export
>
Export
.
What’s next?
While we can’t share specific details yet, we’re working to bring an even stronger property management experience back in the future. Stay tuned for updates!
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please email our Support Team at support@lofty.com, call 1 (855) 981-7557, or chat with us through your CRM.

Manual Listings (formerly known as pocket listings) can be added from the website or by accessing the
Listing Management
page and clicking
+ Add Manual Listing
:
The first step is to fill in the geographic location by searching by address. The latitude/longitude can always be manually edited if needed.
Next, add the listing information
Listing Status
Purchase Type
Listing Date
Listing Price
Listing Agent
*NOTE: This requires an agent from the CRM to be selected as the listing agent for this property.
If lead routing is configured to do so, leads captured via this manual listing will be assigned to this agent
Listing Office
*NOTE: This will automatically sync the CRM company information by default
Display Listing On. . .
(1) My Website
(2) My Team/Group's Websites
If part of a Lofty Enterprise package, this manual listing will only be added to websites within your hierarchy group.
(3) No Websites
In step three, add any images, videos, or virtual tour media.
In the final and fourth step, add property details. The fields for this selection will depend on the MLS(s) you have connected to your website.
Remove a Manual Listing
To remove a Manual Listing, click on the Manage Listing button on the Listing page.
On the Smart Listing Page, click the Action button and select 'Delete Manual Listing' to remove it from the site and the CRM.

#### Article 249: Supercharging Real Estate Advertising: Boosting Lead Quality with Facebook's Conversion API and Google's OCI

- Article ID: `16224414374811`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Marketing Tools`
- Updated: `2025-11-10T01:23:06Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/16224414374811-Supercharging-Real-Estate-Advertising-Boosting-Lead-Quality-with-Facebook-s-Conversion-API-and-Google-s-OCI

Introduction
As an advertising agency that caters to real estate agents, we are continuously seeking ways to improve our services and deliver higher-quality leads to our clients. One of the most recent and effective tools we have implemented is Facebook's Conversion API, which offers significant advantages over traditional pixel-based tracking.
In this article, we will explain what the Conversion API is and share some exciting results from our recent tests which demonstrate how using this tool has improved lead quality for our clients in the real estate industry.
Summary
What is the Facebook Conversion API? (#h_01H2GD1C7ZR8ZGYE186R9TT7F4)
Impressive Results: How the Conversion API Significantly Elevates Lead Quality (#h_01H2GD1K4MTQ0H684PYXXR3K9E)
Implementing Google OCI for Enhanced PPC Lead Quality (#h_01H2GD1TV82QBNN2T5GVQTASWX)
What is the Facebook Conversion API?
The Conversion API is a utility offered by Facebook that enables advertisers to send web and offline events directly to Facebook's server, bypassing the need for browser cookies or pixel tracking. This not only allows for more accurate tracking and measurement of ad performance but also opens up the possibility of personalizing ad experiences based on user behavior.
Impressive Results: How the Conversion API Significantly Elevates Lead Quality
To assess the effectiveness of the Conversion API, we conducted a controlled study in which we compared the engagement and purchase intent of leads generated using our conversion API-based campaigns to those without the Conversion API.
The leads were scored based on the quality of interactions in our AI-driven communication system. We classified the lead tags as "Good Tags" (indicating a strong interest in buying or selling property) and "Bad Tags" (indicating a lack of interest).
Our findings revealed that real estate advertisements using the Conversion API resulted in:
A substantial increase in high-quality leads, with a 47% higher Good Tag rate (16.6%) for leads generated from ads with the Conversion API as compared to ads without the Conversion API (11.3%).
A significantly higher email open rate of 23.2% for leads generated from ads with the Conversion API, as opposed to a 13.3% email open rate for leads generated from ads without the Conversion API.
Based on these compelling results, we are confident in the value of the Facebook Conversion API as a powerful tool for enhancing lead quality in the real estate advertising landscape. By implementing this advanced utility, we are not only better equipped to serve our clients but also able to help them achieve greater success in an increasingly competitive market.
Implementing Google OCI for Enhanced PPC Lead Quality
As part of our ongoing commitment to providing our clients with the best possible results, we are excited to announce that we will soon begin implementing Google's Offline Conversion Import (OCI) to further enhance the quality of leads generated through our Google Pay-Per-Click (PPC) campaigns.
Similar to Facebook's Conversion API, Google OCI enables advertisers to import offline conversions and provide feedback on lead quality based on each client's unique pipeline criteria. By utilizing this feature, we will be able to tailor our PPC campaigns better to cater to specific client needs, optimize our marketing strategies, and ultimately deliver even higher-quality leads to our real estate clients.
Stay tuned for updates on our progress and future success stories as we leverage the best available technologies to help our clients succeed in the ever-evolving world of real estate advertising.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

### Section: Mass Emails & Texts

#### Article 250: Send Mass Emails & Texts

- Article ID: `360054872312`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Mass Emails & Texts`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T07:03:24Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360054872312-Send-Mass-Emails-Texts

Introduction
One of many reasons you likely use the Lofty CRM is to maintain contact with your database. Utilize the mass emails and texts in Lofty to do so.
Summary
Limitations (#h_01F523472ECW7ECT395FC04F3R)
Mass Email Limitations (#h_01F5234AWAGT49NPEART9K99B4)
Mass Text Limitations (#h_01F5234ERHWN1SRZMHJBPS8V83)
Mass Emails (#h_01F5234PBD1ZM2CXGRD6WW17TX)
Mass Texts (#h_01F5234SZVJP84DAKRKWB28RAP)
Smart Plans (#h_01F5234WYXZ8YK01T4T5G311B1)
Limitations
There are a few limitations to be aware of when sending out mass emails and texts. These are all outlined below.
Mass Email Limitations
Leads Without Email Addresses
This is an obvious one, but the system will make you aware of how many leads do not have valid email addresses to send emails to. "Valid" is a keyword here, as any invalid emails that have been marked as such will not be available to send emails to with the mass email action.
Unsubscribed Leads
You will be unable to email leads who have unsubscribed from receiving emails from you.
Maximum Number of Email Recipients
You can only send a mass email to up to 5,000 leads at one time.
Please note, f
or all packages with a monthly email limit, it costs $1 for 5,000 additional emails.
Mass Text Limitations
Leads Without Valid Phone Numbers
The system will make you aware of how many leads do not have valid phone numbers to send text messages. "Valid" is a keyword here as any invalid phone numbers that have been marked as such will not be available to send texts to with the mass text action.
Maximum Number of Text Recipients
Special upper limit, a maximum of
500 leads
can be processed at a time
. If you select more than that many leads (with valid phone numbers), you will see a warning that says "You can only Mass Text 500 leads at a time"
Mass Emails
*Note: Mass emails are sent from your @lofty.com email address. Learn more
HERE (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402367904397-Sending-Email-Address#EmailSendingAddress-ChimeEmails)
.
To send a mass email, navigate to the
People
page, select the leads that you would like to email, and then click on the
Mass Email
button:
After choosing the Mass Email option, you can edit the email before sending it. It will be sent as an individual conversation to every lead,
not
a mass email with everyone copied. You will want to take advantage of any templates that you have pre-built, as well as variables that can be used to reference a specific lead's name, etc. Learn more about variables
HERE (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055270071)
.
If you have family members associated with a lead and would like to copy (CC) them on an email that you are sending out via the Mass Email function, you can do so by clicking on the CC all family members checkbox. Those family members will be added to the email sent to that lead.
To edit a mass email, click the bell icon in the upper right-hand of your CRM.
Click the mass action that requires editing from your Notifications list.
Click the pencil icon to make the changes.
Mass Texts
To send a mass text to your leads, simply navigate to the
People
page, select the leads you would like to mass-text, and then click the
Mass Text
button.
The mass text message will be sent as
individual conversations
, not one group text. You will also want to take advantage of any
text templates (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402878822285)
you have created as well as
variables (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055270071)
that can make the message more personal.
*Important note*
Sending the same content to many leads’ phone numbers at the same time may reduce the delivery rate of SMS and cause your virtual number to be blocked by your leads' carrier. We have added a timestamp at the end of each message to avoid getting the same content and avoid any issues with their carrier.
Smart Plans
Another important tool is
Smart Plans (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/7626737520923)
. Smart Plans are used to automatically send out content.
For example, you can set up a Smart Plan and then adjust the Application Conditions to target the specific leads that you want to send a mass email or text message. The Smart Plan will send the message automatically, so you don't have to worry about it. Learn more about Smart Plans here:
Smart Plans FAQs (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419016941083)
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
