### Section: My/Team Listings

#### Article 251: Buyer Agent Compensation

- Article ID: `26785469679387`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `My/Team Listings`
- Updated: `2025-11-10T01:17:53Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/26785469679387-Buyer-Agent-Compensation

Introduction
The buyer's agent fee is the commission fee that the real estate brokerage that represents the buyer is paid as compensation for completing the transaction. Historically, the buyer's agent fee was paid by the seller, however this is changing due to the NAR settlement.
Note:
Some MLSs do not allow you to add this information to a listing. When the Buyer Compensation field is added, it will be visible on your IDX website. This information will not be added to other websites or to the MLS, it will only be visible on IDX websites on your Lofty account. This field will be removed if the listing is sold. Please be aware of your MLS requirements.
Summary
Add Buyer Agent Compensation (#h_01J0XQ362T3861CT12HYQZ92K2)
Compensation Label (#h_01J0XQ9HVMGYPXD89VCQDKQ5B6)
Compensation Amount (#h_01J0XQB2F68SG81S06W5T5TSKW)
Compensation Visibility (#h_01J0XQEXHVHGPXFJVPGB96JTVG)
Add Buyer Agent Compensation
The Buyer's Agent Compensation field can only be added to My Listings or Team Listings. To add to one of your listings, navigate to the Smart Listing page and select
Add Buyer Compensation
from the Actions menu.
To add to one of your Team Listings, navigate to the Listing Discovery page and add via the
...
menu.
After selecting Add Buyer Compensation, the information is added in a pop-up box:
Compensation Label
The Compensation Label is the field label that is shown on the listing page on your IDX website. By default, the field is called "Buyer Agency Compensation".
You can only edit this label if you have the Manage Website permission enabled on your Lofty account.
Compensation Amount
The Compensation Amount is the buyer agent compensation amount that will be displayed on the listing page on all of the IDX websites on your Lofty account. You can add this field to any of your own listings.
If you have the Manage Website permission enabled, you can add this field to your Team Listings.
Compensation Visibility
Once a listing is marked as Sold, the Buyer Agent Compensation field will be removed from the listing detail page.
The Buyer Agent Compensation field is only being added to your Lofty account websites. This data is not being added to the MLS or any other website.
This field can only be added to your own listings or your team's listings. You cannot add this field to listings that do not belong to you or your team.
Comparative Market Analysis
The buyer's agent compensation can also be added to a CMA report. This is a great way to share this information with a lead, without displaying it on your website.
There is also a block available that can be used to explain why the buyer's agent commission is important.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Menu Order
"My Listings" and "Team Listings" are located at the top of the Listing Page
My Listings Improvement
The "My Listings" page has a Smart Listing design. Once you log in under
Listing Discovery
>
My Listings
, you will see listing cards for all your
active
listings. Sold listings will be supported in the future. If these listing cards do not appear automatically, could you add your MLS Agent ID first?
Each "Listing Card" has
s
even icons
and each corresponds to a marketing tool. These icons will be highlighted in blue when you have taken a corresponding action as the user.
Listing Promotion Ad
Listing Video
Social Studio
Design Center
Promotion Landing Page
Open House Form
Text Code
The listing card also has four icons representing the following:
Listing Views
. The view times for this listing are based on the default listing detail page
and
landing pages

Showings
. Leads who have requested a showing for this property.
Buyer Match

Once you click the listing card, you are taken to the "Listing Overview" page which provides you with some key information on the property.
*Note: "Listing Views" data will not be available for listings that were live before November 16, 2021.
The
$
icon next to the address can be clicked to either access a transaction that is already tied to the listing or create a transaction if one does not already exist:
In the top-right, you can take specific actions for this listing. If it is a manual listing (formerly known as pocket listing), you will also be able to edit or delete it from this menu.
The "Top Buyer Matches" section on the right side shows matched leads. The top four leads will be displayed based on their most recent engagement time with this listing. The button to "View all __ matches" will show all leads whose basic search criteria match this listing.

The listing status pipeline is synced with the MLS data but you
do

#### Article 254: Add an additional email address to receive new lead alerts

- Article ID: `360013184692`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Notification`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T06:53:22Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360013184692-Add-an-additional-email-address-to-receive-new-lead-alerts

This feature allows the account to have multiple email addresses to receive new lead alerts. In case the account owner is not available, an admin or assistant can help distribute and track all incoming leads for their account.
To add an email address to receive Lofty’s new lead alert, please follow the steps below:
Log in to your Lofty CRM account.
Navigate to Settings > My User Settings> Notifications > General.
Find the option for "Additional emails".
Click on "Add Additional Email".
Type in the additional email address.
Upon confirmation, you will have successfully added an email address to receive new lead alerts from Lofty.
If you want to add more email addresses, repeat the same steps.
If you wish to remove an email address from this list, you can do so by following these steps:
Move the cursor to the end of the email address that you wish to delete.
Click the "
" to delete.
A pop-up will appear asking for confirmation. Click "Yes".
The email will be deleted.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.

#### Article 255: Dashboard Announcement Board

- Article ID: `360046736752`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Notification`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T06:53:12Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360046736752-Dashboard-Announcement-Board

Introduction
There is a dedicated section on the Lofty Dashboard that can be used by team admins to communicate important announcements to their teams. The Dashboard is the first page that is seen when you log into Lofty, or when you click the Lofty icon. Announcements share a card with New Updates.
*IMPORTANT
:
Only those who are Owners/Admins or have the "User Management" permission enabled (see
Permissions (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4407530443291)
) are able to
add
new announcements. All other team members can
view
the announcements.
Only 10 announcements can be on the board at once. If an additional announcement needs to be added and the limit has been reached, an existing one will have to be removed first.
Add / Edit / Delete an Announcement
To add a new, edit, or delete an announcement, click on the "Edit" icon.
To delete an existing announcement, find the right one and then click the "x" in the top-right of that section.
To edit an announcement, find the right one and then adjust the content as necessary.
To add a new announcement, click on the "+ Add Another Announcement" button.
If you have more than one announcement, click on the "up" or "down" arrows on each of them to change the order in which they appear.
After doing any of the above actions, be sure to click on the blue "Save" button for the changes to be reflected on the Dashboard:
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

- Article ID: `360016101752`

Introduction
An important part of any productivity tool is notifications. This is especially the case in the real estate world, knowing that timing is everything. Lofty's goal is to enable its users to act quickly regarding important aspects of the system. This is done via notifications that are outlined in this article.
Summary
Editing Notification Settings (#h_01FD6HK23RDQCKE53D94WXNFW8)
Notification Samples (#h_01FD6HK6Q1PB1V2JY687H1FK76)
General Notifications (#h_01HBXY4DC9N6DC9DKJ4NFS6KM9)
Email Notifications (#h_99cb4d60-6b4c-4664-a407-3eeda083368a)
Text Notifications (#h_13756cb2-39b2-4df5-b854-a4bebb465e9a)
Editing Notification Settings
To edit your notification preferences, navigate to
Personal Settings
>
Notifications
.
On this page, you can toggle on/off any notifications that you would like, as well as choose the notification methods that you would prefer (email/text/push).
*Please note that some notifications are
not
available via text.
To edit from the mobile app, do the following. This is on Android, but Apple will be very similar.
*Please keep in mind that your notifications must be enabled for the Lofty CRM app in your mobile settings. Learn more:
How To Setup Lofty Notifications on Your Mobile Phone (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/search/click?data=BAh7DjoHaWRsKwgXV5%%3D%3D--9b2a3fbaddf44d132ce75658b62234df7838462b)
Notification Samples
Push Notifications (Web and App)
The same notifications will trigger on both the web app and the mobile app. In other words, there will be a push notification both in the web app and the mobile app.
Here are the different push notifications that will trigger:
Notification
Trigger
New Email
There is a new email received at the _____@lofty.com email address or synced from the integrated email account.
Sharing Note
Another agent or lender has @tagged you in a note.
Missed Call
When you have missed a call to your Lofty virtual number.
Lead Import
When your .csv file import or phone contact import is completed
Lead Export
When your .csv lead export is completed
New Lead Alert
When a new lead has entered your CRM from any source except the manual import.
New Lead Alert (Lead Routing Reassigned)
When a lead is assigned to you via a rule in lead routing. Applies to "Next Up" or "Blast Alert"
New Lead Alert (Manually Reassigned)
When someone assigns a lead to you manually.
New Partial Lead Alert
When there is a new partial lead generated via your website's Home Evaluation page.
Reassign Partial Lead Alert
When someone assigns a new partial lead to you manually.
Opportunities
When existing leads generate specific actions. Refer to this article for criteria:
Opportunities (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003018292)
.
New Task
When someone creates a new task with you as the assignee.
Task Reminder
Triggered 30 minutes before task start time.
New Appointment
When someone creates a new appointment for you.
Appointment Reminder
Triggered 30 minutes before appointment start time.

When a lead sends you a text message or sends a chat message on the website.
AI Assistant Notification
There are Text and Push notifications related to AI Assistant,
click here (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056783971-AI-Assistant-Chatbot-Qualification-Process#h_2a42acd1-f476-44d5-a9e9-ef43b1b8c391)
to learn more.
There are three notification types in the CRM web view.
General Notifications
You can access this by clicking on the "bell" icon in the top-right when logged into the web CRM.
The notifications will be sorted into the following categories:
Lead
New leads, reassigned leads, and lead import notifications
@Me
Notes that you have been tagged in

Notifications about listing showings
Transaction
Transaction related notifications

Reminders 30 minutes before the task or appointment time
Opportunity Notifications (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003018292)
Actions
The results of a mass action taken on a lead
Listing Promotion
Listing promotion ad recommendations
Unknown Inbound
Calls and text messages received from phone numbers that do not belong to any leads in your CRM.
You can remove notification types from the chat list by swiping left on them in the mobile app and clicking
Mute

Email Notifications
The following are the types of email notifications that are triggered in Lofty:
Notification

Sent to Lofty users every day. Contains a summary of leads, tasks, and lead activities.

When a lead is assigned to you via a rule in lead routing. Applies to "Next Up" or "Blast Alert"
New Lead Alert (Manually Reassigned)
When someone assigns a lead to you manually.

When there is a new partial lead generated via your website's Home Evaluation page.

When someone assigns a new partial lead to you manually.
Showing Request
When a lead submits a showing request on a listing detail page of the IDX website.

When a lead leaves a message in the "Get more information" or "Leave a message" web forms.

When a lead who is logged in already submits a contact form on the Lofty website, an email notification will be sent to the Lofty user.
Sharing Note
Another agent or lender has @tagged you in a note.
The "New Submission" email notification looks like the following:
The "Sharing Note" email notification looks like the following:

#### Article 257: Opportunity Notifications

- Article ID: `115003018292`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Notification`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T06:52:19Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003018292-Opportunity-Notifications

Introduction
Opportunities are notifications that are triggered based on lead activities that Lofty believes to be important to real estate agents. These notifications will allow for leads that match certain behaviors to be prioritized and contacted quickly--thus avoiding missed
opportunities
.
Summary
Opportunity Criteria (#h_01EVYNGV1BZY6NTZNP4BEGG7Y1)
High Interest (#h_01EVYNGZ3ZKNWKGNB34EM8D6WS)
Back To Site (#h_01EVYNH2WG7T57J9NYJWRM8Z34)
Sell (#h_01EVYNH6DQZB73ZNMDXQKY9M5A)
Back On Market (#h_01EVYNH9TAQKN0X8YHDXGSWDGB)
Accessing Opportunities (#h_01EVYNHFSSQGZK7DK0V4F13JR9)
My Dashboard / Team Dashboard (#h_01EVYNHNENR8JDKWMBTTFZW3FF)
Opportunity Push Notifications (#h_01EVYNHSA77SDYZ1V6N196CXFQ)
People Page > Opportunities Filters (#h_01EVYNHX60EARD0XSRQED7CH6R)
Opportunity Criteria
There are four kinds of opportunities: (1) High Interest, (2) Back To Site, (3) Sell, and (4) Back On Market. The following will explain the criteria for these categories:
High Interest
A lead views a listing three or more times
A lead saves a listing on the site
A lead requests a showing (tour request) from a listing page
A lead leaves a message from the fields on the website
A lead saves a search on the website
A lead uses the mortgage calculator 3+ times in one day
A lead submits a form on your website when logged in
Back To Site
A lead who has not returned to the website for at least five days but then visits the website again.
Sell
Leads that intend to sell and request to do so through the "Sell My Home" or "Home Evaluation" options on the website. These must be previous leads in the system and can be a buyer lead type.
Back On Market
Two situations will trigger a Back On Market opportunity notification:
For all third-party sources (excluding FB forms, Ads, and website), including Zillow. Lofty will watch for incoming lead notifications that match an email address already in the CRM database. If it matches an existing lead, it will update the system record for that lead and trigger an opportunity notification. This will only trigger for leads that have been 7+ days in the system to avoid triggering for newer leads in the system. It's worth noting that some information on the lead profiles is updated: the “Phone,” “Search Criteria,” and “Properties” sections of a lead record will update. If auto property alerts are set up, these will update with the new info from “Search Criteria.” We do not overwrite the source of a lead based on the new source if different from the original.
If a lead sends in a text code to the Lofty user's virtual number, this will trigger an update to their lead profile with a note that states "Re-inquired on text code." That lead will receive the automated text code response. For more information regarding text codes, see
Text Codes for Lead Capture (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360018862672)
.
Accessing Opportunities
Opportunities are displayed in three different locations: (1) My Dashboard / Team Dashboard, (2) Opportunity Push Notifications, (3) People Page > Opportunities Filters.
My Dashboard / Company/Office Dashboard
An admin user will have access to "Team Dashboard" and can toggle back and forth between this one and "My Dashboard" which displays summary information only for leads assigned to themselves. The opportunity aspect of this page is just a count of new opportunities for today that, when clicked, will take the user to the People page where these are displayed with the filter of
Today's/Weekly Opportunities
.
Opportunity Push Notifications
These notifications are located on the mobile app as well as on the web app. In the web app, click on the notification bell and select
Opportunity
.
People Page > Opportunities Filters
Another way to search for Opportunities is to use the
Opportunities
filter on the
People
page.
Alternatively, you can select the saved view for "Today's Opportunities" which will show you those who have been triggered today. The criteria they were brought in under will be displayed in the "Lead Score" column.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: Opportunity, back to site, sell my home, back on market, high interest

### Section: Open House Forms

#### Article 258: Open House Forms

- Article ID: `360023770952`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Open House Forms`
- Updated: `2025-12-16T23:07:26Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360023770952-Open-House-Forms

Introduction
The Open House form can be set up on a mobile phone, tablet, or another device that is connected to the internet, to have open house visitors provide their contact information directly on a form that submits it into your CRM. This is the ideal way to capture leads at an open house rather than doing so via a physical pen and paper list as you can set up automation via Lofty Smart Plans to contact these leads immediately or according to a schedule (see
Smart Plan Basics (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/7626737520923)
).
Summary
Accessing Open House Forms (#h_55663e7a-78f5-43d5-836a-9dafc1991e47)
Create a New Open House Form (#h_a9ada14f-0d6f-44a5-8c8e-f2a1a24a7db1)
Open House Questionnaires (#h_01KCMKZGWJX2DD3SAM1C4X6355)
Manage an Existing Open House Form (#h_9a78d110-9592-4403-9c7d-39d800ae5d02)
Using the Open House Form (#h_a27b36a6-f481-4491-b042-7f1efb18f4e7)
Open Houses and Lead Routing (#h_01EF0FNFR6XP9XX4VZSRDD1MJA)
Open Houses and Smart Plans (#h_01KCMPEGQS69PPADYBEQ4TJFE0)
Accessing Open House Forms
Navigate to the
Content tab
and then click on
Open House
Forms.
Note: you may need permission from your admin to create Open House forms.
Create a New Open House Form
Click the
+ Add New
button to create a new open house. In the "
Add Open House"
pop-up window, enter the street address, select the questionnaire you want to use, who the Open House Form is shared with, who owns the form, and if the leads who register via the form will receive a welcome email or text and how those leads will be routing to agents on your team.
Each Open House Form is created for a specific listing, but the questionnaires can be used on multiple open house forms.
Open House Questionnaires
The Open House Questionnaire provides the details that are collected from leads at your open house. To get started, click
Questionnaires
, then click
+ Add New
.
The questionnaire has some default fields for the leads' name, email address, and phone number, along with the option to make the field required. If required, they cannot finish the form without completing all required fields. The form is completely customizable and you can add, remove, or re-order all of the form fields.
Learn how to navigate the Questionnaire:
Scope:
Select who this questionnaire is available to. This could be private for your own use or available to anyone in your team, office, or company.
Add a Question:
Add a new plain text or multiple choice question to the questionnaire.
Questionnaire Name:
This questionnaire will be saved as a template that can be used on multiple Open House Forms, so give it a recognizable name.
Required vs. Optional:
If the box next to the question is checked, the field must be complete for the lead to complete the questionnaire.
Hamburger Menu:
Click this icon to re-order the questionnaire questions. Click the icon and drag the question to its new placement.
Trash Can:
Click this icon to delete the question.
Do Not Enter:
Click this icon to delete a multiple choice option.
Add a Choice:
Add a new multiple choice option here.
Once your questionnaire is complete, click Save and you can view the questionnaire in the list of other questionnaire templates. Under
Actions
, you have the option to edit or delete an existing Open House Questionnaire template.
Manage an Existing Open House Form
To edit or delete an Open House Form, hover on the selected form and click either the edit or trash can icon.
Using the Open House Form
To use the form, first log in to your Lofty account via a computer, tablet, or the Lofty mobile app. Note that there is no app for iPad or Android tablets but you can open Lofty via a mobile browser, sign in, and access the form. Navigate to your Open House page and select the form for the Open House.
From here, leads can scan the QR code to complete the form on their phone or they can fill in the form directly on the computer you provide. You can also print out the QR code for leads to scan on their own.
Once leads click the
Submit
button to send the form. They will immediately be registered into the Lofty CRM.
On the submission page of the questionnaire, you can add a
Visitor Note
or choose to let the next visitor continue the sign-in.
The leads that register will have the source of "Open House" and a
shared
tag of the address for the listing (not city/state/zip). This will help you to easily find these clients later on.
The answers to the questionnaire are added to the lead profile. Those that match up with standard fields supported in Lofty will be added to the applicable field. Those include the following:
Multiple Choice (With Agent) --> With Agent
Multiple Choice (Price) --> Search Criteria- Price
Multiple Choice (House to sell) --> House to Sell
Multiple Choice (TimeFrame) --> Time Frame
Multiple Choice (Pre-qual) --> Pre-qualified
Multiple Choice (FTHB) --> First-Time Buyer
Any customized questions that are asked in the questionnaire will be added to the lead profile as a note.
Open Houses and Lead Routing
If you want to route the incoming leads from the open house to others on your team, be sure to check the box next to
Assign lead by routing?
. This box is not checked, by default.
Next, navigate to
Settings
>
Lead Routing
and make sure you have a lead routing rule set up to capture and route these leads appropriately. Learn more about lead routing here:
Lead Routing Rules (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055177831)
Open Houses and Smart Plans
Since you have just met the lead at the Open House, you may want to put them on a Smart Plan to stay in touch. Learn more about Smart Plans here:
Managing Smart Plans (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/7626737520923)
A quick tip is to set up a Smart Plan trigger for when a new lead is created from the Open House source. This will ensure that any new leads from the open house will automatically be subscribed to your selected Smart Plan.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

### Section: Organize Leads

#### Article 259: Custom Fields

- Article ID: `360054872212`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Organize Leads`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T06:37:43Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360054872212-Custom-Fields

Introduction
Custom fields can be added to your Lofty instance as a way to save information in a pre-planned spot that needs to be available for every lead. When you add a custom field to the settings, you will be able to then add data to that field when editing a lead record.
Summary
Creating Custom Fields (#h_01F398J7JAXCC9GAGJBP005HQ9)
Adding Data to Custom Fields (#h_01F398JB5JQWY6M4ME0CE7NJVZ)
Using Custom Fields (#h_01F398JF9SB7T4RJKZ0E6YSTYS)
Accessing Via Lead Profile Page (#h_01F3BY0ME7SFW4SDV1E09DKQT7)
Access Via Columns on People Page (#h_01F47SS786TWP2MPVDWK7ARSPS)
Filter by Custom Fields (#h_01F47SSDVVB8NWZ88GBH4RZ6N6)
Using In Email/Text Variables (#h_01F3BY1DDM9PFA3ZRGFEMXRCTJ)
Exporting Custom Fields (#h_01F39AVA69TG67CABD7ZTQC0EY)
Creating Custom Fields
To add custom fields, navigate to
Settings
>
Custom Fields
>
+ Add New Field
:
Give the field a name that you will recognize later. This field name will appear next to the field when editing the lead record:
Choose the
Data Type
for the field. You can create 50 of each custom field (a total of 350).
Text
Date
Number
Percentage
Currency
Single-Select
Multi-Select
Notice:
The Starter package is limited to 10 custom fields per type, but the rest is 50 per type. If you are still using a Starter package and are interested in using this feature to its full effect, don't hesitate to contact support(support@lofty.com) to get upgrade options.
Adding Data to Custom Fields
To add data to custom fields, simply navigate to a
lead profile page
>
click the three dots
>
Edit Details
:
Scroll down and find the custom field(s) where you would like to add data and do so directly in that field. The example below shows "Favorite Color" as a custom field, but you will, of course, be adding the information to whichever fields you have created:
Using Custom Fields
Accessing Via Lead Profile Page
When custom field data has been added, it will appear on each lead profile under the
Details
section. This example below is for a custom field called "Favorite Color," and because it has information in it, the field will appear. If a custom field is left blank on a lead profile, it will
not
appear:
Access Via Columns on the People Page
You can add each custom field as a column on the
People
page. This allows for more visibility into custom field data across multiple leads, as well as the ability to sort. The sorting logic is as follows, depending on the custom field type:
Date
: Oldest to Newest, Newest to Oldest
Number
: Highest to Lowest, Lowest to Highest
Text
: A-Z, Z-A
Note: Empty custom fields will always be last when sorting.
Filter by Custom Fields
You can filter and therefore search your leads by using custom fields. This is accessed via the
Custom Fields
header under
Advanced Filter
.
Using In Email/Text Variables
For more information on how to use custom field data in email/text variables, please see
Email and Text Variables: Custom Fields (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055270071)
.
Exporting Custom Fields
Custom fields will be available in a CSV export. For more information on exporting leads from Lofty, see
Lead Export (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360011616892-How-to-export-your-leads-in-Chime-)
.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.

#### Article 260: Lead Organization with Filters

- Article ID: `360055290571`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Organize Leads`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T06:37:56Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055290571-Lead-Organization-with-Filters

Introduction
The main purpose of any CRM is to provide an organization with what can be done with a typical spreadsheet or contact list. In Lofty, this mainly happens on the
People Page
and consists of Pipelines, Segments, Tags, and a variety of filters. This article will introduce how to use the available filters.
Summary
Saved Filters (#h_01F3V9AC681XH4VWY50GNJSJVQ)
Default Filters (#h_01F3V9AKW3QD3MSG1SNTSS9WE8)
Team Filters (#h_01F3V9AYCG5QZ1AC3ZQQX2XKRQ)
Private Filters (#h_01F3V9B2DM0NJ79N9JPEN4NHHG)
Filter by Address (#h_01F3V9BA4KM8GMST1ZR6NF39GQ)
All Filters (#h_01F3V9BJ1DTV1BFFQQ86N5E8G2)
(1) Agent or Lead Pond (#h_01F3V9BR58CKB604W9ZVJC0B3A)
(2) Lead Details (#h_01F3V9BZ09Q9T7PZYSZN3Z537P)
Lead Type (#h_01F3V9C4KRY7CP6HF6EVF0VXTV)
Opportunities (#h_01F3V9C9GNMZDHJS9N2SE1DWVA)

Reg Date (#h_01F3V9CKR2MFJT442F32NJR0DM)
Lead Score (#h_01F3V9D7C4TQN2D4M705DZ5MJV)
Price (#h_01F3V9DDABG6WS96ZF78R1S08P)
Profile Details (#h_01F3V9DW4A8FCGD9TGX26QKN4F)
Close Date (#h_01F3V9E1T42YGF0D6GDK2A9X05)
Contact Info (#h_01F3V9EB2QB575MN87W4P0GE9X)
Undelivered Text Date (#h_01F3V9EG6KXPVY6Y1AMQTRZH36)
(3) Lead Nurturing (#h_01F3V9EPVKSY7Q554DQK7XPWPW)
Smart Plan (#h_01F3V9EX5RS574DE3KX61NZ3GC)
Market Report (#h_01F3V9F33Q9VVH1WEX9GBMHERZ)
Property Alert (#h_01F3V9F96KKJZFJMPPB7F30KN8)
Subscription (#h_01F3V9FDT8EARGCBHJV577Q64G)
(4) Lead Activity (#h_01F3V9FM5KXJQPAM784G91PAGQ)
Last Touch (#h_01F3V9FYJY83B981RNMNEDRZXF)
Last Website Visit (#h_01F3V9G358XGFVVV5ECKKMQ5DF)
Last Reply (#h_01F3V9G7K0QSFR55AM4TH37FZD)
(5) Communication (#h_01F8GGKKZBJE7B702GV3DPVAMN)
(6) Custom Fields (#h_01F47SZF90ECK4H98BJRSPBWK6)
Saved Filters
To access saved filters, navigate to the
People
Page
and click on
Saved Filters
. There are three different types of saved filters:
Default Filters
Team Filters
Private Filters
Default Filters
It includes the following pre-built filters, which are available to everyone on the account. The criteria for these filters are preconfigured, so you cannot edit them.
Today's Opportunities (see
Opportunities (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003018292)
)
Today's New Leads
Not Contacted
Need to Touch
Private Leads (see
Lead Privacy: Team Leads vs. Private Leads (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003544406)
)
Team Leads (see
Lead Privacy: Team Leads vs. Private Leads (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003544406)
)
Three of these are also displayed right below
Saved Filters
:
Team Filters
Everyone on the team can access these filters, but only the Team Owner/Admin or another user with the "Manage Team" permission (see
Team Permissions (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055290451)
) can add/edit them.
To add a saved filter to this category, apply the criteria and save the filter.
To create a view, click the +View option and choose Create View from the drop-down.
You can create a New View using a Custom View or by selecting a Template
You can share the new view with "Share with Company" or keep it "Private".
Private Filters
Similar to
Office Filters,
but these are only accessible to you, as the creator. Please add your criteria, save the filter, and make sure the Share With Team box is
not
checked.
Filter by Address
Use this search field to search for addresses associated with any of the leads. This will search the mailing address, property addresses, etc., as recorded on a lead profile page.
All Filters
First of all, you will notice that some of the filters are displayed right on the left menu. This is to provide easy access to common filters that are utilized in the system. To see all filters, simply click on the
Advanced Filter
button at the bottom-left.
The following are the five main categories where the filters are saved. Each is outlined below with the corresponding filters.
Agent
Lead details
Lead Nurturing
Lead Activity
Custom Fields
(1) Agent or Lead Pond
This section contains a filter for each role that is set up on the team (see
Creating Custom Roles (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360028073892)
and
Assigning Leads to Custom Roles (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003014771)
). When an agent/user is searched in any of these role fields, it is an AND relationship, meaning if you were to search for specific users in each role, then the leads populated will have to have that same assignee assignment in each lead record.
(2) Lead Details
Each of the filters for this section is outlined individually below.
Lead Type
The following options are available:
Buyer
Seller
Renter
Investor
Agent
Homeowner
Landlord
Other
The lead type refers to this field on a lead record:
When filtering by Lead Type, you can include all of the lead types selected, one of the lead types selected, or exactly the lead types selected:
Include all
The People Page will filter for leads who have all of the selected lead types and will include leads that have other lead types as well
Include one of
The People Page will filter for leads who have one of the selected lead types and will include leads that have other lead types as well
Equals to
The People Page will filter for leads who have all of the selected lead types and will not include leads that have other lead types as well
Opportunities
The following options are available:
High Interest
Back to Site
Back on Market
Sell
For more information on Opportunities, see
HERE (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003018292)
.
Source
The source of the lead is where the lead came from before it entered the Lofty CRM. Reference
Lead Source Logic (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360041252272)
for more information. Multiple sources can be selected at the same time with this filter.
A source is recorded in the lead profile here:
Tags
The "Tags" filter has support for the following four combinations. You can also combine the "include" and "exclude" options.
---
(a)
Include + One of + [tag]
. Shows leads that contain any of the indicated tags.
Example
: Include + One of + [A] + [B]. Shows leads that have tag "A"
or
tag "B."
---
(b)
Include + All + [tag]
. Show leads that contain the specific combination of tags used together.
Example
: Include + All + [A] + [B]. Shows all leads that have tag "A"
and
tag "B."
---
(c)
Exclude + One of + [tag]
. Show leads that do
not
contain any of the indicated tags.
Example
: Exclude + One of + [A] + [B]. Shows leads without either tag "A"
or
tag "B."
---
(d)
Exclude + All + [tag]
. Show leads that do
not
contain ONLY one specific tag.
Example
: Exclude + All + [A] + [B]. Shows leads without both tags "A"
and
tag "B."
---
Reg Date
The "Reg Date" is the date that the lead was entered into the Lofty CRM. This is an extremely useful filter to use when trying to narrow down leads that entered the database during a specific date range, today, yesterday, etc. Pre-built options can be selected, or a custom date range can be selected.
Lead Score
Use this filter to find leads that fit within a specific lead score range. More information regarding lead score can be found here:
Lead Score and Lead Analysis (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/115003014731)
.
Price
The "Price" filter will filter leads and display those with their Search Criteria/Inquiry price data matching the indicated amount. For example, if the price range is 100k-200k and there is a lead with Search Criteria/Inquiries that are listed in their profile as 50k-150k, the lead will appear in this search because it falls within the range.
Min Bathrooms
This will pull from a lead's search criteria and requires a manual search input.
Min Bedrooms
This will pull from a lead's search criteria and requires a manual search input.
Property Type
This will pull from a lead's search criteria with a set amount of searchable options.
Profile Details
This filter includes fields such as whether they have a mailing address, birthday month, and questionnaire answers. The questionnaire consists of the questions that the lead will respond to when registering on a Lofty IDX website. See
HERE (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360038005412)
for more information.
*NOTE: For the
birthday
filter, if a lead has family members (see
here (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360021258652-How-to-Manage-the-Family-Members-of-a-Lead)
) with birthdays documented, they will not display when filtering by birthday--only the primary lead will surface when using the birthday filter.
Close Date
This is a filter that allows you to search leads with closed dates, including a range of closed dates. If a lead has no transactions, they will not display. See
Transaction Management (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/sections/360010608752-Transaction-Management)
for more information.
Contact Info
Search for leads with/without a phone number or email address based on whether they have had emails opened or bounced.  There is also a filter for
email opt-in status (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/4403048145307)
.
Undelivered Text Date
If you would like to find leads where texts have been sent but
not
delivered, you can search using this field with either the pre-populated fields or by selecting the option for a "Custom Date Range."
(3) Lead Nurturing
Smart Plan
Search by a specific Smart Plan or whether a lead has any Smart Plans as Active/Inactive or does not have a Smart Plan assigned. Learn more about Smart Plans
HERE (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/7626737520923)
.
Market Report
Use this filter to find leads that either do or do not have a Market Report set up.
Property Alert
Use this filter to find leads that either do or do not have a Property Alert set up for them. Please note that
currently
, leads with an auto property alert set up will also be included in the "With Property Alert" results, even if there are no valid Search Criteria on that lead that would trigger that auto alert to send.
Subscription
Use this filter to search by subscription status for Smart Plans, Market Reports, or Property Alerts. The options for each of these are "Subscribed" or "Unsubscribed." You can also see the following for more information on this topic:
Email Subscription Status (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360042326212)
.
(4) Lead Activity
Last Touch
Use this filter to search for leads who were or were not contacted. The options include all contact methods, including both automatic and manual communication. The last touch can also be sorted by period, either by the pre-selected time intervals in the drop-down menu or by selecting Customized Time to enter a specific number of days.
Note:
This differs from the Last Touch
column
, which gives you the option to sort by your last manual touch OR all contact methods.
Last Website Visit
Synchronizes with the last website visit under the
Insight
section of a lead profile that displays here:
Last Reply
Search for the last time a lead has replied via email, call, or text, and during a certain period.
(5) Communication
Three communication filters track outgoing/incoming communication totals for leads. If a lead has matching communication that falls within the defined range of these filters, they will appear in the results.
The logic is as follows:
Calls
Calls Made
Agent to lead
Outbound calls
Includes a call logged manually
Calls Received
Lead to the agent
Inbound calls
Texts
Texts Sent
Agent to lead
Outbound auto and manual texts
Includes texts logged manually
Does
not
include AI Assistant messages
Texts Received
Lead to the agent
Inbound texts
Does
not
include AI Assistant messages
Emails
Emails Sent
Agent to lead
Outbound auto and manual emails
Includes emails logged manually
Emails Received
Lead to the agent
Inbound emails
(6) Custom Fields
See
Custom Fields > Filter by Custom Fields (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360054872212#h_01F47SSDVVB8NWZ88GBH4RZ6N6)
.

#### Article 261: Lead Organization with Pipeline Stages

- Article ID: `115002890651`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Organize Leads`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T06:40:06Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002890651-Lead-Organization-with-Pipeline-Stages

Introduction
The main purpose of any CRM is to provide an organization above and beyond what can be done with a typical spreadsheet or contact list. In Lofty, this happens on the
People Page
and consists of Pipelines, Segments, Tags, and a variety of filters. This article will address the structure from the top level of the organization (pipeline) down to the filters that are made available.
Summary
Edit Permissions (#h_01EFN0JYXVHGJ6XEXH76Y2W64A)
What is a Pipeline? (#h_01EFN0KYK30A341JP1KS60A8VA)
Customizing Pipeline Stages (#h_01EFN0MFVR2NVFW4S59240D7KN)
Changing the Pipeline Stages for Leads (#h_01EFN0MY06PFMGEF5QKC2Y5DB1)
Edit Permissions
It is important to note that the Pipeline stages are maintained at the team level and cannot vary by user within that team. This means that the Pipeline stages are shared and visible to everyone in the Lofty account.
The ability to edit the Pipeline stages is controlled by the System Configuration > Pipeline permission toggle.
What is a Pipeline?
Though this will likely not be a new definition for anyone with sales experience, the pipeline is the top level of organization and indicates the actual stage of the buying or selling process that a lead/client is at as you work with them.
A lead will always start at the left with "New Leads" and end at the right with "Closed."
A lead can only be in
one
pipeline stage at a time. This is because the pipeline stage should reflect exactly where they are in the buying/selling process.
New UI:
Customizing Pipeline Stages
The stages between "New Leads" and "Closed" can vary depending on your specific sales process.
1. These can be adjusted in Lofty by clicking on the "gear" icon to the right of the pipeline:
2. Add a new Pipeline Stage
3. Drag and drop the stages to reorder, but keep in mind that "New Leads" will always be at the front, and "Closed" should always be the finish line for a lead.
4. You can also click the "Trash" icon to delete.
*Please keep in mind that Pipelines cannot be deleted if other agents have leads in that Pipeline.
Example Pipeline Stages
When you first activate your Lofty account, the system will already have some default pipeline stages built in. You will want to edit these to reflect your buying/selling process.
Some recommended pipeline names that you might consider adding to your CRM (from left to right):
Attempting Contact
Hot
Nurturing/Cold
Currently Showing
Under Contract
Bad Leads
Do Not Contact
All Pipeline Stages can be deleted EXCEPT:
All Leads
New Leads
Closed
All Pipeline Stages can be rearranged (by order) EXCEPT:
All Leads
New Leads
Changing the Pipeline Stages for Leads
*NOTE: Changing the pipeline stage for leads will affect the data on the "Funnel Analysis." Reference
Business Summary (Reporting) (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038030552)
.
Pipeline stages can be changed either one at a time for individual leads or in mass by selecting them from the
People Page
. Here is where it is changed for one individual lead:
You can also change the pipeline stage for multiple leads at once by
(1) Check the box next to the leads on the
People Page
(2) Select the option to "Change Pipeline."
(3) Select the pipeline stage where you would like to move all the selected leads. Note that this will only work for 200 leads at a time.
New UI:

#### Article 262: Lead Organization with Segments

- Article ID: `360038401831`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Organize Leads`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T06:39:44Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038401831-Lead-Organization-with-Segments

Introduction
The main purpose of any CRM is to provide an organization and beyond what can be done with a typical spreadsheet or contact list. In Lofty, this happens on the
People Page
and consists of Pipelines, Segments, Tags, as well as a variety of filters. This article will introduce Segments.
Summary
Edit Permissions (#h_01EFN0QDYW8NK6PJEA7VPZWSG6)
What are segments used for in Lofty? (#h_01EFN0QXMHENTYZXDFJJ0ZXJQ2)
Active vs Static Segments (#h_01K86KB8H1EKV3NQFWZK66PFQQ)
Edit Segments (#h_01EFN0RMW56YBQP0AP91A0BDY1)
Changing Segments for Leads (#h_01EFN0RRPS31B4FYF2D9V6ES5R)
FAQ (#h_01HZJTP7PS4WKAQ29AT6SY7FJT)
Edit Permissions
It is important to note that only users with the Company/Team Filter permission (see
Permissions (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055290451)
) can edit the Segments by default. All users can add Tags and use the other filters. This means that the Segments are maintained at the Team/Company or Segment level and cannot vary by users within that Company/Team or Group.
What are segments used for in Lofty?
Segments are used for organizing and classifying your leads into different categories. Unlike pipeline stages, a lead can be categorized into multiple segments at the same time. You might consider creating segments for events, referrals, family and friends, years, specific reminder periods, etc. Segments are located
in the
People/Segments
dropdown menu shown below.
Active vs Static Segments
A
Static Segment
allows you to add leads to the segment, and those leads stay in the segment until they are removed. Further, no other leads will be added to the segment, unless they are added manually.
An
Active Segment
adds and removes leads from the segment depending on your selected filters. For example, if you've added a filter for a specific lead score, leads that match the lead score will be added to the segment automatically, while leads that fall out of the lead score range will be removed automatically.
Edit Segments
Segments can also be customized to fit your workflow and team structure. The same segments will be available for the entire team and can only be edited by those with access.
Click the "..." icon to edit a Segment.
There is also a "reminder" feature that allows you to set a specific reminder period for each segment, and if a lead is not contacted in that period, they will be marked as "expired." The green/red dots next to the segments indicate whether any leads have expired in that segment (meaning they have not been contacted within that period).
Hover over each segment with a reminder or check the Reminder column to see the "Expired" number and display those leads so that you can contact them. Once contacted, the reminder period will start over for that lead.
When setting the reminder period, you have the option to decide if only manual touchpoints count or if automatic touchpoints also count as a lead contact.
When unchecked, only manual actions will count as lead contacts.
When checked, both automatic and manual actions will count as lead contacts.
Changing Segments for Leads
Just like with the pipeline stages, leads can be added to segments either individually or up to 200 at a time. To add individually, you can do so directly from a lead profile. Note that you can select more than one segment to be associated with the lead.
You can also add/change segments for multiple leads at once by checking the box next to the leads on the
People Page
and clicking the option to "Change Segments." This will add those leads to the selected segments.
FAQ
Q: Are Segments the same as Tags?
A:
Tags are generally used to classify leads that have the same characteristics. Tags are relatively simple, clear, and flexible, and are often used to group leads for easy searching. Segments are designed to group leads with similar characteristics into different categories to be used for business analysis and precision marketing.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.
Related terms: SOI (sphere of influence), events, segments, groups

#### Article 263: Lead Organization with Sources

- Article ID: `360041252272`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Organize Leads`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T06:41:26Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360041252272-Lead-Organization-with-Sources

Introduction
In Lofty, the "source" is a very important piece of data associated with each and every lead that exists in the system. "Source" refers to where the lead originated (e.g. Realtor.com, Zillow, etc.). This source can be used to filter leads, track ROI for specific sources, and even establish lead routing within Lofty to distribute based on specific sources. Some sources can be customized and others sources are built into Lofty by default. Source names can have up to 100 characters. This article will explain how Lofty selects the sources for leads.
Summary
Adding Leads Manually (#h_32dab105-efd8-457c-8eef-822eebde6f1c)
CSV Import (#h_389b6885-a5e5-4980-b6cb-6a5fe66da53f)
Email Parsing (#h_acccdb34-22fb-456b-a149-bbce2c5a2d72)
API (#h_2ff6148e-99f5-46f8-a4cf-4070a1419e0d)
Open House (#h_4d3ae592-6b5d-4cda-a447-60f9293432a1)
Text Codes (#h_d32cfb9a-1952-45b4-8e30-0096cbbe8d6d)
Lofty Websites (#h_1c9641b1-4cbf-4178-ab75-4587594236e5)
UTM Settings (#h_44350fd8-c39d-45c4-a79e-b2a73e62e8af)
Editing Sources (#h_2c85f4ae-4d0a-4b97-800b-40f2eb9143c3)
Source Customization (#id-4/10/2023:FeatureReleaseTrainingforChime3.62-SourceCustomization)
Facebook/Google Registration (#h_0e054fda-0359-4f87-9a7d-62d87ef51037)
Adding Leads Manually
If a lead is added manually via the
People
page in Lofty, the source will default to "Other." However, this can be changed when adding the lead or later as necessary. See
Add a Lead (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038382932)
.
*** There is a permission that will allow an account admin to restrict users from changing a lead's source. By default, this permission is ON for all Lofty users. When the permission is OFF, the Source field is greyed out for all leads this user can see, including Private Leads.
For more information, see
Team Permissions (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055290451)
for team-type accounts or
Enterprise Permissions (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4407530443291)
for Enterprise accounts.
CSV Import
When a user imports a CSV document into Lofty (see
Import your Leads to Lofty (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001710831)
), the lead source is typically available as a column/field in the actual CSV that is then matched as the source (see screenshot below). However, if this field is not present, the source defaults to "CSV Import."
Email Parsing
If a lead comes in through the mail parser, which is the majority of all lead sources (see
Lead Capture Sources (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/sections/115000907871-Lead-Capture)
), the source will be the name of the service where the lead originated. For a list of these names, as they will appear in Lofty, you can reference the following section under
Personal
Settings
>
Lead Settings
>
Lead Capture> Lead Capture Settings
:
API
The lead source should always be pre-defined in the code that connects any direct API integration to Lofty. If not, the source will be "Other."
Open House
If the lead enters Lofty via an Open House Form(see
Open House Forms (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360023770952)
), the source will be "Open House."
Text Codes
If the lead enters Lofty via a text code (see
Text Codes for Lead Capture (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360018862672)
), the source will be "Text Code."
Lofty Websites
The website editor defines the default source:
CMS Tool
>
Settings
>
Lead Source
. If nothing else has been added here, the source is "Website." This source can differ for the main team and agent subdomain websites.
Therefore, by default, any lead who registers on the Lofty IDX website will be assigned to the CRM with the source "Website." Unless, however, any of the following are true:
The "Lead Source" in the CMS has been changed to something else
A lead registers on a landing page or custom page that has a separate lead source defined
A UTM code is built into the URL of a campaign that brought the lead to the website. The UTM source will be the source in Lofty.
If a lead enters the CRM via a link found on Facebook or Google, the source will be "Facebook" or "Google", as long as no other UTM code has been set up.
When using Lofty Lead Gen, the leads will always have the source of "Lofty Paid Lead" and the tags will distinguish if the lead came in from Facebook or Google
UTM Settings
UTM is used to tag leads and better monitor campaign ROI. Users can add UTM codes to URLs and have that data added to leads automatically as they are brought into Lofty.
Google's Campaign URL Builder (https://ga-dev-tools.appspot.com/campaign-url-builder/)
is a useful way to set these up.
There are three different parts to how this works:
Import utm_source as lead sources
. This is ON by default and cannot be turned off. If a lead registers via a campaign or URL with an associated "utm_source," that source will be assigned to the lead automatically. A new source will be created if it does not already exist.
Import utm_campaign as lead tags
. If a lead registers via a campaign or URL with an associated "utm_campaign," that campaign will be recorded for that lead automatically as a tag. A new tag will be created if it does not already exist.
Import utm_content as lead tags
. If a lead registers via a campaign or URL with an associated "utm_content," that content will be recorded for that lead automatically as a tag. A new tag will be created if it does not already exist.
To edit or set this up, navigate to
Personal
Settings
>
Lead Settings
>
Tags
>
UTM Settings
:

#### Article 264: Lead Organization with Tags

- Article ID: `360038603951`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Organize Leads`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T06:38:11Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038603951-Lead-Organization-with-Tags

Introduction
The main purpose of any CRM is to provide an organization above and beyond what can be done with a typical spreadsheet or contact list. In Lofty, this happens on the
People Page
and consists of Pipelines, Segments, Tags, and a variety of filters. This article will introduce Tag.
Summary
General Information (#h_01F9F3ADRWCK1X795BT5112VKA)
Manage Tags (#h_01F9F3AQTTBS546JB2WA61KTH8)
Tag Management (#h_01GQ0WRWT71ZGAZGFPC94RS1S7)
Add / Edit Tags (#h_01F9F3AVX9RCQ1EDSCWPJGW4T1)
Lofty Paid Lead Tags (#h.fcb1j69cts99)
UTM Parameters (#h_01F9F3B7NETCKK083PKV1S70QA)
General Information
The third level of organization with the
People Page
is done with tags. Similar to social media "hashtags," tags can be used for whatever purpose that an Office finds useful--providing a tool that can easily be searched later on for Office leads.
Every user can create their own Tags or lead an organization, and also utilize Tags in the Company or Office Tag Library. The entire office can use Company or Office Tags, but only those created by users with the "Office Filter" or "Company Filter" permission (see
Permission Profiles (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4407530443291)
).
Manage Tags
A full list of all tags can be managed by doing the following:
Click on
Settings
Navigate to
Tags & Sources
under the
Features
section
If you do not have the "Office Filter" or "Company Filter" permission enabled, navigate to
Tags
Select the
Tags
tab at the top
Add new tags, edit a tag to rename it, or delete a tag from your personal Tag Library.
With "Office Filter" or "Company Filter" permission enabled:
Without
"Office Filter" or "Company Filter" permission enabled:
Tag Management
If you have the
"Office Filter" or "Company Filter" permission enabled, you will have the Tag Management button. Any Tags added here will sync to all other users' Tag libraries. T
he lock icon keeps users from editing or deleting this Tag from their libraries. Office Owners' accounts have the same logic, but their Tag Management only includes their own Office Tags.
A Company/Office Owner/Admin can add Company/Office Tags to the Tag library by clicking "+Add New" above. There is a 100-character limit when creating a Tag.
Add / Edit Tags
To add tags to individual users, navigate to a lead profile and select the
+
in the "Tag" field of the
Details
section. If a tag does not exist, you can choose to create it:
You can also add/remove tags on up to 200 leads at once by navigating to the
People Page
, (1) selecting the boxes next to each lead, (2) clicking on the option to "Change Tags," and (3) selecting from the list, removing, or creating a new Tag.
The following tags are built into Lofty by default: Open House, Text Code, and Lofty Paid.
Lofty Paid Lead Tags
All leads that enter Lofty from one of our marketing campaigns currently have the Source of “
Lofty Paid Lead
.” Now, with this update, Lofty users will be able to see whether they came from one of the following, in addition to that source:
LoftyPaid - Google
LoftyPaid - FB
LoftyPaid - FBform
One of the above will be
added as a Tag
on the lead in addition to the source being Lofty  Paid Lead.
The tags can now be used for filtering specific sources even more granularly, Smart Plans, etc.
The tags can be added/removed manually if needed
UTM Parameters
See the following article for a full explanation of how to edit UTM settings:
Lead Source Logic > UTM Settings (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360041252272#h_44350fd8-c39d-45c4-a79e-b2a73e62e8af)
. As to how this applies to tags, note that the following can be populated into Lofty as tags using UTM parameters:
Import utm_campaign as lead tags
. If a lead registers via a campaign or URL with an associated "utm_campaign," that campaign will be recorded for that lead automatically as a tag. A new tag will be created if it does not already exist.
Import utm_content as lead tags
. If a lead registers via a campaign or URL with an associated "utm_content," that content will be recorded for that lead automatically as a tag. A new tag will be created if it does not already exist.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.
Related terms: tags, UTM, UTM content

#### Article 265: Add a Lead

- Article ID: `360038382932`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `People List & Detail Page Overview`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T06:44:44Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038382932-Add-a-Lead

Introduction
If you have a new lead that you would like to add to the CRM to communicate with them, track their progress, etc., this can be done by navigating to the
People
Page
and then clicking on the "+ Add Lead" button:
Once you click the “+ Add Lead” button, there will be a pop-up window where you can input the lead‘s information. You must enter the lead’s first name when adding the lead. Remember that you can always go back and add/edit more details to a lead's profile after they have already been added.
A few important things to keep in mind when adding a lead:
Privacy
Please reference the following article to learn more:
Lead Privacy: Team Leads vs. Private Leads (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003544406)
.
Phone Type | Status
If the lead’s number is labeled as landline/DNC number/DNC Contact, the lead will not receive any auto texts.
Property Address
The system will add a property to the lead automatically once you enter the address in this field.
When the billing address country is set to Canada, all address fields in the CRM will be updated to reflect the Canadian address format.
Note: This
will not
automatically mark all phone numbers currently listed on a lead’s profile as Canadian; however, all newly added numbers will
default
to the Canadian country code.
Source
The source will default to "Other," but a drop-down menu is available to select from any of the existing sources already in the database.
Custom Fields
Lofty supports using custom fields when adding leads. You can set up custom fields in Lofty settings, and then they will appear on the pop-up window for you to use. Please reference this article for more information:
How to use Custom Fields (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360054872212)
.
Send Welcome Email
The system will send a welcome email to the lead with the login information for your IDX website. Their activity on the IDX website will then be tracked automatically.
Family Member
You can add additional family members to the lead if you have enough information. For more instructions on how this works, please reference this article:
How to Manage the Family Members of a Lead (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360021258652)
.
Once all of the information has been entered correctly, click on the "Save" button to create your new lead!
Adding Agents as Leads
A user's email address can be used as both an agent/user login as well as an email address assigned to a lead. Admins may be interested in adding their new team members as a way to provide them with training via an automated Smart Plan that they have built out, for example. The email address can only be used
once
per team as a lead as well.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or chat with us through your CRM.
Related terms: add a lead, adding a lead

#### Article 266: How to Delete/Erase Leads

- Article ID: `115002886592`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `People List & Detail Page Overview`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T06:45:46Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002886592-How-to-Delete-Erase-Leads

Introduction
To protect valuable lead information, there is an important mechanism built into Lofty so that all deleted leads will first be moved to a list named “Deleted leads.” Information on deleting leads permanently will also be outlined in this article.
To temporarily delete leads, log in to your Lofty CRM and follow the steps outlined below. There are two ways to delete leads in Lofty CRM.
Via Lead List Page
Log in to your CRM account and click on
People
. Select the leads you want to delete by ticking the checkbox next to the lead’s name, and click
Delete.
New UI:
When the alert window appears, type in the delete reason (optional), click
OK,
and the leads will be deleted.
Via Lead Detail Page
Click on a lead’s name to get to their info page. Move your cursor to the "more" button on the top left of a lead's profile page, and click "
Delete Lead
" in the menu that appears.
When the alert window appears, click
YES,
and the leads will be deleted.
Recover Leads / Delete Leads Permanently
To recover leads or delete leads permanently, click
People
on the page menu to go to the lead list page. Then click the
Deleted Leads
tab, and you'll be taken to the DELETED LEADS list page.
New UI:
On the DELETED LEADS page, select the leads you want to recover/erase by ticking the checkbox next to the lead’s name. Click
Recover
or
Erase,
depending on the action you wish to take.
New UI:
To recover your leads, choose the pipeline and click
OK
.
To permanently delete leads, click
Erase
. When the alert window appears, click
YES,
and the leads will be permanently deleted.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 267: How to Manage the Family Members of a Lead

- Article ID: `360021258652`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `People List & Detail Page Overview`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T06:45:39Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360021258652-How-to-Manage-the-Family-Members-of-a-Lead

Introduction
Purchasing a home is usually a family decision, thus, all the decision-makers in a family need to be considered and contacted by real estate agents. Lofty supports easy management of leads' family member info. Follow this guide to learn how to create and manage a lead's family members.
Create Family Members For A Lead
To create family members for a lead, click
in the Lead Details section of a lead's profile page
.
Enter the family member's information in the fields on the right side. You may want to input, e.g., husband or son, in the Relationship field to note the family member's relationship to the lead.
Auto Emails in the Smart Plans, Auto Property Alerts, and Market Reports will also be sent to the family members of a lead. If you want the family member to
not
receive these kinds of automated emails set up for the lead, check the corresponding option in the Family Member Unsubscribe options.
Click "
Save
" when you finish. Shortly after, you will see the family member's information on the left side of the lead's profile page. You can add up to
four
family members.
Contacting a Lead's Family Member
To contact a lead's family member via call, email, or text message, click the down arrow on the right of the Call, Email, or Text button on the top left of the lead's profile page. The emails or phone numbers of the family members will be shown in the menu that appears. Click the one you want to contact the family member with.
*IMPORTANT
:
Please note that currently, any communication made to a family member on a lead will show up on the lead profile as if you are contacting the primary lead. Keep that in mind if you plan on merging leads. You can always reference the email address and/or phone number and who it belongs to to distinguish who the communication was with, but it will display as if it was always to the primary lead.
If that will not work for your established workflow, an alternative option of connecting two leads could be to copy the URL for one lead, add it as a note in another lead, and pin that note to the top. Repeat the other way around. By doing this, you have connected the two leads, who are completely separate, but you do have a pinned note pointing out their relationship.
Currently, any mass email sent to leads will only be sent to the primary lead, not the family members of that lead.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: family member

Introduction
Lofty uses a new API improvement to detect the number type when new leads enter the system from the Website, Zillow, Zapier, Open House, or Email Parsing (other sources). This integration will determine whether the number is a landline as well as whether the number is valid. Because this API improvement will not always be 100% accurate, users can still mark numbers as "
Bad Number
" to manually void that number.
There will also be a warning that displays when an invalid or landline number is selected. This will display on both the web app:
Here is how it displays on the mobile app:
For mass text messages, the system will exclude the leads with invalid phone numbers. See the screenshot of the pop-up message below:
For any auto texts scheduled in Smart Plans, the system will skip the texts if the lead’s number is marked as invalid or is a landline number.
For leads that are coming from Zapier/Zillow (no other sources are currently supported), this integration will work to detect the lead’s name as well (if unknown). Lofty will then update the lead’s name if applicable. There will be a system log left on the lead's timeline indicating what happened as an explanation to all users:

#### Article 269: Lead Preference Profiles

- Article ID: `47347302562715`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `People List & Detail Page Overview`
- Updated: `2026-03-03T20:12:26Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/47347302562715-Lead-Preference-Profiles

Introduction
Lofty CRM now logs Preference Profile activity in a lead's activity timeline. When a lead's property search preferences are created or updated, either by the lead through the website or by an agent in the CRM, a timeline event is recorded so you have a complete history of how their search criteria have changed over time.
Summary
What Are Preference Profiles? (#h_01KJTM9T5NVQSNFV86H4EGSA8V)
Preference Profile Timeline Events (#h_01KJTMAYZYFG76Q79MCECTKXFP)
How to View Preference Profile History (#h_01KJTMC8K1YYQ5WT0V3DVQAKYA)
Why This Matters (#h_01KJTN6W94KBDBXENQGSH0ET7J)
What Are Preference Profiles?
A Preference Profile captures a lead's property search criteria, including:
Property type
(single family, condo, townhouse, etc.)
Price range
(min/max)
Bedrooms and bathrooms
Location
(cities, ZIP codes, neighborhoods)
Other filters
(garage, pool, lot size, etc.)
Leads can update their preferences directly on the Lofty-powered website, or an agent can update them manually in the CRM.
Preference Profile Timeline Events
The following events are now recorded in the lead's activity timeline:
Event
What It Logs
Preference Profile Created
When a lead sets up their preferences for the first time
Preference Profile Updated
When any preference criteria is changed
Price Range Changed
Specific old and new price range values
Location Changed
Added or removed cities/ZIP codes
How to View Preference Profile History
Open the lead's profile
Look at the
Activity Overview Timeline
Update to the search
Preferences
will be available on the overview
Click any preference event to expand it and see the full details of what changed
Why This Matters
Tracking preference changes gives you powerful insight into where a lead is in their search:
Price range expanded
→ lead may be getting more serious and exploring more options
Location narrowed
→ lead is zeroing in on a specific area — great time to send targeted listings
Preferences not updated in 60+ days
→ lead may have gone cold or found a property
Use this data to time your outreach and personalize your follow-up based on what the lead is actually searching for.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
