#### Article 286: Reporting Page Metrics

- Article ID: `37938425417499`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Reporting`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T01:15:48Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/37938425417499-Reporting-Page-Metrics

Introduction
This article outlines the metrics available on the Lofty Reporting Page. Here, we will define the metrics included on each default report so you can decide which metrics are important to you. Learn how to navigate the reporting page here:
How to Navigate the Reporting Page (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/37938213977499)
Summary
Agent Activity Overview (#h_01JXJK0ZQVJHQQ0AWRMQ1XK14E)
Leads Not Acted On (#h_01JXJK4RCA65P98KCJ5HZ98YPX)
Follow-up Speed & Effort (#h_01JXJK75N7608ADWM00SSKGXE0)
Lead Response Performance (#h_01JXJK9WS532T5D6C3K6A93XTQ)
Call Accountability (#h_01JXJKHSTR23NEKE4Q6CMGP95R)
Text Accountability (#h_01JXJKMPSQ2JE5V22KTDP7Q3TM)
Email Accountability (#h_01JXJKP901JFYYSYB1MTG9VNGH)
Agent Activity Overview
This report focuses on the activity count for each agent, regardless of whether leads are assigned to them. Here are the metrics available on this report:
Metric Name
Definition
New leads assigned
The number of leads created within the selected timeframe and currently assigned to that agent.
Initial leads assigned
The historical number of leads created within the selected timeframe, who were first assigned to that agent.
- This metric could be used to complete a lead distribution analysis - that is, track the fairness or balance in lead distribution/routing
Current leads assigned
This is the same calculation as the current ‘total leads assigned', but is now renamed to 'current leads assigned’ to provide a distinction between currently assigned leads and initially assigned leads.
- That is, this metric provides the number of leads assigned within the selected timeframe that are currently are still assigned to that agent
Total leads previously worked
The historical number of leads assigned within the selected timeframe, but may not still be assigned to that agent
- This metric could be used to measure the overall workload for agents
Contacts made (Manual only)
The sum of all outbound communications, including calls made, texts sent, and emails sent, including logged activity. This metric is only counting manual activity.
Contacts made (Include auto)
This metric includes all the data as Contacts made (Manual only) but also includes automated communications, like Smart Plans.
Calls made
The number of outbound calls, including logged calls
Call connect rate
This metric calculates the percentage of ‘Talked Calls’ from the total number of calls made. This does not include inbound calls.
Texts sent (Manual only)
The number of outbound texts sent, including logged texts
- This metric only includes manually sent text messages. Automated texts are excluded.
Texts sent (Include auto)
This metric includes the number of all texts sent, including automated texts.
Emails sent (Manual only)
The number of outbound emails sent, including logged emails
- This metric only includes manually sent emails. Automated emails are excluded.
Emails sent (Include auto)
This metric includes the number of all emails sent, including automated emails.
Tasks completed
The number of tasks completed by the agent during the selected timeframe
- This metric includes smart plan tasks that are completed manually by the agent
Total appts
The number of appointments created during the selected timeframe that are either owned by the agent or the agent is a participant
Appts set
The number of appointments created by that agent during the selected timeframe
Appts completed
The number of appointments with the status of 'completed’
No show rate
This metrics is calculated as:
(Total appts - Appts completed)/Total appts
Leads Not Acted On
This report focuses on the number of new leads that have not received any follow-up, regardless of whether the follow-up is done by their assigned agent. Here are the metrics available on this report:
Metric Name
Definition
New leads assigned
The number of leads created within the selected timeframe and currently assigned to that agent.
Leads not acted on
The number of ‘New leads assigned’ who have not been contacted in the selected timeframe
Leads not called
The number of ‘New leads assigned’ who have not been called in the selected timeframe
Leads not texted
The number of ‘New leads assigned’ who have not been texted in the selected timeframe
Leads not emailed
The number of ‘New leads assigned’ who have not been emailed in the selected timeframe
Follow-up Speed & Effort
This report analyzes the follow-up speed and effort of the agents on their new leads. Communications made by team members other than the assigned agent will not be included in this report. Here are the metrics available on this report:
Metric Name
Definition
New leads assigned
The number of leads created within the selected timeframe and currently assigned to that agent.
Avg. response time
The average amount of time (in days:hours:minutes) taken from the lead creation to the first contact (call/text/email) by the lead’s assigned agent
Avg. speed to first call
The average amount of time (in days:hours:minutes) taken from the lead creation to the first call by the lead’s assigned agent
Avg. speed to first text (manual only)
The average amount of time (in days:hours:minutes) taken from the lead creation to the first manual text message sent by the lead’s assigned agent
Avg. speed to first email (manual only)
The average amount of time (in days:hours:minutes) taken from the lead creation to the first manual email sent by the lead’s assigned agent
Avg. contact attempts
The average number of contacts (calls/texts/emails) to new leads by the lead’s assigned agent
Avg. call attempts
The average number of calls to new leads by the lead’s assigned agent
Avg. text attempts (manual only)
The average number of manual text messages sent to new leads by the lead’s assigned agent
Avg. email attempts (manual only)
The average number of manual emails sent to new leads by the lead’s assigned agent
Lead Response Performance
This report analyzes lead responses to communications initiated by agents. Automated communications are excluded from this report. Here are the metrics available on this report:
Metric Name
Definition
New leads assigned
The number of leads created within the selected timeframe and currently assigned to that agent.
Leads contacted
The number of leads contacted by the agent during the selected timeframe
Leads responded
The number of leads that have responded to the agent during the selected timeframe
Lead response rate
This metric is calculated as Leads responded/Leads contacted
Leads called
The number of leads called by the agent during the selected timeframe
Leads responding by call
The number of leads who picked up the outbound calls from the agent during the selected timeframe
% of leads responding by call
This metric is calculated as Leads responding by call/Leads called
Leads texted (manual only)
The number of leads texted manually by the agent during the selected timeframe
Leads responding by text
The number of leads sending inbound text message to the agent during the selected timeframe
% of leads responding by text
This metric is calculated as Leads responding by text/Leads texted (manual only)
Leads emailed (manual only)
The number of leads emailed manually by the agent during the selected timeframe
Leads responding by email
The number of leads that have replied to an email from the agent during the selected timeframe
% of leads responding by email
This metric is calculated as Leads responding by email/Leads emailed (manual only)
Call Accountability
This report analyzes the calling data of the agents, teams, and offices for a specified period of time. Here are the metrics available on this report:
Metric Name
Definition
Calls made
The number of outbound calls made, including logged calls, in the selected timeframe
Calls received
The number of inbound calls from leads and unknown numbers, excluding missed calls, in the selected timeframe
Leads called
The number of unique leads called by the agent in the selected timeframe
Talked calls
The number of calls with the call result of 'talked’ in the selected timeframe
Convos more than 2 mins
The number of calls with the call result of 'talked’ and the call duration is more than 2 minutes, in the selected timeframe
Voicemails
The number of calls with the call result of 'voice message’ in the selected timeframe
Bad numbers
The number of calls with the call result of 'bad numbers’ in the selected timeframe
No answer
The number of calls with the call result of 'no answer’ in the selected timeframe
DNC
The number of calls with the call result of 'DNC’ in the selected timeframe
Calls missed
The number of inbound calls missed by the agent in the selected timeframe
Total call duration
The total time of talked calls
Text Accountability
This report analyzes the text messaging data of the agents, teams, and offices for a specified period of time. Here are the metrics available on this report:
Metric Name
Definition
Texts sent
The number of texts sent by the agent during the selected timeframe
Leads texted
The number of unique leads sent any text messages during the selected timeframe
Texts delivered
The number of texts successfully sent during the selected timeframe
Leads delivered
The number of unique leads that have successfully received any text messages in the selected timeframe
Texts delivery rate
This metric is calculated as Texts delivered/Texts sent
Texts received
The number of inbound text messages that the agent received in the selected timeframe
Opt-outs
The number of unique leads that unsubscribed from text messages in the selected timeframe
Carrier filtered
The number of texts that have been directly blocked by carriers in the selected timeframe
Other errors
The number of text messages failed to be sent by other errors, such as sending to an invalid/landline number.
Note: A high number of "Other Errors" can damage your sender reputation with carriers, making it more likely for future messages to be flagged as spam.
Email Accountability
This report analyzes the emailing data of the agents, teams, and offices for a specified period of time. Here are the metrics available on this report:
Metric Name
Definition
Emails sent
The number of emails sent by the agent during the selected timeframe
Leads sent
The number of unique leads sent any emails during the selected timeframe
Emails delivered
The number of emails successfully sent during the selected timeframe
Leads delivered
The number of unique leads that have successfully received any emails in the selected timeframe
Emails opened
The number of emails opened by leads in the selected timeframe
Leads opened
The number of unique leads opening emails in the selected timeframe
Emails replied to
The number of emails replied to by leads in the selected timeframe
Leads replied to
The number of unique leads replying to emails in the selected timeframe
Emails bounced
The number of emails bounced in the selected timeframe
Leads unsubscribed
The number of unique leads who have unsubscribed from emails in the selected timeframe
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your CRM.

#### Article 287: Site Traffic Report

- Article ID: `360036552711`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Reporting`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T01:15:06Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360036552711-Site-Traffic-Report

Introduction
In this article, we will review how to utilize the Site Traffic Report to have an overview of your Lofty website and traffic status. The data for this report is generated by Lofty's built-in site logs. If you would like a different type of reporting data you may want to consider taking a look at our
Google Analytics Integration (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038373351)
.
Reporting
First, navigate to
Reporting
>
Marketing
>
Site Traffic.
*Please note that you can only view your website traffic, the subdomains are not included.
You can view how many people have viewed your website, how many pages were viewed, and how many pages are viewed on average in the selected timeframe. There is also a trend statistics chart under the overview numbers. The blue line represents current data, which you can compare to the gray line, which represents past historical data.
In the
Visitor Activity By Hour
section, you can have an overview of the traffic pattern, displayed seven days a week in the vertical direction, and also the traffic pattern displayed 24 hours a day in the horizontal direction. Each cell shows the number of visitors that visit your site by hour on a particular day. This dataset will show an aggregate of data over the selected time to give you better overall insights. All data is shown in your CRM's time zone.
In the
New vs Returning
section, you can see how many new visitors and returning visitors you've had for a selected date range. Please note that new visitors may also be counted as returning visitors if they returned within the selected date range.
In
Avg. Visitor Activities
section, you can see the average number of properties viewed or searched by visitors from different sources.
Paid: Visitors that come from Lofty Paid Lead Generation.
Direct: Visitors who type in your site URL.
Search Organic: Visitors who find your site from a search engine.
Social Organic: Visitors who visit from social media that are not from advertisements.
Email: Visitors who come from clicking an emailed link.
Other: Visitors from other sources.
In the
Visitors by Source
and
Pageviews by Device
sections, you can see visitor metrics broken down by source and visitor page views broken down by device, respectively.
In the
Site Traffic
section, you can see the number of visitors, page views, and average page views per visitor for a particular page. You can compare visitor behaviors from different sources as well. Note that return visitors may count multiple times if they use a different source to reach your page.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 289: SEO Setup Checklist

- Article ID: `28406739481499`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `SEO Agent`
- Updated: `2026-04-06T20:08:08Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/28406739481499-SEO-Setup-Checklist

Introduction
The SEO Setup Checklist is the first tab within the CMS SEO settings. This feature will help you maximize your site SEO with the help of a simple checklist.
The SEO Checklist is only available if you have a full Lofty website.
The SEO Checklist outlines the steps required to optimize your website's SEO. Click the
Go to Fix
button next to each step to see why this step is important and how to optimize this step.
Basic Info
This section allows you to set your core SEO inputs, such as Brand Name, Service Area(s), and high performing website keywords.
Integrations
Here, connect your search engine integrations, like Google Search Console. This is also where you can set up your custom website domain and your service area pages.
Page SEO
This section lists the pages on your website and alerts you to missing SEO information. Those details can be edited here.
Schema & Technical
This section controls advanced SEO and structured data. Most sites don’t need to change anything here. ‘Not Found’ just means no custom schema or files have been added yet — it doesn’t mean anything is broken.
Schema markup is structured data added to your site’s code that helps search engines understand:
What type of page this is (homepage, listings, reviews, location page, etc.)
What entities exist (real estate agent, city, property, reviews)
Think of schema as
labels for Google
, not text for visitors.
Techincal files control how search engines crawl and index your website. Lofty provides safe defaults, so most sites won’t need to upload anything here unless directed by an SEO professional.
robots.txt
– Tells search engines which pages they can and can’t crawl. Lofty includes a default file automatically.
sitemap.xml
– Helps search engines discover your pages. Lofty generates a sitemap for you; upload one only if you have a custom version.
.htaccess
– Advanced server rules for redirects and security. Only upload this if explicitly instructed, as incorrect files can impact site performance.
Tip:
If you’re unsure, it’s best to leave these settings unchanged.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, don't hesitate to get in touch with our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 290: AI Smart Auto Property Alert (BETA)

- Article ID: `39284150047131`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Sales Agent`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T07:00:25Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/39284150047131-AI-Smart-Auto-Property-Alert-BETA

We are beta testing AI-generated, fully personalized, auto property alerts. Previous Auto Property Alerts were extremely generic, following a preset template for the subject and body and only the listings would change. Smart Auto Property Alerts create a unique subject, body, and set of recommended listings for each lead based on their actual search and conversation history.
Key Upgrades:
Personalized Content
: Email subject, body are all AI-generated and tailored to the lead’s persona and search behavior.
Smarter Recommendations
: The listings are selected by AI based on each lead’s latest activity, preferences, and engagement patterns.
Dynamic Reasons
: Every listing in the alert features a short, clear AI-generated “why this property” reason.
You can switch between Traditional auto property alerts and Smart AI auto property alerts in Marketing > Auto Property Alerts.
How Smart AI auto property alerts work:
Lead Persona Creation
Lofty’s AI begins by analyzing a lead’s registration details, agent communications, search criteria, and recent website activity. This data is synthesized into a comprehensive “Lead Persona,” which includes a summary of the lead’s preferences and the most effective engagement strategy.
Smart Listing Recommendation
Using this persona, the system selects 10 active listings tailored to the lead’s interests. It applies a mix of strict and flexible criteria, along with fallback strategies, to ensure both relevance and coverage. Each listing is accompanied by a concise, natural-sounding explanation of why it’s a good match.
Personalized Email Content
The email’s subject line and body are generated by AI to reflect the lead’s unique persona and preferences. While the content is dynamic, the agent’s existing email signature remains intact. Listing cards within the email also include the personalized “why matched” reasons, adding further context and appeal.
Real-Time Feedback & Optimization
The system continuously learns and adapts. If a lead interacts with a recommended property by saving it, favoriting it, or requesting a showing, that behavior is used to refine their persona and improve future recommendations.
The fine print:
The email content cannot be edited for Auto Property Alerts in Smart Mode.
Manual Property Alerts can still be fully customized.
The AI can broaden its search when not enough listings are found. This flexible approach has been shown to generate 30% more matches compared to traditional exact-match searches. If no new matches are available, no email will be sent - just like in the current system.
This strategy is specifically designed for
auto property alerts
, which are typically used when before you have identified your lead's specific search criteria. These alerts help drive leads back to the website and open the door to further conversations. Once you have spoken with the lead and understand their specific needs, you can set up a manual property alert using exact criteria.

#### Article 291: Configure Your Office AI Sales Agent

- Article ID: `46088402849819`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Sales Agent`
- Updated: `2026-01-30T21:20:17Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/46088402849819-Configure-Your-Office-AI-Sales-Agent

Introduction
Lofty's AI Sales Agent, powered by ChatGPT and Claude, is your dedicated lead capture, nurture, and conversion powerhouse in Lofty. In this Help Center article, we will go over the configuration of your Office AI Sales Agent.
To configure your Office AI Sales Agent settings, go to
Office Settings
>
Sales Agent
>
Sales Agent Settings
.
The Office AI Sales Agent is  at the Office level for all office / team add-ons. The Office-Level Sales Agent will power the chat box on the office Lofty website, and agent websites within the office, as well as text all
visible
leads matching the criteria you set. The Office-Level AI Sales Agent cannot work on agents' hidden leads.
Assistant Profile
In the Settings, you can adjust the appearance of your Sales Agent and the way that it interacts with leads. Please keep in mind that this AI is at the
Office
level, meaning these settings will be in effect for all agents within your office.
Communication Persona
We recommend utilizing “as an assistant” for office settings to ensure the assistant is communicating as an assistant for all agents, not as you, the office owner or admin.
Assistant Photo
Upload a photo to represent your assistant. We recommend a company logo or stock photo.
If you do
not,
the photo will auto populate with the image of whoever's website it is. So, if this was on agent A’s website it would show agent A’s photo but the assistant's name.
Assistant Name
We recommend giving your Sales Agent a different name from anyone on your team. This will help prevent confusion when it hands off warm leads to the actual agent.
Virtual Number
This is the phone number the Sales Agent will use when it is communicating via text with your leads. Texts sent from the AI's Virtual Number will not count against your text limit.
Assigning the number to a 10DLC campaign is
critical
for ensuring text deliverability.
Call Forwarding
Call Forwarding gives you the option to connect leads who call the Sales Agent to a live person. You can choose to disable, forward to the lead’s assigned agent, or forward to a dedicated number.
Sales Agent Working Strategy
The Assistant Working Strategy determines how your Sales Agent will communicate with your leads.
Engage Style
The Engage Style determines how frequently the AI will reach out to your leads.
You can choose between Proactive, Balanced, and Reserved.
If you'd like to learn more about how the AI interacts with leads, check out the
AI Assistant / Chatbot Qualification Process. (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056783971)
Handle Rental Inquiries
Use this dropdown to enable or disable rental inquiries.
When
enabled
, Sales Agent will attempt to complete the renter profile of the lead and recommend rental properties.
When
disabled
, the Sales Agent will gently let the lead know that your business does not handle rental inquiries. These leads will not count against your total lead quota.
Real Estate Experience
Use this box to enter a prompt to customize or coach your Sales Agent. Include information about yourself, your company, how long you've been in business, the tone you'd like your Sales Agent to use, and any other relevant information.
Sales Agent Enrollment
Leads Enrollment
These settings determine which leads the AI Sales Agent will engage.
Auto Enrollment
Automatically start the AI Sales Agent for eligible leads. Sales agent will be active when a lead is created to match the conditions.
Manual Enrollment
Manually start the AI Sales Agent for existing leads. You can select specific leads and activate the AI Sales Agent when you want more control over when follow-up beings.
Channel Enrollment
You can enable or disable individual channels, like chat or text, here.
All channels are turned ON by default. Use the radio button on the right side to toggle off or on different channels of communication for the AI Sales Agent:
Website Channel
This powers the chat experience on your Office website and all connected Agent Websites beneath it.
If the website chatbot is enabled, it will be installed on the website.
The AI Assistant
replaces
the Chat Box on your website, but it
does not
share settings. If you need to edit the Chat Box settings, please see this
article. (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038610171)
Text Channel
This enables the AI Sales Agent to text new and existing leads in your Lofty CRM.
Email Channel
This enables the Sales Agent to reply to emails sent to your Sending Email. For more information on Sending Email, check out
Sending Email Address. (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402367904397)
Facebook Channel
Connect your Facebook account to the AI Sales Agent to start receiving Facebook messages by your Sales Agent. Click
here (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360054759112-AI-Assistant-Facebook-Messenger-Whitelist-Only-)
to learn more.
Team Enrollment
All teams are turned to ANY by default. Use the drop-down options to add or remove different members.
Agent
Use this dropdown to enable/disable the AI Sales Agent for specific Agents in your office.
Office
Use this dropdown to enable/disable the AI Sales Agent for specific Teams/Offices in your organization.
Lead Pond
Use this dropdown to enable/disable the AI Sales Agent for specific Lead Ponds in your office.
Assistant Voice
Unknown Inbound Calls
If checked - the Inbound Call Handler will answer phone calls from phone numbers that do not belong to a lead in your CRM. Create your conversation strategy and let AI do the rest!
Voice Type
Choose your voice type (female or male) and hear a preview of the voice before settling
Receiving Number
Choose which number the AI will answer ( AI number, or personal number)
Applied Numbers
Choose between unknown callers, untouched leads, or both.
Active Hours
You can choose what hours the AI Sales Agent will be able to text your leads.
Note: Most communication from the AI Sales Agent is triggered by lead activities. Meaning, it will text leads when they take action on your website. Reducing the Active Hours could prevent the AI Sales Agent from texting your leads when they have website activity.
Active Days
You can choose which days the Sales Agent will be able to text your leads.
Interactive Steps
Actions & Conditions
Welcome Script - Create a welcome script for the AI Sales Agent to use when answering the call.
Actions – Choose what actions you want the AI to take under specific conditions
AI Prompts
Provide some prompts to help the AI Sales Agent communicate with callers
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at
<support@lofty.com (mailto:<support@lofty.com)
>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 292: Getting Started with AI Sales Agent

- Article ID: `39659584983067`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Sales Agent`
- Updated: `2026-04-14T21:16:40Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/39659584983067-Getting-Started-with-AI-Sales-Agent

Lofty's AI Sales Agent, powered by ChatGPT and Claude, is your dedicated lead capture, nurture, and conversion powerhouse in Lofty. In this Help Center article, we will go over setup-related topics such as purchase, configuration, and billing.
Summary
How does the AI Sales Agent Work? (#h_01K1H1SR1F3SK8A658XF10ENY7)
Activating Your AI Sales Agent (#h_01KKA4J7CMJVHVWDAQJCY79Z8P)
Configuring Your AI Sales Agent (#h_01K1V204HGGAAZMX6F2K3HV5PG)
How do Sales Agent Emails work? (#h_01K5VHK1YW4KCACF0PNHE8H18F)
Sales Agent Overview Page (#h_01K2JZBPVANFWMFZXT7A03FXX3)
How does Pricing work? (#h_01K2JZEBJJJ84H5B81MG5ZYD8C)
Managing your Sales Agent Quota (#h_01K2JZG27410P5KDK5VPTRVZT5)
How does the AI Sales Agent Work?
The Sales Agent is a multi-channel AI assistant that works across three channels simultaneously:
Channel
What the AI Sales Agent does
Website Chat
Powers the chat box on your Lofty website to engage and capture new visitors in real time.
Text (SMS)
Texts new leads as they arrive in Lofty CRM and follows up with existing leads when they meet your enrollment criteria.
Email
Reads and replies to emails sent to your configured Sending Email address, keeping conversations alive automatically.
The Sales Agent’s goal is to qualify leads, complete their profile, and hand off warm, ready-to-talk leads to the assigned agent.
The Sales Agent will not work on leads in the following situations:
The lead is a Hidden Lead (see
Lead Privacy: Company Leads vs. Personal Leads (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003544406)
), unless the individual agent has their own Sales Agent subscription.
The lead has a wrong number, DNC number, or landline phone number.
The lead had no phone number when first added to Lofty, even if a number is added later.
For more information on the Lofty Sales Agent qualification process, check out:
Sales Agent / Chatbot Qualification Process (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056783971)
Activating Your AI Sales Agent
The Sales Agent is activated through a streamlined one-step setup card. Here’s how to get started:
Step 1: Access the Sales Agent Page
Navigate to
AI Copilots > Sales Agent
in your Lofty CRM. If you have not yet activated Sales Agent, you will see a Branding Page with an activation card.
Step 2: Review the Digital Employees
Select the Sales Agent that best meets your needs.
Anna:
Speed to Lead Specialist
Anna has been the default Lofty Sales Agent - if you already set up your Sales Agent, you are working with Anna! Anna reaches out to all lead types.
Lucas:
Buyer Specialist
Lucas only auto-enrolls Buyer and Renter leads.
Lily:
Seller Specialist
Lily only auto-enrolls Seller leads.
Note:
Currently, the only difference between the digital employees are the auto-enrollment options. Their working strategies are the same.
Step 3: Activate
Once you’ve made your selection, click Hire. Your Sales Agent will begin working immediately according to their enrollment rules.
Company vs. Individual Sales Agent
Sales Agent is available at both the Company level and the individual Agent level.
Company-Level SA:
Works on all visible leads across your account. Powers the chat box on all Lofty websites and texts leads matching your enrollment criteria. Cannot access agents’ hidden leads.
Individual Agent SA:
Purchased by individual agents. Can work on their personal (hidden) leads.
Configuring Your AI Sales Agent
After initial activation, you can update any setting at any time by going to
AI Copilots > Sales Agent > Settings.
Assistant Profile
The Assistant Profile controls how your Sales Agent appears and communicates.
Assistant Name:
Give your Sales Agent a name that is different from any real team member. This prevents confusion when leads are handed off.
Virtual Number:
The phone number Sales Agent uses to text leads. Texts from this number do not count against your text limit. Assigning the number to a 10DLC campaign is critical for SMS deliverability.
Call Forwarding:
Optionally connect leads who call the virtual number to a live person. Options: Disabled, Forward to Assigned Agent, or Forward to a Custom Number.
Email Address:
The Sales Agent sends email from it's own email address that matches the Sales Agent's name and uses your sending domain.
Handle Rental Inquiries:
Enable to have Sales Agent qualify renters and recommend rental properties. Disable to have it politely decline rental inquiries — these leads will not count toward your quota.
Real Estate Experience:
Enter a custom prompt to coach the Sales Agent’s tone and personality. Include details like your market, years in business, team name, and communication style preferences.
Enrollment
Leads Enrollment
Enrollment settings define which leads the Sales Agent will work on. You can filter by:
Lead Source — Default is “Any.” Toggle individual sources to limit the Sales Agent to specific lead origins.
Lead Type — Default includes all types. Narrow to Buyers, Sellers, Renters, or Other.
Pipeline — Select which pipeline stages are eligible. All stages are included by default.
Agent — Enable or disable Sales Agent for specific agents in your organization.
Office — Enable or disable Sales Agent for specific teams or offices.
Lead Pond — Enable or disable Sales Agent for specific Lead Ponds.
Channel Enrollment
Toggle individual communication channels on or off. All channels are enabled by default.
Website Chat Box — Powers the chat experience on your Company website and all connected Agent websites. Note: The Sales Agent replaces the standard Chat Box widget but has its own independent settings.
Text Channel — Enables SMS follow-up for new and existing leads. You can set Active Hours (the time window SMS can be sent) and Active Days. Reducing active hours may limit the Sales Agent’s ability to respond to real-time lead activity.
Email Channel — Enables the Sales Agent to send and reply to emails.
Facebook Channel — Allows the Sales Agent to communicate via Facebook Messenger
Team Enrollment
Agent:
Use this dropdown to enable/disable Sales Agent for specific Agents in your organization.
Office:
Use this dropdown to enable/disable Sales Agent for specific Teams/Offices in your organization.
Lead Pond:
Use this dropdown to enable/disable Sales Agent for specific Lead Ponds in your organization.
How do Sales Agent Emails work?
Sales Agent has full context of your lead - from their search preferences, to any communication you or the Sales Agent have had with the lead. When a lead reaches out by email, the Sales Agent can reply to continue the conversation on your behalf. Sales Agent can respond to emails in 15 seconds.
You can enable or disable the email channel in Sales Agent Settings. The Sales Agent will read and respond to emails sent to the Sales Agent email address that is configured in its settings.
Here is a sample email sent from the Sales Agent:
Sales Agent Overview Page
The Sales Agent overview gives you clear insights into how AI is helping your business. You can also see all leads Sales Agent is actively working on and mute them directly on this page.
Total Engaged
: Number of leads contacted via text, chat, or email
Total Contacted
: Total outreach messages sent
Total Updated
: Number of times the Sales Agent automatically updated a lead’s information.
Saved Time & Cost
: See how much time and money you’ve saved
Lead Handoffs
: Track when Sales Agent flags leads for your attention
Lead Management
: View and mute leads directly from the reporting page
How does Pricing work?
You can choose the number of leads - or quota - that you would like the Sales Agent to be able to work. This simplifies the experience and gives you control over your cost and opportunities.
Your quota
does not reset monthly
. It is a running total of the leads that the Sales Agent is working on your behalf. You can increase or decrease your quota at any time.
The AI Sales Agent starts with 200 leads at $60 per month. Additional coverage can be added in increments of 100 leads ($30 per month).
Pricing is prorated based on the day of the month, but you will always receive the full lead amount. You will be charged the full amount in the following month.
How is usage calculated?
Any lead the AI Sales Agent has messaged is considered an engaged lead.
If you mute Sales Agent for a lead, either manually or using a Smart Plan, the lead will no longer be counted in the quota.
If the lead does not respond after 6 months of automatic follow-up, the lead will no longer be counted in the quota.
Managing your Sales Agent Quota
Any lead Sales Agent has messaged is considered an engaged lead. The Sales Agent will follow up with leads for 6 months by default. During this period, the lead will continue to count towards your quota (because the Sales Agent is still working on that lead).
If you mute the Sales Agent for a lead, either manually or using a Smart Plan, the lead will no longer be counted in the quota.
If the lead does not respond after 6 months of automatic follow-up, the lead will no longer be counted in the quota.
How to Apply or Mute Sales Agent
In the Lead Profile
You can click on the ellipses (...) to open the action menu and either mute or unmute the Sales Agent in the lead's profile.
Via Smart Plan
You can use a Smart Plan action to mass enable or disable the Sales Agent.
In Sales Agent Settings
You can view all leads the Sales Agent is engaged with, as well as recommended leads, in Sales Agent Settings. From here, you can mute currently-engaged leads and activate the Sales Agent on recommended leads.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: Sales Agent Settings, AI Sales Agent

#### Article 293: Sales Agent Smart Leads & Playbook Settings

- Article ID: `45951611704603`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Sales Agent`
- Updated: `2026-04-10T17:33:49Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/45951611704603-Sales-Agent-Smart-Leads-Playbook-Settings

Introduction
Summary
Playbook Settings (#h_01KG0KKC48YR6F3X4D15DV7Q1F)
Smart Leads View on People Page (#h_01KG0KRXM1JRBKYPT8YKKRH55P)
How to monitor the Sales Agent (#h_01EY4GH7VGYB45E2T9CT96M6WK)
Playbook Settings
The Playbook defines how Sales Agent engages with leads at each stage of their journey. Unlike one-size-fits-all automation, the Playbook uses a goal-based methodology similar to how experienced real estate agents work. Sales Agent adapts its strategy based on where each lead is in their decision-making process.
Where to Find Playbook Settings
Navigate to AI Copilots in the main menu
Select Sales Agent
Click on Settings
Select the Playbook tab
The Four Playbook Goals
The Playbook is organized around four sequential goals. Each goal represents a stage in the lead qualification and conversion process:
Goal 1: Capture Contact Details
Objective:
Convert anonymous website visitors into known leads by capturing their name and contact information.
When leads enter this goal:
New visitors who land on your website and haven't yet been created as leads in your CRM.
How Sales Agent works:
Proactive Welcome Message: Uses website chat box to send a friendly welcome message on the visitor's first visit
Instant Auto Reply: Answers visitor messages and asks for their name and contact information
What this goal delivers:
New Lead Created in CRM
Tag Applied to identify the lead
Call Task Assigned for agent follow-up
Goal 2: Clarify Intent & Preferences
Objective:
Turn vague interest into clear, actionable signals about what the lead is looking for.
Information gathered:
Buyer or seller intent
Timeline for purchase/sale
Budget range
Location or property criteria
How Sales Agent works:
Sends structured follow-up messages
Adjusts cadence based on lead engagement
Creates call tasks when human conversation would be valuable
Benefit:
When you step in to call the lead, you have full context on their preferences instead of starting from zero.
Goal 3: Win Appointment
Objective:
Make it easy for qualified leads to say "yes" to a meeting with you.
How Sales Agent works:
Appointment-focused outreach
Clear next-step suggestions
Stops automatically once an appointment is booked
Key point:
Sales Agent gets the lead ready and qualified; you close the loop by conducting the appointment.
Goal 4: Grow Long-Term Trust
Objective:
Maintain relationships with leads who aren't ready to act immediately, keeping you top-of-mind for when they are.
How Sales Agent works:
Low-touch, long-term follow-up sequences
Periodic check-ins to gauge readiness
Re-engages leads when they show renewed interest
Opportunity Behavior Playbook
In addition to the four goals, Sales Agent detects
Opportunity behaviors
—signals of strong interest or intent—and engages appropriately. These settings determine how the AI Sales Agent reacts to specific lead behaviors.
Behavior categories:
Missed Call: Lead attempted to call but didn't connect
Buyer Interest: Property views, saved listings, share listing requests, tour requests, saved searches, mortgage usage, form submissions
Seller Interest: Home evaluation requests
Back on Market: Return visits, new inquiries from past leads
How Each Goal Works
Each goal in the Playbook answers three key questions:
How does Sales Agent work in this stage? Is it doing proactive outreach or auto-reply only? What cadence and tone?
What does Sales Agent deliver? Tags, call tasks, appointments, and clear signals for agent intervention.
When does the lead move forward? What qualifies the lead for the next goal? What information must be clarified first?
This structure makes Sales Agent's behavior predictable and explainable—you always know what the AI is doing and why.
Customization Options
Within each goal, you can configure:
Whether proactive messaging is enabled
Which communication channels to use (text, email, website chat)
What tags are applied at each stage
When call tasks are created for agent follow-up
Smart Leads View on People Page
The Smart Leads view is a new tab on the People page that provides at-a-glance visibility into all leads being managed by Sales Agent. This view organizes leads into three priority categories, making it easy to understand which leads need your immediate attention and which ones are being actively nurtured by AI.
Where to Find Smart Leads
Navigate to the People page and look for the
Smart Leads
tab. The tab displays a count of leads in each category and is marked with an AI indicator.
Go to Sales in the main navigation
Click on All Leads or My Leads
Select the Smart Leads tab
Lead Status Categories
Smart Leads organizes leads into three categories based on their engagement level and required actions:
High Priority
What it means:
These are leads actively managed by Sales Agent that require your immediate action. The AI has identified an opportunity or task that needs human intervention.
Examples of required actions:
Making a phone call to a qualified lead
Handling an offline appointment
Updating lead information or preferences
What you see in this view:
Name, Inquiries, Tags: Same as the standard CRM Lead List
AI-Generated Summary: Quick context on the lead and their current status
Tasks: The most recent incomplete task (Call, Appointment, or Lead Update) created by AI
AI Suggestion: Helpful call-to-action buttons based on task type
AI Prospecting
What it means:
These are leads actively managed by Sales Agent that require no immediate action from you. The AI is actively working these leads through the qualification process.
Criteria:
Leads have shown activity within the past 30 days.
What you see in this view:
Name, Last Visit, Activities: Same as the standard CRM Lead List
AI-Generated Summary: Context on recent engagement and lead preferences
AI Next Step: The most recent incomplete task in the AI's follow-up plan
AI Goal: The Playbook goal the AI is currently working toward
AI Suggestions: Always shows "Call with AI Script" CTA
Tip:
Clicking "Call with AI Script" generates a custom call script based on the lead summary and current AI goal.
AI Monitoring
What it means:
These are leads that require no immediate action and have not shown activity in the last 30 days. Sales Agent continues low-touch, long-term follow-up to re-engage these leads.
Criteria:
Leads have had no activity within the past 30 days.
What you see in this view:
Name, Score, Last Touch: Same as the standard CRM Lead List
AI-Generated Summary: Overview of the lead's current status
AI Nurturing Plan: Shows how the AI is re-engaging inactive leads
Calls Made: Number of calls already made to the lead
Benefits of Smart Leads View
Clarity: Instantly see which leads need your attention versus which ones are being handled by AI
Efficiency: Understand what needs to be done without digging through lead details
Actionable: Complete tasks right away using AI-generated suggestions and scripts
Best Practices
Prioritize High Priority leads: These leads have been qualified by AI and are ready for human engagement. Responding promptly avoids missed opportunities.
Monitor AI Prospecting progress: Check in on these leads periodically to see how the AI is progressing toward appointment setting.
Use the AI Script feature: When calling leads, use the AI-generated script for context-aware talking points.
Let AI handle monitoring: Leads in AI Monitoring don't need your attention unless they re-engage or are escalated to High Priority.
How to monitor the Sales Agent
The Sales Agent is designed to notify you when a conversation is out of their scope or is making great progress and ready for your involvement. If you want to make sure things are going well, you can monitor the active leads that the Sales Agent is working on, qualifying.
A few notes regarding permissions:
All users have access to monitor conversations on the chat list and the lead detail page
of leads assigned to them
.
The Team Owner/Admin and users with the “Access All Team Leads” permission (see
Team permissions (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055290451)
) are only able to monitor conversations on the lead detail page, but it is not visible on their chat list unless the leads are assigned to them.
To monitor conversations, click the
Workspace
icon, then click
AI
This will take you to the AI Sales Assistant Following conversations.
In this section, you can:
View all active text and website chat conversations the AI is having
"Mute" the conversation (keep the Sales Agent from qualifying the lead)
Type in your own message to take over the conversation
*IMPORTANT
: Please note the following:
When clicking the "Mute" option, you are
stopping
the Sales Agent. You can unmute the Sales Agent at any time by clicking on the ellipses in the lead's profile, followed by
Unmute AI Sales Assistant
.
Please also note that any form of manual communication (making a phone call, sending a text message, or sending an email) will also take over from the Sales Agent. This does
not
include automatic content sent out via Smart Plans.
What if a lead unsubscribes on a Sales Agent email?
If a lead clicks the unsubscribe option on an email sent by the Sales Agent, they will only unsubscribe from emails sent from the sales agent's email address. The lead can still be sent other automated emails, smart plan emails, and manual emails. The Sales Agent can also still send text messages to the lead.
If the lead is moved into the Do Not Contact (DNC) pipeline stage, they will automatically be unsubscribed from all communications from the Sales Agent.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 294: Sales Agent Virtual Number

- Article ID: `47108878161435`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Sales Agent`
- Updated: `2026-02-25T21:38:15Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/47108878161435-Sales-Agent-Virtual-Number

Introduction
The Sales Agent uses a dedicated virtual phone number to send texts. The Sales Agent displays a reminder when the virtual number has not been selected or cannot be used, so you can take action right away.
How to Identify a Problem with the Sales Agent's Number
You may see an "AI virtual number unavailable" notice in the following situations:
The virtual number has not yet been provisioned for your account
There is an active porting or carrier registration issue with the number
Your calling/texting package has expired or reached its usage limit
The number is temporarily suspended due to a billing issue
The number is not linked to a 10DLC campaign
What the Notice Looks Like
When the AI virtual number is unavailable, you will see a yellow warning banner at the top of the Sales Agent panel:
"Your AI virtual number is currently unavailable. Sales Agent calling and texting are paused. Please contact support or check your account settings to resolve this."
How to Resolve the Issue
Depending on the cause, take one of the following steps:
Provisioning issue
: Select a virtual phone number for the Sales Agent.
Billing issue
:Go to
Billing Center → Payment Methods
, update your payment information, then click the banner to restore service.
Porting/carrier issue
:Contact Lofty Support and reference your virtual number or account ID.
10DLC Campaign Issue
: If a campaign is available, select it from the drop down menu. If there is no campaign, one must be created. Learn more here:
How to Register for A2P 10DLC (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/34198619150363)
Will Sales Agent Continue Working Without a Virtual Number?
Partially. Sales Agent requires a valid virtual number to send texts on behalf of the agent. While the number is unavailable:
Sales Agent texting will be
disabled
Email outreach through Sales Agent will
continue normally
(email does not require a virtual number)
Frequently Asked Questions
My virtual number was working before, why is it suddenly unavailable?
The most common causes are a lapsed billing cycle, a package upgrade that requires a new number assignment, or a carrier-level registration renewal. Contact Lofty Support with your account ID and we will investigate.
Can my leads still reach me while the virtual number is unavailable?
Yes. Leads can still contact you through your personal agent number. Only Sales Agent's AI-initiated calls and texts are affected.
How long does it take to restore a virtual number?
Most provisioning and billing issues are resolved within 1 business day. Carrier-level porting issues may take 2–5 business days.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 295: Sales Agent: Meet Your Digital Employee

- Article ID: `48973695962523`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Sales Agent`
- Updated: `2026-04-14T13:56:05Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/48973695962523-Sales-Agent-Meet-Your-Digital-Employee

Introduction
Sales Agent has evolved. Rather than configuring a generic AI tool, you now hire a Digital Employee — a named AI specialist with a defined role, skill set, and follow-up strategy tailored to the types of leads you work with most.
You can choose from three pre-built agents or build your own from scratch. Once hired, your Digital Employee goes to work immediately: engaging new leads, sending follow-ups, and keeping your pipeline moving — without you having to lift a finger.
Note: The digital employee is currently only available to newly purchased Sales Agent packages. If you have already set up your Sales Agent, you are working with Anna!
Meet Your Digital Employees
Three specialized agents are available in the Marketplace. Each one is designed around a different lead type and follow-up focus:
Agent
Role
Auto-Enrollment Default
Anna
Speed-to-Lead Specialist
All new leads (Buyer, Seller, Renter, Other)
Lucas
Buyer Specialist
Buyer leads only
Lily
Seller Specialist
Seller leads only
💡  Tip:
Not sure which agent to hire? Anna is a great starting point — she works across all lead types and is the most versatile choice for general-purpose follow-up.
Getting Started
Step 1: Open the Sales Agent Marketplace
Navigate to Sales Agent in your Lofty account. If you have not yet hired an agent, you will land on the Marketplace — a page displaying the three available Digital Employees, plus a Build Your Own option.
Each agent card shows the agent's name, role, and a short description. Hover over any card to see the agent's first-person pitch and a list of their skill tags.
Step 2: View an Agent Profile
Click any agent card to open their full Agent Profile. This page gives you everything you need to evaluate whether the agent is the right fit before committing.
Left panel:
Agent name, role, and supported communication channels (Email, Text/SMS, Website Chat)
Key performance stats
A Hire button
Your available follow-up quota (shown before hiring)
A count of how many other agents have hired this Digital Employee
Right panel:
About — a description of the agent's approach and methodology
Skills — a list of specific capabilities the agent uses during follow-up
Step 3: Hire Your Agent
When you are ready, click Hire on the Agent Profile page. A brief deployment sequence will run, confirming your agent is fully configured and connected:
Step
Action
What's Happening
1
Initializing Workspace
Setting up your agent's environment
2
Configuring Channels
Enabling Email, Text/SMS, and Website Chat
3
Loading AI Model
Activating intelligent response capabilities
4
Connecting to CRM
Syncing with your Lofty lead database
5
Activating Channels
Finalizing Email, Text, and Chat activation
The entire process takes about 4 seconds. Once complete, your agent's follow-up quota is activated and you are taken to the Overview page where you can monitor activity.
Build Your Own Agent
Prefer a fully customized approach? Select Build Your Own from the Marketplace to create an agent tailored to your specific communication style and business needs.
You will define:
Agent name — give your agent a name that feels right for your brand
Description — this becomes the agent's persona and guides how it communicates with leads
Channels — choose which of Email, Text/SMS, and Website Chat your agent uses (all three are enabled by default)
Click Create & Hire Agent to launch the same deployment flow as the pre-built agents. Your custom agent will be ready in seconds.
💡  Tip:
The description you write acts as your agent's core instructions. Be specific about tone, priorities, and any key talking points you want the agent to use when reaching out to leads.
Understanding Auto-Enrollment
Each pre-built agent comes pre-configured with a default Auto-Enrollment setting that determines which new leads are automatically enrolled for AI follow-up after hiring.
Anna enrolls all new leads — Buyer, Seller, Renter, and Other.
Lucas enrolls Buyer leads only.
Lily enrolls Seller leads only.
You can adjust these defaults at any time in your agent's Settings after hiring. Auto-enrollment only applies to new leads created after your agent is hired — existing leads are not automatically enrolled.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I hire more than one agent?
Currently, one Digital Employee can be active at a time. If you hire a different agent, it replaces your current one. Your previous agent's settings and activity history are preserved.
What communication channels does my agent use?
By default, all three channels are active: Email, Text/SMS, and Website Chat. You can adjust which channels are enabled in your agent's Settings at any time after hiring.
Is my agent active immediately after hiring?
Yes. Once the 4-second deployment completes, your agent is live and will begin engaging newly enrolled leads right away.
What is the follow-up quota?
Your quota determines how many AI-powered follow-ups your agent can send per billing period. The quota amount shown on the Agent Profile reflects your current plan. Freemium accounts include 10 free follow-ups. Paid plan quotas vary by bundle.
Can I edit my agent's settings after hiring?
Yes. After hiring, you can update your agent's name, description, channels, and Auto-Enrollment defaults from the Settings page within Sales Agent.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 296: Unknown Inbound Call Handler

- Article ID: `26120207659291`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Sales Agent`
- Updated: `2026-02-11T20:31:57Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/26120207659291-Unknown-Inbound-Call-Handler

Introduction
Say goodbye to missed opportunities and hello to seamless communication! The Unknown Inbound Call Handler will answer incoming calls from unknown numbers and leads that you have not communicated with yet. It's like having a dedicated team member who works tirelessly to ensure that no lead goes untouched.
Setting up the Inbound Call Handler
In order to use the Inbound Call Handler you must have an AI Sales Agent package. Navigate to the Sales Agent settings and select
Voice.
Check the box next to
Unknown Inbound Calls
to allow the handler to answer incoming calls on your behalf.
Settings
Voice Type
Select either a Male or Female voice
Receiving Number
This is the phone number that the handler is answering. By default, this will be the AI Sales Agent's virtual phone number, but any virtual phone number is available.
Applied Numbers
The handler will not answer calls from leads that you have communicated with before. Here, you will select what calls the handler will answer:
Untouched Leads = Phone numbers that belong to a lead in the CRM that you have not spoken with before.
Unknown Caller = Phone numbers that do not belong to any lead in the CRM.
Active Hours and Active Days
These are the times that the handler is answering calls, the same as this setting elsewhere in the CRM.
Interactive Steps
Actions & Conditions
This is the handler's welcome script that it reads upon answering the call. The Actions define how the handler should react on the call.
AI Prompts
This is a detailed flow that tells the handler how it should behave. If you edit this flow, the Actions & Conditions will not longer be available, as too many customizations will confuse the AI.
Remember, the handler's goal is to collect information and determine who is calling, it cannot hold a conversation with the caller.
Check the box at the bottom of the page to add the caller to the CRM as a lead. Whatever information the Voice Bot was able to obtain will be available on the lead detail page.
You can test the Inbound Call Handler by calling from your bridge/personal cell phone number. When you call the receiving number at the top of the settings from the number provided at the bottom of the settings, you can test the handler's actions without altering any lead data in the CRM.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 297: Security and Account Access

- Article ID: `8814830989211`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Security and Account Access`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T06:02:11Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/8814830989211-Security-and-Account-Access

Introduction
The security of your Lofty account is of utmost importance. We have implemented a few security measures to help you protect your account.
Security Settings
Navigate to
Settings -> User -> Security
to access your Lofty account security settings.
For the Sensitive Action, after selecting this setting, you will be required to verify 2FA for the following actions:
Editing Agent Information
Deleting an Agent
Editing Agent Permissions
Password Reset
Here, you can easily reset your Lofty account password. Please note that you will need to know your current password to reset it here. If you do not know your password, you can request a reset on the Lofty login page.
Two-factor authentication (2FA)
We offer Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) as an added level of security. If you check the box next to
Require Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
, we will text a verification code to your phone number or email a verification code to your email address each time you log in to your Lofty account. Your Lofty account email address and password will be added here as a 2FA verification method. You can also add another phone number or email address.
Account Access
To provide support to you, Lofty employees may need to access your Lofty account. If you are contacting the Lofty support team, please be sure to check the box next to
Allow Lofty to assume access to your account for support purposes
so that our team can best assist you.
FAQ
Q: I did not choose any of the options for 2FA, but it prompted me to verify using another number I have not listed. Where did you get this number?
A: The system will use the integrated mailbox and outbound call number in the dialer settings as your account's default MFA, which is the current product logic.
Questions?

### Section: Showing Management (Web & App)

#### Article 299: Listing Showing Management

- Article ID: `18596161600027`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Showing Management (Web & App)`
- Updated: `2025-12-10T01:07:01Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/18596161600027-Listing-Showing-Management

Introduction
The Showing Tool offers a comprehensive solution for handling various aspects of showings and is designed to enhance the efficiency of both listing agents and buyer agents in managing their showing schedules.
From a Buyer Listing Agent's Perspective:
The Showing Tool encompasses a range of functionalities, including managing showing requests, scheduling showing appointments, and coordinating buyer tours. This documentation will guide buyer agents through utilizing these features to streamline their showing-related tasks.
From a Listing Agent's Perspective:
For listing agents, the Showing Tool primarily focuses on the management of showing appointments. This documentation will provide insights into how listing agents can leverage the tool to efficiently organize and oversee the scheduling of property showings.
Additional information regarding Listing Management can be found in our
Smart Listings (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4410497918107)
Help Center article.
Summary
Accessing the Showing Management Tool (#h_01H9R9XH1EQSDCHX3ECA7ZY5WV)
Buyer Agent's Perspective (#h_01H9RBGKDY688R95JQX365X87X)
Listing Agent's Perspective (#h_01H9RBGKDYFSS3WA6SDGPSB5W8)
Non-Lofty Agent Perspective (#h_01HAARKD9C5HXX73NW8DBC7XKT)
Accessing the Showing Management Tool
To manage your showings, navigate to the
Calendar
and select
Showings/ Tours
.
The left side panel allows you to navigate to your own or your team members ' requested, pending, approved, completed, and canceled showings. To view your team member's showings, you must have the
Manage User permission
enabled on your Lofty account.
The calendar on the dashboard prominently displays your showings with different status indicators. This makes it easy to differentiate between upcoming, confirmed, and completed showings, ensuring you stay organized at a glance.
By clicking on the tab in the upper-right corner, you can seamlessly switch to the Listing Agent view, which focuses primarily on listing agent-related functions.
Buyer Agent's Perspective
First, we will look at the Showing Management Tool from the perspective of an agent working with a Buyer lead to purchase a home.
Managing Showing Requests
When a Buyer lead requests to see a home, their request can be addressed either on the Lofty calendar or the lead's detail page.
On the Lofty calendar, filter by Showing Requests by either clicking "Showing Requests" in the side panel or selecting "Showing Requests" from the Status menu.
Clicking on the lead's name will open the lead's detail page. Hovering over the lead's name offers the following actions:
Call Lead (if the lead has a valid phone number, opted into calls)
Text Lead (if the lead has a valid phone number, opted into texts)
Email Lead (if the lead has a valid email address, opted into emails)
The Showing Request can be accepted or deleted by clicking the option on the request card.
The showing request can also be addressed on the lead's profile.
When accepting the showing, the first step is to select the date and time. This is optimized to match the lead's requested showing date.
The next step is to contact the Listing Agent to acquire the access code. Once acquired, enter in the Access Instructions box to confirm the showing:
Once the showing is approved, the request status will update to
Approved
.
If the requested showing listing has been sold, it will be marked with a red Sold banner, and the option to accept the showing request will be removed. If the showing is approved, it will automatically be canceled, and all participants will be notified via email. Scheduled showings can also be manually canceled by clicking
Cancel
on the showing card. When a showing appointment is canceled, the following will occur:
Confirm Cancellation:
After clicking "Cancel," you may be prompted to confirm the cancellation. Confirm your decision to cancel the showing appointment.
Email Notification:
Once you confirm the cancellation, the Lofty system will automatically send an email notification to the listing agent, informing them of the cancellation.
Updated Showing Status:
The showing status for that particular appointment will change to "Cancelled" in the system, reflecting the cancellation of the showing appointment.
Submitting Showing Requests to the Listing Agent
If the listing agent has configured a showing schedule for their listing, you have the option to request a showing directly from the Listing Discovery page.
Once you've identified a suitable listing, click the "Book a Showing" button. A booking page will allow you to choose from the available showing time slots. Lofty will automatically send a showing request email to the listing agent on your behalf. A new entry will be added to your buyer leads showing calendar, indicating a pending showing request for that specific listing.
Showings can also be requested via the mobile web browser. This feature is available to Lofty and non-Lofty users.
Managing Buyer Tours
For detailed instructions on creating and managing a home tour for your buyer leads, please see our Help Center article,
Buyer Home Tour (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/13186756281243)
.
You can conveniently access and customize your buyer tours within the "My Buyers" section.
Here, you'll find a snapshot of your tour route, along with a count of the listings included in the tour. Additionally, you'll have access to the following essential tour details:
Tour Name:
Simply click on the tour name to navigate to the tour's dedicated landing page.
Time:
The scheduled start and end time for the tour.
Lead Information:
Click on the lead's name to navigate to the lead's detail page.
Listing Agent's Perspective
Next, we will look at the Showing Management Tool from the perspective of an agent working with a Seller lead to sell their home.
Configuring the Showing Schedule
To configure the showing options for your listing, first, navigate to
Listings → My Listings → Manage Listing:
If this is the first time setting up the Showing Configuration for this listing, click the
Showing Configuration
button in the upper-right corner. If you are editing the showing configuration, click
Actions → Showing Configuration
:
Here, you may set up the showing details, such as the available times, whether approvals are done manually or automatically, and any information the buyer's agent will need to access the property:
When complete, click
Save
to confirm the details.
The scheduling link is located in the upper right corner of the Showing Configuration page. Click the icon to copy the link. This link may be shared in the
MLS private notes
for interested buyers' agents to access. When clicking the showing request link, all agents, whether they are Lofty users or not, may request to show the listing. Here is an example showing the request page:
The ASAP option for showing requests has been removed from the website.
OLD UI
NEW UI
Approving and Denying Appointments
The requested showing time will now be displayed in multiple locations related to the showing request:  record:
A. Lead Details Page [App and PC]
B. Lead Timeline [App and PC]
C. Calendar [App & PC]
D. Showing Dashboard [PC]
E. Showing Request [App]
F. Email Notification
Non-Lofty Agent Perspective
When non-Lofty users request a showing time via the link, they will be prompted to sign up for Lofty's property showing feature:
Once an account has been created, non-Lofty users can create their own showing links by clicking
+ Create Showing Link
:
The showing configuration steps are the same as for Lofty users.
Non-Lofty users also have a dashboard to approve and deny showing requests, as well as track their own scheduled showings. At this time, there is no landing page for non-Lofty users to access this tool. They must register via the Lofty user's Schedule a Showing link.
Questions?

### Section: Social Studio

#### Article 301: Social Media Account Troubleshooting Guide

- Article ID: `18315075779483`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Social Studio`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T02:17:33Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/18315075779483-Social-Media-Account-Troubleshooting-Guide

Introduction
Lofty employs access tokens, provided by the respective networks, to link with your social accounts. When these tokens expire or become invalid, your social media accounts will disconnect and must be reconnected. This generates a new token.
Each social network has its own security policies. If certain actions are detected on an account, the network may expire its token, disconnecting the account from Lofty.
Like other third-party partners, Lofty adheres to these security measures. Often, these are more strict than what you encounter on the social network itself. Disconnections might be frustrating but they're enacted to ensure your protection.
Summary
Token Expiration (#TroubleshootingWhySocialAccountsDisconnect-Tokenexpiration)
Account setting changes that result in disconnection (#h_01H8YJEC44JS4VDRR0RWSFFVBP)
Security measures that result in disconnection (#h_01H8YJEKMCR140QXA2RX13133K)
Token lifespans for each social network (#h_01H8YJEXN8FD1PVNY19CCDHQH8)
Top disconnection reasons (#TroubleshootingWhySocialAccountsDisconnect-Topdisconnectionreasons)
Token Expiration
Account setting changes that result in disconnection
Lofty relies on settings you maintain in each social network. Making changes in a social network, such as Twitter or Instagram, can result in your account disconnecting from Lofty. Here are some changes that cause disconnections:
Changing your username or password.
For example, if you sign in to Facebook and change your password, your Facebook account will disconnect from Lofty.
Revoking Lofty’s access to your social account.
Social accounts have settings that list which apps have permission to connect to your social account. Lofty must remain on that list if you want to publish to that social account from Lofty.
If you manually revoke Lofty access from the social account settings, your account will disconnect from Lofty.
If the user who added a social account to Lofty loses their Admin status or access to the page, the account will disconnect from Lofty.
Security measures that result in disconnection
To keep your social account secure, a social network might disconnect the account from Lofty when it identifies certain behaviors. The following behaviors are likely to get flagged and should be avoided as a best practice:
Using alias usernames that don’t appear to be real names.
Logging in with the same account credentials from different IP addresses. In other words, sharing logins between users or devices.
Publishing content that gets flagged for copyright violations or other inappropriate content.
Token lifespans for each social network
Tokens from each social network may have built-in expiration dates, so that access is not granted forever. Disconnection can be expected based on each social network’s authentication policy:
Facebook and Instagram Business:
Tokens for these social networks have a 60-day lifespan.
LinkedIn
: Tokens for this social network has a 365-day lifespan.
Twitter
: This social network does not issue tokens with expiration dates, so it should not need re-authentication.
Google My Business:
Tokens for this social network has a 365-day lifespan.
YouTube
: YouTube shouldn't need re-authentication, since these tokens refresh each time they are used to collect data from the network.
Top disconnection reasons
Facebook and Instagram Business
1. Facebook password or security alert:
Most common reason for disconnection.
Caused by updating your Facebook password or suspicious login attempts.
Recommendations:
Use your real name on Facebook.
Avoid sharing your account credentials.
Enable Facebook alerts for unrecognized logins.
2. Facebook access revoked:
Disconnection occurs if Lofty is removed from authorized connections.
Revoking access can be a troubleshooting step.
Be sure you understand consequences before revoking access.
3. Facebook security checkpoint:
Triggered if Facebook suspects account security compromise.
Follow provided instructions to complete the security check.
Clear browser cookies and history if encountering issues.
4. Facebook token expired:
Disconnection when token reaches expiration date.
Tokens expire every 60 days for security.
Regularly reconnect to get a new token.
5. Insufficient Page role:
Need Admin or Editor role to connect a Facebook Page.
Role changes or removal can cause disconnection.
Ensure Page Admins maintain necessary access.
6. Unconfirmed Facebook account:
Resolve Facebook issues before reconnecting to Lofty.
7. Lofty lacks Page permissions:
Lofty missing required permissions for actions.
Grant all necessary permissions during setup.
Permissions can be revoked in Facebook settings.
LinkedIn Token Expiration
LinkedIn provides tokens for Lofty to access your account securely.
Tokens have built-in expiration dates to prevent indefinite access.
When a token expires, your LinkedIn account, including your profile and Pages, disconnects from Lofty.
LinkedIn tokens expire every 365 days.
Reconnecting annually is necessary to get a new token and confirm Lofty's access.
1. Inactive Account Token Expiration:
LinkedIn expires tokens for inactive accounts.
If you haven't used LinkedIn within Lofty (engaged with LinkedIn stream, published, or loaded Inbox) in the last 60 days, your token will expire.
2. LinkedIn Access Revoked:
Lofty is authorized as a permitted service when linked to LinkedIn.
If Lofty is removed from LinkedIn's Permitted services, access is revoked, and the LinkedIn account disconnects from Lofty.
Revoking access can be a troubleshooting step to start fresh before reconnecting.
3. Insufficient Access:
To connect a LinkedIn Page, you need to be a LinkedIn Super admin of that Page.
Removal from the Admin list disconnects the Page from Lofty.
Ensure all LinkedIn Page admins know the authorizing account.
4. Restricted Profile:
LinkedIn restricts accounts violating its acceptable use policies.
Restrictions could be temporary or permanent based on the violation.
Regain access to resolve the restriction and reconnect with Lofty.
Tips to Avoid LinkedIn Restrictions
Don't create multiple accounts if one is restricted; LinkedIn permits only one account per user.
Follow LinkedIn's Professional Community Policies and User Agreement.
Spread activity over days if performing numerous actions (e.g., searches, views, requests).
Test different browsers if unusual activity is detected.
Review LinkedIn's account security best practices.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Introduction
Group Text in Lofty allows you to create a shared SMS thread with multiple participants, including leads, vendors, and team members. All replies are visible to everyone in the thread, making it easy to coordinate follow-up and keep conversations organized.
Summary
How to Create a Group Text (#h_01KJT7454JG3703MZK6000X0TR)
Managing a Group Text Thread (#h_01KJT7EEDX329GC1F8XKWEE1FC)
Group Text Billing (#h_01HVS5TG4QFJYD5MKZ7V0HNDM7)
How to Create a Group Text
Go to a lead's profile and click
Text
Click the
+ icon
to create a
New Group Text
Add leads:
the lead and family members you want to include in the thread
Only the selected lead and their family members can be included in the group text.
Add agent virtual numbers:
select one or more agent virtual numbers to include in the conversation
Type your message and click
Send
Tip:
All agents whose virtual numbers are included in the thread will be able to see and respond to messages in the conversation.
Managing a Group Text Thread
Viewing the thread:
All participants (leads and agents) can see the full message history
Replying:
Any agent in the thread can reply on behalf of their virtual number
Adding participants:
Currently, participants must be added when the thread is created
Leaving a thread:
Contact Lofty Support if you need to remove a participant from an active group text
Group Text Billing
Each Lofty text message package has an allocated number of text messages that are available to be sent each month. Learn more about this here:
Billing, Usage, and Availability for Call/Text Packages (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360059754912)
. Please be mindful that you may hit your allocated number of text messages sooner than you typically do. The number of text messages sent each month is calculated as follows:
Each text message sent counts towards your monthly allocation.
Example 1: If you send one (1) text message to one (1) number, this counts as one (1) towards your allocation.
Example 2: If you send one (1) text message to a group text with three (3) other numbers, this will count as three (3) towards your allocation.
Now, if one of the numbers involved in the group text responds to the group text, you will have three (3) more text messages towards your monthly allocation. This is because you were the group text initiator, so you are responsible for all text messages sent by yourself
and
by the others in the group text.
Example 3: If you are involved in a group text, but did not initiate the group text, only the text messages that you send will count towards your monthly allocation. This is because you are not the initiator of the group text.
