Introduction
MMS stands for "Multimedia Messaging Service." As related to Lofty, MMS-enabled accounts will have the ability to send media content (pictures, GIFs) in messages instead of just text content.
Summary
Requirements (#h_01FGSK3SKGWR3H8YMYQ2QYHN49)
Cost (#h_01FGSK3WGBJMRKBA1NMNM67VX3)
Limitations (#h_01FGSK6H9C7P8S61VMXQ237C2S)
Technical Limitations (#ChimeBetaMMSProductNotes-TechnicalLimitations)
Other Limitations (#ChimeBetaMMSProductNotes-OtherLimitations)
How it Works (#ChimeBetaMMSProductNotes-HowitWorks)
Sending MMS Messages (#h_01FGSM0A2GREEWEE69DVJVK85K)
Viewing Images (#h_01FGSM0E4P01JJ23P220235A73)
FAQs (#h_01FGYJVBEBGDYPX8F0R8E25MSE)
Requirements
The MMS functionality will only be available to users who have an active text message package with us. For more information regarding text packages, please see
Billing, Usage, and Availability for Call/Text Packages (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360059754912)
.
Cost
There is no separate package for MMS functionality to be enabled as long as you meet the requirements outlined above.
Please Note
- sending
one
MMS is equivalent to sending
three
SMS. In other words, if you send one MMS message, it will count as three SMS messages on your daily usage.
Limitations
Technical Limitations
Supported file types to be sent via MMS
JPG
PNG
GIF
Supported file types to be received via MMS
JPG
PNG
GIF
Video Messages*
Multi-Image Messages
Maximum Number of Images per message
1
Maximum Image File Size
JPG/PNG = 5 MB
GIF = 900 KB
*The vendor used for MMS support will automatically compress incoming video files from carriers. The video file size will not exceed 2MB.
< 1MB: Previews
1MB - 100MB:  Links
> 100MB: Cannot be sent.
Other Limitations
MMS can only be sent to ONE lead at a time–meaning
no
mass texts, group texts, auto texts, etc.
If a lead sends you an MMS message with more than one image in that message, only the first image will populate in Lofty.
Whenever a new number is added or changed on your account, please note that the MMS functionality has to be manually configured per number meaning it will
not
work immediately–the turnaround time will vary but will be added ASAP. Please communicate with the Lofty Support Team (support@lofty.com) if you change or add another qualifying text package or change to a new virtual number and request MMS support as part of the beta program. They will submit a ticket on your behalf.
How it Works
Sending MMS Messages
As outlined above, an MMS can only be sent to one lead manually–auto texts, group texts, and mass texts are not currently supported. So, click on any option in the CRM to send a text to one specific lead and the following options will be available to add an image:
Once the
Image
icon or the
Select Image
link is clicked, it will open up a browser on your computer to find a file. You can only send one at a time. The image will then be added to your message, ready to send:
Viewing Images
Media content can be viewed from the side message window or a lead profile. Once clicked, they will preview in a larger pop-up.
FAQs
Do inbound AND outbound messages count against the limit for MMS? (#h_01FGYJWWZHVT16G4B4VNF67FY2)
Do size limitations apply to both inbound and outbound messages? (#h_01FGYK2A8CNZZZ82PRZSSRPVMJ)
Are group messages supported? (#h_01FGYK6BAVJN8K05C4RV9QPFKQ)
Are Video MMS supported? (#h_01GT2CB8K2JB4V04SR30C274CM)
Are both inbound and outbound MMS messages supported? (#h_01FGYK6F127Z2QF2FB4ADY0PJ1)
Do inbound AND outbound messages count against the limit for MMS?
Only outbound messages will be counted toward usage.
Do size limitations apply to both inbound and outbound messages?
Outbound messages are limited as outlined above under
Technical Limitations
. Inbound messages may see some compression but the content should not be missed due to this compression.
Are group messages supported?
No. Not at the present time.
Are Video MMS supported?
This is still in Beta.
Are both inbound
and
outbound MMS messages supported?
Yes. Both inbound and outbound MMS messages are supported.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 309: Text Templates

- Article ID: `4402878822285`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Texting`
- Updated: `2025-12-08T08:00:01Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402878822285-Text-Templates

Introduction
Use Lofty to create text templates that you want to have easy access to in the future. You can build out responses that you find yourself having to repeat over and over again or put together a template that you want to use in a mass text or Smart Plan. All of these are available options.
Summary
Accessing Text Templates (#h_01F7YMSE6VYV5S50BM9A2T5ZKK)
Setting Up Text Templates (#h_01F7YMSJHASZVES49PMT4FZJS5)
Auto Welcome Text (#h_01F7YMSSCNMCRNM5TW788653T3)
Text Templates (#h_01F7YMTN9WQ4F0QTF0DVYVTSTN)
My Text Templates (#h_01F7YNGSN6HQ474FC8E2SXDFS2)
Team Text Templates (#h_01F7YNGXWNCD19F9Q7D2BWM0BC)
Using Text Templates (#h_01F7YMSXNHSYYFN746XVSQ0F81)
Accessing Text Templates
To access your text templates, go to
Marketing
>
Text Messages
>
Templates
:
Setting Up Text Templates
Welcome Text
The Welcome Text is a way to automatically text your leads when they first enter your database, when you turn on the toggle button. Any welcome texts built out here are unique to your specific user account and are not shared with others on the team.
*IMPORTANT
: If enabled, this Welcome Text will be sent to leads from
all
incoming lead sources (i.e., Zillow, Realtor.com, etc.), and it cannot be customized to trigger only for specific sources. If you would like a "welcome text" for specific sources, we recommend using Smart Plan auto texts for that purpose.
Click on
+ Add
to add a new welcome text. Each welcome text can have a defined time range. So, you could create a welcome text that triggers after hours to let people know you will reach out the next day. If a lead enters the CRM at a time when no corresponding time range is set, no welcome text will be sent to them.
You can also utilize a previously built text template as well as image and variable options (see
Email and Text Variables (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055270071)
). Type your message and click on
Save
if you have finished.
Use the
on/off switch
to enable or disable a certain auto text, the
edit
option to edit an existing auto text, and then
delete
if you would like to remove an auto welcome text.
With auto welcome texts configured, any new incoming leads that are assigned to you will receive the welcome text, regardless of source, as long as they are within the defined time range.
Text Templates
These are standard text templates that, once created, can be utilized in a variety of ways throughout the Lofty platform (outlined below in
Using Text Templates (#h_01F7YMSXNHSYYFN746XVSQ0F81)
). There are two types of text templates.
My Text Templates
Text templates added here will only be visible and accessible to you as an individual user. They are
not
intended to be shared with others on your team. On the main page, you can preview your templates as well as
edit
or
delete
them if you would like.
Click on the
+ Add
to create a new template that only you can access:
You can add new content or pull in content from an existing template that has already been created. With text templates, we recommend setting up variables (see
Email and Text Variables (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055270071)
) so that you can easily use them with many different leads but still make them personal.
Company and Office Text Templates
These sections are the same as "My Text Templates" except that these templates are accessible to all users in the Company/Office. However, only those who have been given the permission (see
Permissions (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360055290451)
) will have the option to create, edit, or delete these templates. All other users in the Company/Office can still
use
these templates!
Using Text Templates
You are able to use text templates anywhere a text message can be sent in the Lofty platform. This includes (but is not limited to) the following:
Lead detail/profile page
People Page
Smart Plans
Call panel (during or after a call made via Lofty)
Typically, a window like the following will appear, and after clicking
Select Template,
you will be presented with both
My Templates
and
Company Templates
that you can use:
Questions?

#### Article 310: Texting via Lofty

- Article ID: `360057630352`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Texting`
- Updated: `2026-03-03T16:16:46Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057630352-Texting-via-Lofty

Introduction
If you have a Lofty text package, you can send and receive text messages from leads.
This article will review how to send and receive text messages with Lofty via desktop and the mobile app.
Summary:
Character Limits (#h_01J8N5HTGRPR1PDJGP666H7728)
Virtual Phone Numbers (#h_01G7WE8BFYVB1ANTE2QJHBS39V)
Text Subscription Message (#h_01HXF9NH49Q1CHVR1RCC391Z1N)
Text Message Quiet Hours (#h_01K117G60XSG514KSNBVHWCZH9)
Sending Text Messages with Lofty (Desktop) (#h_01G7WEAG3YR02HVWT9RDMHY595)
Group Texting (#h_01HVS5TG4Q6HY133RPYWNDBA2E)
Receiving Text Messages from Leads (#h_01G7WEAG3YR02HVWT9RDMHY595)
Texting with the Lofty CRM Mobile App (#h_01G7WEASRPV98WAQHZXJ09H6M0)
Group Texting (#h_01HVS5TG4Q6HY133RPYWNDBA2E)
Receiving text messages from leads (#01H8HQVQMT8PX966TMS8AMYRJQ)
Replying to a Lead (#h_01HVSH6X4EH301VV5TW9DY2BY8)
Texting with the Lofty CRM mobile app (#h_01G7WEASRPV98WAQHZXJ09H6M0)
Character Limits
One text message can have up to 160 characters. If Non-GSM-7 Characters are included in the message, you can have up to 70 characters.
Common examples of non-GSM-7 characters:
Emoji (😃🔥💯 etc.)
Smart quotes:
“ ” ‘ ’
En dash and em dash:
– —
Curly brackets or non-standard symbols:
• ™ © ® ±
Accented letters not in GSM-7:
á í ó ú ñ ç ê â ô
(many others depending on the accent and language)
Non-Latin characters:
你好
,
مرحبا
,
नमस्ते
, etc.
If the text message exceeds the character limit (160 or 70 characters), it will be sent as two messages.
Virtual Phone Numbers
All text messages through Lofty will be sent from one of the virtual phone numbers set up with the dialer under
Personal S
ettings > Call/Text Settings > My Numbers
There is NOT an option to “mask” the virtual numbers. When you send text messages via Lofty, they will be sent from the virtual number you select.
For more information on setting up virtual numbers, please see these articles:
Getting Started with a Virtual Number (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047294012)
Company Number (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360059630312)
Text Subscription Message
Regulations require that consumers should be able to easily opt-out or unsubscribe from receiving text messages from a business. To support this, the Text Subscription Message will be sent to leads following a text message that meets the following criteria:
The first time the lead is texted
When the lead is texted after having not communicated via text message in the last three (3) months.
This is a rolling 3 months, so for example, if the lead is texted for the first time on August 1, they will receive the text subscription message.
If the lead is texted or texting back regularly, they will never see this message again.
If the lead is not texted again until after November 1, they will receive the text subscription message again.
The Text Subscription Message will be added automatically to the text message that matches the criteria above and will be counted in the text message's total character count.
This setting is located in
Personal Settings > Call & Text > Info & Settings.
Click
Customize
to update your name and your company name. By default, the data here will be pulled from your Lofty profile and 10DLC Campaign.
Text Message Quiet Hours
The Quiet Hours setting is a tool to ensure that text messages are not sent to your leads in the middle of the night. Many states have requirements around the times of day that a consumer can be contacted by call or text. We recommend that you get familiar with the regulations in your area.
This setting is located in
Personal Settings > Call & Text > Info & Settings
When enabled, mass text messages will not be sent during the quiet hours and will be scheduled to be sent when the quiet hours are over.
The quiet hours do not affect 1:1 text messages or smart plan text messages.
Sending Text Messages with Lofty (Desktop)
To send a text message to a lead via the lead profile, click the "Text" option.
A pop-up window allows you to draft your text message. Click the drop-down menu on the
From
line to select the virtual phone number the text is sent from.
Select the lead's number that you want to send the text message to on the
To
line. If your virtual phone number is hosted on Twilio, you have the option to send a group text by clicking the
+ icon
.
While you can enter any message you like in the text box, we also offer several tools to help you craft the best message possible. These icons are defined from left to right below:
AI Writing Assistant (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/15578133886235)
This tool utilizes AI to help you write a text using prompts and keywords.
Insert Listings
This tool allows you to insert a link to your own or your team's listing
Video (Beta Feature)
If you see the Video icon, you have the option to send a video text message. This feature is currently being beta-tested
MMS, Image Messaging (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4407592156699)
The photo icon allows you to send an image. Your Design Center templates are also available to be sent
Text Templates (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402878822285)
Your personal and team text templates are available here
Email and Text Variables (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055270071)
The hashtag icon contains lead and agent variables. This allows you to personalize a text without entering the personal information yourself
Virtual Business Cards (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/27353952007579)
The virtual business card is the contact card for you and your team members.
You can also send mass text messages to leads from the People page.
Learn More:
Send Mass Emails & Texts (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/search/click?%3D%3D--474aae69445135b6ac887ba6ab9a40c06a3631f4)
Group Texting
A group text is a text message that is sent to multiple recipients, and all the recipients can see and reply to each other. Learn more about Group Texting here:
Group Texting (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/47332506052891)
Receiving text messages from leads
Replies from the lead will appear in Lofty under the lead profile as well as your
Lofty Workspaces (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/5591212569371)
.
To receive a notification that you received a message on your mobile phone, enable the option “forward incoming text messages to another number”.
Please keep in mind that this is not an actual message from the lead; it is only a notification that you have received a new text message.
See this article for more information:
Call/Text Package Settings (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000306652)
Replying to a Lead
To reply to a text message, first click on the chat icon. This will open the chat panel with the most recent messages at the top of the list. Select the lead that you want to respond to. The text can be crafted directly in the chat panel.
The same options will be available to select which number to text from, insert variables, and text templates.
Texting with the Lofty CRM mobile app
To send text messages through the Lofty CRM mobile app, start by selecting the lead you want to text, then tap on the messaging icon:
Be sure to check which number the text message will be sent from. There will be an option to select your virtual phone number, company number, or personal mobile number.
Tap the phone number to select, and the phone number selected will have a check mark.
*Please note that if the text message is sent from your mobile number, it will not be recorded in Lofty.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: group text

### Section: Transaction 

#### Article 311: Commission Disbursement Authorization (CDA) Generation

- Article ID: `18252204443547`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Transaction `
- Updated: `2025-11-11T01:02:32Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/18252204443547-Commission-Disbursement-Authorization-CDA-Generation

Introduction
CDA stands for "Commission Disbursement Authorization". It is used to confirm the commission payment arrangements of individuals involved in a transaction, typically signed by the buyer, seller, and agent/brokerage.
The CDA is useful because it confirms the commission allocation of all parties involved in the transaction and helps ensure
commission payments adhere to legal regulations and oversight, protecting the rights of all parties.
Summary
CDA Generation (#01H8Q9NYW2VY31Y5AWD8P8S4FJ)
CDA Form Components (#01H8Q9YD1SGQ4WA5XR9364RGRT)
CDA Generation
A CDA can be generated for any transaction that you have access to.
To create a CDA, navigate to the closed transaction, select the
... icon
, and click
Generate CDA.
Important:
The transaction must have a close price and GCI set before the CDA can be generated.
The CDA can also be generated by navigating to the transaction, clicking
Accounting
, then clicking
Generate CDA.
CDA Form Components
1. Document Name:
The default Name is "Commission Disbursement Authorization."
2. Transaction Details
This section displays the Property Address, Sale Type, and Closed Date.
3. Contacts to Display:
All transaction roles involved in the transaction are available to be selected.
The "
Escrow / Title" transaction role will be included by default, whether is has a contact or not, because it is typically a contact in the CDA.
4. Total Payments
This section displays the Sales Price and the GCI
5. Payout
This section displays the commission details.
6. Instructions and Notes:
This is an optional field that may include additional instructions for the CDA.
Once the CDA is complete, click
Next
to preview the document.
If anything needs to be changed, click
Cancel
to go back to the CDA editor. If the CDA is complete, click
Generate
to save the CDA.
The CDA will automatically be saved to the Transaction. Here, you have the option to email the CDA to the contacts on the transaction. The email will attach a pdf copy of the CDA, but will not contain any other content. The Subject Line and Email Body will need to be completed by the user sending the email.
The CDA will be saved to the transaction in the
Document
section.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: Commission disbursement authorization, CDA

#### Article 312: Offer Management

- Article ID: `4412776507163`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Transaction `
- Updated: `2025-12-16T22:09:51Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4412776507163-Offer-Management

Introduction
Offer Management allows listing agents to create an "offer link" that is then listed in the MLS instructions for accepting offers from potential buyers. MLS listings do not display this link publicly; it is only accessible via the MLS to the buyer's agent who will submit the offer on behalf of the buyer. The offer link will then outline all of the required information and documents needed in order for an offer to be accepted. Offer Management allows you to track the offers and compare them to find the best one with the seller.
Listing Agent
Buyer's Agent
Works with the Home Seller
Works with a Home Buyer
Creates offer links and offer instructions, adds to MLS
Utilizes Listing Agent's Offer Link or follows their offer instructions to submit an offer, as documented in MLS
Receives offers and reviews from the seller
Submits offers on behalf of the buyer
Summary
How to Create an Offer Link (#h_01KCMKBT3JMEPPSX7Y21JNYDHD)
How to Add an Offer (#h_01KCMC6S3T70MHDQH6N26XB6YZ)
Reviewing and Comparing Offers (#h_01KCMGXG7MCXRMVGPWN0PWWGS4)
Notifications (#id-12/13/21:FeatureReleaseTrainingforCRM3.40,Site5.28-Notifications)
How to Create an Offer Link
In Lofty, offers will be tracked on the related transaction. If you are the listing agent, the first step is to create an offer form. Navigate to the listing transaction and select
Offers
.
Next, add instructions or an introduction for the offer form which will be displayed at the top. Required documents that need to be attached to the form need to be uploaded in this step using the "attachments" icon. Click on
Preview
to continue.
The form itself
cannot
be edited.
Once you save the offer form, you will be taken to a page where the offer link is available to copy and then paste into the MLS portal to add as the next step for potential buyers to submit offers via their buyer's agent.
When the buyer's agent uses the link to submit an offer, all required fields are marked with a red asterisk. After submitting an offer, the buyer's agent is provided with a link that will allow them to see what they submitted as well as preview any status changes, etc. Multiple offers from the same buyer's agent email address will not be accepted by the system. If the buyer's agent would like to upload additional documents, this is
not
currently supported, but they can communicate directly with the Listing Agent via email if necessary.
Once offers are received, the listing agent will be able to review these as part of a transaction on the
Offers
tab. Offers can be reviewed here or the offers form can be edited as necessary. The newest offer will appear at the top. Rejected offers are hidden at the bottom.
How to Add an Offer
To submit an offer for your buyer lead, navigate to the lead's profile, select
Searches
, and scroll to the bottom.
All of the lead's offers will be visible in this section.
Reviewing and Comparing Offers
Navigate to
Sales -> Offers
to review and compare offers for all of your listings and buyers.
Listing Side Offers
The Listing Side Offers are offers on your listings. These offers are organized by listing, and all offers for that listing are grouped together. Click the drop down arrow to view all offers.
Check the box next to at least one offer and click the Compare Offer button to get an AI generated analysis of the selected offer(s). This tool tells you which offers are the strongest match for your listing, based on the AI analysis.
Navigate to the transaction Offers tab to update the offer status. The available statuses are Pending (default status when created), Accepted, Rejected, and Withdrawn.
Buyer Side Offers
The Buyer Side Offers are your leads' offers on properties. The offers on this page are organized by lead, and all of the offers a lead has submitted are grouped together.
Like with Listing Side Offers, you can select at least one offer to generate an AI analysis of the offer(s). When comparing Buyer offers, the offers are not compared against each other, but against the property listing price.
The lead's offers are also visible in their profile, under
Searches
. Here, the offer status can be updated. The available statuses are Submitted (default when created), Accepted, Declined, Lost, and Withdrawn.
Notifications
The following are the email notifications that will be triggered during this entire process. These emails will be sent from the client's Lofty
sending email address (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402367904397)
.
Scenario

Hi #BuyerAgentName,
Thank you for submitting an offer on behalf of your client. The Listing Agent will review all offers with the seller and contact you if necessary.
Use the link below to review the offer details and status.

an offer on behalf of a seller

The offer submitted on behalf of your client for this listing (#houseLocation) has been REJECTED at this point in time.
Feel free to view other listings available on my website.

indicating that an email should be sent:

#### Article 313: Transaction Document Templates

- Article ID: `37425534313115`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Transaction `
- Updated: `2025-11-11T00:59:54Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/37425534313115-Transaction-Document-Templates

Introduction
We know that real estate transactions often use the same documents. This feature lets you add those documents into Lofty and use them over and over on your transactions.
Note:
All Lofty users can access Transaction Document Templates in their personal settings, but you must have the templates permission to add or edit these templates. Please reach out to your account owner for assistance creating a Transaction Document Template.
Summary
How to Create a Transaction Document Template (#h_01JW9VSBR47SKWD4SC1YZP5WBE)
Adding a Document Template to a Transaction (#h_01JW9WMGYC9HPZWFVHGNMFN4AA)
How to Create a Transaction Document Template
To get started, navigate to
Company/Office Settings > Transactions > Document Templates
. The template must be created for the specific transaction type - Purchase, Listing, Lease, or Other. Existing templates will be available here or click
+ Add Template
to create a template.
Give your template a name, select the transaction type, then upload your documents.
Once you have uploaded the template documents, click the Edit icon to add text fields, check boxes, and radio buttons to your document.
Double click a Text box to add an autofill field from the standard and custom transaction fields.
Document Limitations
Documents must be in pdf format
Up to 40 documents can be added to each template
Each document can be up to 30MB
Template Limitations
Enterprise Lofty accounts can create an unlimited number of document templates
Non-Enterprise Lofty accounts can create up to 50 templates in the Company scope and up to 20 templates in each Office/Team scope
Editable Elements Limitations
Each document up to the following amount of editable elements:
Up to 200 Text boxes
Up to 50 Checkboxes
Up to 50 Radio buttons
Adding a Document Template to a Transaction
To apply the template to a transaction, navigate to
Transactions > Select a transaction > Documents > Add New > Upload a document > Document Template.
Here, you can add as many templates and as many documents from each template as is appropriate for the transaction.
If you have added autofill fields to your template, edit the document to make sure that the autofill fields are sync correctly.
You have the option to sync these fields to the transaction.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 314: Transaction Lead Portal

- Article ID: `48972164737435`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Transaction `
- Updated: `2026-04-10T16:11:57Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/48972164737435-Transaction-Lead-Portal

Introduction
The Transaction Lead Portal lets you bring your clients into the transaction process without giving them access to your back-office tools. Once you activate the portal for a transaction, selected Leads can log into the Closely app to view the current stage of their transaction, access shared documents, e-sign required forms, and even upload their own files — all in one place.
This feature helps you keep clients informed and engaged while reducing back-and-forth communication throughout the deal.
Getting Started
Step 1: Open the Lead Portal Tab
Navigate to the transaction you want to share with your client. On the Transaction detail page, select the Lead Portal tab.
Step 2: Activate the Portal
Use the Portal Active toggle to turn the portal on. When active, the transaction becomes visible to the selected Leads inside the Closely app.
Toggling Portal Active ON makes the transaction visible to all added Leads in Closely.
Toggling it OFF immediately hides the transaction from all Leads — no content is deleted, just hidden until you turn it back on.
Step 3: Add Leads
Click Add Lead to go to the Contacts module and select the clients you want to include. Any Leads you add there will automatically sync to the Lead list in the Lead Portal.
💡  Tip:
If a Lead has never logged into Closely before, you will be prompted to send them a text message with a download link as soon as you make their visibility toggle active.
Step 4: Preview the Portal
Click Preview to see a web-based simulation of exactly what the Lead sees on the Closely mobile app. Use this to review the experience before sending an invite to your client.
Sharing Documents with Leads
Once the portal is active, you can share specific documents from the transaction's Documents module directly to your Leads' view in Closely.
Go to Transaction → Documents.
With Portal Active turned on, a Share to Lead action will appear next to each document.
Shared documents will show a Shared tag next to the document name.
To stop sharing a document, remove the share — the Shared tag will disappear and the document will no longer be visible to Leads.
Shared documents are visible to all Leads who have access to that transaction, so only share documents intended for all involved parties.
Configuring Which Stages Leads Can See
You can control which pipeline stages are displayed to your clients. This lets you show progress at a high level without exposing every internal step of the transaction.
How to set stage visibility:
Open the Transaction List page and click into the Stage Settings popup.
For each stage, enable the Visible to Lead option to include it in the client-facing view.
Stages without this option enabled will be hidden from Leads in Closely.
💡  Tip:
You only need to configure stage visibility once per pipeline. These settings apply across all transactions that use the same stage configuration.
What Your Client Sees in Closely
When a Lead logs into the Closely app, they will find a My Transactions section under the My Home tab. This section lists all transactions that have been shared with them, with the most recent appearing first. If no transactions are shared, this section is hidden.
Progress Tab
The Progress tab shows the Lead their current transaction stage, along with the completion dates of all previous stages. This gives clients a clear, timeline-style view of where things stand without any additional explanation needed from you.
Documents Tab
The Documents tab is divided into three sections.
E-Signatures
Any documents requiring the Lead's signature — or already signed by them — appear here. If there are no signature-related documents, this section is hidden automatically.
Documents
Files shared by you (the agent) from the Documents module appear here. Leads can view these documents at any time. If no documents have been shared, this section is hidden.
Upload
Leads can also upload their own files directly from Closely. Any file a Lead uploads will:
Automatically sync to the Documents module on the Transaction detail page in Lofty.
Be visible to all other Leads who have access to the same transaction.
Staying Notified of Lead Document Activity
Lofty will automatically notify you when a Lead uploads or deletes a document in the Lead Portal, so you always know when new materials are ready to review.
How to manage this notification:
Go to Personal Settings → Notifications.
Find the Document Action by Lead (Upload/Delete) notification type.
Email and push notifications are turned on by default.
Toggle either notification method off if you prefer a different cadence.
📌  Note:
Only the Transaction Owner receives these notifications.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I share the portal with multiple clients on the same transaction?
Yes. You can add multiple Leads to the portal. All added Leads with their Visible toggle active will be able to see the transaction and any shared documents.
What happens if I turn off Portal Active?
The transaction will be immediately hidden from all Leads in Closely. No data is deleted — simply toggle it back on to restore visibility.
Can a Lead see documents uploaded by other Leads?
Yes. Any document uploaded through the Lead Portal is visible to all Leads who have access to that transaction, so make sure Leads are aware of this if privacy is a concern.
What if my client hasn't downloaded Closely yet?
When you activate visibility for a Lead who has never logged into Closely, Lofty will prompt you to send them an automated text message with a link to download the app.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 315: Transaction Management Checklists

- Article ID: `360057001712`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Transaction `
- Updated: `2025-11-11T01:04:02Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057001712-Transaction-Management-Checklists

Introduction
Learn more about all Lofty Transaction Management features in this section of the Help Center:
Lofty Transaction Management (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/sections/360010608752-Transaction-Management)
.
When you create a transaction in Lofty, you can apply a checklist that will automatically create tasks as you move the transaction to the next stages of the pipeline. In simple terms, the checklists can provide a templated set of tasks that can be made available to the team as they manage transactions.
*IMPORTANT
:
You are only able to create a maximum of 10 checklist templates for all transaction types. If a new template is needed, you will have to delete an existing one.
If you edit/create/delete transaction stages, do not forget to update your checklist templates
Summary
Permissions (#h_01EZ8AHK39C0HH23GH5VKE86D4)
Checklist Folders (#h_01K86NME92HCDSJNW7A5HWZ54J)
Set Up Checklists (#h_01EZ8AHRPY1DD34ZJV2J71CTXH)
Applying a Transaction Checklist (#h_01EZ8FH24M6RHPXVADHRA35ZZM)
Transaction Checklist Library (#h_01EZ8FH70VCE11ARW93D05H8AV)
Viewing Tasks (#h_01EZ8FH70VCE11ARW93D05H8AV)
Cancelled Tasks (#h_01JDQ3V6B263E6EZ623QXRQ4XM)
Permissions
The Company Owner/Admin or users who have the Transactions Setting permission have access to create Company checklist templates. All users on the account can use the Company checklists that have been created.
For more information regarding permissions, see
Organization - Permission Profiles (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4407530443291)
All users can create their transaction checklist templates, which are only able to be used by the creator.
Checklist Folders
Transaction Checklists are organized into folders. The folders can be in the Company, Office, or Personal scope.
Company folders contain checklists that are available to everyone in the company.
Office or Team folders contain checklists that are available to everyone in the office or team.
Personal folders contain your own personal checklists that are not available to others.
Click
+ Add Folder
to add a new checklist folder.
Permissions mirror existing checklist permissions:
Company Admins
can manage all folders across the company.
Office Admins
can manage folders for their office and sub-offices.
Personal folders
are private to each user.
Set Up Checklists
To create a checklist, navigate to
Settings
>
Checklist Templates
>
+ Add Checklist
:
Company transaction checklist templates will be located in the Company settings. Personal checklist templates will be located in the Personal settings. The process for creating the templates are the same, regardless of whether you are creating a Company or Personal transaction checklist template.
First, give your checklist a name so that you can easily reference it later and choose the
Transaction Type
that you want this checklist to be available for. The available transaction types are Purchase, Listing, Lease, and Other. The transaction checklist can only be applied to transactions that match the type.
Once you've created the checklist, click the
Edit
icon to start adding the tasks.
Simply click on the
+ Add a Task
button under the stage where you would like to add the task. The stages will correspond with what you have configured under the
Transaction Management
page. If you add/edit/remove a new state under transaction management for a certain transaction type, it will be reflected here automatically.
Create the task by giving it a name/description. When the task is created, this is the actual title of the task.
The
Assign To
field allows you to choose the transaction owner or other transaction roles. These roles must be defined in the transaction role section of the CRM. For more information go
here (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360004792091)
.
Choose either "No Due Date" or choose a Due Date. This will have to be associated with a date listed on the transaction details. If you would like the due date to be on a specific date simply choose "0 Day(s)" before/after. You can add custom date fields (see
Transaction Management Introduction > Transaction Custom Dates (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057572991#h_01FC6PW2QYQDKW9EEG6FCSRKMP)
).
If you would like to set up a reminder, you can do so either by email, SMS text, call, or push notification. Please note that a call/text package must be active to receive a notification via call or text.
The order of transaction checklist tasks can be adjusted when building out the checklist templates. When a transaction moves to the corresponding stage,
all
tasks will still trigger, but they will be in the order created within the checklist template.
Once you are finished adding the tasks where you would like them at the stages, be sure to click on the blue
Save
button at the bottom right so that the checklist is complete.
Applying a Transaction Checklist
Please note that transaction checklists do
not
auto-apply like Smart Plans. They must be applied manually to a transaction.
To apply a checklist to a transaction, first, navigate to the transaction detail page. There are two ways:
(1) via a lead detail page
(2) via the Transaction Management page
Once you are on a transaction detail page, select
Checklists
> Apply a Checklist Template
. There is also an option to add an individual task, that is not related to a checklist.
Next, choose the checklist that you want to apply to the transaction. The only ones that you will see on this list are those that match this transaction type. Click the blue
Confirm
button to apply it to the transaction. You can select as many checklist templates as necessary.
If you have tasks that trigger based on the stage you are currently on, they will appear immediately on the transaction detail page.
The checklist tasks can be viewed in either a list or kanban view.
As you move the transaction to a new stage ("Under Contract" in this screenshot below), the other tasks will be created as well. You may have to refresh your browser for the new tasks to appear. Note that if you go
back
to a previous stage in the pipeline, it will
not
delete the tasks that have already been created.
To mark a task as complete, simply drag the task to the Done column (Kanban view) or hover to trigger the change of status to Done (List view).
We support up to four-digit numbers when editing the days.
Tasks from templates can be switched to a specific date within the transaction.
The two filter options in the list view of the transaction will retain your last selection, so you don't need to reapply the filters every time they enter the transaction page.
Transaction Checklist Library
Transaction Checklist Library allows you to import transaction checklists directly into your workflow. No matter whether "Personal," "Office," or "Company" is currently selected in the top-left navigation bar, the Library will always remain available. The difference is that, depending on the selected option, importing a Checklist from the Library will automatically correspond to the respective scope.
Press the checklist name, and see the details of the checklist to be imported.
Importing Process:
Step 1： Name the imported template.
Step 2：Map the Stages and the importing is completed. If you have not customized the stages, this step will be skipped.
Viewing Tasks
There are a few locations where you can view tasks that need to be completed on a transaction.
On a transaction detail page:
On the transaction page
On a lead profile page
On the Tasks page
Completed Tasks must be opted into being shown, this option is under
Actions
.
Task Presentation
All transaction tasks are displayed under a transaction stage. This makes keeping old and new tasks in the right order will be much easier to accomplish.
Cancelled Tasks
If a transaction is cancelled and there are outstanding tasks, a pop-up will give you some options to either remove the task from your task list completely or just remove any scheduled due dates.
This pop-up both notifies you that there are outstanding tasks associated with this cancelled transaction and allows you to either change the task status to "Not Applicable", which will remove the task from your task list or remove the tasks due date, which will remove and reminders and remove the task from your calendar. Removing the due date will still keep the task in your task list.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: Transaction checklist, transaction page

#### Article 316: Transaction Management Documents

- Article ID: `360061195871`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Transaction `
- Updated: `2025-11-11T01:03:03Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360061195871-Transaction-Management-Documents

Introduction
Transactions always include some sort of documentation or paper trail. There are several ways to save documents in Lofty so that you can access them later as needed. Learn how to upload documents to Lofty here:
Uploading Documents to Lofty (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/34270032061723)
Summary
Document Instructions (#h_01HB8ZR5TQQ1TEAF85Y4K179QA)
Document Folders (#h_01HB8ZR5TQRAJMJ8TM34MYM43Y)
Bulk Operations (#h_01JB2J7XGVQCTE7SV0W3RHVVDM)
FAQs (#h_01HB8ZR5TQ782B12YSBE9KX7MW)
Document Instructions
To access and save a document associated with a transaction, navigate to a
Lead Profile
> Transactions & Docs
>
click on the transaction
:
You can also access a transaction by navigating to
Transaction Management
>
clicking on a transaction
:
You are now on the transaction detail page. Next, click on
Documents
:
Use the
Click here to upload a document
to attach a file:
Upload a file from your computer, Dropbox, Google Drive, send as an email attachment, or DocuSign.
Each file that is uploaded can only be a maximum of 70 MB in size.
There is currently no limit to the number of files that can be uploaded to a transaction.
Another way to upload a document is via a transaction task. Transaction tasks are accessed on the
Checklists
page of a transaction. Once you click on a task, you will be presented with four different options. The one related to this topic, of course, is the
Upload
option:
You will have the same options for uploading a document, and you can toggle on/off the switch that allows you to mark a task as complete once a document is uploaded.
To learn more about Transaction Checklists, see
HERE (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057001712)
.
Document Folders
Documents are categorized in folders. A default folder will be created on each transaction and lead profile.
There is no limit to the number of folders that can be created.
Each file that is uploaded can only be a maximum of 50 MB in size
There is no limit to the number of files that can be uploaded to a transaction
The default location for documents uploaded will be the
Default
folder. Each transaction will have a default folder. This folder cannot be deleted but can be renamed.
You can also rename or delete the other folders at any time if needed. Folders will be categorized by A-Z.
Bulk Operations
If you need to take action on multiple documents, select the documents and choose the action from the menu.
Check the box next to one document to access these actions:
Preview: This allows you to peek at the document without downloading it.
Rename: This allows you to change the name of the document in the folder
Check the box next to one or more documents to access these actions:
Download
Delete
Move: Moves the document(s) to another folder.
Send Email: Attaches the document(s) to an email for sending
Send to Docusign: Send the document for signature directly from the transaction. Requires an integrated DocuSign account.
FAQs
Are notes in Transactions searchable?
Yes, the following types of notes can be searched:
Manual Notes (including those made for calls, emails, and texts)
System Log
Is it possible to upload more than one document to a transaction checklist task before it's marked as completed?
Yes,
you can click the edit button on the checklist and upload the additional document.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 317: Transaction Management Introduction

- Article ID: `360057572991`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Transaction `
- Updated: `2026-04-10T15:33:34Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057572991-Transaction-Management-Introduction

Introduction
Managing your transaction data is an extremely important part of doing your job in real estate. Transaction management features have been built into Lofty to provide you with a location to save important numbers, dates, checklists, etc. to assist during the transaction process.
The features for transaction management available in Lofty are intended primarily for reporting purposes as well as to provide tasks that can be used to remind you of what needs to happen at each stage of a transaction process.
Summary
Transaction Management Setup (#h_01EZDW5A624RNZFWC0J6FEB79N)
Adding a New Transaction (#h_01EZDW6454VPMH4HN41R5CPR25)
Closing a Transaction (#h_01H52X0TDF3C00YFW5WAZH2ZY9)
Commission Disbursement Authorization Generation (#h_01HN3GWC18HH1Q3KRW8V46VRWW)
Managing a Transaction (#01H8QDNSJJGWV97G809HZNHPF9)
Exporting and Integrations (#h_01EZFTQ5DM17QP319Y0PT3N9AG)
Transaction Management Setup
Before using Lofty Transaction Management to record transactions, you will want to make sure you have it set up to reflect how you manage your transaction process in the real world. The following information will guide you through what can be configured.
Transaction Views
When you access Lofty
Transaction Management
you will want to choose the view that best fits your needs. There are two different views:
List View
This view supports columns for all of the different fields that are supported when recording a transaction in Lofty. You can use this view to easily view a transaction as a row with dates that can be sorted.
Kanban View
With the Kanban view, you have columns/lists that contain a card representing each transaction. Drag/drop a transaction from one column/list to the next to move a transaction down the pipeline. The top of each column/list also contains a total count of the transactions in that stage of the transaction.
Transaction Search Functionality
Transactions can be searched by Transaction Name, Property Address, and Lead Name in our Transaction Management section. Add filters to refine the search criteria.
To search for transactions associated with leads that you are not assigned to in the primary "Agent" role, check the
Include Unowned Transactions
box.
Transaction Pipelines
Each transaction type outlined above (Purchase, Listing, Lease, or Other) will have its pipeline with individual stages representing where the transaction is at in the process.
The default stages available for each transaction type are as follows:
PURCHASE
LISTING
LEASE
OTHER
Pre-Contract
Under Contract
Pending
Closed
Canceled
Pre-Listing
Active Listing
Under Contract
Pending
Closed
Active
Under Contract
Pending
Closed
Active
In Progress
Pending
Closed
A few important notes regarding transaction stages:
You can add a “
Stage
“ filter with a multiple-select function, allowing you to choose multiple stages for the selected transaction type. The displayed numbers will update dynamically based on the selected filters.
In addition to "Closed" and "Cancelled," you can create up to 15 stages in total for each transaction type
To edit the transaction stages,
click on the gear icon on the far-right side
>
select "Customize Transaction Stages"
Add new stages, delete/rename the ones you do not want, and drag/drop to reorder.
You can also hide/display "Cancelled Transactions" by checking or unchecking the box found here.
Transaction Custom Fields
If you want to add transaction fields for milestones that might not be supported by default, navigate to
Company/Team Settings → Field Groups → Transaction Custom Field Management
Note:
You can add up to 100 custom transaction fields.
The following types of Transaction Custom Fields are available:
Date
Text
Number
Includes the option to add a thousand separator comma to the number
Percentage
Currency
Single-Select
A list where only one option may be selected
Multi-Select
A list where multiple options (up to 20 options) may be selected.
To create a new transaction custom field, navigate to
Company/Team Settings > Transactions > Field Groups > Transaction Custom Field Management > Custom Fields > + Add New
Click
Confirm
to save the custom field. If a transaction custom field needs to be changed, click the edit icon. New options can be added or the current options can be deleted or re-ordered.
Custom Roles
You can add custom roles by navigating to
Company Settings
>
Transaction Roles,
Up to 100 custom roles can be added by clicking on the
+ Add a Role
button. When adding a new role you will assign a
name
and a
type
which has four options:
Lead/Client - Only leads can be assigned to this role
Agent - Only another user on the Lofty account can be assigned to this role
Lender - Only a lender-type account can be assigned to this role
Vendor/Partner - Only a vendor/partner can be assigned to this role
If you want this role to be filled by the same contact on every transaction, toggle on the
Auto-add to new transactions
option and select your contact. They will be added to the
Default Person
column on the Transaction Role page and will be added as on contact on all transactions that you create.
Adding a New Transaction
A transaction saved in Lofty lives within a lead profile. It can be found on the Transaction Management page, but it always has to be associated with a specific lead. Transactions can be added in a variety of ways as outlined below.
(1) Adding a transaction via the Lead Profile page
Navigate to a
Lead Profile
>
Transactions
>
Add New Transaction
(2) Adding a transaction via the Transaction Management page
There are two different ways to add a transaction via the
Transaction Management
page and both are outlined below.
(a) Adding manually
While on the
Transaction Management
page, you can click on the
+ Add
button to add a transaction directly from here. You will have to associate it with a specific lead, which can be added directly to the transaction.
(b) Adding from an MLS transaction
This option is also accessed directly from the
Transaction Management
page by clicking on the
__ unclaimed MLS transactions
button. Please note that "unclaimed" just means these transactions have been pulled from the MLS and are now available to associate with a lead in your Lofty database.
*IMPORTANT
: These "Unclaimed Transactions" will only appear if you have added your MLS Agent ID.
Once you click on this button, you will see a list of transactions (assuming there are recent transactions that have closed or are getting close to closing) that you can either claim or delete.
Claiming a transaction simply populates as much information as is available in the fields for a new transaction, or you can match the property to an existing transaction. You will also have to choose the lead who is associated with this transaction.
An introduction email can be sent to the transaction’s contacts when the transaction is first created.
Navigate to the Details View when creating a transaction and check the box next to Send Introduction Email on Assignment to send an email to the provided contacts when the transaction is created. This email can be edited before it is sent.
Closing a Transaction
To close a transaction, click the
Closed/Cancelled
stage and select "Closed".
Next, input the sold price, GCI, Commission Splits, and adjustments. The total payment will be calculated. If the GCI will be higher than the close price, such as a Rental transaction, enter the GCI as the total commission to be split or received.
There are three (3) stages of commission splits:
Add/Deduct Before Splits:
These are additions to or deductions from the
total amount
, before the commission split.
These adjustments affect the amount everyone is able to be paid.
Splits:
This is where the commission splits are entered.
If additional agents are receiving a split, they may be added here.
Add/Deduct After Splits:
These are any adjustments that individually apply to the team/brokerage OR a particular agent, from their own share of the commission.
Use the "Paid From" and "Paid To" columns to indicate which side the payment is coming from.
Lofty CRM allows Vendors, or anyone who is not a member of the Lofty account, to be included in the commission split on a transaction.
When clicking the "Paid To/From" box, the dropdown menu will display some suggestion, which includes the following:
The transaction owner's Team
The party that was Recently searched (displaying a maximum of 6)
A “Temporary Entity” that can be added to this transaction
If the party who should be included in the Commission split is not a Team member or a Vendor on the account, they may be added:
A summary has been added after each Split, so you can see the commission split results in real-time, as you are closing the transaction.
Commission Disbursement Authorization Generation
To learn more about this feature you can check:
Commission Disbursement Authorization (CDA) Generation (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/18252204443547)
Managing a Transaction
Transaction Detail Page
The name of the transaction along with the transaction type is displayed in the top-left:
You can adjust the transaction owner or click to be taken to the associated lead with the options here:
Click on the three dots
. . .
to access additional options associated with integrations, edit, or delete the transaction:
To move a transaction to the appropriate stage of the pipeline, click on the stage where you would like to move it using this section:
Under the
Checklists
tab, you can add individual tasks or apply a checklist template. A
transaction checklist can be used to create tasks automatically as a transaction is moved to different stages in the transaction pipeline. To learn more about this feature, please refer to the following:
Transaction Management Checklists (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057001712)
.
The
Accounting
tab will show you the transaction numbers. This is also where you can add or edit the splits related to the transaction.
The
Contacts
tab allows you to send the basic lead contact information and simple details from the transaction itself to a vendor/partner saved in your settings. For more information on how to use this feature, see
How to Assign a Vendor/Partner to a Transaction (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360004792091)
.
You can upload documents that are intended to be saved with this transaction to the
Documents
tab. To use a document, you can access it here but will have to download to your computer and then upload it elsewhere as needed.
The
History
tab simply serves as a log for all activity related to the transaction.
Once a transaction is tied to a listing, the lead's information will also be listed on the Smart Listing page:
Exporting and Integrations
If you have the "Export Transactions" permission enabled, you are able to export transaction data to a csv file.
Transactions recorded in Lofty can connect to a few other services that are worth noting. Please be aware that just because a connection is available to these services does
not
mean that a two-way sync is 100% supported for all data. Be sure to review each Help Center article if you are interested in learning more about the integration to better understand what
can
and
cannot
be done with each integration.
Brokermint Integration (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360054860192)
SkySlope Integration (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360036580712)
Dotloop Integration (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003826571)
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.
Related terms: transaction management, checklist, transaction tasks, commission

#### Article 318: Uploading Documents to Lofty

- Article ID: `34270032061723`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Transaction `
- Updated: `2025-11-11T01:02:12Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/34270032061723-Uploading-Documents-to-Lofty

Introduction
Your CRM should be an all-in-one place to organize everything for your leads and transactions. This article outlines how to upload documents to your Lofty account.
Learn more about document management here:
Transaction Management Documents (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360061195871)
Summary
File (#h_01JMN5TCWG557XD6FD84GQXBS0)
Email Attachment (#h_01JMN5Y4PZYDW9DD3A8A0ZTXDD)
Scan Docs (#h_01JMN61SVQ3DF6P1B90E6K3A2B)
Dropbox (#h_01JMN6DK6P5NF43VBQHXTHFTH7)
Google Drive (#h_01JMN6GNEJ7RXYK9DWM6WHJ74T)
DocuSign (#h_01JMN6M4Z2197AGSSRJH49XC6N)
Upload a Document to a Transaction
Navigate to a transaction or a lead profile and select
Documents
.
Click the
Add New
drop down menu to add a new folder to organize your documents or a new document.
Click
Upload
or simply drag and drop a document to the screen to upload.
After clicking
Upload
, you'll see that there are many options to upload your documents to Lofty.
File
Select file to upload a document that has been downloaded to your device.
Email Attachment
This option allows you to forward emails attachments to Lofty and upload them has documents, using the unique email address provided here.
Scan Docs
This option allows you to scan paper documents or upload photos to create a pdf document to upload to Lofty. This option does require that you download the
Lofty Real Estate App (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/17801017502491)
. Select Scan Docs, open your Lofty mobile app, select the More menu, and select Scan Docs.
Then, scan the QR code here:
You can scan up to 40 pages or select up to 40 photos from the camera roll for a single document. Once the scan is complete, it will save as a pdf to your Lofty account.
Dropbox
If you have a Dropbox account, integrate that here to upload document to Lofty directly from Dropbox.
Google Drive
Integrate your Google account to upload files to Lofty directly from your Google Drive.
DocuSign
Learn more about our integration with DocuSign here:
Docusign Integration (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/22404108524315)
Upload a Document to a Lead Profile
Documents can also be uploaded to a lead's profile, regardless of whether they have an associated transaction or not. Navigate to the lead's profile, select
Transactions & Docs
, and click the
+ icon
next to Documents.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 319: Vendor and Partner Management

- Article ID: `360004792091`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `Transaction `
- Updated: `2026-04-10T15:46:43Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360004792091-Vendor-and-Partner-Management

Introduction
Real Estate agents and teams work with a variety of vendors, partners, and contacts while in the process of closing deals with their clients. Lofty built the Vendor/Partner feature with that in mind. Though future improvements to this feature are planned, the current functionality allows for Team Owners/Admins to add contact information for their trusted vendors and partners and to then share lead information with these individuals so that they can follow up and assist in their respective roles. A vendor/partner can be added as a contact for any of the vendor/partner roles on a transaction.
Setting Up Vendors / Partners
Follow these steps to find this setting in your CRM:
Navigate to
Settings > Company
Click on
Vendor / Partner
found under the
Company User Settings
section
Choose to
+ Add A Vendor / Partner
or
Edit
or
Delete
those currently on the list
*Only Team Owners/Admins are able to add vendors and partners. The setup portion will be unavailable for all other users.
Add a New Vendor / Partner
Currently, Vendors/Partners can be added for the following roles:
Utilities
Home Improvement
Home Warranty
Escrow/Title
Home Insurance
Home Inspection
Agent

- Article ID: `218007123`
- Category: `CRM`

Introduction
Setting up the Lofty Profile is a key step in making sure your account is ready to go before interacting with clients via the CRM. The fields that can be edited in this section will be displayed in emails sent from the Lofty CRM, including Property Alerts and Welcome Emails, so it is very important to have your profile set up from the very beginning.
Summary
Profile Settings (#h_01F77VYH596BRFZ7FR7C0NSK3C)
Email Signature (#h_01F77VYQEC7HB5X3TCXME442H7)
Profile Settings
To navigate to your profile go to
Settings
>
Profile
:
Once on this page, you can complete the following profile fields. Each one is defined below.
Profile Photo
Add your headshot, this will appear in an auto-populated email signature for property alerts, market reports, etc.
First Name / Last Name
No explanation is needed. This is simply your first and last name as the Lofty user. If you need to edit this, here is where it's done!
Email Address
This is the email address you will use to log into Lofty. If you change this, it will affect the email on file for billing statements, email notifications, etc.
Phone Number
Add the best phone number to reach you here. This will be the phone number that is also placed into the auto-populated email signature for property alert emails, etc. You can always update it as needed.
License ID
Add your license ID as an agent. This will also display in auto-populated email signatures for emails sent via Lofty so keep this up-to-date as well.
Position
Choose your position within your organization from the pre-populated options or choose the option to
Customize
if you would like to add your own.
MLS Agent ID
This part is very important to get right because this ID is used to pull in your listings for
Listing Discovery (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360004048551)
,
Transaction Management (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057572991)
, and other Lofty tools.
These fields will not appear until your MLSs have been connected to your website. Once that happens, you will be able to add
only one
MLS Agent ID per MLS. Each MLS will be listed. In the sample below, there are four MLSs
You will add your MLS ID by searching by either name or email address and the options will then be populated for you to select from:
Email Signature
Under
Settings
>
Communication
>
Email
, you will find the
Email Signature
section. This email signature will be pulled in automatically when you send manual emails in the system
and
when utilizing the #signature# variable (see
Email and Text Variables (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055270071)
to learn more about how this works). To attach this signature to Automated Emails, such as the Welcome Email and Property Alert Emails, check the box at the bottom.
For your signature, you will want to typically replicate what you have used before in your email, so add your logo, email address, name,
phone number, social media links, etc. Take advantage of the hyperlink option, embedding an image, etc.
If for whatever reason you would like to make your phone number clickable, follow the steps below.
First, edit the code of the email signature:
Then add this part (changing both numbers of course to be your own):
<a href="tel:+1-123-456-7890">123.456.7890</a>
Here is what it would look like in the code view:
Once you click "Save", this number should now be clickable. Test it to make sure it works, as sometimes copying/pasting, etc. throws off important formatting that could cause it to not work.
If for some reason it stops working, something might have been edited in the email signature so check to make sure the same format is in place as described above.
Email Signature Preview
The email signature shown at the bottom of Settings > Communication> Email> Email Settings is a preview only. To edit the email signature you must click on the Edit icon:
Variable Support
Email signatures now support agent variables. When a variable is used, it will show in the "edit experience" but once saved it will have the actual information pulled into the signature preview so that you can make sure it is working correctly.
Apply this signature to ALL outgoing emails
After choosing the option, the Email Signature set in the profile will be applied to all emails being sent from Lofty.
Default Format & Reset Link
This option will reset the signature in the profile to the signature in the welcome email which is created by the system and consists of variables as stated above.
You can set the default information for "Reset Signature" as well by following some of the steps below:

Click here to manage Brand Email Signature

#### Article 322: Goal Setting Portal

- Article ID: `38585284533531`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `User Settings`
- Updated: `2025-11-17T07:00:01Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/38585284533531-Goal-Setting-Portal

Introduction
The goal setting portal allows an account owner to set goals for their entire company, all the down to individual agents setting goals for themselves. One the goals are set, you will be able to track your monthly cadence to ensure success at the end of the year!
Summary
Permissions (#h_01JZ6J1VNS6DSXYE6QXVD9BTVQ)
Setting Your Annual Goals (#h_01JZ6JA5RWK03VTK888V9KR146)
Goal Calculator (#h_01JZ6KW4GREKZXABCEEENZFAC9)
Permissions
All agents will be able to set their own personal goals. Within the Permission Profiles, those with the Entire Company permission can set goals in the Company scope. Those with the User’s Office permission can set goals for their own Office/Team and sub-offices/teams.
Setting Your Annual Goals
Your annual goals will help you determine what your monthly goals should be to keep you on track. To set a goal, navigate to
Settings -> Reporting
. Goals are available in Company, Office, Team, and Personal settings. The first step is to select the year the goal applies to and the goal scope.
Company goals will be visible to everyone in the company
Office/Team goals will be visible to those in that office/team
Agent goals will be visible to that agent only
The scope that is available to you will be determined by your permission, as outlined above.
Goals are separated into
Business Goals
and
Activity Goals
. Click Start to create a goal.
If you need help creating business goals, we have provided a calculator, which can help you determine what your goals should be, to reach a certain income amount.
After setting your annual goals, the system will break the numbers down into even monthly goals. You can edit these fields to reflect a busier or slower season.
After saving the goals, you can see the overall goals, as well as the monthly breakdown on the goals tab. You can create multiple goals.
Goal Calculator
It can be difficult to know exactly what you need to do to make the amount of money you want to this year. The goal calculator can help you determine the total volume and closings needed to reach your revenue goal.
Depending on if you are setting up an individual goal or a company/office/team goal, the questions ask may be in a different order.
Revenue Goal
The revenue goal is the amount of money you want to make this year. This is a great place to start, and the calculator will help you determine the number of closings needed to hit this goal.
Revenue by Transaction Type
Revenue by transaction type allows you to select the percentage of your transactions that are expected to come from buyers, sellers, leases, or others, broken down by lead ownership.
If the commission split depends on the lead ownership, this page will be important in determining if most of your transactions originate from your own leads or company/office leads. If you do not expect any transactions from a particular lead type, enter 0 in that field.
Estimated Price and GCI Split Rate
The estimated price and GCI split allows you to provide the average sales price, along with your commission rate. There is also an option to include leases. We recommend being conservative with the average sales price, as the market is always changing and it's better to overestimate the number of closings, than underestimate and miss your goal.
GCI Split for Transaction Type
Similar to revenue by transaction type, here you will add your GCI for those transaction types. Each field does need to be completed, however, if you did not specify a particular transaction type earlier in the goal calculator, it will not be a factor in calculating the goal.
The results will be added to the Business Goals section. They are editable, if they don't look quite right or if you want to make a change. All Activity Goals will need to be completed, it order to save the goal.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 323: How to reset your Lofty Password

- Article ID: `360015946952`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `User Settings`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T06:10:09Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360015946952-How-to-reset-your-Lofty-Password

Introduction
You can easily reset your password if you have lost access to your account for whatever reason.
Follow the steps below to do so.
Navigate to
https://lofty.com/ (https://chime.me/)
, and click
Sign In
in the top-right corner.
Click on
Forgot your password?
Type in the email address associated with your Lofty account and click “Send Email.”
Check your email inbox for an email that looks like the following and click the
Reset Password
button.
Type in a new password, confirm it, then click “Reset.”
Kindly note the password requirement:
Must be between 9-20 characters.
Have both letters and numbers.
No spaces.
The following special characters are supported:
-/:;()$&@".,?!'[]{}#%^*+=_~<>¢£¥
You should see a confirmation message that looks like the following:
Navigate back to
https://lofty.com/ (https://chime.me/)
, click on "Sign In" in the top-right corner, type in your email address and the new password, and log into the account.
When a Lofty account password is changed, either by you(user) or by the Lofty support team, you will receive a confirmation email.
If you would like to change your Lofty login email address, please see
Log In to your Lofty Account (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/217091086)
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Open Your Welcome Email
After signing up with Lofty, you will receive an email to activate your account by setting up your account password.
If you have not received the welcome email, please reach out to the account owner and ask them to resend it to you.

Desktop
You need to create a password to complete your account activation, which can only be done through the desktop. Click on the additional radio button to agree to the terms and security requirements, and then click the
ACTIVATE ACCOUNT
button.
Mobile App
To use Lofty on your phone, we recommend downloading the Lofty mobile app. Learn more here:

. Once the app has been downloaded, sign in using the same credentials as you use to log in to lofty.com.
Change Your Password
To make sure your account is secure, you can change your Lofty login password. To do so, click on the
Settings
icon from the menu at the top:
Make sure
Account & Security
is selected on the left side, and then click "Change Password":
Remember to write down your new password for future reference! If you do happen to forget, you will have the option to reset it if necessary.
How to reset your Lofty Password (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360015946952)
Change Your Login Email

to update your Lofty account login email. Click the edit icon next to your email address.

#### Article 325: Virtual Business Cards

- Article ID: `27353952007579`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `User Settings`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T06:05:50Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/27353952007579-Virtual-Business-Cards

Introduction
A Virtual Business Card allows you to quickly send your contact information to a lead via text. Your contact information can be imported directly into the lead's address book or contact management system.
Summary
Creating Your Virtual Business Card (#h_01J2M0P1H06K8JS52HGP7J6FEX)
Sharing Your Virtual Business Card (#h_01J2M16S80JCJWKGAC4RZ18BNR)
Creating Your Virtual Business Card
Your virtual business card will already be created for you, using the information on your Lofty user profile. If you edit the business card, it will not edit your Lofty account information. This means you can add a different photo, phone number, email address, etc. to your virtual business card, and that information will not automatically be available on your Lofty user profile.
Navigate to
Settings > Profile
and click
Manage My Virtual Business Card
to get started.
The Virtual Business Card will automatically import your information from your user profile. Here, you can edit that information or add additional information that you want to share with your contacts. Anything you add or alter on the Virtual Business Card will stay on the Virtual Business Card and will not be added or altered on your user profile or website.
Click
Edit
to update your Virtual Business Card. The card can only be edited on the web.
The only required information on the Virtual Business Card is your first and last name. All other information is optional. The address, URLs, and notes will be blank and allow you the freedom to complete this information if necessary.
Sharing Your Virtual Business Card
Your Virtual Business Card can only be shared with leads. You can share your card or the Virtual Business Card of any other Lofty users that you can see on your account. This makes it easy to refer your leads to your colleagues.
To send the Virtual Business Card, open a text with the lead and select the business card icon. A list of all of the agents on your account will appear, with your own Virtual Business Card at the top. Use the search bar to find a specific agent's card to send. This functionality is available in both the web and mobile apps.
When the lead receives the Virtual Business Card, it will look like this:
The card is available to view in your chat history with the lead.
You can also add a Business Card to the smart plan (Auto Text). If the selected agent is inactive or deleted, then the smart plan will be suspended.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 326: Working Hours & Vacation Mode

- Article ID: `360028368751`
- Category: `CRM`
- Section: `User Settings`
- Updated: `2025-11-07T06:09:48Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360028368751-Working-Hours-Vacation-Mode

Introduction
Working Hours and Vacation Mode are settings that can be adjusted by individual Lofty users and Team Owners/Admins in order to keep leads from being sent when a specific Lofty user is unavailable. If Working Hours are established and a lead comes in
outside
of those hours, it will
not
be sent to those who are marked as unavailable per the Working Hours or whose Vacation Mode is toggled on.
For more information on lead routing rules, see this article:
Lead Routing Rules (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055177831)
.
Summary
Individual Lofty User Setup (#h_01EKWV9E5CVBBF3JEYDPB5SPFR)
Office Owner/Admin Setup (#h_01EKWV9HHY61W7647AY8D5YH2J)
FAQ (#h_01EKWV9MH7CV2G86EYV4XSZTVS)
Is it possible to set up working hours that are on a night shift or cross-day schedule? (#h_01EKWVDBHC9EFQGXVEZ9YCRF4A)
Individual Lofty User Setup
Individual Lofty users can set this up from their Lofty accounts by doing the following:
Navigate to
Settings
Click on
Profile
under
My User Settings
In the
Working Hours
section, adjust the schedule and/or toggle on/off Vacation Mode.
Office Owner/Admin Setup
An Office Owner/Admin can adjust the schedule for themselves by following the steps outlined above in "Individual User Setup." However, if they wish to adjust the settings for their team members, they can do the following:
Navigate to
Settings
Click on
My Organization
under the
My User Settings
section
In the
Working Hours
column, adjust the schedule and/or toggle on/off Vacation Mode for the corresponding team member.
FAQ
Is it possible to set up working hours that are on a night shift or cross-day schedule?
No, this is currently not feasible with the working hour function. Currently, the "end time" always needs to be later than the "start time," meaning you cannot go from PM to AM with the current logic in place.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
