### Section: Landing Page

#### Article 393: Landing Pages

- Article ID: `360038228552`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Landing Page`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T02:27:48Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038228552-Landing-Pages

Introduction
"Landing Pages" are a single page created specifically for marketing and advertising to bring leads in and get them to register. With the Lofty CMS, the ability to create high-quality landing pages is quick and easy to access.
All users on a Lofty account with an IDX website can access landing pages. A
gents without a website will use the Team or Company Website to build landing pages. These users can create up to 10 landing pages. If the limit is exceeded, the user will need their own agent website or subdomain to create more landing pages.
All leads captured on these landing pages will be assigned directly to the agent who created the page. The account admin can disable the user's access to build landing pages by turning off the Landing Page permission (see
Organization - Permission Profiles (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4407530443291)
).
Summary
Adding Landing Pages (#h_01EH69KHCY2ENBPQ1CZ5BKPYYN)
Automatic Landing Pages (#AutomaticLandingPages-AutomaticLandingPages)
Recommendations (#h_01G7AY430VVKSJWB7C6Q9F9B2Y)
Editing Landing Pages (#h_01EH69KMPJPMMCFK7S5VBX0JJG)
Sharing / Using Landing Pages (#h_01EH69KRDM3A7QRA0AX57PGZK4)
Registration Rules (#h_01EH69PQADB0MJMYS3BS1GA2X6)
Viewing Conversion (#h_01EH69KWE8TK5ZH4RYQD73ERN4)
Adding Landing Pages
I want to let you know that the Landing Page functionality is not found directly in the CMS Tool. Instead, it is located in the "Marketing" section of Lofty.
Click on "Landing Pages" from the options available on the left and then click “Add a New Landing Page” to start building a page:
The first step is to choose a page template to use. Page templates provide the basic page skeleton for you to edit and will also provide default blocks and content on the new landing page that you create.
Available Templates:
All
This is all of the Landing Page templates
Listing
Includes the following:
Feature a Listing
New Listings
Open House Listings
Price Reduced Listings
Listing Search Campaign
Multi-Property with Map
For Seller
Includes the following:
Home Valuation
New Seller Form
Seller Guide Download
For Buyer
Includes the following:
Featured Area Page
Buyer Guide Download
Live Tour (Standard Listing)
Host a Live Tour
Activity
Includes the following:
Lead Registration Form
Meeting with leads
Build Your Own
The next step is to enter the page URL / Page Name / Lead Source according to your preferences and campaign goals. The leads registered on this page will be added directly to the Lofty CRM and classified into the source defined in this setting. All of these fields can be modified later when editing the page.
Click "Save" and you will then be taken to the new landing page:
Automatic Landing Pages
Automatic Landing Pages are a feature that creates landing pages every time a new listing is added to the MLS. This requires that your Agent ID be added to your integrated MLS. It is also required to have an active Lofty website as well; this can be a team website, an agent website, or an agent subdomain. When a new listing is created, it will be generated as the "Single Property Promotion" template.
You will also receive an email alerting you to the creation, and also with the link to the new landing page.
To distinguish these from other pages in your Tools section. The automatically created listing will have an "A" icon at the end of the name of the landing page that was generated.
You can disable this feature if needed at
Marketing> Landing Pages> Settings
Recommendations
A list of recommended (commonly used) landing pages is available at the top of the page. A landing page can be created directly from this list by clicking the button below the desired option. This menu can be hidden if no longer helpful.
Editing Landing Pages
In the interface to the edit page, you will see three floating icons on the left (Settings, Style, and Block Library, SEO):
Settings
In this section, you can configure the following:
Basic Info
Basic Settings:
Page Name
URL
Page Style
Lead Source
Lead Type (leads who register on this page will come in as this type)
Lead Privacy and Assignment
Lead Privacy (see
Lead Privacy: Team Leads vs. Private Leads (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003544406)
)
Assignment Method (Directly Assign vs. Assign via Lead Routing Rules)
Additional Actions
Tag
Note
Send Welcome Email (yes/no)
Send Welcome Text (yes/no)
SEO
Meta Page Title
Meta Page Description
SEO Cover Photo (what displays when sharing a link to social media)
Chat Box
Show Chat Box (yes/no)
Page Tracking
Google Analytics Account
Facebook Pixel ID
Style
In this section, you can edit the theme color, title style, and button style of your landing page.
Theme Color
. This consists of two parts: (a) primary color and (b) hover color. This includes all colors except the title and buttons. The primary color is the default color for most elements on a website. The hover color is the hover color of all clickable elements on the website.
Title Style
. You can edit the title style of all blocks
Button Style
. You can edit the style of all the buttons
Block Library
20+ block types can be added to any page by dragging and dropping the block to the right side. Each block type has different styles to choose from. If you want to modify the title, image, data, etc. of a certain block, double-click the block or click the "Edit" icon, and all of the content that can be edited on this block will be displayed.
For a full list of the blocks and how to use them, see this section in the Help Center:
Block Library (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/sections/360007590131-Block-Library)
.
You can drag a block to the desired position by using the arrow icon.
When finished with editing, always remember to click on the "Publish" button in the top-right in order for changes to be reflected on the live website.
Sharing / Using Landing Pages
Share on Social Media (Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn)
Whether you are on the interface to edit the page or on the page list, you can quickly share your landing page to Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn by clicking on the "Share" icon:
Share via Link
The direct link to the landing page can be copied and used in an ad campaign or on other social media platforms not currently supported to drive traffic to the landing page and obtain visitor registrations.
Share via Email/Text
On the
Landing Pages
section of the
Marketing
page, you can click on the "send" option to share the landing page directly to leads via email or text:
Upon clicking on the option to send a page, you will be able to filter out leads (200 at most) and send them via email or text:
Share via Chat
Click the LP icon to send a landing page to a lead directly via chat in the web or mobile apps. Use the search bar or filter to find the landing page you want to send.
Registration Rules
Landing page registration settings have been set up to make the transition to a redirected page work more smoothly. With this setting, the registration rules of the landing pages, a user can configure where registration is triggered.  This will allow users to better control the registration pop-up on this transition.
*IMPORTANT
: Please note that if you plan to test the registration rules (which is always a good idea), be aware that having the main IDX website and a landing page open at the same time and in the same browsing session, etc. will likely cause a conflict. Be sure to test using a new incognito window each time you test or be sure to clear the browser cache and cookies.
Viewing Conversion
You can view the conversion details and lead activities on each landing page directly on the list interface as seen below. The overview is not currently clickable, but you can filter by "Lead Source" or "Tag" directly on the People page if you have set those to register specifically for a landing page.
FAQs
Q:
Sounds like the 10 Landing Page limit is in place for users with NO website, and either a subdomain or website user can have more than 10.
A: Yes, users with a subdomain or website can create unlimited Landing Pages.
Q: When building an Open House Landing Page,
how does Lofty define “this week” (Sunday–Saturday or Monday–Sunday)?
A: When
"This week" is selected, the search will show properties listed as available this week. The time range for "this week" is from Sunday to Saturday.
Q: If an admin logs in using the main account to create a landing page for a subdomain, will the setting be available like the ones in the parent site?
A: Landing pages created in the parent (main) site cannot be directly synced or copied to subdomain sites. Each subdomain’s landing page is managed separately.
Q: Is the build your own page option available for all packages?
A: The "Build Your Own" option is NOT available for all packages. The ability to create a blank landing page (i.e., a fully customizable landing page where you can add/remove blocks as you wish) is only available on upgraded website packages. Specifically, this feature is included in:
Vanity Domain Website
Full SEO Website
Team Website (with upgraded package)
Company Website (Enterprise, with upgraded package)
It is NOT available on the basic/free/agent website, only packages.
Users on these entry-level packages do not have access to the blank landing page option or are limited to pre-set templates with minimal customization.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please get in touch with our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: LP, landing page, custom page, promotional page

### Section: Listing Block

#### Article 395: Listing Blocks

- Article ID: `360037923132`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Listing Block`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T05:14:41Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037923132-Listing-Blocks

Introduction
The "Listing Block" can be used to embed a specific selection of listings on any page that you build. This can be ideal to feature your listings, office/brokerage listings, or a specific type of listings. These blocks are added by default to the Home Page as well as on Neighborhood Pages. The instructions to use this block type are found in this article.
Here is an example of what these blocks typically look like:
Summary
Adding the Listings Block (#h_01FARTQR6XWCJBEWRXG73BBG2Q)
Editing the Listings Block (#h_01FARTQW6G7SZ3M98BJV8Z56J5)
Listings + Filters Help (#h_01FARTR0S3EPARCJ2ZNBMGWMK5)
External Website Widget (#h_01FARTT8FXM1X54VQJS6E8CJYQ)
Adding the Listings Block
To add the "Listings Block," navigate to the page where you would like to add it and then click on the "+ Blocks" button:
Drag the type of the "Listing Block" that you would like to add to the right side where you would like it to appear on your web page.
Editing the Listings Block
To edit the settings for this block, double-click on the block or click on the "Edit" icon in the top-right of that block:
Style 1
The first style looks like this:
In this style, the first thing to edit is the maximum quantity to display in this section before clicking on the "MORE LISTINGS" button:
You can then choose to select the listing source (All Listings, Sold Listings, Use Custom Listing Filter), any preset filters, and default listing sort.

affect the search results that a site visitor will see if they type into the search bar. In other words, the results populated by using the search bar on these blocks are

Introduction
If you have access to sold data from your MLS (not every MLS will provide this data), there is a toggle in the CMS Tool that allows for some basic adjustments to be made to the pricing information that is available for site visitors to see.
Adjust Settings
Previously, MLS organizations couldn’t fully control Sold Price visibility—it depended on website settings.
Now, the Sold Price display follows this logic:
Website OFF
→ Always hidden
MLS OFF
→ Always hidden
Both ON
→ Displayed
MLS OFF + Website ON
→ Hidden for that MLS’s listings
To adjust the settings, navigate to
CMS Tool
>
Listing Settings
>
Listing Info Settings
.
Show Listing Price
Toggle this option on/off to choose whether the listing price is shown on sold listings. This is displayed in the following locations:
- Sold Listing Search
- Sold Listing Detail Page
Show Sold Price
Toggle this option on/off depending on whether you would like the "sold price" to display on your website's sold listings. This is displayed in the following locations:
- Sold Listing Search
- Sold Listing Detail Page
Toggled-Off Display
If both of these are toggled off, this is how it will display on both locations (Non-Disclosure):
Note:
Prime MLS
requires explicit disclosure of data sources. To stay compliant, we have
removed the “Facts About the Property” section from Prime MLS’s sold listings.
FAQ
Q:
How far back do sold listings show from the MLS on the website?
A: We usually only support displaying listings sold in the last 3 years, and it also depends on what sold data is included in the MLS data feed.

#### Article 397: Location Search Bar Settings

- Article ID: `360046736851`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Listing Detail Page`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T05:15:46Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360046736851-Location-Search-Bar-Settings

Introduction
The LoftyIDX website Search Bar logic can be set to force the site visitor to choose from the provided suggestions in order to better narrow down their searches. This means that if a site visitor simply presses "Enter" on the keyboard or clicks the "Search" icon on the website, it will use the first suggestion as the default input value. When combined with the additional setting to determine what displays at the top (see
below
), this will increase the accuracy of listings shown when searching.
Summary
Search Bar Location Logic Optimization (#h_01EDPPRAQDG7EZ5N2ZMBK30WF1)
Search Bar Location Type Options (#h_01EDPPRJ424Z5NFRQZJN2BA9RB)
Search Bar Suggestions (#id-9/24/21:FeatureReleaseTrainingforCRM3.35,Site5.23-SearchBarSuggestions)
Questions? (#h_01H9K5MKYTBYTBSBV6Y0JPH1HA)
Search Bar Location Logic Optimization
By default, when a lead hits "Enter" or clicks on the "Search" icon, they will be sent to a results page showing listings associated with the first category (city, neighborhood, county, etc.) displayed. This is what is called an "Exact Search."
Exact Search
. If you choose one of the provided suggestions from the drop-down menu, the search will show listings based on the category chosen (city, zip code, etc.).
Fuzzy Search
. If you type in a value and press the “Enter” button on the keyboard or click the "Search" icon, listings will be shown without category restrictions (city, zip code, etc.).
If you would like to adjust this setting so that it is not "Exact Search" by default, you can change this setting in
CMS Tool
>
Listings
>
Listing Settings >
Location Search Bar
:
Search Bar Location Type Options
You can also access settings to customize what categories (city, neighborhood, zip code, etc.) appear when a site visitor uses the search bar on your Lofty IDX website. Perhaps you do not want to display a certain category, or you would like to change the order, or rename them. This is all possible with the available settings.
The setting is located under
CMS Tool
>
Settings
>
Listings
>
Location Search Bar
. With these settings, you can do the following:
Hide/Display
Reorder (determines which one displays first, second, etc.)
Rename
Search Bar Suggestions
If you go to one of our websites and simply click on the
Search Bar
, you will notice that it will automatically populate suggestions.
You can control which suggestions will populate by navigating to
CMS
>
Settings
>
Listings
>
Location Search Bar
>
Location Suggestion
. Any criteria added here will be auto-populated when a site visitor first clicks on the search bar. After they start typing, criteria matching their search will begin to populate, of course.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 399: External Website Widgets

- Article ID: `4403706761371`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Listing Embed`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T09:30:05Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4403706761371-External-Website-Widgets

Introduction
We currently support the creation of one type of block into a widget that can be embedded in an external website (not Lofty-built). Currently, only the
Featured Listings block (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037923132)
is supported with the widget feature, though more might be added in the future. This feature is also limited to certain packages.
*IMPORTANT
: Please review each of the following before continuing with this feature.
Basic front-end coding skills are needed to use this widget. We are
not
able to customize the code from implementation on another website, that is the sole responsibility of you as the Lofty user.
Even though the widget can be embedded in an external site, when a listing is clicked, it will link the lead back to the Lofty-built website.
Every time a change is made to the widget settings via the CMS, the code will be updated and will need to be changed on the external website. In other words, just because a change is made to the widget in the Lofty CMS does
not
mean that the change will be reflected in the location(s) where embedded.
The widget settings will
not
save the code as generated. In other words, this tool is for generating the code but
not
for saving it for future editing. You will need to generate a new code if you need to make changes in the future.
MLS compliance is extremely important to remember here. When embedding listings in an external website other than Lofty, MLS approval must be in place on that other website before displaying listings there. Lofty will
not
be able to track this and therefore will
not
be held responsible for any MLS violations that may result from the inappropriate use of MLS data.
How it Works
First, navigate to
CMS
>
Widgets
:
Choose the style of the featured listings to block that you would like to use. The settings will now appear on the left panel:
Click on the
Edit icon
to adjust the settings for this block (choosing the basic design, text, listing source, etc.)
Once the settings have been configured, click on the blue
Generate Code
button at the bottom:
To use the embed code, copy the entire code provided to your computer clipboard and then paste it into the desired location on an external website:
You can your widget configurations and give them a name so that you can edit and reuse them as needed.
Click on
Saved
to access all saved configurations.
FAQs:
Q: Is there a reason why certain sites would have the "widget" option and others wouldn't?
A:
The Starter and Core packages
do not
come with this feature. If you are on either package and interested in using this feature to its full effect, please contact
Support (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/115001982346)
to get upgrade options.
Q: Will an
agent site on an Enterprise account have this option?
A: Yes for Agent websites but Subdomains won't have the widget feature.
Questions?

#### Article 400: Advanced Control Panel for Agent/Office Criteria

- Article ID: `360038005212`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Listing Filter Settings`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T05:26:17Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038005212-Advanced-Control-Panel-for-Agent-Office-Criteria

Introduction
This article is only to outline the Agent/Office criteria which are options in listing filters under the “Sold” listing type. If you are looking for documentation on how to use standard listing filters, please click here:
Listing Filter Basics (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038373211)
.
How the Criteria Works (using “Agent” as an example)
When you add the “Agent” criteria in your listing filter with the Sold Listing Type. You will see a “gear” icon next to it.
When clicking on the “gear” icon, you will see a control panel popup with four options:
Filter by both the Listing Agent and Buyer’s Agent
. Display listings where the listing agent and buyer’s agent are the same person (that you select).
Filter by Listing Agent Only
. Display listings where the listing agent is the one you set (whether it is sold by the same agent or not).
Filter by Buyer’s Agent Only (Default)
. Display listings where the buyer’s agent is the one you set (whether it is listed by the same agent or not).
Filter By Listing Agent Or Buyer’s Agent
. Display listings where the listing agent or buyer’s agent is the one you set. If you choose this one, it also means the listings you display include all listings related to this agent.
*
IMPORTANT:
If you add multiple agents in the field, it will be an OR type of relationship meaning that it will be Agent 1’s listings + Agent 2’s listings, etc.
Each group can have different settings selected by using the Advanced Control Panel as explained in this article.
You can use these same guidelines to set up criteria by “Office” as well.
Don’t forget to save!
After any modifications, do not forget to click on the blue “Save” button at the bottom. You can then publish all changes to the website and your listings will be displayed as filtered per your settings.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 401: Listing Filter Basics

- Article ID: `360038373211`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Listing Filter Settings`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T05:19:20Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038373211-Listing-Filter-Basics

Introduction
Listing Filters allow you to be selective about the listings you want to display on your website. The listing filters put in place control the listings from all MLSs that are connected as well as any manual listings (formerly known as pocket listings) that you have added to your website.
*IMPORTANT
: With the filter options, you can inadvertently keep listings from displaying on the “All Listings” section of your website. When adjusting the filter and criteria for “All Listings,” be sure that you do not remove all the listings by accident.
Default Filters
There are two filters provided by default:
All Listings
. By default, these will display all listings that are active and on the market. You can adjust the criteria to prioritize certain price ranges, locations, brokerage listings, etc. All property alerts are based on this “All Listings” category, meaning that if you remove listings in this option, they will (a) not display on the website and (b) not be sent in property alerts.
Sold Listings
. If the data is provided by the MLS, sold listings can be displayed in this section based on the criteria you establish in this filter.
To find these two filters, click on the CMS Tool > Listing Filters > All Listings / Sold Listings:
Custom Listing Filters
All custom listing filters are built directly into the listing pages and listing blocks (that make up a page). To learn more about listing blocks, please reference
Listings (Featured) Block (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037923132)
. More information regarding listing pages can be found here:
Listings Pages (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402568813723)
.
This block can be edited by double-clicking the block or selecting the "Edit" icon for that specific block:
You would then select Listing Source > Use Custom Listing Filter. Normally, Lofty uses "All Listings" as the source for the block. However, if you need to create a specific listing set for the block. You can choose “Use Custom Listing Filter.”
Editing Listing Filters
When adding a new custom filter, you can select the Listing Type and the default sorting rule in the groups you set up. This sorting applies if you choose not to add any other criteria to a group.
Group Settings
Within a filter, you can add multiple groups with specific criteria to prioritize and display those in Group #1 first, then Group #2, etc. This is how the order of listings is prioritized for each filter.
You can “+ Add Criteria” within each group, reorder your groups, or click on the trash can icon to delete a group.
*IMPORTANT:
It is always best practice to check the “Listings Selected” to understand how many listings match the criteria that you are setting up in each of the groups. If “0,” this means that there are no active listings that match your current criteria within that group. If you are editing the “All Listings” filter, the last group should always have the remaining listings that you want to display on the site, but want to display AFTER the other groups ahead of it. You do not want to change this last group unless you no longer want these listings displayed on your website at all or have them sent via property alerts. This is a catch-all group that will display all listings
after
the other groups.
Filter Out Listings
You can add different criteria (the options available will depend on the MLS connected to your site) in each group to help you select the listings that you want to display. The following is a sample of the criteria available to you:
*IMPORTANT
:
If you check multiple checkboxes within criteria (e.g. Property Type), the relationship between each option is an "OR" relationship. For example, the listings selected with the criteria would combine all property types that you have selected (Single Family Homes + Townhouses + Vacant Land, etc).
If you add other criteria within the same group (e.g. Beds), the relationship between those criteria and the others (e.g. Property Type) is an "AND" relationship. This means that the results would be fewer because it finds the properties that match the Property Type filter AND have the range of Beds selected.
Listings Preview
When all your filters are established, you can check the "Results" by clicking the tab at the top to make sure that the listings displaying here are the correct ones and in the correct order as well. The order would be determined by the order of the Groups that you have created.
Advanced Control Panel for Agent/Office Criteria
This setting is related to the "Sold" Listing Type only. Please reference the following article for more information on how this works:
Advanced Control Panel for Agent/Office Criteria (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038005212)
.
Save your Filter
After any modifications, do not forget to click on the blue “Save” button at the bottom. You can then publish all changes to the website and your listings will be displayed as filtered per your settings.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Introduction
Lofty provides thirty-three (33 mobile-friendly website templates that are designed to load quickly, be optimized for SEO, and provide you with the flexibility you need to display your business. You first choose a template when you start your website for the first time on Lofty. However, if you would like to change this website template, that is also possible. Below are the template styles you can choose from:
Reliance, Hearth, Echelon, Primenest, Harmonia, Anchor, Nexus, Ambiance, Inspira, Elyssian, Serenity, Pinnacle, Prestige, Homestead, Apex, Azure, Elevate, Oakridge, Greenwood, Heritage, Verity, Skyline, Havenwood, Sundara, Serena, Aviara, Solace, Ember, Horizon, Lumina, Vista, Willow, Luxenest
Steps
To change the website template, click “Style” in the Page Editor first.
In the Style tab, select
Template
. When you select another template, you will immediately see the website style change in the preview interface on the right. You can also switch between pages to see how the change applies to different pages. When changing templates, you may need to adjust some individual block styles to make everything look its best.
If you want to go back to the previous style, click the "Undo" icon on the top bar.
Always be sure to click the "Publish" button in the top-right for changes to apply to the live website.
Currently, we only support switching between default templates and do not support switching to a custom template.

#### Article 404: Recruiting Templates

- Article ID: `39795015672475`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Lofty Templates`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T09:26:18Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/39795015672475-Recruiting-Templates

Introduction
Lofty users often ask for ways they can improve their recruiting efforts. To make it easier out of the box, we built recruiting landing page and website page templates.
Landing Page Templates
We frequently get asked for resources that will help companies recruit new agents. To address this request, we have built two new recruiting page templates for users to choose from. These page templates are available in the CMS editor and in the Landing Page library.
To get to the Recruiting Landing Pages, go to
Marketing
>
Landing Pages
>
Add a New Landing Page
Scroll down to the bottom or click on the Careers tab.
Why Join Us
and
Your Career Journey
are both landing pages designed to support recruiting efforts.
Here is a sample of Why Join Us:
https://salesdemo.lofty.com/recruiting-page-1
Here is a sample of Your Career Journey:
https://salesdemo.lofty.com/your-career-journey
Leads who register on a Recruiting landing page will enter Lofty with the lead type of Agent.
Webpage Templates
If you want to add recruiting pages directly to your Lofty website, go to Pages > Add Page > Recruiting.
Tips and Tricks
Here are some tips to make your recruiting efforts stand out:
Easy Application Submission Form:
End with a form for prospective agents to enter their contact information, upload a resume, or express their interest. This step initiates the application process, making it seamless for interested candidates.
Booking Link for Introductory Chat:
Include a scheduling link where interested agents can set up an informal coffee chat or meeting with someone from your brokerage to learn more.
Competitive Commission Splits:
Highlight clear details of commission splits, showcasing any unique advantages that set your brokerage apart.
Clearly explain commission plans (e.g., 100% commission options or split plans). A chart or table can be particularly effective in breaking down the options, allowing agents to quickly understand their earning potential.
Advanced Systems & Real Estate Technology:
Emphasize the technology tools provided, such as a CRM, lead management, and marketing automation, that help agents streamline their work.
Comprehensive Coaching & Mentorship Programs:
Describe personalized coaching options, mentorship for new agents, and development pathways that foster growth and career advancement.
Outline the 1:1 coaching and mentorship options, as well as any group training sessions, continuing education, or development programs offered to help agents build their skills and grow their careers.
Full-Service Support & Professional Workshops:
Mention the dedicated support staff and regular workshops that provide ongoing training and help with day-to-day tasks.
Culture & Team Environment:
Illustrate your company’s culture—whether it’s collaborative, innovative, or supportive—and share team photos or a short video.
Highlight the amenities available, such as meeting spaces, technology tools, or any on-site conveniences like a dedicated work cafe, gym access, or private workstations.
List any health or retirement plans, wellness programs, and financial perks that make joining your brokerage attractive beyond commission.
Authentic Agent Testimonials:
Include quotes or short videos from current agents who can speak to the impact the brokerage has had on their careers.
Dedicated Support Roles:
Detail the services provided by roles like the ISA for lead qualification, a Marketing Manager for content support, and a Transaction Coordinator for seamless transaction management.
Showcase the in-house support available, like practicing brokers for mentorship, a photographer or videographer, a real estate attorney, title company, and partnerships with lenders and vendors. This support can make agents feel equipped to succeed.
Leads Provided:
Highlight any partnerships with lenders that provide agents with vetted, ready-to-go leads through preferred lenders.
Mention if and how the brokerage provides leads, whether through a lead generation program/ads or preferred partners, to show agents you’re invested in helping them build their business.
Independence & Flexibility:
Emphasize the freedom agents have to build their businesses and control their schedules.
Emphasis on Work-Life Balance:
Showcase how the brokerage supports agents in balancing work commitments with personal life, an attractive aspect for both experienced and new agents.
Opportunities for New vs. Experienced Agents:
Include specific benefits for both brand-new agents (such as training and support) and experienced agents (like high commission splits and leadership opportunities).

#### Article 405: Global Listing Filters

- Article ID: `29397257666587`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `MLS Application & Compliance`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T03:29:38Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/29397257666587-Global-Listing-Filters

Overview
Some MLSs operate across multiple states, while you may only service a specific area and prefer to exclude listings outside of those regions from being displayed on your website or sent in your Lofty Property Alerts.
The Global Listing Filters feature allows you to customize the area in which which listings are displayed on your website, in the Listings tab, and sent in your Property Alerts. This is important to help you ensure compliance with local regulations and improving the overall user experience for yourself and your clients.
Key Features (#h_01J886J01GD1WEGBGXN1DRY868)
How to Configure Global Listing Filters (#h_01J886PFSSP970KB49QWG0304K)
Important Notes (#h_01J886NMFQF5325D3NAB429BDD)
Troubleshooting (#h_01J886KSQQM7F92CWKX3XJ55J5)
Key Features
Customizable Listing Display: You can select which Office or State listings you would like to have displayed or sent. Listings not meeting the selection criteria will not be accessible through Google search.
Unified Settings: The configuration applies across
all listing modules
in both the CMS and CRM, streamlining the management process.
How to Configure Global Listing Filters
Step 1: Access the Edit Global Filters button
Log into Lofty, then click
Website
>
Listings
>
MLS Integration
.
Look for the
Total Listings
edit button in the upper right corner. It will be visible only when there are active or pending MLSs.
In the selection window, specify the Office and/or State that you want to include. At the top,
Total Listings
will display the number of listings that match your selection.
Important Notes
Listings excluded from your selection will not be accessible on the website, in the CRM, or via Google search.
Ensure to regularly review and update your listing criteria as needed to remain compliant with local regulations and business needs.
Troubleshooting
If you encounter any issues while configuring the Global Listing Filters, consider the following:
1. Ensure that you have active or pending MLS listings. The module will not display if there are none.
2. Double-check your selection criteria for accuracy.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related term: Global listing filter

#### Article 407: MLS Application - Agreement Process

- Article ID: `31259313104539`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `MLS Application & Compliance`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T03:25:54Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/31259313104539-MLS-Application-Agreement-Process

Introduction
Lofty manages four types of MLS application processes: Agreement
,
Instruction (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/33091286385819)
,
Online (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/33091887424667)
, and
Vendor (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/33092749218331)
. These processes are designed to streamline your MLS applications and provide you with updates on their progress, as each MLS processes their application differently. Depending on the MLS you are applying to, you will go through one of the four processes.
Agreement
This article covers the Agreement process, which begins when you submit an MLS application in the CMS. The agreement is a document that outlines the terms and conditions between you (the agent and broker) and the MLS. To move forward with your application, both you and your broker need to sign this agreement.
Once you submit an MLS application in the CMS, you will go through the following four (4) stages:
Sign the MLS Agreement (#h_01JJA48418ZHJ1Y50D9XMCXEHP)
Lofty Reviews the Agreement (#h_01JJA4DR0AR14HMZ9YJ17S2HB2)
MLS Reviews the Agreement (#h_01JJA4MR4P5G474NZBHSTN42X4)
Data Integration (#h_01JJA4VSWBHF1SXDFV5XD95KK1)
1. Sign the MLS Agreement
Once you submit your MLS application, both you (the agent) and your broker must sign the MLS agreement for your application to proceed.
For Agents:
You will receive a link to electronically sign the MLS agreement via email. You may also see a "Sign Here" button in your CMS. Simply click the link, review the document, and sign it.
For Brokers:
Simultaneously, your broker will also receive a link to sign the agreement. Once both parties have signed, the agreement is complete and the application will proceed to the next stage.
2. Lofty Reviews the Agreement
After both parties sign the agreement, Lofty will review the document to ensure everything is accurate and ready for submission to the MLS.
Estimated Time:
This process typically takes about
two (2) business days
.
What Happens:
Lofty verifies the agreement and checks for any issues. If everything is in order, the agreement is submitted to the MLS for review. If more information is needed, Lofty will reach out to you for clarification.
What You Can Do:
If the application is pending at this stage for
over two (2) business days
, click the "Request Update" button in the CMS to notify our MLS Support Team.
Our Support team will prioritize your request and address it as soon as possible.
3. MLS Reviews the Agreement
Once Lofty submits the signed agreement to the MLS, the MLS will review it to ensure it complies with their standards.
Estimated Time:
This review usually takes
two (2) business days
, though timelines may vary by MLS board.
What Happens:
The MLS reviews your application, which may include website compliance checks.
If approved, your application status will update to "MLS Approved."
If there are any issues, Lofty will notify you with next steps.
What You Can Do:
If the application is pending at this stage for
over two (2) business days
, click "Request Update" in the CMS.
Our MLS Support Team will contact the MLS directly to confirm the status and provide you with an update.
4. Data Integration
Once the MLS approves your agreement, we will begin integrating the listing data into your CMS.
Estimated Time:
This process typically completes within
one (1) business day
after MLS approval and may take
up to ten (10) business days
for new MLSs.
Need More Help?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <
support@lofty.com (mailto:support@lofty.com)
>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Introduction
Lofty manages four types of MLS application processes:
Agreement, (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/31259313104539)
Instruction, (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/33091286385819)
Online, and

These processes are designed to streamline your MLS applications and provide you with updates on their progress, as each MLS processes their application differently. Depending on the MLS you are applying to, you will go through one of the four processes.
Online
This article covers the
Online process
, which begins when you submit an MLS application through the CMS. The process involves creating an online application and submitting the necessary details to move your application forward.
Once you submit an MLS application in CMS, you will go through the following four stages:
Lofty Reviews the Application (#h_01JJA6K3EH1ABTJ5GEJX63HV3F)
Waiting on the Client (#h_01JJA6XKRHDX8W7GPSN8FCYYSE)
MLS Reviews the Application (#h_01JJA728RAYB0XDDCJG6E6N321)
Data Integration (#h_01JJA774S1ZKTDSY8K1VSJ3B9H)
1. Lofty Reviews the Application
Once you submit your online application, Lofty will review the information to ensure all required details are complete and then submit an online application on third-party vendor platform on your behalf.
Estimated Time:
This process typically takes up to
two (2) business days
.
What Happens:
Lofty will verify your application for completeness and accuracy. Then, we will submit your online application on the third-party vendor platform on your behalf.
What You Can Do:
If your application is pending for
more than two (2) business days
, click the "Request Update" button in CMS. Our MLS Support team will prioritize your request and deal with your application as soon as possible.
2. Waiting on the Client
At this stage, you will receive an online invitation in your email, prompting you and your broker to sign the agreement. Or, you may be required to provide additional information or take further action to complete your application. The status is marked as "Pending on Client's Info."
Estimated Time:
This process can vary depending on how quickly you can provide the required information, but typically
two (2) business days
.
What Happens:
You will be contacted by Lofty if more details are needed. Please keep an eye on your email and phone for any updates.
What You Can Do:
If you need assistance or have questions, click the "Contact Lofty" button in CMS to reach our support team. Your email will automatically be sent to
mls_support@lofty.com (mailto:mls_support@lofty.com)
.
3. MLS Reviews the Application
Once Lofty submits your completed application, the MLS will review it to ensure compliance with their standards. This may include checks on your website.
Estimated Time:
The review process typically takes
two (2) business days
, but can vary depending on the MLS board.
What Happens:
The MLS will review your application, including any necessary compliance checks. If approved, your application status will update to "MLS Approved." If any issues arise, Lofty will notify you with next steps.
What You Can Do:
If the application is pending for
over two (2) business days
at this stage, click "Request Update" in CMS to notify our MLS Support team. We will follow up with the MLS to check the status.
4. Data Integration
Once the MLS approves your application, we will begin integrating the listing data into your CMS.
Estimated Time:
This process typically completes within
one (1) business day
after MLS approval and may take up to 10 business days for new MLSs.
FAQ
Q: How would I know if my Trestle Application process has been initiated?
A: Once the MLS Team successfully submits the application in the Trestle platform, an auto email will be sent to you advising that your signature is required to proceed with the rest of the steps.

Vendor process
, which starts when you submit an MLS application through the CMS. The Vendor process involves verification steps by specific MLS vendors to confirm your MLS membership before approving your application.

#### Article 411: MLS FAQs

- Article ID: `360046997872`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `MLS Application & Compliance`
- Updated: `2026-04-15T19:41:05Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360046997872-MLS-FAQs

Introduction
The MLS connection on the Lofty IDX websites is one of the most important reasons to be on Lofty! Here are some common questions to help you understand how things work.
Summary
How do I initiate my MLS application if I have already set up a site? (#h_01HAAYR3HQ5C3JBTZ4RSHKXAP1)
My MLS has more filters for finding properties on my website and setting up property alerts than I see on Lofty. Is that to be expected? (#h_01EF0G9QDGDQYDWZGDZH5EXJAK)
Can I connect multiple MLSs to one Lofty IDX site? (#h_01EFFWEK4PF3X28KZBYN6YSDW3)
What is VOW and how is it treated on my Lofty website? (#h_01F8E282CAVNF46NXXTNJTMP8E)
How can I check the status of the MLS applications for myself or users on my account? (#h_01HAAYR0W71Y0X2JHWC9CAK4AM)
My MLS has a data-sharing agreement with another MLS. Can I integrate that other MLS? (#h_01HQVCCF2KA4C3990WCKYT6FPY)
What should I do if a homeowner asks to remove their listing photos from my site? (#h_01J0V9VQSHWSTR582A8KERDXC6)
How do I initiate my MLS application if I have already set up a site?
There are 2 areas to get started with your MLS application.
1.
Listings Page
2.
CMS Tool> Listings> MLS Integration
My MLS has more filters for finding properties on my website and setting up property alerts than I see on Lofty. Is that to be expected?
Yes. Because Lofty works with such a large variety of MLSs, we are unable to map all of the fields by default since they are all so different. However, we completely understand the value of adding additional filters that might be key to your business. Send a list to our Support Team (
support@lofty.com (mailto:support@chimeinc.com)
) so that we can help get them added.
Please send screenshots directly from your MLS of the fields that you would like to have available on your Lofty website and property alerts. Once we have the list and screenshots for the requested fields, it should not take more than a few business days to add them to the site.
Can I connect multiple MLSs to one Lofty IDX site?
Yes, you can, as long as there are no issues with MLS compliance that would keep this from happening.
The technology supports it and has no set limit
. Note that by putting two MLSs on one website you may need to build a custom navigation for better searching on your website as the search bar will search all MLSs that are connected to your site.
If you would like to add another MLS to your website, navigate to
CMS
>
Listings
>
MLS Integration
>
+ Add New MLS
:
If I have multiple MLSs connected to one Lofty IDX site, how does it treat duplicates?
The system will
attempt
to locate duplicates and remove one of them for a better homebuyer site experience. It will do this based on the address and will also try to identify slight differences in formatting (which can vary by MLS), such as "Street" vs. "St" or "Road" vs. "Rd." Please note that this is
not
a perfect solution, but it is one of the only ways to automate this. Some duplicates will still appear on your website.
What is VOW, and how is it treated on my Lofty website?
VOW stands for
V
irtual
O
ffice
W
ebsite. Some MLS data is only available via a VOW feed (different from an IDX feed). A VOW feed typically includes additional data and, therefore, requires specific rules to be followed to access the listing data via VOW. To maintain compliance with MLSs and certain VOW feeds, Lofty has been asked to lock down active listing data in addition to sold listing data. This just means that a site visitor has to create an account first, and then they can see the VOW data without issue.
How can I check the status of the MLS applications for myself or users on my account?
Navigate to the Listing dashboard on the CMS editor by going to Website > Listings. The MLSs can be sorted by All, Awaiting Signature, MLS Processing, Lofty Processing, Incomplete Application, and Active, as well as by specific Agent, MLS, and application start time.
My MLS has a data-sharing agreement with another MLS. Can I integrate that other MLS?
Yes, if your MLS has a data-sharing agreement with another MLS, we will automatically integrate that MLS into your IDX website. You will receive an email notification when this is complete.
What should I do if a homeowner asks to remove their listing photos from my site?
The listing photos on your site come from the MLS, along with the listing data. If a homeowner asks for the removal of certain images, please let them know that they contact their listing agent or the MLS directly to remove the photos from the MLS IDX feed. If this does not resolve the issue, Lofty can remove the images from our sites, but cannot guarantee complete removal.
How can I exclude MLS listings from other states or brokerages from appearing on my website?
This configuration should exclude the listings outside of the specified selection. The configuration becomes available only after an MLS application has been submitted. By clicking the 'Edit' button, you can filter listings by "Office" and "State".
If no filters are applied, the "Total Listings" number will display the total number of listings within the MLS(s), including those from MLSs that are still in the application process.
When filters are applied, the "Total Listings" number will reflect the count of listings based on the selected criteria.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: Add MLS, MLS application

#### Article 413: Calculator Block

- Article ID: `360037923072`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Mortgage / Affordability Calculator`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T09:13:06Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037923072-Calculator-Block

Introduction
The "Calculator Block" can be used to provide additional resources to your site visitors in a way that will assist them in their home-buying process. As a block that can be added to specific sections of pages, you are able to customize where you want it to appear.
Note: When using the Calculator Block, the currency will be displayed in USD.
There are two types of calculators available: (1) Mortgage Calculator and (2) Affordability Calculator. Both will be explained in this article.
Summary
Adding the Calculator Block (#h_01GYFQ33YFG04MB7B1712A61FV)
Mortgage Calculator (#h_01GYFQ3A91BR3PT4R2DZT31M5R)
Affordability Calculator (#h_01GYFQ3GY81NYTMBKE4GF1RS20)
Adding the Calculator Block
To add the calculator block, go to the Page Editor in the CMS Tool and select the "+ Blocks" button.
Choose the desired calculator that you want to insert and drag it to the right section of the CMS Tool.
Mortgage Calculator
The mortgage calculator can be used for website visitors to calculate their monthly payment based on the factors like home price, down payment, interest rate, etc. There are two styles of mortgage calculators:
Style 1
This mortgage calculator style includes a lead capture form. You can click on the "Edit" icon or double-click on the calculator block that you added in order to edit the available options. These options include editing the title and description as well as setting the default calculator values that you would prefer to display (until edited) including home price, down payment (%), loan term, interest rate(%), property tax rate (%), home insurance (per year), condo/HOA fees (per month).
In this style, you can also change the "Form Settings" including the title (displayed in the colored part to the right), the name format (full name or first and last name), and the phone number as required or optional. Also, if you want the leads to register before using the calculator, you can turn on the "Need to register before using" switch.
Style 2
This style is just the calculator portion (no lead capture) but has the same values that can be adjusted.
Affordability Calculator
The affordability calculator can be used by website visitors to calculate the number of houses they can afford. All of the fields (for which default values can be set) include annual income, down payment ($), other monthly debts, loan term, interest rate, property tax rate, home insurance (per year), condo/HOA fees (per month), and debt ratio (%).
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: Calculator block, Mortgage calculator, affordability calculator

### Section: Multilingual & Currency

#### Article 415: Language Translation and Currency Conversion Add On

- Article ID: `13764506865947`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Multilingual & Currency`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T02:35:52Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/13764506865947-Language-Translation-and-Currency-Conversion-Add-On

Introduction
The Language Translation and Currency Conversion add-on will allow you to automatically translate the language and convert the currency shown on your Lofty website and in your CRM. This is especially helpful if you service an international client base. The feature is a paid add-on that can be found in the Lofty Marketplace. This article will show you how it works and what it looks like for visitors to your Lofty website.
Summary
Purchasing the Language/Currency Add-On (#h_01GVRDHBSJACT1ZBVHT35BMHB5)
Utilizing the Language/Currency Add-On (#h_01GVRDHN37A9D4AEMG60CT9Z2M)
Editing the Translation (#h_01GVRDHW1EDZWH3B5Y0R1AVWEZ)
Website Visitor Experience (#h_01GVRDJ2KPN0BNQ4GABSC1TYCS)
Language Translation in the CRM (#h_01GVREGCE3QXK4VZBC27BHWEAR)
Lead Preferred Language (#h_01GVREGQFQN631WNGWPM2CV1V1)
Email/Text Template Translation (#h_01GVREH0273FJQNMQRD4S20RSG)
Purchasing the Language/Currency Add-On
This add-on will only be available to Lofty users who have their own Lofty IDX website. If you do not have a Lofty website, this will not be available in your Marketplace. To purchase the language translation and currency conversion add-on, first navigate to the Lofty Marketplace> Lofty Products> Branding and Marketing.
Click "Learn More" to view a gif that quickly demonstrates what this feature does, along with some additional information, and the option to purchase.
There are two (2) packages available, an Agent package and a Team package:
The
Team package
is available to be purchased by the Account owner only. This package allows for language translation and currency conversion in both the Lofty CRM and the Company or Team level website. The CRM translation and conversion will be available to all users
of the company/team
.
The
Agent package
is available to be purchased by any Lofty user. An Account owner may purchase this for individual users on their account, but non-account owner users may only purchase for themselves. This does not include any language translation or currency conversion in the CRM, it will only apply to the user's website for which it has been purchased.
Utilizing the Language/Currency Add-On
After purchasing the Language/Currency add-on, navigate to the CMS tool and click Settings -> Tools -> Language/Currency to get started.
To add a language or currency to your website, click "+ Add Language" or "+ Add Currency". At this time, we are only supporting a few options. Language translation is done by Google Translate, so we do recommend you only offer languages you speak, as you are able to edit the translation if it's not quite right.
Once a language or currency has been added, it can be deleted at any time. English and US dollars are the default options and cannot be deleted.
Editing the Translation
All content on the Lofty website, except for data provided by the MLS, may be edited. Navigate to the website editor and select the language from the drop-down menu. All of the content will automatically be translated into the selected language.
Editing the content is the same as how you would regularly edit the content in the Lofty IDX page editor. Please see this Help Center article for more information:
Add / Edit Website Pages (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037816472)
Website Visitor Experience
When a lead visits your Lofty website, they will have the option to select another language to currency to display in the header.
This will automatically translate the website and/or currency selected.
The website URL will include the parameter "lang=**" when website visitors switch to a non-English language on the Lofty website. This allows you to set a default language for your website through the URL when promoting the website externally.
Language Translation in the CRM
Lead Preferred Language
With this add-on, there will be a field on the lead's profile for the preferred language, which may be added or edited. This is an optional field, and it is not required when adding a new lead.
Email/Text Template Translation
A field will be added to the email and text message templates for the language. This is not a translation service, but a way to distinguish email/text templates that are written in another language. To access your templates, navigate to Settings -> Templates. When drafting a new template, select the language in the "Language" field.
This also allows the creation of email templates for automated emails, smart plans, and text messages in different languages.
FAQ:
Q:
Is this add-on extended to the subdomains?
A:
The add-on is only available for the Basic group site and does not include the subdomains.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, don't hesitate to get in touch with our Support Team via email at support@lofty.com, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chatting with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: language, currency conversion

### Section: Page Editor

#### Article 417: Add / Edit Website Pages

- Article ID: `360037816472`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Page Editor`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T02:36:29Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037816472-Add-Edit-Website-Pages

Introduction
Lofty provides a library of page templates to speed up the construction of your professional website. These page templates can serve as a foundation that can then be edited and rearranged according to the theme you are looking to present on your site.
Summary
Add a Page (#h_01F6663HSY34WQPM3MN5G9T4Q0)
Part 1: Basic Settings (#h_01F6663SZ1J8A4DGWPZQSX98DF)
Part 2: Page SEO (#h_01F6663XN7NCB2Y14E6DT8738P)
Part 3: Neighborhood Data (#h_01F666413QNNNNDFYXMH1N7WP8)
Edit a Page (#h_01F66645P60K0GVEHYGJJ76Z6M)
Add a Page
To add a page, click on the “Pages” button while in the Page Editor
Then, click on the "+ Add Page" button.
You will then need to select a page template. There are currently 12 types of page templates (more on the way). You can choose the template that best matches what you need to accomplish.
Current page templates include the following:
Home (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037816492)
Listings (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402568813723)
Sell (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038509131)
Home Evaluation (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038509091)
Reviews (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038133432)
Neighborhood Detail (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037816512)
About (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038509071)
Contact (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038133392)
My Team (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038133412)
Mortgage Calculator (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038509151)
Affordability Calculator (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360040092351)
Blank (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360039683372)
Link (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360040092491)
After you have selected the page, you will need to configure the page settings. There are two parts to this process (three if doing a neighborhood page). . .
Part 1: Basic Settings
The following are the options that can be configured in the "Basic Settings" section. Default values are provided by Lofty, but you can modify them as needed.
Page Name
: The name of the page that will be displayed on the CMS Tool and the website to distinguish it from other pages.
Page Template
: This section will simply display the page template that was selected in the previous step. You can also return to the previous step and select another one by clicking on "Change it."
URL
: Define the URL for this page.
Open Style
: Configure whether the link, when clicked, will open on the "Current Page" or as a "New Page."
Display Style
: Configure whether to show on desktop or mobile view.
Page Style
: Setting to turn on/off page header and footer.
There is also a setting to hide a page on all Agent Subdomains (see
Agent Subdomains (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360054744232)
). This option will only be available if the page can be hidden. Please note that the following pages
cannot
be hidden on Agent Subdomains:
Home
All Listings
Sold Listings
Home Valuation
Blogs
Market Snapshot
Listing Detail Pages
Agent Detail Pages
Blog Detail Pages
You may consider using this checkbox if you have a page that makes sense at the Team Website level but does not work as well on an Agent Subdomain. The setting is all or nothing--you are
not
able to choose which Agent Websites are affected.
Part 2: Page SEO
This section can be used to configure the meta title, meta keywords, and meta description of this page. This section also has support for inserting variables (merge fields). As the CMS-related values change, these meta fields can change automatically.
The "SNS Cover Photo" is the image that is displayed when sharing the link on platforms such as Facebook, etc.
In order to improve your website's SEO, it is recommended that you configure different content on different pages. You will also want to keep the meta content highly summarized. If you want to learn more about meta tags, please reference
Edit Website Meta Tags (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038183991)
.
Part 3: Neighborhood Data
*This section will only appear if you select the "Neighborhood Detail" page template.
More information about configuring this section can be found here:
Add / Edit Neighborhood Pages or Groups (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037816512)
.
---
*The final step is to click on the "Save" button. Please note that all added pages/folders will be located on the "Hidden Navigation" by default. See this article for more information on editing the navigation:
Edit Website Navigation Bar (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038184011)
.
Edit a Page
If you want to adjust the page style, please refer to
Add / Remove / Edit Blocks on Pages (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037816532)
.
If you want to modify the content of the page, click on the "Edit" icon on that page.
FAQ
Q: Is there a character limit when adding a Page name?
A
: Yes, 50 characters maximum.

#### Article 418: Edit Website Navigation Bar

- Article ID: `360038184011`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Page Editor`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T02:36:18Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038184011-Edit-Website-Navigation-Bar

Introduction
The website navigation is the outline of the available pages on the website for any site visitor to select from. It is very important to have this section up-to-date and customized to present the correct pages and in the correct order. All edits to the navigation will be reflected in this section of the website:
Edit Navigation
To edit the navigation, click “Pages” on the Page Editor, and the page list will appear here with all of your pages. The page list consists of two parts: (1) Displayed Navigation and (2) Hidden Navigation.
Displayed Navigation vs. Hidden Navigation
Displayed Navigation
This is also called "Menu" and contains all pages displayed on the website navigation bar. If you want to display a page on a website, drag it to this section.
Hidden Navigation
It contains all pages that are not displayed on the website. Hiding a page on the navigation keeps that page as an actual page on the website, but it will not be displayed on the navigation menu. If someone had the direct link to that page, they could still navigate to the page even though it does not appear on the navigation.
"Page" vs "Folder" vs "Page Group"
Page
A page is a specific link that connects directly to a specific page with its URL, etc. A page can be listed at the top level of the navigation (i.e., clicking on "Home" takes you directly to the home page) or you can list a page within a folder.
Folder
A folder is a category that can be used to organize the website navigation above and beyond simply having one level of pages. In the example below, "Test Folder" is a folder that is listed directly on the main navigation. When a site visitor hovers over the "Test Folder," they are presented with the content within that folder. In this example, "Blogs" and "Test Subfolder" would be on that list. Folders can also be nested again within another folder (only one more level maximum), as seen in this example.
Page Group
A page group is a group of pages.  The pages in the page group are all at the same level in the navigation menu and have the same style and different content. These are grouped for easy management. There are currently several types of page groups:
Neighborhood Detail
Property Detail
Sold Property Detail
Agent Detail
Blog Detail
Add Pages/Folders
*Please note that all added pages/folders will be in the "Hidden Navigation" section by default.
To add a folder, click on the "+ Add Folder" button, type in the folder name, and click Enter on the keyboard. You can then save pages within the folder as described above.
To add a page, click on the "+ Add Page" button, and you will see the 12 types of page templates, each with different styles available to choose from. For more detailed steps on adding pages, please see the following articles:
Add / Edit Website Pages (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037816472)
Add / Edit Neighborhood Pages or Groups (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037816512)
Reorder Pages/Folders
Reorder the pages on the navigation menu by simply dragging and dropping the page/folder to the location where you would like it to be on the website.
Delete Pages/Folders
Click "Delete" to delete the corresponding page/folder. Just so you know, deleting a folder will also delete all pages/subfolders under that folder.
Remove Pages from Agent Subdomains
Click "Settings" to access that page's settings.
To remove a page from Agent Subdomains, uncheck the box. This will remove the page from all Agent Subdomains.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.

#### Article 419: How to Save / Restore Website Versions

- Article ID: `360038182591`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Page Editor`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T02:36:52Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038182591-How-to-Save-Restore-Website-Versions

Introduction
Many users constantly adjust the website style in order to get more website traffic and higher conversion rates but sometimes find that better results were seen on previous website versions. In this scenario, being able to easily go back to a previous version would be ideal. This CMS Tool feature makes this possible without having to do so one by one.
*IMPORTANT
:
Currently, Lofty only allows for managing six (6) website versions. You will need to delete any unnecessary website versions in order to use those slots for other versions. You can always edit the name of the versions should you want to make changes and re-use it as something new.
We recommend that before switching between versions you save the current version as a new one in case you need to "undo" the change you just made.
If you build landing pages (see
Landing Pages (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038228552)
), these are
not
affected by this site version tool. In other words, if you create a landing page but then make a change on your website by restoring it to a previous version, it will
not
delete the landing page.
Step 1: Save Website Version
After completing any website edits and deciding that the current website version is an important one to keep track of, you can click on the "Save" icon in the top-right.
You will then need to give the version a name:
The version will then appear on the list of site versions.
Step 2: Restore Website Version
To restore a previously saved website version, click on the "website version" icon on the top menu in the middle:
After clicking on this section, you can see all the saved website versions. Select the version of the website you want to restore and click "Restore."
After clicking "Restore," the website preview will be restored to the selected website version, and all current operations will be overwritten.
Please note that this website version will not take effect until you click "Publish." If you no longer want to restore to this website version, click the "Undo" icon on the top bar.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: site version, restore site

#### Article 422: Blank Page

- Article ID: `360039683372`

- Section: `Pages`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T02:30:49Z`

Please note that the header and footer sections can only be edited on the Home Page. Hover over the header or footer blocks and then click the "Edit" button. You can adjust some details of the Header and Footer.
Helpful Website Tips
Best practice for website photos
Hero Image - 3000×1000px, recommended file is .jpg
Mobile Image - 800×640px, jpg, the recommended file is .jpg
Logo size and quality - 96 pixels in height, the recommended file is .png
(Generally, a logo that is twice as wide as it is tall works best)
Headshot/profile size and quality - 400x400px, recommended file is .jpg
For the SNS, the recommended size is 920 x 300 pixels. Maximum file size of 5MB. JPG, GIF, or PNG
Featured Blog Image - ratio of approximately 5:1 would be more appropriate

#### Article 425: Link Page

- Article ID: `360040092491`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Pages`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T02:30:38Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360040092491-Link-Page

Introduction
A "Link Page" is simply a page that appears on the navigation menu that, when clicked, will take the visitor to the indicated destination page which can be either an internal Lofty page or an external page on another website. Lofty users
cannot
add/remove blocks and edit blocks within this type of page unless it is built on Lofty.
Adding a Link Page
On the CMS Tool and while on the Page Editor, click on "Pages":
Click on "+ Add Page" at the bottom of the left menu:
Click on the "Link" template from the available options and then click on "Next":
Adjust the link settings and then click on "Save" to add the link:
Page Name
. This is what will be displayed on the navigation menu.
URL
. Must begin with an "HTTP" or "HTTPS"
Open Style
. "Current Page" means that when clicked, it will change the page to the destination page added in the URL. "New Page" means that it will open a new tab/window, depending on browser settings.
Display Style
. Toggle on/off whether this should display on the menu when the site is being viewed on either a computer or a mobile device.
The linked page will now appear on the "Hidden Navigation" and can be moved to where you would like it to display.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: link page, hyperlink, redirect

- Article ID: `360046759392`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Pages`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T02:30:31Z`

Introduction
The "Market Snapshot" page consists of four elements: (1) Search Bar, (2) Market Statistics, (3) Listing List, and (4) Contact Form. This is a default page on Lofty IDX websites, so you can easily find it on the hidden menu (see
Edit Website Navigation Bar (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038184011)
) if you would like to use it, but you can also build multiple market snapshot pages based on the marketing areas that you service.
Here is an example of what this page typically looks like:
*Please also note that in an
upcoming
release, when a lead clicks on a link/button in a Market Snapshot email, they will also be taken to this page. Until that release, they will be taken to the old Market Snapshot pages which will still display content.
Market Snapshot Page Summary
Market Snapshot Page Breakdown
(1) Search Bar (#h_01EEKGDVJY8GCW1GYKY1GQP5Y4)
(2) Market Statistics (#h_01EEKGDZTZQMSKRBV9HHVP9ADJ)
(3) Listing List (#h_01EEKGE4C407F76F1V05P3HM23)
(4) Contact Form (#h_01EEKGE93A46R1WBVFVTQ6CYTH)
Adding a New Market Snapshot Page (#h_01EEKHBSV0DD9K7AZSC7BZTJB3)
Edit the Market Snapshot Block (#h_01EEKHD3W2PBG905CY5NRDKEVV)
(1) Search Bar
Site visitors can change the search criteria based on the information they are looking for. This will display the local market trends that they might be interested in.
*IMPORTANT
: Please note that site visitors must input at least one location criteria in order for information to be displayed on this snapshot page.
(2) Market Statistics
Site visitors can view the sales statistics for the last 30 days. The system will also compare the data from the last 60 days to show how the market might be changing.
*IMPORTANT
: Please note that some MLSs may not provide sold listings to Lofty. Without sold listings, this report cannot be generated.
(3) Listing List
The system will sort the listings based on the different Listing Status, So visitors can know the details about how the market changes.
*IMPORTANT
: Please note that the sold listings displayed here are restricted by the "Sold Date" filter under the advanced search panel (see
Listing Filter Basics (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038373211)
).
(4) Contact Form
This is basically the same as other contact forms used throughout the website. See
Form Block (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402562066971)
.
Adding a New Market Snapshot Page
To create a new Market Snapshot page, open the CMS Tool, navigate to the Page Editor, and click on the "Pages" button in the top-left:
Click on "+ Add Page" at the bottom of the menu:
Choose a template under the "Market Snapshot" category:
Set up the basic configuration for a page and click "Save":
Edit the Market Snapshot Block
Please reference the following article for more instructions:
Market Snapshot Block (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360059380491)
.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at support@lofty.com, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat
through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: Market snapshot block

- Article ID: `4402562066971`
