#### Article 453: How Lofty Secures Your Website

- Article ID: `29366727277211`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Member Website`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T03:00:50Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/29366727277211-How-Lofty-Secures-Your-Website

At Lofty, we prioritize the security of your website and the protection of your business. Our team is continuously working to enhance the security of all websites hosted on our platform to ensure that you, your clients, and your leads are protected from potential threats such as spam and fraudulent activities.
While no website can be 100% immune to unwanted traffic, Lofty has taken several important measures to safeguard your site. This article outlines what Lofty is doing to secure your website and provides tips on how you can defend against fraudulent lead registrations and other malicious activities.
Summary
Lofty's Two-Layer Security Approach (#h_01J85MA62VJ79B7HGC4851PJ7Q)
Front-End Security Layer (#h_01J85MA62VG3YWTECNXAMX2FM5)
Back-End Security Layer (#h_01J85MA62VR3Y6KTHMF279W5Z0)
How You Can Defend Against Fraudulent Leads (#h_01J85MA62VN74EEM1F1PZB7W7Z)
Be Cautious with Off-Platform Communication (#h_01J85MA62VMV8BNW8BBDE50VJ6)
Lofty’s Commitment to Your Security (#h_01J85MA62V8QZBNVM663NTZZ67)
Lofty's Two-Layer Security Approach
Lofty implements a robust two-layer approach to protect your website, comprising both
front-end
and
back-end
security measures. These layers work together to mitigate potential threats while ensuring that your website remains accessible to legitimate visitors.
Front-End Security Layer
In the front-end security layer, Lofty configures a set of
Web Application Firewall (WAF)
rules designed to filter out unwanted traffic, including spam crawlers and junk requests. These rules help prevent malicious activities before they even reach your website's core systems.
Blocking Unauthorized Access
: Traffic from certain regions or countries unlikely to have a legitimate interest in U.S. or Canadian real estate is blocked, reducing exposure to spam and fraudulent leads.
Preventing Exploits
: Lofty blocks illegal requests attempting to exploit system vulnerabilities or disrupt operations. This includes shielding your site from common web-based attacks, such as SQL injection or cross-site scripting (XSS).
Mitigating DDoS Attacks
: If a request matches the criteria of a
Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS)
attack, it is immediately blocked, preventing attackers from overwhelming your site with a flood of illegitimate traffic.
When a request is flagged by our WAF, it is responded to with a
403 Forbidden
status, effectively preventing the traffic from proceeding further.
Back-End Security Layer
In the back-end security layer, Lofty performs thorough analysis and filtering of traffic that passes through the initial front-end defenses. This layer involves:
Monitoring Access Logs
: We continuously monitor access logs to identify suspicious IP addresses that may be attempting to disguise themselves as legitimate users. If a potential threat is detected, users from these IPs are blocked.
Regular Rule Updates
: Our security engineers periodically review and update our WAF rules based on new findings and trends, ensuring that our defenses remain effective against evolving threats.
This two-layered approach ensures that for the most part, only legitimate traffic gains access to your website, while suspicious activity is filtered out and handled appropriately.
SSL Encryption
All Lofty websites come with
SSL (Secure Sockets Layer)
encryption, which secures the transmission of data between your website and its visitors. This encryption ensures that sensitive information, such as login credentials and personal details, is protected from interception by unauthorized parties.
Secure Hosting on AWS
Lofty websites are hosted on
Amazon Web Services (AWS)
, a leading cloud platform known for its robust security infrastructure. Hosting on AWS ensures that your website benefits from industry-leading measures that prioritize data integrity, availability, and security.
How You Can Defend Against Fraudulent Leads
Even with these security measures in place, fraudulent leads may still find their way through. Here are some steps you can take to protect your business from potential threats:
Be Cautious with Off-Platform Communication
If a lead requests communication via non-traditional methods, such as WhatsApp, take extra care to verify their identity. Fraudsters often use off-platform channels to avoid detection.
Watch for Red Flags
Fake leads often include incomplete or suspicious information. Pay attention to:
Names
that seem generic or fake.
Emails
from suspicious or random domains.
Phone numbers
that don’t correspond to the expected area or country code.
Validate Lead Intent
Some fraudulent leads may appear interested in your services but quickly shift the conversation to irrelevant topics, like personal information or financial details. Be cautious and always verify a lead’s intent before engaging further.
What to Do If You Encounter a Fraudulent Lead
If you suspect that a lead is fraudulent, follow these steps to protect your business:
Do Not Engage
: Avoid responding to the lead or providing additional information.
Report the Lead to Lofty
: Notify Lofty support immediately. Provide us with the lead’s details so that we can investigate and take action.
Flag Suspicious Emails
: If you receive a phishing attempt through your website, mark the email as spam in your email client to prevent future attempts.
Lofty’s Commitment to Your Security
Lofty is committed to keeping your website secure by continually monitoring and enhancing our platform's defenses. By following these best practices and staying vigilant, you can help protect your website from fraudulent activities.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 454: Hyperlocal Website

- Article ID: `47502661499547`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Member Website`
- Updated: `2026-03-30T16:53:39Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/47502661499547-Hyperlocal-Website

Introduction
The Lofty Hyperlocal Website is a premium website package designed to establish you as the go-to real estate expert in your local market. This article walks you through what the package includes, how to purchase it, and what to expect after you do.
Summary
What Is a Hyperlocal Website? (#h_01KK2HG9PG2X1G3NDQKXMVBXBT)
Why Choose a Hyperlocal Website? (#h_01KK2HM4CJZ99M4FD3CK3E3SK6)
How to Purchase a Hyperlocal Website (#h_01KK2HR24P4RARQ2HYZGVPCBYR)
What Happens After You Purchase? (#h_01KK2J0ZQP8V6KG6N3GYJ1N937)
What Your Hyperlocal Website Includes (#h_01KK2J2H8HAJQD3XEWH4ARVB6H)
Frequently Asked Questions (#h_01KK2J79BQZ47184HDZF9KNSCT)
What Is a Hyperlocal Website?
A Lofty Hyperlocal Website is a professionally designed, AI-powered website built specifically around your specialized area. Unlike a standard real estate website, a Hyperlocal Website focuses deeply on the neighborhoods and communities where you work, giving buyers and sellers a reason to see you as their local authority.
The package combines two things: a hyperlocal website plan and a done-for-you design service. That means Lofty's team handles the setup for you. You do not need to build anything yourself.
Why Choose a Hyperlocal Website?
Establish yourself as the neighborhood expert with a site built around your specific farm areas, not generic content.
AI generates your site content using your marketing profile, including area pages, neighborhood guides, and blog posts designed to rank in local search results.
An interactive Click Map lets visitors explore your farm areas visually, driving engagement and capturing lead information.
A premium homepage showcases your brand, active listings, and social proof in a polished, professional design.
Three SEO-optimized blog posts are published automatically to help build your online presence from day one.
The done-for-you service means a Lofty team member handles the site setup process with you directly, so you are not on your own.
How to Purchase a Hyperlocal Website
Go to the Marketplace
From the main navigation, click Marketplace. Under the Branding and Marketing section, you will see the Hyperlocal Website card listed first.
Review the package and click "Get Website Now"
On the product detail page, review the package details and pricing. The "We do it all for you" bundle will be pre-selected. This is the only available option. When you are ready, click Order Now to continue.
Select the website owner
If you are an Account Owner purchasing on behalf of a team member, select the member's name from the list on the next screen.
Review and Pay
Review your order summary and complete payment using your saved payment method.
Confirm your purchase
After payment is processed, a confirmation message will appear. Click to close it.
You will receive a confirmation email shortly after purchase. A member of the Lofty team will reach out within 24 business hours to begin your site setup.
What Happens After You Purchase?
Here is what to expect after completing your purchase:
1.  You receive a confirmation email
A confirmation email is sent immediately after purchase. It confirms your purchase and introduces your new Hyperlocal Website. Keep this email for your records.
2.  Lofty reaches out within 24 business hours
A Lofty team member will contact you to kick off the setup process. They will work with you to confirm your farm areas, preferences, and any additional details needed to personalize your site.
3.  AI builds your site
Once setup begins, Lofty's AI analyzes your marketing profile and builds your complete Hyperlocal Website automatically. The AI-generated site includes everything listed in the next section.
What Your Hyperlocal Website Includes
Once your site is built, you will have a complete, ready-to-launch website with the following:
Premium Homepage
A professionally designed homepage that showcases your brand, your active listings, and social proof like reviews and endorsements. This is the first thing visitors see when they land on your site.
Interactive Click Map
An interactive map of your specialized areas is embedded directly on your site. Visitors can click on individual neighborhoods to explore area information, which drives engagement and prompts visitors to submit their contact information.
Hyperlocal Area Pages
Each of your areas gets its own dedicated page with neighborhood-specific content, local market data, and community insights. These pages are designed to rank in local search results and give visitors a reason to stay on your site.
Four SEO-Optimized Blog Posts
Four blog articles are written and published to your site automatically. Each article is optimized for search engines around keywords relevant to your farm area, helping you build organic visibility online.
Frequently Asked Questions
Q: I already have a website on my account. Can I still purchase a Hyperlocal Website?
A: Yes, you can purchase a Hyperlocal website, but it will not replace your existing website. You will now own two websites.
Q: Can I purchase a Hyperlocal Website for someone on my team?
A: Yes, if you are an Account Owner you can purchase a Hyperlocal Website for any team member. During the purchase flow, you will be asked to select which member the website is for.
Q: How long does it take to get my website set up?
A: A Lofty team member will reach out within 24 business hours after your purchase to begin the setup process. The time to complete the full build will depend on the details confirmed during onboarding.
Q: Can I buy just the hyperlocal website without the design service?
A: No. The hyperlocal website plan is only available as a bundle with the done-for-you design service.
Q: Can I edit my site content after it is live?
A: Yes. Once your site is live, you can log in to Lofty CMS to update content, add new blog posts, edit area pages, and make other changes at any time.
Q: Will the blog posts and area pages be updated automatically over time?
A: The four blog posts and area pages are generated at the time your site is built. Ongoing updates to content are your responsibility through Lofty CMS. Contact the Lofty support team if you have questions about adding or refreshing content.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

- Article ID: `37950239399451`

Introduction
Whether you're a Company, Team, Office, or Agent, your website plays a key role in showcasing your brand and supporting your business goals. It is where your leads start to build trust with you, find their dream home,
In this guide, we’ll walk you through how our website system works, how your site is built, and how you can unlock powerful packages to take your online presence to the next level. From custom domains to full SEO control, we’ve got the tools to help you stand out and stay on brand.
Summary
Website Types (#h_01JXK1NS9BNFGVQR1W9KNH8TRC)
Company Website (#h_01JXK1NNZ6PNJQ1FNAV841Q3JJ)
Agent Website (#h_01JXK1P3QNC8RCQXA4XCA395R9)
Team Website (#h_01JXK1PBHPSQKADVV2ZGAWC5GH)
Office Website (#h_01JXK1PP54MVN1TQHS26E6795R)

Full SEO Website (#h_01JXZJ5XQTXRX8APXRGM6T9HX9)
Purchase a Website Package (#h_01JXK3CVFBYD24PB92E344RFRC)
Website Types
Website Type refers to who the package is for. There are Company Websites, Agent Websites, Team Websites, and Office Websites. In the section below, we’ll walk through what each type includes right out of the box. After that, we’ll explore the available upgrade paths so you can see how to expand your site as your goals grow.
Company Website
1 Company Website is included with each Lofty package.
Site Owner
: Lofty Account Owner
Site Level
: Company
Site Type
: Full Site
Able to configure a vanity domain. Has full SEO capabilities and unlimited personalization.
Must go through an individual MLS application to get the data connected
Websites nestled beneath a Company website will be copies of the Company website.
Agent Website
1 Agent Website is included per user (except the Company Owner). Additional Agent Websites can be purchased if you want different branding or work in different areas.
Site Owner
: Lofty Users, except Account, Office, or Team owners.
Site Level
: Individual User
Site Type: Basic
Has limited customization and feature access
Based on the Company, Office, or Team website above it.
Does not need to go through an individual MLS application. Listings are provided by the Company, Office, or Team website.
Always a third-level domain (firstname.website.com)
Team Website
1 Team website is included with the purchase of a Team Add-On.
Site Owner
: Team Owner
Site Level
: Team
Site Type
: Full Site
Able to configure a vanity domain. Has full SEO capabilities and unlimited personalization.
Must go through an individual MLS application to get the data connected
Websites nestled beneath a Team website will be copies of the Team website.
Office Website
1 Office website is included with the purchase of an Office Add-On.
Site Owner
: Office Owner
Site Level
: Office
Site Type
: Basic
Has limited customization and feature access
Based on the Company or Office website above.
Does not need to go through an individual MLS application. Listings are provided by the Company or another office website.
Always a third-level domain (firstname.website.com)
Website Packages
The Company Website is the core structure that other websites are built on. This setup ensures consistency across your brand while giving you the flexibility to grow.
To go beyond the basics, you can unlock additional features through Website Packages:
Vanity Domain Website
Unlocks the ability to set a custom domain name for your website, giving you a branded, professional web address.
You can bring your domain, or you can purchase one through Lofty.
Full SEO Website
Enables full customization of your website content and structure, along with advanced tools to optimize your site for search engines.
What to choose? If you're an agent who wants to stand out with a fully customized site, you'd start with your Agent Website and unlock Full SEO. Or if you're part of a team looking for a branded domain, Team Website + Vanity Domain is the perfect fit.
You can tell what package you have in the CMS site list.
Purchase a Website Package
In the Marketplace under Branding and Marketing, you will see Vanity Domain Website and Full SEO Website.
If you are a Company, Team, or Office Owner, you have the option to purchase for your Agents or your Team/Office(s).
If you are an Agent, you will only have the option to purchase for yourself.
Go to your Lofty Website
To find your Lofty website, go to
Website
in the top menu navigation.
This will take you to the Site List. Here, you will be presented with a list of the websites to which you have access. This will vary based on permissions, but if you are the Company Owner/Admin, you will be able to see
all websites,
and if you are a Team or Office Owner/Admin, then you will see all websites within the team or office that you manage.
Clicking on the site you would like to manage will take you to the CMS editor. Here, you can manage the appearance of your website, your website settings, listing filters, blog posts, and more.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at support@lofty.com, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 458: Strategy for handling DNS issues

- Article ID: `27551462183451`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Website Domain`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T06:32:34Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/27551462183451-Strategy-for-handling-DNS-issues

Introduction
This article will help you understand DNS errors and provide guidance on how to resolve them.
What is a DNS Error?
DNS (Domain Name System) errors occur when your domain's DNS settings are incorrect or incomplete, preventing your website from being accessed properly. DNS errors can arise from various issues, including misconfigured records or failed domain renewals.
DNS Errors and their Impact
DNS Record is empty
Impact:
Your website cannot be reached because there are no DNS records configured for your domain.
Explanation:
Without DNS records, the domain has no direction on how to connect to the server hosting your website.
DNS Record has an error
Impact:
Your domain points to incorrect addresses, leading to various issues like 404 errors, 5xx errors, or being directed to another platform.
Explanation:
This occurs when all existing A and CNAME records are incorrect and need to be reconfigured.
CNAME DNS Record has an error
Impact:
Your domain points to incorrect addresses, leading to various issues like 404 errors, 5xx errors, or being directed to another platform.
Explanation:
The specified CNAME records are incorrect and need reconfiguration.
Lofty Domain Payment Failed
Impact:
Your domain purchased through Lofty hasn't been renewed due to a failed payment or cancelled order, so the website is inaccessible.
Explanation:
Without renewing the domain, it cannot be accessed.
Partial DNS Error
Impact:
A m
ix of correct and incorrect DNS records can lead to unpredictable behavior, such as sometimes accessing the site correctly or being directed to incorrect pages.
Explanation:
The DNS records contain both correct Lofty A records and incorrect records, causing conflicts.
Cloudflare DNS Issues
Impact:
DNS issues with Cloudflare can cause partial or complete inaccessibility of your site.
Explanation:
The Lofty system cannot access domains with DNS records hosted on Cloudflare. This makes it impossible to pinpoint specific DNS issues. Verify your DNS records to ensure the configuration is correct.
How to Proceed
To resolve these issues, follow the steps below:
Identify Your DNS Error:
Understand the specific DNS error affecting your domain.
Update DNS Settings:
Follow the guidance to verify and update your DNS settings in our
Domain Configuration Guide (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360054554712)
Verify that all A and CNAME records are correctly configured, as per the instructions.
Renew Domain (If Applicable):
Confirm if you need the domain linked to your Lofty website.
If you do, check that your payment card details are up to date and contact our support team to verify your domain order and attempt to renew it.
If you do not, to ensure your Lofty website remains accessible, please configure a different domain. Follow the guide here:
Domain Configuration Guide (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360054554712)
Seek Assistance:
If you encounter any issues or need assistance, please submit a support ticket. We are here to help you correct your DNS settings.
By following these steps, you can ensure that your website remains accessible and free from DNS errors. If you have any questions or need additional support, please reach out to our support team.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Introduction
Lofty provides an option to purchase your vanity domain directly via the Lofty platform. If you own your domain, you can still use that for your Lofty website. However, if you have not already purchased a domain, your website will exist temporarily on a "_____@lofty.com" domain. We highly recommend that you purchase a domain that you can use to build a brand for your business.

Purchase Process (#h_01FARP6RG38S07YHB556B4ZKW0)
Price (#h_01FARP6VRV1D9AKNPMRHQ58FHX)
Other Important Notes (#h_01FARPKS2ECHSQG8Y0Q373NWX2)
Purchase Process
*IMPORTANT
: You will only see the option to purchase a domain via Lofty if you have not already configured your domain. This is accessible for the Team Owner/Admin on the Team Website or for individual agents who have already upgraded to an Agent Website and are not already using a vanity domain.
There are two locations where you will see the option to purchase a domain via Lofty:
(1) In the CMS
(2) In the Lofty Marketplace
Once you click either of the options above, you will be taken to a quick introduction page where you can learn about some of the important reasons to upgrade to a vanity domain. These are outlined here for your reference:
Consistent email marketing
Use your vanity domain as your email address for marketing and nurturing emails sent via Lofty.
Maintain your branding and make your team look more professional by sending automated emails in Lofty from your vanity domain (e.g. demo@yourdomain.com).
Automatic configuration
There's no need for any configuration. Our automated setup makes it easy and includes DNS configuration and SSL certificate installation.
Domains purchased through Lofty are registered for one year and can be canceled at any time.
Own your domain
Rank higher in organic searches. Vanity domains help you rank higher if similar keywords are searched.
Establish your brand. A Vanity domain makes it easier for leads to remember you and find your website later.
More than 80% of Realtors own vanity domains. A domain name gives your business credibility and tells leads that you are here to stay.
Click on the blue
Get a domain
option to continue:
You will be presented with a screen that looks like the following. Type in the domain name that you are interested in purchasing and then click the blue
Search
button:
All of the available options related to that domain name will then appear as suggestions along with their associated annual registration fee (which will vary by domain). You can click on "Show more results" to display more options. Choose the domain that you would like to purchase from the list to go to the next step.
A summary of the cost of this purchase will be presented to you. If you do not have a payment card on file you can add one during this process. Details of the cost are outlined
below (#h_01FARP6VRV1D9AKNPMRHQ58FHX)
.
Once you click on the blue
Place Order
button, you will see a confirmation message that looks like the following:
"Your domain purchase request has been submitted! We will work to process the purchase as well as complete the DNS & SSL configuration in the background, which can take up to 1 hour to complete. You will receive an email notification when this process has been completed successfully or if the domain is not available. You will NOT be charged unless successful."
Once this process is complete, you will receive an email confirming the result. If successful, you will receive the following email:
"
This email is to let you know that your Vanity Domain purchase has been processed
successfully
. The Annual Domain Registration Fee and Monthly Hosting Fee have been deducted from your billing account.
You can access your website via the Lofty CMS, where you will notice that the domain name should be automatically configured and associated with your site."
In other scenarios, the purchase might fail due to unknown issues or if the domain is no longer available for some reason. If that is the case, you will receive the following email:
"
This email is to let you know that your Vanity Domain purchase request has
FAILED
to process. This could mean the domain is no longer available or could be the result of another error. Please try again via the Lofty Marketplace.
Please note that no domain fees were deducted from your account as the purchase process was not successful."
Price
If you are setting up a vanity domain for the first time on Lofty (see
Start your Lofty IDX Website (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360054969871)
), you will be presented with free options to select from that are located at .net. However, please note that if you choose a free option you
cannot
take this with you if you cancel your Lofty subscription. If you purchase a paid-for option, you can take that with you if you need to leave Lofty for whatever reason.
Please be aware of the following regarding the price of a vanity URL purchased via Lofty:
Domain Registration Fee
: The
yearly
fee will vary depending on the domain purchased–this fee is passed on directly from the domain provider (AWS) to you.
Hosting Fee
: The
monthly
fee of $5 Lofty charges to host the domain, integrate to Lofty, and support email traffic.
The purchase of a domain name is
NOT
refundable. We purchase domain names from third parties and therefore do not support refunds. If you want to terminate service with Lofty, you can transfer the domain name out for continued use.
Other Important Notes
When you purchase a vanity domain via Lofty, the following happens:
We will automatically complete the DNS and SSL configurations
The Sending Email will be automatically adjusted to match the purchased domain. You can learn more
HERE (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402367904397#h_01FARKS9NNVJWGTV25QENNSGCK)
.
When you choose a free domain, you will see the following pop-up appear. This pop-up will help clarify how this free domain is provided.
"Please note that this free domain name will not be available to use if service with Lofty is terminated. Also, you only have ONE opportunity to select a free domain name."
If your initial payment fails when purchasing a vanity domain, there will be a popup to notify you that this is the case and you will have the option to purchase another domain made
unavailable
. We will also send an email advising you on the next steps in addition to a pop-up.
"Payment failed! We have still purchased the domain (#domain#) for you, but you will need to confirm the status of your payment card on file and contact us to try again."
If you purchase a domain from Lofty, we cannot support the use of an external email provider. That means if you purchase a domain via Lofty, you will only be able to use that domain for emailing within the Lofty platform at present.

#### Article 460: Personal Disclaimer

- Article ID: `4413545419675`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `MLS (Multiple Listing Service)`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T05:12:56Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4413545419675-Personal-Disclaimer

Introduction
Users from certain regions may have a requirement for a Personal Disclaimer on their website per MLS regulations. To aid in this, we have added a Personal Disclaimer section in the Agent area under Team Info.
Regions with Required Personal Disclaimers
Texas (#h_01FQHWGVRVPMXV1FP3BW2N1H95)
Texas Real Estate Personal Disclaimer
Add Complaint Doc from TREC
Working in Texas, all brokers and sales agents need to be compliant with the
Texas Real Estate Commission (https://www.trec.texas.gov/)
's (TREC) laws, which ask all agents to display the
Information About Brokerage Services (https://www.trec.texas.gov/forms/information-about-brokerage-services)
(IABS) that has been correctly filled out and the
Consumer Protection Notice (https://www.trec.texas.gov/forms/consumer-protection-notice)
. Both of these two forms need to be posted on the homepage of the license holders’ business website in a readily noticeable place.
Introduction for the IABS Form and Consumer Protection Notice
Under the Texas law, all brokers and sales agents are required to provide a written notice regarding information about brokerage services at the first substantive communication with prospective buyers, tenants, sellers, and landlords concerning specific real property. So TREC provides the IABS form to give the information about brokerage services to those parties.
The Consumer Protection Notice provides information about filing a complaint with TREC and information regarding the two TREC recovery funds.
Add IABS Form to Your Lofty Websites
The Consumer Protection Notice has been added for all Texas agents automatically. But it's your responsibility to upload the IABS Form that has been filled out with your own info. There are two steps you will need to add the IABS form to your site.
1. Complete the IABS Form and Get a Publicly Accessible Link
First of all, you need to download the IABS form
here (https://www.trec.texas.gov/forms/information-about-brokerage-services)
and fill out it. Make sure all the requested info has been added to the document so that it will be effective.
2. Add the IABS Form to your site
Add IABS Form to "Personal Disclaimer", and it will display in the site's footer.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your CRM.

Introduction
All pages on Lofty websites are composed of blocks. These "blocks" can be combined to build pages with a specific content focus or to provide a certain set of resources to site visitors. These blocks can be customized on every Lofty website page.
Summary
Step 1: Select the Page to Edit
Click
Pages
on the Page Editor and a page list will appear with all of your pages shown. Find and click on the page you want to edit and the Page Editor's interface will switch to that page.
Add Blocks
Click
Blocks
in the Page Editor, and the block library will appear. 20+ block types can be added to any page by dragging and dropping the block to the right: the type has different styles to choose from.
Edit Blocks
If you want to modify the title, image, data, etc. of a certain block, double-click the block or click the
Edit
icon that appears when hovering in the top-right of that specific block. Upon doing this, all of the content that can be edited with this block will be displayed.
Block Types
The following are the different types of blocks available:
Reviews (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038293251)
Agent (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038293271)
Contact (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038293171)
Team Info (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038293191)
Featured Areas (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037923152)
Partner Links (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037923172)
Form (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402562066971)
Hero (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038293231)
Home Evaluation (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037923112)
Calculator (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037923072)
Banner (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038293151)
CTA (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037923092)
Content (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038611351)
Listings (Featured) (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037923132)
Search Bar (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360042871671)
Quick Search (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038293131)
Blog (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360042441452)
Video (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360042435652)
Live Blocks
YouTube Live Block (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360040837852)
Facebook Live Block (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360040840652)
Custom Blocks
Note:
Custom blocks can only be created if your website is built off of a custom template. If your website was built off of one of the website templates that Lofty provides, the option to create a custom block will not be available.
To create a custom block, first add a block to your website by dragging the block to the body of the website. Make any necessary edits to the block and click the ... icon and select Custom
Note, not all blocks can be customized. Only the following blocks can be customized:
Agent
Banner
Content
CTA
Embed
Form
Gallery
Team
Video
After you have saved your custom block, it can be found at the top of the Block Library in a section called
Custom.
Remove Blocks
If you need to delete a block, hover over that specific block and click the
Trash Can
icon in the top-right of that block.
Reorder Blocks
You can drag a block to the desired position by clicking on that specific block until it is highlighted and then dragging it to the new destination on that page. You can also reorder by selecting the icon with three lines and dragging it to the spot where you would like it on the page:
Copy Blocks
If the block has the capability to be Copy/Pasted, you will see a ... icon next to the other block actions. Click the ... to select Copy or Paste. The block will be copied as is. When you paste a block, it will be pasted directly below the selected block. This is only available to full websites, not to users with subdomain sites.
Note, not all blocks can be copied. Only the following blocks can be copied:
Agent
Banner
Content
CTA
Embed
Form
Gallery
Team
Video
Preview
You can toggle between the desktop view and the mobile view to see what the page will look like on a mobile device versus a laptop or desktop computer.
If you need to experience the effects of button jumps and pop-ups triggered by the website, you can click the
preview
button to open a new tab that will preview this page.
Publish
If you have made any changes on this page by adding, removing, or editing any blocks, be sure to click the
Publish
button in the top-right corner in order for changes to apply to the live site.

#### Article 466: Content Block

- Article ID: `360038611351`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Block Library`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T02:48:44Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038611351-Content-Block

Introduction
The "Content Block" is used for displaying basic text or images which typically includes a business description or the vision of the business, etc. This is a useful block to place on your page should you need to add text, images, videos, or HTML code.
Summary
Adding a Content Block to a Page (#h_01FGT07B4QV8A6K3GBQW3QRYNW)
Content Block Types (#h_01FGT07JFMTBPSMKM1610ZP396)
Rich Text (#h_01FGT07RE3WTB34KZ0SCTH7ZNA)
How it Works (#h_01FGT07WVF2JVJ51W6YG7V8XDC)
We Are (#h_01FGT081Q3AD5R4MGW9K6RVE6F)
Two-Columns, Two-Rows (#h_01FGT085KVXSXHV8MKJT61RWDS)
Adding a Content Block to a Page
Click on the "+ Block" button on the Editor:
Choose "Content" from the Block Library, select the type of content block that you would like to use, and then drag it to the right side of the CMS where you would like to place it.
To edit the block, double-click on the block or select the "Edit" icon on the right side.
Content Block Types
Below are the different types of content blocks:
Rich Text
The first type of content block is
Rich Text
. This type is extremely flexible and can be used to insert text, images, videos, and even HTML or Javascript (front-end code). This block size is not ideal for large interactive content and is instead best used with static content that fits well in the space.
This is what this field will look like prior to editing:
To edit, double-click or select the "Edit" icon of the block as indicated above. Then, select "Click to Edit Rich Text."
This view will allow you to edit the content, adjust text formatting, embed links, images, and even videos:
To add/edit code, click on the "Source Code" icon on the far right side of the editor. You can then embed your code as needed.
**Please note that if you insert code yourself, the mobile adaptation will also need to be considered within your code.
To learn more about adding custom code to your website, please see
Advanced Website Customizations (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038705671)
.
How it Works
The second content block type is called "How it works." This is typically used for displaying your business process for buying and/or selling. It has three columns for displaying the content (this cannot be customized). An image, title, and description can be added to each column.
Here is what this type looks like:
All of the options to edit this block will be available on the left side when you double-click the block or click on the "Edit" icon for that block.
We Are
The third content block type called "We Are" is similar to "How it Works" with the only difference being that it does not allow for the display of images and only displays text. The background type and color can also be adjusted.
Here is what this block looks like:
Two-Columns, Two-Rows
The fourth type is a two-column and two-row content block. It is typically used for showing your business value or benefits that clients will see when working with you. You can define your title and four descriptions, as well as the background of the block.
Banner Block
The "Banner Block" is typically used to display a picture (or multiple, sliding pictures) or a video. It normally has text on top of it and including a heading and a subheading.
For background settings, you can choose the "Background Type" (image, color, slideshow, video), desktop image, and mobile image.
You can adjust the spacing before or after the block:
For "Block Size," you can adjust the desktop size type (aspect ratio, full screen, exact height) as well as the mobile size type (aspect ratio, full screen, exact height).
For "Content Mode", you can choose what content you want to display, Agent or Heading and Subheading.
You can choose an agent to show their information.
Also, you can choose to show a heading and subheading. You can change the heading and subheading here
. If you do not want to display any text here (e.g. a simple slideshow or standalone video), you can leave the heading and subheading fields blank.
Size Recommendations
At present, we have four sets of templates and each template image size is slightly different from the other. Also, the mobile view and the desktop view will vary. This section will provide the suggested sizes for each of these scenarios.
Image Background Type
For the "Block Size," we recommend leaving the default selection of "Exact Height" for both desktop and mobile.
Banner Style 1
Desktop Size Recommendation: 1440 x 460 pixels
Mobile Size Recommendation: 750 x 440 pixels
Banner Style 2
Desktop Size Recommendation: 1440 x 460 pixels
Mobile Size Recommendation: 750 x 500 pixels
Video Background Type
As far as file size, the video can be
no bigger than 50 MB.
We recommend checking the box for "Auto-Adjusted Height":
For "Block Size," our recommendations are as follows:
Desktop View
Leave at the default values:
Mobile View
Adjust to the following:
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: content block, pixel

#### Article 467: CTA Block

- Article ID: `360037923092`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Block Library`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T02:51:56Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037923092-CTA-Block

Introduction
CTA stands for "Call To Action" and is well-known among those with experience building websites. A CTA is used to encourage site visitors to visit specific pages and
act
on what is being suggested to them. The Lofty block library has several types of CTA blocks that can be used on any page. This article explains how these blocks work and can be added/edited via the CMS Tool.
Summary
Adding a CTA Block (#h_01F01Z1Z3P2PT5KGZ68CZFDJQZ)
Editing a CTA Block (#h_01F01Z22MG7QZ46VFGM9GFACC0)
Adding a CTA Block
First, from the Page Editor, click on the "+ Blocks" button.
Choose the CTA option from the library and then drag the desired style to the right side where you would like to place it on the right.
Editing a CTA Block
To edit a CTA block, double-click on the block or click on the "Edit" icon in the top-right of that block.
Edit Options
When editing a CTA block,
the configurable options will vary depending on the style of the block
. Across all CTA block styles, you will see a mix of the following settings that can be adjusted:
Background
Desktop Image
Mobile Image
Background Type
Color
Image
Border Color
Block Size
Desktop Size Type
Height
Mobile Size Type
Mobile Height
Style
Add spacing before/after the block
Opacity Layer
Show Opacity Layer
Vertical Margin
Horizontal Margin
Heading and Description
Heading
Description
Button
Action Type
URL
Your site visitors will be redirected to a different URL when they click the button. Please note that if you just want to redirect the visitor to a page on your Lofty site, you only need to enter the "relative URL." For example, enter "/evaluation" to send the site visitor to the Home Evaluation page. If you want to redirect the visitor to an external page (one not part of your Lofty site), you will need to enter the complete URL including https:// (e.g.
https://www.google.com/
). After entering the URL, you can also choose your "Open Mode" to open the page in a new window/tab or open the page in the current window/tab.
Trigger Registration
Set the lead type using the Lead Type Settings dropdown menu for this action type.
When your site visitor clicks the button, the site global registration pop-up will appear. See
Registration Pop-up Style & Settings (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056629652)
.
Text
Color
Button Position
The best way to learn about all you can do with a CTA Block is to test it out on your website. The visual builder gives you a great preview that can be used to see how it will work on your website. If it doesn't work out, you can always delete the block and try again.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at
<support@lofty.com (mailto:%3Csupport@chimeinc.com)
>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: Call to action, CTA

#### Article 468: Embed Block

- Article ID: `4407612265499`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Block Library`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T02:39:26Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4407612265499-Embed-Block

Introduction
The Embed blocks allow you to add custom code to a specific part of your Lofty-built website.
Summary
Adding the Block (#h_01FGT0MNRKFHCWV4YT39XS9RG3)
Editing the Block (#h_01FGT0RBSZBSA8HWWV82E3HM3X)
Beta Released Image to Code Block (#h_01HT0MF728QAQYDXXWE907ZRGQ)
Adding the Block
To add an Embed Block, navigate to the
CMS
>
Editor
>
Page
:
Navigate to the page where you would like to add the block and click on that page. In this example, we selected the
My Team
page but you can select whatever page you want to add the embed block to.
Once on that page, click on
+ Blocks
:
Find and click
Embed
on the block list and then drag it to where you would like it to appear on your page:
Editing the Block
To edit the block, double-click on the block, and the menu will appear on the left where you can add your code:
The code added in this block will only work on the current page and when the block loads successfully.
When adding code in a block, a <script> tag is needed. For example:
<script>
//your custom code
</script>
Adding in custom content via an external link:
<script src="external_link_url"></script>
All functions for Page Script or Page Style can also be used at the block level for customization when using the <script> tag. For more information, see
Advanced Website Customizations > Page Customizations (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360038705671#h_01FGSY8Y3VAZK2CHCCD7CX4PGG)
.
Beta Released Image to Code Block
The Image to Code block is currently available as a beta release to about 20% of Lofty users. This block allows you to upload an image and use AI to recreate the image on your website.
After dragging the block over to the website, open the edit panel to upload your image. AI technology will do its best to recreate the image. Once the image has been generated, you can provide a prompt in the box to have the AI alter the image.
Hover over the image to upload a new image or access the text code to alter the image directly.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: embed, HTML code, code block

Introduction
This block was designed as a way to capture additional leads who might be interested in getting access to download a home buying/selling guide if they submit their information in the form. Summary
Using the Block (#h_01H9VGGBHBJH58BNFTA9GF3MTS)
Using the Block
Here is where you will find the
Guide
option in the "Lead Capture" category. There is only one style.

More importantly, you can choose the file you want to have downloaded automatically. The file size limit is
5 MB
.
You can pick from two built-in options within the "Lofty Library," or you can upload your own PDF.
When a lead fills out the form fields (which can be customized) and then submits their information, they will see a confirmation message (also customizable) and the file will download automatically.

#### Article 472: Hero Block

- Article ID: `360038293231`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Block Library`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T02:51:17Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038293231-Hero-Block

Introduction
The "Hero Block" refers to the first section that is typically seen on an IDX website with the large image, and text on top. Because of its prominent location on the Home page, this is an important block to configure correctly.
Summary
Adding Hero Block (#h_01EHQTS8Q3JZKZGV736PRK0CE1)
Background (#h_01EHQTSD0WYBGNYKCDYKS4Q6BB)
Content (#h_01EHQTSQ0451B5TGJWGF90721J)
Search Section (#h_01EHQTSTMFBMM4747H4ZHSC6ZK)
Size Recommendations (#h_01EHQTT1C01VGVH7PVJ3W0R572)
Image Background Type (#h_01EHQTT822K9BXQM5GDJEX1NR2)
Video Background Type (#h_01EHQTTC9CC31WC62T2EJS2CG2)
Adding Hero Block
The first block you will see on the Home page is the "Hero Block." Click the "Edit" icon on the top-right of that specific block in order to configure this block.
There are three tabs in this block editor: (1) Background, (2) Content, and (3) Search Section.
Background
You can configure all of the settings for the block background here. Choose your preferred background type: (a) Image, (b) Slideshow, or (3) Video. When you choose "Image" as the background type, you need to upload the image both for desktop size and mobile size. If you do not upload an image for the mobile screen size, Lofty will use the desktop image instead.
When you choose the "Slideshow" type, you need to upload multiple images for desktop size and mobile size. If you do not upload an image for mobile size, Lofty will use the desktop images instead. You can then choose the transition effect (slide or fade effect), the slide transition time (in seconds) can also be adjusted here. The "Show Dots" will determine whether the noticeable dots display on the images so that visitors know there are more images to slide between.
When you choose the "Video" type, you need to upload the video first. The Lofty CMS Tool supports YouTube URLs or uploaded MP4 files with a maximum size of
50 MB.
After uploading a video, you can choose a video preview image in cases where you do not want to show the first picture of the video. After uploading the video, you can configure the video play settings:
Auto Play
: The video will be played automatically if this checkbox is selected. If this checkbox is not selected, the video will only be played after the visitor clicks the play button that appears in the background.
**Please note that this setting only applies on desktop-sized devices as the video cannot autoplay in mobile browsers.
Inline Play
: This setting will only be shown when "Auto Play" is
not
selected. After selecting this option, the video will be played directly in the background when a site visitor clicks on the play button. If not selected, the video will be played in a pop-up after the visitor clicks the play button.
Auto-Adjusted Height
: If selected, the block height will be adjusted automatically according to the video height in order to show as much of the video as possible.
Show Progress Bar
: If this is not selected, the video progress bar will be hidden.
Show Mute Option
: If this is selected, the mute option will be shown in the right corner.
You can turn on the "Different Background Type for PC and Mobile" in order to choose a different type for each device. This is ideal for video as auto-play does not work on mobile devices.
The "Background Size" can also be adjusted in this block for both desktop device sizes and mobile device sizes. First, choose the size type. Lofty recommends the "Aspect ratio" type because it will be responsive for devices with different screen sizes. Other types available include "Exact Height" and "Full Screen." If you choose "Exact Height," you will need to define the specific pixel height.
The last background setting is that of the "Background Overlay." With this setting, you can add an opacity layer above the background. You are able to choose the color for this opacity layer.
Content
In the "Content & Search Position," section you can also choose the relative position of the content (heading and subheading) to the search section: Top-Bottom or Left-Right.
In the "Heading and Subheading" section, you can edit the content and style of the heading and subheading. Note that you can change the alignment of the heading and subheading in the text editor.
If you want to show an image (typically a team/company logo) in the heading and subheading part, you can change the heading type from text to image in the setting for "Heading Content-Type." The position of this image can also be adjusted as center, left, or right.
Search Section
In the tab for "Search Section," you can edit the search section of the hero block. First of all, choose your preferred search style: None, Advanced Search Bar, Tab+Search bar, Button.
Note
: Do not display any search options on the hero block.
Advanced Search Bar
: Choose the search fields that you want to display here. For now, the only options available are the following: Price, Beds, Baths, Property Type, and Purchase Type.
Tab+Search Bar
: Define the default text in the search bar for the Sell My Home and Home Evaluation tab. You can also choose the name format and whether a name and phone are required.
Button
: You can add up to four buttons at most. Edit the button text, style, and destination URL by clicking the "Edit" button for each button on the button list. You can also adjust the order of the buttons.
Size Recommendations
There are four different hero block styles and each style has slightly different size recommendations.
Image Background Type
Hero Style 1
Desktop Size Recommendation: 1440 x 480 pixels
Mobile Size Recommendation: 750 x 500 pixels
Hero Style 2
Desktop Size Recommendation: 1440 x 635 pixels
Mobile Size Recommendation: 750 x 640 pixels
Hero Style 3
Desktop Size Recommendation: 1440 x 635 pixels
Mobile Size Recommendation: 750 x 452 pixels
Hero Style 4
Desktop Size Recommendation: 1440 x 740 pixels
Mobile Size Recommendation: 750 x 1334 pixels
Video Background Type
As far as file size, the video can be
no bigger than 50 MB.
Hero Style 1, Style 2, Style 3
For all three of these styles, we recommend keeping the default values which are as follows:
Hero Style 4
We recommend the following settings as default:

Introduction
With this block, site visitors complete a form and by doing so add a manual listing (formerly known as pocket listing) directly to your Lofty website. The key part here is the
site visitor
who is the one adding the manual listing to the website, not you as the agent/user. Once submitted, the property details are added to a manual listing automatically placed on the website–there is
no
approval process built into this. The site visitor must also submit their contact information when submitting the listing and by doing so their information is captured in the database as a lead.

CMS
>
Page Editor

Blocks

List Your Home
. No settings (other than spacing) can be configured for this block meaning no additional fields can be added to the form. There is also only one style for this block.
Using the Block
The best practice on a page that contains this block would be to clearly set expectations for the site visitor so they understand what happens when they submit that manual listing. Could it potentially be deleted? Will it only be the starting point for a conversation? Should they expect communication from the agent whose website it is?
Below is what this new block looks like published on a sample website. Email address and other key fields (address, price, status) are required in order for a site visitor (lead) to submit this form. Once the form is submitted you, as the Lofty user, will receive a new lead notification if it is a new person not already in their database, and an
opportunity notification (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003018292)
if it is an existing lead.
*IMPORTANT
: There is
no
approval process for added manual listings–they will simply be added directly to the Lofty website.
Manage Manual Listings
Once a listing is added via these fields, it will be available as a manual listing under
CMS
>
Filters
>
My Manual Listings
:
You then edit the manual listings or delete them as desired:

Introduction
The Blocks in the Media category allow you to more effectively display high-quality video and images at
full screen width and with d
ifferent background colors, etc.
Summary
Adding Media Blocks (#h_01EWBT2103BFSBEG4PQEQXAJMB)

Adding Media Blocks
To add Media Blocks, navigate to the
CMS
>
Page Editor
>
+ Blocks
:
Scroll down and find "Media".
There are multiple types of Media blocks, including Image, Video, and Live.
Video Block Types
There are
four different styles
available for the video block:
Single Video
The first type of video block is "Single Video." You can input your YouTube URL or upload your video, edit the video title, background color, and style as you would like. This is what these fields look like before editing:
The video settings default to showing a progress bar, so do not forget to choose the other options if you would prefer to adjust this.
Double Videos
The second video block style is called "Double Videos." This style has two columns for displaying the videos (this cannot be customized at present). As you can see in the picture, it is divided into the left and the right, and you can edit them separately.
Here is what the settings for this style look like:
The video play method is forced to play because there are multiple videos. It will also show the progress bar by default and unmute the volume when played.
Video List
The third style of this block is presented as a video list. This is typically used for showing more than two videos, and you can choose the columns (2-5) and spacing (0-50) as you would like. You can set the title and descriptions as well as the background of the block.
Just like with the "Double Videos" style, the video play method is forced to play because there are multiple videos. It will also show the progress bar by default and unmute the volume when played. You can also customize what order in which the videos are displayed on the site.
Virtual Tour
The last style of the video block is for displaying virtual tours and videos in a large format:
You can upload multiple videos and multiple virtual tour links using this option. You can also edit the titles of the video and virtual tour sections displayed on the site. The background color can also be adjusted.
Zoom Live Block

Live Name

meeting
password (for more information see

)
*IMPORTANT
: Please note that currently all Zoom Meetings that are integrated into the Lofty website will be set to be public so that all leads can participate directly.
Schedule a Zoom Live Meeting

Stream

post

#### Article 478: Quick Search Block

- Article ID: `360038293131`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Block Library`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T02:52:57Z`

Introduction
The "Quick Search Block" is a useful spot to outline specific filters that you have built out and want to put together in a list that displays well on any page. This article outlines the settings that can be adjusted with the quick search block.
There are a few important things to keep in mind with the Quick Search Block:
You can choose any search list in the Quick Search Block wherever you created it, and the same quick search list and corresponding data can be used regardless of the style or page where you add this block.
In most instances, Lofty suggests that you use the "Preset Filter" to help you populate the listings for your quick search links and keep the listing source set to "All Listings" unless you want to limit the searchable listings in the link. For more information on filters and listings, please reference this article:
Listing Filter Basics (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038373211)
.
Summary
Adding the Quick Search Block (#01H8PPRSBVGYQYA34EWWRQYQHE)
Editing the Quick Search Block (#01H8PPRSBV3YMVJW86ZVT607VV)
Quick Search List (#h_01J540ABMVR0TA782028GGZGXQ)
Quick Search Configuration Editing (#01H8PPRSBV9CZA7N5KAXY59XJ3)
Quick Search Lists (#id-9/24/21:FeatureReleaseTrainingforCRM3.35,Site5.23-QuickSearchLists)
Adding the Quick Search Block
To add the "Quick Search Block," navigate to the page where you would like to add it and then click on the "+ Blocks" button:
Drag the type of the "Quick Search Block" that you would like to add to the right side where you would like it to appear on your web page.
Editing the Quick Search Block
To edit the settings for this block, double-click on the block or click on the "Edit" icon in the top-right of that block:
Quick Search List
Users can build quick search lists that they can reuse or keep independent from one another.
Users can add a new quick search configuration in the Quick search list, give it a name, and then define the links that will be saved and synced anywhere else that this specific configuration is selected:
Also, users remove any existing quick search configurations or choose an appropriate existing quick search configuration from the quick search list and add it to the corresponding page.
Quick Search Configuration Editing
For the quick search configuration, in the quick search list, you can edit the title:
Under "Link Management" you have the option to define the links that will display under the "Quick Search" menu on this block.
Clicking on "+ Add Quick Search Link" will take you to this menu where you can define the link name, the listing source (All Listings, Sold Listings, or Use Custom Listing Filter), preset filters, and default listing sorts. There is no limit on the number of links you are allowed to create.
You can also select a specific "View Pattern" for each link. This will adjust how a lead views the listing pages when they click that specific quick search link,
not
how the quick search link displays.
Quick Search Lists
Users can build quick search lists that they can reuse or keep independent from one another.
Users can choose from quick search configurations that have already been built:
Or users can click on the option to add another block, give it a name, and then define the links that will be saved and synced anywhere else that this specific configuration is selected:

. The name will be displayed next to the review. This is the name of the person leaving you a review.

not
a required field but does look nicer.
Additional Description
. This is a short description that appears right below the reviewer's name. You could describe their buying/selling situation, family size, etc.
Review
. Write the content of their actual review for you.

10 most recent

:

:

you will choose whether you want to display "All" or "Part"

This block type was designed support the addition of vendors on Lofty-built websites. This block type was designed to display vendors/partners and their contact information, etc. directly on your Lofty-built website to make their details accessible to site visitors.

Vendor Block Setup
To add a new vendor, navigate to
CMS
>
Settings
>
Team Info
>
Vendors
>
+ Add a Vendor
:
The following are the fields that can be added to a vendor profile. Company Name is required but you will definitely want to provide as many details as possible.
To add a vendor category, click on the settings cog wheel. You can edit, reorder, and delete the categories as needed.
Next, to add the block, navigate to the
Page Editor
>
+ Blocks
>
Vendor
> Drag the block where you would like to add it on the page:
Below is how it is displayed on the website. All vendors added via the settings will be displayed within this block and can be searched. You are not currently able to choose only certain vendors to display in specific blocks of this type, it's all or nothing.

Vendor Block Sorting
As of July 19, 2021, the Vendor Block supports creating a default sort method for the block. This is done by editing the vendor list under
CMS
>
Settings
>
Team Info
>
Vendors
, dragging/dropping to reorder, or clicking to move one to the top of the list. In other words, the order of vendors can be customized in the CMS settings.
When editing the actual Vendor Block, there is a switch. By default, the switch will be
ON
which means vendors in that block will be sorted A-Z. However, if you turn the switch
OFF

Settings
>
Team Info
>
Vendors
instead of being alphabetical.

ote, the RateMyAgent integration is exclusive to those with

#### Article 486: Blog Page

- Article ID: `360039336851`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Blog`
- Updated: `2026-01-14T23:45:13Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360039336851-Blog-Page

Introduction
Adding blog content to your Lofty IDX website is a great way to share valuable content to your site visitors/community/social network and improve the SEO value of your website (see
HERE (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360039873672)
). Creating blog content will be your responsibility (or you can explore third-party services) but you can use the available tools on Lofty to display the blog posts as an embedded part of your Lofty website.
Depending on when you started with Lofty, there are two different ways to manage the blog: (1) using the Lofty-built blog editor or (2) using a WordPress blog editor which is only available for those that have joined Lofty
prior to
May 8, 2021.
Notice:
The Starter package does not come with this feature. If you are on a Starter package and interested in using this feature to its full effect, please contact
Support (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115001982346)
to get upgrade options.
Summary
(1) Lofty Blog Editor (#h_01F543XJPRJBZ1A4PKK4GCER35)
Categories (#h_01F543AX644BCQ2T9245865VYX)
Posts (#h_01FARS24HGGFGX2X12G9H8NWPK)
Posts Overview (#h_01GVPT2YSC0K0WAJVYG9F3BEK6)
AI Blog Assistant (#id-3/16/2023:FeatureReleaseTrainingforChime3.61-AIBlogAssistant(BetaRelease))
How to manually add a Blog Post (#h_01GVPT3M198BT5WPDQA2EXXR64)
RSS Aggregator (#h_01FARS29JSJ7SDTEP37JEGH7FY)
Lofty Blog Editor FAQs (#h_01FARSBHCDKW9GX6EPG7887AQE)
(2) WordPress Blog Editor (#h_01F543XTTVBBNY6A2VGPYGW0J5)
Blog Page Components (#h_01F545AYX9T1BPFK8K7WPKVZXR)
Customizing the Style of the Blog Page (#h_01F545B324FPS34JC8J95NX8S3)
Blog Editor Migration: WordPress --> Lofty (#h_01FD6J01AJ37K0Q6NPMEFSRQ20)
(1) Lofty Blog Editor
To access the Lofty Blog Editor, go to
CMS
>
Quick Actions
>
Blogs
:
Your blog posts will display in the same order they appear within the posts list within the CMS settings. You can pin one post to the top, or you can sort the posts by published date or updated date to have those appear in that order automatically.
Categories
Use categories to file specific blog posts under specific groups so that you can easily classify and display your content for site visitors.
Categories Overview
All the categories that have been created are available on the
Category List
:
Name
: The name of the category
Blog Count
: The total number of blog posts currently in that category
Add a Category
To add a category, click on the blue
+ Add New
button in the top-right, add the category name, and then click on the green checkmark to add it.
Edit / Delete a Category
Click on the
Edit
or
Delete
buttons to edit or delete a blog category:
Posts
Posts Overview
View all posts, those that are published, drafts, or those that have been trashed, using the tabs at the top:
All
: Includes those that are "Published" or "Drafts."
Published
: Posts that are published and displayed live on your website.
Scheduled:
Posts that are set to be published at a future date.
Drafts
: Drafts can be edited in the back end but will not be visible on your website.
Trash
: Posts that are deleted can be recovered or deleted completely.
The columns display the following data:
Title
: The title of the post. A post with no title will show "no title," and any drafts will have a "Draft" tag next to them in this column.
Author
: The author of the blog post.
Category
: The categories of a blog post.
Publish Date
: The format is mm/dd/yyyy and is based on the date the blog post was created. The most recent blog posts will be displayed at the top.
Updated Date:
This is based on when the blog post was revised, adjusted, or corrected.
AI Blog Assistant
The AI Blog Assistant uses AI to help you craft blog posts seamlessly! Navigate to the CMS tool and click
Blog.
Next, use the AI chat panel to tell the AI what you would like to write a blog about. The AI will give you a few prompts, or you can start fresh!
Once created, take a moment to review the blog, make any necessary edits, and decide when to publish!
How to manually add a Blog Post
To add a new blog post to your website, go to
Posts
and then click on the blue
+ Add New
button in the top-right:
You will then be presented with the blog post editor window:
Content
Title
: The title of a blog post. If no title is added, the post will display as "no title."
Blog Post Content
: The body of the blog post. Using the tools available, you should be able to build the content out in the format you would like, including adding images, embedding videos, changing the styles, fonts, etc. You can even embed source code in the blog post if you have coding experience and would like to use the blog feature to display something unique.
As you add blog content, you can preview how it will display in the panel at the right:
When creating a new blog post, you can now edit the line spacing
and
schedule a specific time for your post to be published:
Settings
The following are the settings that can be edited for each individual blog post. Click on the
Settings
tab to edit:
Author
: The default author is always the owner of the website, but you can manually overwrite this if you would like to do so.
URL Slug
"URL Slug" refers to the last part of a URL that is specific to a web page. The default URL Slug is the post title but you can edit this without having to change the post title. The following are supported: letters, numbers, and hyphenated words (e.g. "first-blog-post"). Other characters cannot be recognized and will be changed into hyphens automatically.
Categories
This is where you will select the category that this blog post belongs to. Adding new categories is outlined
above (#h_01F543AX644BCQ2T9245865VYX)
or you can add a new category directly in this field. A post can belong to multiple categories. A blog post that has no category selected will belong to "Uncategorized."
Featured Image
The default featured image is the first image in the blog post content. The featured image for a post that does not have an image will be the logo from your website header. The featured image can be changed and/or deleted as needed.
SEO
For more information on SEO basics, you may want to reference
THIS (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360039873672)
article.
To edit the SEO settings for an individual blog post, click on the
SEO
tab:
Meta Title
:
A meta title (also called a title tag) is an element in the head section of an HTML document that defines the title of each page of a website. It is retrieved by web browsers and also used by search engines such as Google to display a webpage in search results (SERPs). The default meta title is in the following format:
Blog Title - Creator Name - Company Name
This can be edited and you can use the tool to "+ Insert variable."
Meta Keywords
:
Meta keywords describe the content of a web page in a short and concise way and should be important indicators of a page's content to search engines. The default meta keywords are blank when you create a new blog post in Lofty but you can add/edit as well as use the "+ Insert variable" tool if needed.
Meta Description
:
A meta description is an HTML element that describes and summarizes the contents of your page for the benefit of users and search engines. The default meta description is the first sentence in the blog post but can be changed by editing and using the "+ Insert variable" tool.
Edit, Delete, or Recover a Blog Post
To edit or delete a post, click on the
Edit, Delete, or Recover
icons for a post:
You can now
Recover
deleted posts as well under the "Trash" tab:
RSS Aggregator
Find this option under
CMS
>
Blogs Tab
>
RSS
Aggregator:
Here is the information presented on the
RSS Aggregator
page shown above:
Name:
The name of the RSS blog source.
Last Updated
: Displays the last updated time as well as the number of items imported with the most recent import.
Imported Items
: The total number of articles obtained from the feed.
On/Off
: If turned
on
, articles will be automatically synced from the blog source one time daily at 7:00 am. If turned
off
, a sync button under
Imported Items
will have to be clicked manually to bring in the newest content.
When adding a new RSS feed, all of the following are visible:
Name
: The name of the RSS blog source.
URL
: The RSS feed URL from the blog source.
"Input the URL of the feed source. In some situations, the URL of the site will work, but for best results, we recommend finding and using the URL specific to the RSS feed. Be sure to also include http:// or https:// at the beginning of the URL."
Post Type
: Not editable, will default to "Feed Source."
Post Status
: Choose from "Published" (new RSS feed blog posts will be published automatically) or "Draft" (new RSS feed blog posts will come in as drafts and must be published manually). If changed, the status will only reflect on the next pulled post, not on previous ones.
Post Date
: This will always be the original post date of the incoming blog content.
Remove featured image from post content?
:
Yes = The featured image from the incoming blog article will be
removed
and when sharing the blog post link on social media, the image will be the header logo (if available) otherwise, it will be the first image in the article or an image from the Lofty gallery as a last option.
No = The first picture of the article is selected as the SEO content so if the article is shared on social media that will be the one shown. If there are no images in the article, a default image from the Lofty gallery will be displayed instead.
Feed Preview
: Displays previews of the five most recent articles available at the RSS feed URL.
Lofty Blog Editor FAQs
How can I wrap text around an image?
1. Click
Insert/Edit Image
2. Upload an image and click
OK
4. Adjust the width and height of the image
5. Click
Save
6. Add text below the image
7. Click on the image and click on
Align left/right
8. The text will wrap around the image
(2) WordPress Blog Editor
*IMPORTANT
: Please note that the WordPress blog editor will
not
be available to use if you do not already have it enabled on your account prior to May 8, 2021. You will still be able to add/edit blog content using the Lofty-built blog editor if you do not have access to the WordPress blog editor.
Lofty + WordPress Basics
Here is a video explaining the basics of how to access and use the WordPress/Lofty blog feature:
Changing Post Meta Title & Description via WordPress
Lofty uses a Yoast SEO plug-in to change the SEO title and Meta Description in WordPress. This will then be automatically synced to the Lofty website.
Log in, access a post, and edit here:
Blog Page Components
All blog page templates have the same basic components as seen in the screenshot below.
Blog Posts
listed on the left side of the page
A
Search Bar
that can be used to search for any keywords that are contained within the post titles or content
Categories
that synchronize with the categories created in the blog settings
Recent Posts
are shown on the right side as well
Customizing the Style of the Blog Page
As always, you can add, edit, and delete, blocks to customize your Lofty pages. To learn how to do so, please reference the following article:
Add / Remove / Edit Blocks on Pages (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037816532)
.
Blog Editor Migration: WordPress --> Lofty
If you are currently using the WordPress blog editor within Lofty to produce blog content, you will see a pop-up appear giving you the ability to trigger the migration of (a) all of your blog posts and (b) all of your categories f
rom the WordPress Editor to the Lofty Blog Edito
r instead. If you have RSS feeds configured, those will
not
transfer during this process and will have to be set up manually. The migration should be complete in a matter of seconds, though that will depend on the number and complexity of the blog posts and categories. You will
not
be able to access the blog editor during the transfer process. If, after the transfer, you need to access your previously-used WordPress Blog Editor (to reference old drafts, etc., for example) then you can contact the Lofty Support Team (
support@lofty.com (mailto:support@chimeinc.com)
) and they will be able to assist you by providing direct login credentials to WordPress.
*IMPORTANT
: Once you have transferred from the WordPress blog tool to the Lofty one, you will
not
be able to transfer it back.
Questions?

### Section: Customization

#### Article 487: Advanced Website Customizations

- Article ID: `360038705671`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Customization`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T09:29:25Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038705671-Advanced-Website-Customizations

Introduction
If you have front-end development experience and knowledge and want to get more in-depth with your website customizations, this article will provide you with the basic information you need to get started when using the Lofty CSM to do this.
There are three levels at which you can perform advanced customizations on your Lofty-built website--all of which are explained in detail in the sections below. Depending on what you want to accomplish (integrating a third-party widget, modifying a page's style, etc.), you will want to understand what is available at each level.
Notice:
The Starter package does not come with this feature. If you are on a Starter package and interested in using this feature to its full effect, please contact
Support (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115001982346)
to get upgrade options.
Summary
Global Customizations (#h_01FGSY7KBXT85X8H3MGNYNJ9N5)
Website Currency (#h_01GDY0221ZBFCFKR2D61NZXVV5)
Page Customizations (#h_01FGSY8Y3VAZK2CHCCD7CX4PGG)
Block Customizations (#h_01FGSY91JJY0NSTMJSSG1D9T05)
Global Customizations
To establish global customizations on your Lofty-built website, navigate to the
CMS
>
Settings
>
Tools
. You should be able to
click here (https://cms.lofty.com/cmsnew/setting?sp=customCode)
to get there as well (assuming you are signed in).
This type of customization is divided into two different areas: (a) styles and (b) scripts--both of which are explained in more detail in their corresponding section below.
(a) Global Styles
Styles influence a page's layout, structure, color, shape, etc. Scripts can greatly enhance the visual aspects of static web pages.
Add
document.head
to the link tag embedded.
Write style directly. For example, use
h1{color:red;}
rather than
<style>h1{color:red;}<style>
.
(b) Global Scripts
An example of when you might use scripts is if you need to embed a piece of code to track your site's conversion.
Run the
new Function('siteAppVm', customcode.script)(siteAppVm)
each time you enter the page. This can be used as an immediate function.
The script content is the function body
The properties defined in the function body are not globally accessible
The function parameter is siteAppVm (explained in the global object)
For example, to globally define a method
foo()
that fires when a button is clicked, you would do the following.
Custom Style & Script / Script:
window.foo(){
console.log('hello, world')
}
Button to trigger:
<a href="javascript:foo();">WELCOME!</a>
Global Object
(1) siteAppVm
SiteAppVm is a Vue instance mounted on the
document.querySelector('main.page-content')
element.
moduleData
ModuleData is an array
[{name: module 1,data:{}},{name: module 2,data:{}}]
. Objects are modules on the page in the array. Modules are displayed from top to bottom on the page. Depending on the dynamic binding technology, you can modify the moduleData in the moduleData to modify the content display of the module.
// Suppose siteAppvm. moduleData[0] is a header module
// Change the size of the logo to 300
siteAppVm.moduleData[0].data.size = 300
(2) Util
(a) addStyle(css, async=true)
Function
: Add link tag in
document.head
Usage
:
