Parameters
:
CSS:
If the CSS string contains '.css', then regard it as a link. For example:
Util.addStyle("//static.chimeroi.com/servicetool-temp/example.css", true)
Or the CSS string refers to the content of the style like this:
Util.addStyle(".red{color:red;}", true)
Async:
- True: This means that the return of the
Util.addStyle()
the function is Promise, which means the CSS code has been completely loaded on this page.
- False: This means that the return of the
Util.addStyle()
function is a link element that loads the CSS code in the document.
(a) Example
: How to introduce a Google font link: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Sofia
Because this is a link without '.css', then a '&name=sofia.css' suffix needs to be used to let Util.addStyle() function by regarding it as a link.

(b) addScript(url, async = true)
Function
: Add script code in
document.body

:

Parameters
:
URL:
A link to the script page
Async:
- True: This means that the return of the
Util.addScript()
function is Promise, which means the JavaScript has been completely loaded. If the script was cached, then it will use cache.
- False: This means that it will insert the external link script in <head> instead of using cache.
(b) Example

It is necessary to run the script again each time a new page is reached instead of using the cache. Suppose the content of this link https://www.example.com/1.js is as follows:
console.log('welcom to visit', location.pathname)
The control center needs to publish the path of the current page each time it is reached.

(c) toast(text, delay = 1000)

. With this function, a hint of 'hello' will show on the current page and disappear two seconds later.
(d) isMobileSize(size = 600)

(3) siteAxios
The siteAxios points to the module [axios](https://github.com/axios/axios).
Using the axios module to intercept a request and modify the request parameters:
// Add a request interceptor
window.siteAxios.interceptors.request.use(
function (config) {
// Do something before request is sent
return config;
},
function (error) {
// Do something with request error
return Promise.reject(error);
}
);
Using the axios module to intercept a response and modify the response data:
// Add a response interceptor
window.siteAxios.interceptors.response.use(
function (response) {
// Any status code that lie within the range of 2xx cause this function to trigger
// Do something with response data
// For example:
var config = response.__config__;
var addHouse = /api-site\/sell\add-house/;
var register = /api-site\/leadRegister;
if (config && (register.test(configurl) || addHouse.test(config.url))) {
debugger
}
return response;
},
function (error) {
// Any status codes that falls outside the range of 2xx cause this function to trigger
// Do something with response error
return Promise.reject(error);
}
);

To access this setting, navigate to
CMS -> Tools -> Language/Currency
. There is an option to sync currencies to agent subdomains, but subdomains
cannot
set their own currencies.
We currently support the following currencies:
US Dollar
Canadian Dollar
Euro
Pound Sterling
Chinese Yuan
Japanese Yen
Visitors to the website can easily change the currency:

Listing/Sold prices
Home Valuation
values
Mortgage Calculator
Page Customizations
To establish global customizations on your Lofty-built website, first navigate to the
CMS
>
Page Editor
>
Pages
:
Once you have clicked on
Pages
, select the setting wheel for the page you would like to add customize to. The screenshot below shows the
Home Page
being selected, but you can choose the page that you want to apply the customization to.
Then, scroll down and select the drop-down menu for
Page Style & Script
:
This type of customization is also divided into two different areas: (a) styles and (b) scripts. Both are explained below.
(a) Page Styles
Page styles influence the current page's layout, structure, color, shape, etc.
The page style will only apply to the current page. You can add it to the page by using
Util.addStyle(pageStyle, false)
.
Write style directly. For example, use
h1{color:red;}
rather than
<style>h1{color:red;}<style>

(b) Page Scripts
Page scripts can significantly enhance the current static page. You may consider using page scripts when you need to embed a script to track certain conversion data on the current page.
Page scripts will only run on the current page. Similar to what is outlined above for
Global Scripts (#h_01FGSZR2TA9N0B596QVXSAJKEN)
, the page scripts also run by using
new Function(pageScript).call(siteAppVm)
. But the 'this' pointer points to siteAppVm.
Block Customizations
There are two block types available in the Lofty CMS that can be utilized to embed custom code. Please reference the two articles below to learn more:

Code Block (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4407612265499)

### Section: Listing Plugin

#### Article 488: Getting Started with the WordPress + Lofty IDX Plugin

- Article ID: `35429819768091`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Listing Plugin`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T09:30:17Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/35429819768091-Getting-Started-with-the-WordPress-Lofty-IDX-Plugin

Summary
Who is this for? (#h_01JM37J0QGQSX0FT4ZC6ZZJV1R)
How does this compare to ____? (#h_01JM37KB5WXF83X4ADR2HWT52N)
Setup Instructions (#h_01J01JFFJQ2ETRG9YSQR1DYR6D)
Who is this for?
Agents, teams, and brokerages who want to take advantage of all the capabilities in the Lofty Platform but wish to retain their existing WordPress website.
Existing Lofty customers who already have a disconnected WordPress site that want to significantly improve the value they’re getting from Lofty while also improving the browsing experience for their clients.
How does this compare to ____?
A majority of other tools on the market only offer IDX connections (the MLS feeds) to WordPress websites. What's missing from this equation?
Actionable, insightful data on which activities the leads are performing on the agent's website
A seamless Property Alert experience for your leads
The ability to trigger Smart Plans based on website activity
+ the multitude of other powerful features that the Lofty platform provides
What do you need to know?
The WordPress Plugin connects
one WordPress website
to
one Lofty user
.
It cannot auto-create agent websites or send property alerts for multiple users.
If you occupy the Account Owner seat in Lofty, your Property Alerts will send from your Lofty Company site.
If you would like a dedicated site for your agent activities, we recommend configuring a separate Lofty seat and linking the WordPress plugin to that seat.
Setup Instructions
Step 1: Purchase the IDX Plugin
The Lofty IDX Plugin can be purchased in the Lofty Marketplace.
Step 2: Connect Your WordPress Website with Lofty IDX
Note:
This step does not make the WordPress site go live.
This just tells Lofty which WordPress site will eventually be connected, so it can use that domain for MLS feeds.
Once the purchase is complete, go to the CMS editor and select the
Connect your WordPress Site
option.
Clicking this link will take you to the WordPress Site connector. The domain that you enter here will be used for MLS applications and connected to your Lofty account.
Once this step is done, your WordPress site will be visible in Lofty. The domain will be listed in the domain section, and the Package will show
WordPress Plugin.
Your next step will be applying for your MLS feed(s)
Step 3: Enable the IDX Plugin on your WordPress website
There are two options to enable the IDX Plugin in WordPress. You can either download from the Lofty CMS Editor, or from the WordPress Marketplace.
Download from Lofty
Go to CMS Editor > Settings > Plugin Installation File
Download from the WordPress Marketplace
Step 4: Connect the Lofty API Key
Head into the
CMS Editor
>
Settings
to find your API key.
*note: this is different from the API Key in your Lofty Settings. Please make sure that you are copying from the right place.
Copy the API Key from Lofty, then log into
Wordpress
>
Settings
>
Lofty IDX Settings.
Paste the API Key and hit save.
At this point, you have completed the connection of Lofty and your WordPress site. Now you can start configuring your IDX pages to your liking.
Step 5: Apply MLS to your Lofty Site
Once the WordPress site is linked, you will need to go to the CMS Editor > Listings and apply to your MLS board(s).
This is a regular MLS application, so it may take some time for the board to approve.
The WordPress Plugin comes with sample IDX data so you can configure your website while you wait for their MLS feed to go live. Once the feed goes live, the sample listings will be replaced with your live feed.
When the MLS is approved, the status will be Active and the sample listings on your WordPress site will be replaced with live listings.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at support@lofty.com, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 489: WordPress + Lofty IDX Plugin

- Article ID: `26466256969371`

Introduction
43% of websites on the internet are built with WordPress.
The Lofty IDX Plugin integrates the power of Lofty with your existing (or new!) WordPress site. This Help Center article will walk you through the different pages and features that are available in a Lofty<>WordPress integrated website.
If you're looking for steps to set up your WordPress IDX Plugin, head over to
Getting Started with the WordPress + Lofty IDX Plugin (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/35429819768091)
.
Summary
Summary (#h_01J3DJ3XRA8GJDMA8J6YTNHQBZ)
Which Lofty pages will be available in WordPress? (#h_01JM38YKFVCP2597VV5CB7WRSJ)
Search Pages (#h_01JM38ZQ9VWGT04J7ZWT20FJT1)
Featured Listings (#h_01JM399E2S6KQZQXQ1S9QT3WP6)
Listing Detail Pages (#h_01JM39GC46JSSXF5KGZ7EB0HP0)
Sold Listings (#h_01JM39KF8N1V68K6PCFKNQTCCY)
Sold Listing Detail (#h_01JM39ST59K5VBX3B8QBDCE8EC)
Market Report (#h_01JM39WQME4GS1NP18ZEQP48DA)
Home Valuation (#h_01JM39ZTGF0NME5VNFCR8VSXVV)
What non-page tools are available? (#h_01JM3A6S0TD7PFWD5Z0EA8QY40)
Dynamic Variables (#h_01JM3A6YE4MCW5C6D4AEG6SPMX)
Lead Activity Tracking (#h_01JM3A7ZE8YGQAWQZXT6N5R1BF)
Lead Portal (#h_01JMDH7NV2Q32XCE5ZR0K19Y2F)
Property Alerts (#h_01JPPA4D0RHCPKH0VSE2S12DZX)
Custom Lead Capture and Registration Form (#h_01JPPA5GNMZMDCCW82AMJJS6J8)
What is NOT available on the WordPress Plugin? (#h_01JSQ7NAX6RGQJGRZ8QS5FM4Q3)
AI Chat Bot (#h_01JSQ7NAX6CRFCJR9WQNCRZRH8)
WordPress Website as a Company Website (#h_01JSQAG5RZWVQP8J4QDY970NTQ)
Automatic Subdomain Creation (#h_01JSQ84SJNXP9XNZAPB6S2X431)
Market Report Emails (#h_01JSQ8S1V2CHJ4A2J58P4WGG6K)
Account Owner - WordPress Site for Property Alerts (#h_01JSQAG5S0Z9W6TQTWD4Y006ZQ)
Which Lofty pages will be available in WordPress?
Search Pages
The WordPress Plugin supports two Search Page views - Grid View, or Map View. You can select which view you would like in the
Layout
section.
Search functionality is also available as a Shortcode. If you want to embed the Search functionality on a different page, like a Featured Neighborhood page, you will use the Shortcode functionality.
WordPress Backend:
Map + Grid on a live website:
Grid on a live website:
Featured Listings
You can set a filter, such as price or office, to display a curated selection of featured properties on your website. There are three (3) different Featured Listing views: Grid, Slider, and Gallery.
WordPress Backend:
Grid on a live website:
Slider on a live website:
Gallery on a live website:
Listing Detail Pages
These are the pages that open when someone clicks on a listing. Since this is a template page that changes depending on which listing is selected, the edits are limited. You can use the WordPress backend to update your SEO meta tags for these pages. We recommend using the dynamic Variable tags.
WordPress Backend:
Listing Detail Page on a live website:
Sold Listings
The WordPress Plugin supports two Sold Listings Page views - Grid View, or Map View. You can select which view you would like in the
Layout
section.
WordPress Backend:
Sold Grid:
Sold Map + Grid:
Sold Listing Detail
These are the pages that open when someone clicks on a Sold listing. Since this is a template page that changes depending on which listing is selected, the edits are limited. You can use the WordPress backend to update your SEO meta tags. We recommend using the dynamic variable tags.
WordPress Backend:
Sold detail page on a live website:
Market Report
Market Reports are valuable pages that showcase data about a specific area. The Market Report shortcode allows you to embed this data on your desired pages and capture leads. You will need to set the criteria for the area you would like to cover with the Market Report.
WordPress backend:
Market Report on a live website:
Home Valuation
The Home Valuation tool is a great way to capture seller leads by giving them a free home valuation estimate for their property.
You can configure each of these pages in the WordPress Backend.
Step 1: The site visitor will input their home address into the address box
Step 2: After submitting the address, the visitor is required to provide their contact info to view the home valuation estimate for their property.
Step 3: When the lead completes the previous step (#2), a home valuation report will be sent to their email and an estimated price of the address will be shown on the screen.
What non-page tools are available?
Dynamic Variables
A dynamic variable is a tag that can be modified based on the content or data of the article, website, or in real time. This is crucial when setting up pages for SEO. Instead of hardcoding information, these adaptable variables enable the creation of reusable page templates with minimal adjustments.
Lead Activity & Tracking
When a lead has registered on the WordPress site, their activities will be tracked in the Lofty CRM similarly to the activities that are tracked on the Lofty website. This means that you can see what listings the lead is looking at, saving, and searching on the WordPress site in the lead's timeline in Lofty. The WordPress plugin does
not
currently track any activity beyond the WordPress listing pages. Only listing page activity is tracked.
The source of any lead registering on the WordPress website should be "WordPress Website" and cannot be customized.
Lead Portal
Leads will be able to sign in to WordPress<>Lofty websites to view their saved listings and saved searches.
The portal experience on a WordPress<>Lofty website is different from a Lofty website.
Lofty Website:
My Homes
Property Tours
Favorites
Saved Searches
Account
WordPress Website:
Saved Listings
Saved Searches
Account
Leads on a WordPress<>Lofty website are able to give properties a star rating and add notes that get sent to their Agent.
Property Alerts
Lead-Created Alert
Leads who register on a WordPress<>Lofty website can save their preferred search criteria and set up a property alert.
They can view and edit their saved searches in their lead portal.
All lead activity that happens on a Lofty-synced WordPress page will be passed back to Lofty CRM, so you can be informed of the lead’s activities.
Agent-Created Alert
You can create property alerts for your leads in the Engagement tab of the lead’s profile.
The following outlines the property alert sending logic for different website scenarios:
WordPress site only
: Property alerts will send from the WordPress website
Lofty site + WordPress site
: The Lofty website will be the default sending site for property alerts.
Multiple Lofty sites
: The user can select their preferred Primary website
If you have purchased the WordPress<>Lofty Plugin, but has not completed the setup steps, the functions in the Engagement tab will be locked.
Custom Lead Capture and Registration Form
WordPress+Lofty users can customize the lead capture and registration form that triggers on Lofty-synced pages.
Go to WordPress > Lofty IDX Plugin > Lead Capture Settings
You can also customize your Disclaimer Language
Lastly, you can customize the trigger rules for the Lead Capture form.
Important to note: the Lead Capture form will only trigger on Lofty-synced pages. This includes all Listing and Sold detail pages, Search pages, Featured Listing pages, and Sold Listings pages.
What is NOT available on a Lofty<>WordPress website?
AI Chat Bot
Lofty's AI Sales Assistant can only work on websites that are hosted on Lofty. There will be no AI Chat Bot on a WordPress<>Lofty website. Sales Assistant will still be able to
text
leads who register on a WordPress<>Lofty website, since they will sync to lofty immediately.
WordPress Website as a Company Website
The WordPress Plugin connects the Lofty search experience to 1 WordPress website. At this time, it is not possible to set a WordPress<>Lofty website as a Lofty Company website.
Automatic Subdomain Creation
Lofty websites are closely connected to the Lofty platform and can create subdomains for agents to use with tools like Property Alerts, CMAs, Market Reports, and Market Snapshots. However, a WordPress website connected to Lofty cannot automatically create these subdomains.
Market Report Emails
We do not currently support the ability to set a recurring Market Report email using a WordPress<>Lofty site. You can create a Market Report
webpage
and drive traffic to that page.
Account Owner - WordPress Site for Property Alerts
For users with a Lofty site + WordPress site, the Lofty website will be used as the default for Property Alerts. If you are a Lofty account owner, your Company site will be used as the default for Property Alerts.
In the meantime, we recommend configuring a second seat as your "agent" seat and purchasing the WordPress plugin under that account. This will allow you to use the WordPress website as your primary website.
FAQs
Q: How are the listings displayed? Are they iFramed?
A:
The Plugin connects to the MLS database(s) using IDX protocols to pull real-time property listing data.
The properties are not iFramed.
It fetches property details, including descriptions, images, prices, and locations, via API or direct data feeds in real-time.
The Lofty IDX plugin also supports WordPress shortcodes and widgets to display IDX data in various formats, such as search forms, property grids, and market reports.
Shortcodes like [idx-listings], [idx-search], and others allow you to embed dynamic real estate content on a page without manually coding the listings.
Q: How do you create the Listing and Sold Detail pages? Is it going to take up a lot of bandwidth?
The listing and sold detail pages are dynamically generated by pulling property data from your MLS (Multiple Listing Service). We use the Lofty IDX(Internet Data Exchange) plugin to create these IDX pages automatically.
Each property typically has its own dedicated page, which means every listing will have a unique URL. However, the impact on bandwidth and server resources depends on the size and number of media files (such as images and videos) on each page. If you have many listings, we can ensure that resources are optimized to avoid slow loading times and excessive bandwidth usage.
Q: Do I have to have a Lofty website
and
a WordPress website to use this plugin?
A:
No. Purchasing the WordPress Plugin in the Lofty Marketplace and completing the setup steps connects the Lofty platform to your WordPress website.
Q: Will the WordPress plugin push data on what the site visitor is looking at on the WordPress site back to the CRM?
A:
Yes, but only for Lofty-synced pages (not for any of the other pages on the WordPress website.) The data provided is similar to the data provided when a lead is browsing a Lofty-built website. After the lead registers on the WordPress site, you will have the lead name, listing, time, etc. synced to the activities timeline.
Q: Are both active and sold listing pages supported?
A:
Yes, the Lofty IDX Plugin automatically supports both active and sold listing pages being displayed on your WordPress website.
Q: Is the API key used for the plugin the same one on my integrations page?
A:
No, it is a unique API key generated only for the WordPress plugin.
Q: Can I edit the listing layout?
A:
No.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 490: How to set up the Closely mobile app

- Article ID: `21760812153243`
- Category: `Website`
- Section: `Closely`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T09:33:05Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/21760812153243-How-to-set-up-the-Closely-mobile-app

Introduction
Closely is a consumer app designed to streamline the entire home buying or selling process, serving both buyers and sellers. It helps you better manage and facilitate real estate transactions, deliver personalized service, and enhance the client experience. Closely is offered to Lofty clients with a website at no additional cost.
For an introduction to the consumer facing Closely app, please see
Introduction to Closely Mobile App (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360041042691)
Summary
Setting up the Closely App (#h_01HKAMF6AQJ8W3GKE8WJTC9TD4)
How do leads log in or register for the Closely app? (#h_01HKAN509WE9C84VD62PE20CRH)
How do I know if my leads are using the Closely app? (#h_01HKAQKDA3QJVV1Y0M15Y4VFBM)
How do I guide my leads to the Closely app? (#h_01HKANW72NZFRYV0WY25BC9YMD)
What does the Closely app download page look like? (#h_01HKAPX4YA306363BQX2F5N0YP)
Is there an agent version of the Closely app? (#h_01HKAQ2DTXSQ3HQNE2K856W462)
Setting the Closely App Map Search (#h_01HKAMXKCZVJQ59W7TPX2V438V)
Setting up the Closely App
After integrating your MLS and setting up your Lofty built website, the Closely mobile app will automatically be configured for you.
Navigate to
CMS -> Settings -> Lead Capture
.
Here, you will find the Closely toggle switch, which is turned
on
by default. By enabling the Closely app, your website, welcome email, and email alerts will display the QR Code for your leads to download the Closely app.
Toggling off the Closely app switch will remove the Closely app download QR Code from your website and email notifications, however your users can still access the Closely app independently.
How do leads log in or register for the Closely app?
Closely app accounts and Lofty built websites are interconnected. The lead's activity in the Closely app will tracked in the same way their activity is tracked on your Lofty built website.
If your leads have registered on your website, they can use their website credentials to log in to the Closely app.
If a lead has not registered on your Lofty built website, but they do exist in your CRM, they can download the Closely app through the QR code on your website or email notifications or from the invitation link you sent them, and Lofty will connect the existing lead in your CRM with the account they just created on the Closely app.
If a new lead downloads the Closely app via your QR code, and they do not exist in your CRM, they will be created as a new lead in your CRM with the Source listed as
Closely App
.
How do I know if my leads are using the Closely app?
If your lead registered through the Closely app, their source will be marked as "Closely app", as shown above. Any activity performed by your leads using the Closely app will be tagged as "via Closely" in the lead's activity log.
You can also identify Closely users by using the Advanced Filter in the Leads list.
How do I guide my leads to the Closely app?
If the Closely app toggle in the CMS settings is enabled, your website's footer, mobile site's bottom bar, welcome email, alert emails, and home reports will automatically include your Closely app's download QR code or download link.
You can also invite your leads to download Closely manually by sending the Closely app download link via text message. This text message can be sent in mass:
The Closely app download invitation can also be sent to an individual lead:
Please note, the download links on your website, emails, and invitations will contain your agentId parameter to ensure that your leads are matched with you when they log in or register. If a lead downloads the Closely app from the app store, and not from the code or link you provide, Lofty will not be able to identify that this lead belongs to you and the lead will be matched with whichever agent has most recently had this lead register on their Lofty built website.
What does the Closely app download page look like?
After scanning a Closely app download QR code or clicking on the download invitation link, the following download page will open.
The link will automatically detect whether the Closely App has been installed on the device. If Closely is installed, it will prompt to open the app. If it is not downloaded, the system will guide the user to the App Store or Google Play for installation.
Is there an agent version of the Closely app?
No, the Closely app is a consumer facing app, designed to be used by your leads. To experience the Closely app yourself, register as a lead on your website and log in or download the app via your download link.
If your leads send you messages through the Closely app, you can still receive and chat with them through the CRM or the Lofty mobile app.
Setting the Closely App Map Search
The Closely app will by default use the map center point you have set up for your Lofty built website. Navigate to
CMS -> Editor -> All Listings page -> Listing Search -> Map Center Point
to configure the point the map search centers on for both your website and the Closely app.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 491: Introduction to Closely Mobile App

- Article ID: `360041042691`

- Updated: `2025-11-11T09:33:34Z`

Introduction
Lofty has released
a
mobile app that is intended for use by your buyer/seller leads.
Please
keep in mind that this app is not fully supported for every MLS, and we cannot guarantee the listing data
.
Though we
are working to gain MLS approval to use the data, some MLSs might not make their data available, or they might charge a specific amount for using their data on a mobile app that you, as the user, would be responsible for.
Lofty websites, are always a mobile-friendly option that can be used by leads
,
should Closely not be available.
*IMPORTANT NOTES
You will
not
be able to sign in on Closely unless (a) you have gotten approval for your account via your MLS and this has been set up by Lofty and (b) you have a
test lead
that you are signing in as (remember, this is a mobile app for leads, not for you as Lofty users).
Summary
Video Tour (#h_01H29F9KZGEVRQ21EM35EGGP3S)
Explore Page (#h_01H29ABD6F3QFVB0WGRKWN596B)
Search Bar (#h_01H29ABPT0C2FYAGXSG258BJSH)
Tools (#h_01H29ABWFWZ5X0YTAK9FM41FDW)
Mortgage (#h_01H29AC2P1B16EHB4PM38GM3ZW)
Your Agent (#h_01H29AC8G3CDSG91ZN8S79HGNB)
Featured (#h_01H29ACEX18BYBEVC1GQ8KCC8R)
Valuation (#h_01H29ACNEFS5M2JQMHSHXXCNTC)
My Home (#h_01H29ACXG4P0ETC4YJADC2G93R)
Listings (#h_01H29AD5Z8VDE3ZW2DMX065PVV)
Search Page (#h_01H29ADFBEAEJFHMM76WRW5KE5)
My Home (#h_01H29ADQCFYSE58CXGV0SCFTYH)
Chat (#h_01H29ADXSC3FTY3P82V4H8NHY9)
Profile (#h_01H29AE4850NJ693B0Y4CBF992)
My Tours (#h_01HA8DVF5VT5PWMYWB3TXW08Q3)
Closely App Informational Guide (#h_01H3FBW3XH3QC52R4DQZTCSEBX)
FAQs (#h_01H29AEABHW3DB8878QVPNB7V2)
Video Tour
Explore Page
Upon logging in to the Closely app, the lead will see several options relating to their home buying or selling journey.
Search Bar
At the top of the screen is a search bar. Here, you are able to search for a property by location. Multiple locations may be added, to refine the search:
Tools
Under the search bar is a series of tools:
Mortgage
A mortgage calculator is built into the Closely app, which can help determine the price range for a home purchase.
Your Agent
This section contains the user's real estate agent's contact information, so they may be in touch quickly and easily.
Featured
This tool filters properties per the user's search criteria.
Valuation
This page connects to the Home Valuation page on the Lofty website and allows the users to enter their address to get an update value for their home.
My Home
In this section, homeowners can provide their home address and see the current value as well as request to sell the property.
Once the address has been provided, if the MLS has sufficient data to provide a home valuation, it will be available here. There will also be an option to request a Home Report from your Real Estate Agent. If the MLS does not have sufficient data to provide a home value, your Real Estate Agent will be notified to contact you with more information.
Listings
The final section on the Explore Page is MLS listings, filtered by the following categories:
Open House: These are listings that have a scheduled open house
New: These are listings that are newly on the MLS
Price Reduced: Listings that have had a price reduction
Recommended: Listings that are recommended for you, per your search criteria
Search Page
The search page allows you to search current homes for sale via a list or map view. Searches may be saved so that you do not have to enter your required filters each time you search for a property.
My Home
This page allows you to track the value of the home you currently own, as well as request to sell the property with your Real Estate Agent.
Chat
The Closely app allows you to chat directly with your Real Estate Agent. Here, you can reach out to your agent quickly and see your previous conversations.
Profile
The profile is your Closely app account information. Here you can see your saved listings and searches, your agent's information, and edit your profile.
Click the hamburger icon in the upper right corner to enable or disable app notifications, submit Closely app feedback, or log out of the app.
My Tours
Closely app users access their Showings via their profile. Once in the app profile, click
My Tours
Tours Tab
This tab allows the user to view the showing appointments and buyer tours that have been confirmed by their agent. The status of the showing will be displayed in the top right corner of each card.
Clicking on a card will take users to the tour detail page, to see more information, like the listing details, time, location, etc. If the tour has been completed, the lead can leave feedback directly in the Closely app.
Requests Tab
This tab shows the record of the user's "Request a Tour" requests from the listing details page.
Clicking on the request card will take you to the listing detail page.
Tour Detail Page
The tour detail page is accessed by clicking on a tour in the Tours tab.
The details include:
The entire route for the showing
The scheduled time
The listing information
The driving distance
The driving time.
Users can switch the listing information by clicking on the listing point on the map or sliding the card. Clicking "Directions" will open the map app on users' devices for navigation. If they have not downloaded a map app on their phone, it will prompt them to download one from the app store. Clicking on the "Calendar" icon in the top right corner allows users to add this showing event to their device's calendar.
Listing Feedback
When the showing/tour status is "Completed" the user has the option to leave feedback. The feedback content is the same as the web version.
Push Notifications
The Closely app will send push notifications to users for various events related to a showing, including:
Showing/Tour Creation
Showing/Tour modifications
Showing/tour cancellations
Reminders before the showing starts
Closely App Informational Guide
We have created a guide that may be shared with your leads to teach them about the Closely app and how useful it can be in their home-buying or selling process.
Click here to download the guide (https://help.lofty.com/hc/article_attachments/19565090141851)
FAQs
Q:
What services does this app provide to your leads?
A:
The app allows buyers/sellers to work closely with his/her home team. All your buyer and seller leads can browse your listings and easily chat online with their agent anytime, anywhere.
---
Q:
What can this app bring to you?
A:
The app allows you, as an agent, to work closely with your leads. Your leads can receive your messages anytime, anywhere. All lead behavior on the app will be sent to your Lofty CRM as a note on the timeline.
---
Q:
How does a lead download this app?
A:
You can search for “Closely” on your iPhone or Android device app stores to download directly to your device. The download link could be provided to current leads so that they can sign in and use the features provided.
iPhone Link:
Click Here (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/closely-real-estate/id1468041067)
.
Android Link:
Click Here (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.renren.android.chimesite&hl=en_US)
.
---
Q:
How will your leads use this app?
A:
Your leads will use the accounts that they already have registered with your IDX website to log in and browse the available listings populated from the MLS. They can also favorite listings that they can access quickly and easily
,
and send these listings directly to their assigned agent in Lofty.
---
Q:
What if a lead's information (email address) is in the database of more than one Lofty user?
A:
If you send the lead your Closely app link, their app will automatically be linked to you. If they download the app on their own, they will have to select who they want to work with.
---
Q:
With the Closely app, can agents pre-load searches, etc.?
A:
In Closely, the "Suggested Properties" section in the Buyer Market shows properties from the buyer property alerts set up for that lead by the Lofty user (agent). The "Suggested Properties" section in the Seller Market shows properties from the market snapshot/seller alerts that are set up by the agent.
---
Q:
What kind of push notifications are supported for leads via the Closely mobile app?
A:
Text or chat messages are supported (though these would also go to the lead's cell number
), as well as
notifications for new properties that match their criteria and scheduled showings.
---
Q:
Closely has an option for leads to send listings to their agent. Who will the message go to in Lofty?
A:
The message will be received by the agent in the "Assigned To" section of a lead profile
.
---
Q:
Can I turn off the Closely app link in my property alert emails?
A
: Yes, you can go to your CMS tool Settings> Lead Capture > Closely App. There is a
one-day cache for this switch, once you turn it off, it will be removed the next day.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: Closely app, closely mobile

.

#### Article 493: Android Notification Setup Guide

- Article ID: `34373279431963`
- Category: `Mobile Apps`
- Section: `Lofty Mobile App`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T09:34:16Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/34373279431963-Android-Notification-Setup-Guide

Since an Android software update in 2024, activity restrictions on background applications have become stricter, preventing users from receiving Lofty app notifications unless they have chosen specific settings.
This is a guide on how to configure your settings on your Android phone to ensure you can continue to receive reliable notifications from Lofty.
Overview
Samsung series (#h_01JMZ054FTFVDTQTKJQSY792DB)
Google series (#h_01JMZ05A986NAJ0FNM274EB16Q)
Huawei series (#h_01JMZ05EA4N70YCY532BMC4M44)
Samsung series
1. Open Lofty notification settings and toggle on “Show notifications”
2. Go to Settings > Applications > find Lofty
Enter the Lofty info page > find Battery
Enter Battery
Change to Unrestricted
3. Go to Settings>General management>Battery
Turn off "Power saving"
4.
In Battery, go to “Background usage limits”
Go to “Deep sleeping apps”
In “Deep sleeping apps”, if Lofty is in the list of Deep sleeping apps, tap the three dots on the top right, then select Lofty to remove it from the list.
5. Navigate back to “Background usage limits” and enter “Auto run apps”
Find Lofty and toggle on
Google series
1. Open Lofty notification settings and toggle on “All Lofty notifications”
2.
In Settings > Apps > find Lofty
Enter the Lofty application details page > find "App battery usage"
Change the battery usage to “Unrestricted”
3. In Settings, go to “Battery”
In Battery, enter “Battery Saver”
Toggle off “Use Battery Saver”
Huawei series
1. In Settings, find Lofty in your Notifications. Turn on the “Allow notifications” switch
2. In Settings, go to Battery, toggle off “Power Saving Mode”
3.
In Settings > Apps & services > App launch > find Lofty
Turn OFF automatic management for Lofty
In the resulting pop-up, turn on “Auto Launch” and “Run in background”, then tap “Ok”

#### Article 495: Gmail Email Integration via Lofty Mobile App

- Article ID: `115000976843`
- Category: `Mobile Apps`
- Section: `Lofty Mobile App`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T09:39:42Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000976843-Gmail-Email-Integration-via-Lofty-Mobile-App

Introduction
In this article, we will review how to add and set up Gmail Integration via the Lofty Mobile App. Adding the Gmail integration will allow you to sync 'Sent' and 'Received Emails' and manage your email communication for all things real estate in one place.
For instructions on setting this up via a desktop/laptop computer, please reference this article:
Gmail Email Integration (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360054865692)
.
Setup
To start, launch your Lofty CRM mobile app on the mobile device and tap the '3 dots' icon at the bottom of the page, and tap on Settings.
Click on the "Integration" line, then GMAIL on the next. Turn on the Toggle button to proceed:
As long as you already have your Gmail connected to your phone, select the correct account from the list. Otherwise, enter the email address for the Gmail account you wish to use with Lofty.
Tap 'Allow' to ensure that your actions in Gmail will be able to sync with Google's servers in the event you lose cellular connection. This will guarantee all your Gmail email actions will be synced properly between any device.
If the integration process goes smoothly, you'll see the screen display "Authorization succeeded." Gmail is now fully integrated into your Lofty CRM on mobile and desktop.
Questions?

Introduction
Connect directly with other Real Estate Agents in your Lofty app! The Lofty mobile app allows you to search for and connect with other agents in your MLS. The ability to search for other agents and be found by other agents can be disabled in your Lofty mobile app settings.
This feature is not currently available in the Lofty web app.
Find an Agent
To find a fellow agent in your MLS in the Lofty app, select the
People
icon and select
Contacts
. Here, you will see that your own team members and other contacts, like lenders, are already visible to you. To search for another agent, who
does not
have to be a Lofty user, click
Find Agent
and select them from the list.
Use the Location, With Listing, or Specialty filters or the search bar to find your friends. Adding a friend will send an invite to connect with the agent. They must agree to send any communication.
Disabling this Feature
If you do not want to be able to search for other agents or be found via an agent search, navigate to the Lofty mobile app settings to disable these features. As a Lofty account owner, you can enable or disable these features for all the users on your Lofty account.

#### Article 498: How to Set Up Caller Identification

- Article ID: `115001743643`
- Category: `Mobile Apps`
- Section: `Lofty Mobile App`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T09:38:46Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115001743643-How-to-Set-Up-Caller-Identification

Introduction
As a real estate agent, you have hundreds of contacts and these contacts are the most important part of your business. With Lofty’s Caller ID, you will know whether one of your Lofty contacts is calling you so you are prepared before you pick up the phone.
Here is what this will look like on your phone:
Download the App
,
Sign In
In order for this feature to work, make sure to download the Lofty CRM app in the Google Play Store (Android) or the Apple App Store (iPhone). After downloading the app, sign in with your Lofty login credentials.
*Please note that this feature will only work for your contacts whose phone numbers are attached to leads in your Lofty CRM database.
iOS Setup
Navigate to your iPhone settings
Select "Phone"
Select "Call Blocking & Identification"
Locate the "Lofty
CRM"
option and slide the switch to the "On" position.
Open your Lofty CRM app
At the bottom of the screen, click the 3 dots option
Click on "Settings".
Click on the refresh icon to the right of the Update Contacts line and follow any steps that appear.
Android Setup
Google recently changed its requirements for this type of feature to work. This being the case, Lofty is actively working on gaining access to enable this feature again for Android devices. Until this is resolved, this feature will be unavailable on Android phones.
When this is enabled again
, these will be the steps to follow:
By default, devices using Android have Caller ID set up through the Lofty CRM app. To see how to manually set up a Caller ID, simply follow these steps:
1. Open your Lofty CRM app, and at the bottom of the screen, click
More
.
2. Click on
Settings.
3. Click on the refresh icon to the right of the
Update Contacts
tab and follow the steps that appear.
FAQ
Q: When calling from the dialer, when the number shows up on the recipient's phone on the caller ID, the number is displayed, does the location where the number is based show up as well?
A: Yes, it does show the location.
Questions?

#### Article 500: Lofty Real Estate App

- Article ID: `17801017502491`
- Category: `Mobile Apps`
- Section: `Lofty Mobile App`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T09:35:27Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/17801017502491-Lofty-Real-Estate-App

Introduction
This article provides an overview of the features available in the Lofty Real Estate App.
Overview
Login Page (#h_01H7DR45W90N15YQ4GGHZSPYBA)
Settings (#h_01JZ8RYQDPTJD6RP53JY6D870S)
Mobile Dashboard (#h_01H7DR4BZDR18YAJM1GFGNTJ15)
Chat Page (#h_01H7DR4BZDR18YAJM1GFGNTJ15)
People Page (#h_01H7DR4KMK6MSGBNMRF54TF55E)
Listings Page (#h_01H7DR4QX6BF27BFFNYCQH9WYJ)
All Other Features (#h_01H7DR50YZ2MMDSSB1RNWH8P4G)
Login Page
We added two login methods for mobile users: Biometric and Pattern Lock.
Navigate to the app settings → Account & Security to modify the login method. You can enable either FaceID/TouchID or Pattern Lock.
Face ID (iOS only)
If you have not already set up FaceID on your device, there will be a pop-up that guides you through configuring FaceID. Once this is done, you can then go back to the Lofty app and turn on Face ID.
Notes: If you have a phone that does not support FaceID, you can set up Touch ID in the same way.
An iPhone can have either FaceID or Touch ID, not both.
Fingerprint Unlock (Android)
Face Unlock is not currently supported for Android phones. If you have not already set up a fingerprint unlock on your device, enabling this option will walk you through setting it up first, just like FaceID for iOS.
Pattern Lock
When turning on the Pattern Lock switch, you will need to choose a pattern, then verify it. If you have set up a pattern lock for your phone before, you will need to set up another pattern lock for the Lofty app. The app will not unlock with your phone's pattern unlock by default. You can, however, set up the same pattern lock if you want to.
Settings
The Settings icon will take you to your Lofty mobile app settings. Here, you can make any needed changes to your Lofty mobile app experience.
Navigate to
Account & Security
to set up alternative login methods, two-factor authentication, or to reset your password.
Mobile Dashboard
A notification chat called "Your Priorities" can be muted or pinned. Every day at 8 a.m. in your time zone, we will push a notification through the chat to guide you to go into the mobile dashboard.
We support new leads, opportunities, need to follow-up, tasks, transactions, appointments, and showings.
You can switch to different categories to view your work.
And can switch the time filter between “today” and “this week”.
For leads, swipe left can either text, email, or call the leads
For appointments, swiping left can complete or postpone the appointment.
Chat Page
Use this page to manage and respond to messages.
Text communication with leads
AI Assistant messages (if applicable)
Individual and group messages with other users on your same Lofty account
You can use the search feature to easily find specific messages.
All notifications will also be located on this page:
Unknown Inbound
Showing Assistant
Opportunity
New leads
Reassigned leads
Task Reminders
AI Assistant notifications
Community
Transaction
People Page
The Lofty app categorizes your people into two categories:
Leads
and
Contacts
.
"Leads" are Buyers, Sellers, Renters, or Others. These people sync with the web app.
Leads can be shared with Contacts.
"Contacts" are other agents on your team or in your MLS. The Lofty app makes it easy to communicate with your peers.
Listings Page
The listing page will be identical to the web version of Lofty. The
Discover
tab will have the same functionality as the web app's
All Listings
page.
You can view and share your listings in the
My Listings
tab.
Listings can be shared with other agents, leads, or you can generate a showing link.
When sharing listings with a lead, you have the option to filter by leads who are
Matched Buyers
or by
All Leads.
You can also copy the URL to the listing to share on social, or send via email by clicking on the arrow in the bottom right-hand corner. Using this option will generate a short URL that is friendly for sharing.
Add Property in Mobile Email Sending Process
In the mobile app, when sending an email to leads;
You can select multiple listings.
After insertion, the listing appears as a variable on the editing page. But after sending, it will become a listing card in the email body.
Social Studio
Currently, this version only includes the basic functions of Social Studio, including:
Authorizing social accounts
Posting/ scheduling posts
Tracking engagement data of posts
Excludes feature:
Automatic post settings and display
Package upgrade
Boost post-related functions
To access the Social Studio, click the More menu next to the website icon.
Social Accounts Authorization
If you are a new user, you will first see the authorization page.
Authorized users can access the Account Management page through the icon in the top right corner. From this page, you can perform actions such as connecting, removing, or refreshing the social accounts. The authorization status is synchronized between the web and mobile.
Post Dashboard
When there are no sent posts, an empty state will be displayed to guide users to create posts.
When there is content available, it will be divided into two tabs: one for sent posts and another for scheduled posts.
Sent: from the most recent to the earliest.
Post time
Post content: text, image, video, or link preview
Engagement data: same as web, including impressions, clicks, and engaged leads
Post channel: The grey icon means it failed to send the post to a specific channel.
Action:
View post content on a social channel
Delete
Scheduled: from future to most recent
Scheduled post time
Post content
Post channel
Action:
Edit
Delete
Create Post
Operations are close to the web version.
Click the Social Studio icon
AI will provide a prompt
Edit content
Choose social channels
Click the Publish button
All Other Features
All other features will be identical to the web version of Lofty.

Chat/Text Leads Individually

count towards your daily text limit.

2. Select the "messages" bubbles at the bottom of the page:

*
These messages
will
count towards your daily text limit.

will be sent as INDIVIDUAL conversations
. When a lead responds, they will only respond to you. No recipients can see each other as they are all receiving a separate conversation from you.

#### Article 504: Property Alerts & Market Snapshots from Mobile App

- Article ID: `360039378151`
- Category: `Mobile Apps`
- Section: `Lofty Mobile App`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T09:36:07Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360039378151-Property-Alerts-Market-Snapshots-from-Mobile-App

Introduction
After many client requests, the
Lofty Mobile App (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360012545351)
will allow Lofty users to add/edit/delete Property Alerts (buyer) and Market Snapshots via their mobile phones. The filters available on the mobile app will be synced with the web app, meaning if users have specific filters from their MLS set up on the Lofty website, they will also be available on the mobile app.
Current
Limitations
include the following:
Currently, the mobile app does not support the option to "plot" an area on a map when using the mobile app
The ability to send individual listings is not currently supported--only the creation of an alert using the available criteria. This can be done on the desktop
web
app using Listing Discovery, but is not currently available on the mobile Lofty app.
Market Reports cannot be created with this feature, only Property Alerts (buyer) and Market Snapshots (seller).
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 505: Open House Tablet App

- Article ID: `360056122032`
- Category: `Mobile Apps`
- Section: `Open House Tablet App`
- Updated: `2025-11-11T09:42:05Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056122032-Open-House-Tablet-App

Introduction
Lofty has published an Open House app designed to be used on Apple and Android tablets. The features are basically the same as on the Lofty web app (logging in via your computer) with one important difference–you can use the tablet app
offline
to collect open house registrants and then synchronize them to your Lofty CRM later when you have WiFi, etc.
For more information on using the "online" version of Open Houses via the CRM, see
Open House Forms (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360023770952)
. This article will refer specifically to the tablet app.
Summary
Setup (#h_01EXSR2P0D1X1TSAA6VEY4ZSGX)
How It Works (#h_01EXSR398YYK0RZ2TSVENVXC90)
FAQ (#h_01EXSZ9T86RF0RX8HZMQBQ3C4H)
Setup
Download the App
The app can be downloaded for a tablet device using the following links:
Apple App Store
Click Here (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/chime-open-house/id1551577603)
.
Google Play Store
Click Here (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.renren.chime.openhouse)
.
Log In
Now that the app is downloaded, log in using your Lofty account (email) and password. You will have to be connected to the internet for this part of the app.
How It Works
Main Page
Any open houses created via the web or tablet app will be displayed here
Expand and click on the
House
icon to open up the form for this open house:
Click the
Edit
or
Delete
buttons to perform either of those actions:
Add New
To add a new Open House form, click on the "+ Add New" button at the bottom. We suggest that you add this when connected to the internet via WiFi as the MLS address suggestions and listing images will only be loaded with an active connection.
The fields available on the tablet version for adding a new Open House are the same as with the web app version (see
Open House Forms (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360023770952)
).
Open House Form
Expand and click on the
House
icon to open up the form for this open house:
After launching an open house form, open house visitors can fill out the form to provide their information and then click the "Submit" button:
With the tablet app, there are two different scenarios that can happen when data is submitted:
With an Internet Connection
After submission, the lead's data will be synced to your CRM automatically. Any notes you've added after their submission will also be synced right away.
Without an Internet Connection (Offline Mode)
After submission, the lead's data will be stored on your tablet's local storage. When connecting to the internet later and opening this app, the data (including any notes you've added) will be synced to your Lofty CRM.
Any open houses that are synced with the CRM will show up with the green checkmark. Those that are not synced with the online CRM will have the grey "x" appear:
If leads fail to sync, there will be an error visible on the Open House in the web app CRM.
Once you click
View Details
, you will see the reason (email duplication or "other") and have the chance to re-upload in scenarios where that failed reason has been resolved.
FAQ
How can I see the leads captured via the Open House tablet app?
Please note that in this initial version, the ability to view leads captured via the open house form on the tablet is not available directly on the tablet. You can see any synced leads in the Lofty web app or mobile app. Future versions will likely provide the ability to preview captured leads.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: open house app Android, open house IOS app

#### Article 506: Feature Availability for Users in Canada

- Article ID: `360056581812`
- Category: `Help & Troubleshooting`
- Section: `Help & Troubleshooting`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T00:33:32Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056581812-Feature-Availability-for-Users-in-Canada

Introduction
This article will outline Lofty features that may be at a reduced capacity for clients located in Canada. All features in the CRM work as expected, but there are some differences in features available on the website.
Summary
Neighborhood Pages (#h_01EY9NHA94EVF6VW0C9XE4CDF4)
Home Evaluation (#h_01EY9NK85CY8H7J1SP02H5YQPP)
Mortgage/Affordability Calculators (#h_01EY9NNPEWW7XJWF1K99H1CXHZ)
30-Minute Time Zones (#h_01EY9NNSYKBEDYAXXZSFST0ZR8)
Self-Service Lead Generation (#h_01EYVAMSCYZ54TZEYBJZ545F84)
Listing Detail School Data (#h_01F0VQZSM3P1NAWEE51NFE8CNX)
Postcards (#h_01F1DFZSQ6HFE9PKF91A2JKKGB)
Geographic Farming (#h_01GH2BK6WQV6DQ0SAD6YV39KQ2)
Lofty Bloom (#h_01JK6E9PRQTRY7PM4SRRFZE68W)
CMA Access (#h_01G00A2TBM8RZ42J3G906TVAB0)
Home Report (#h_01GRS2NES2VXZRYSZ3AEH0GRAJ)
Google Local Service Ads (#id-4/10/2023:FeatureReleaseTrainingforChime3.62-GoogleLocalServiceAdsSelfPurchase)
FAQs (#h_01EZ5EEEG4BRNY9V68JM0XXKVJ)
Neighborhood Pages / Featured Area
Neighborhood data outlined in
this Help Center article (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037816512)
will not be available for any areas in Canada. While neighborhood pages are desirable because they bring in demographic data as well as all listings available automatically, you will still be able to build a listing results page for a target neighborhood or city to share with your clients and include on your website.
Adding a Listing Page
1. Go to Page Editor> Click the +Add Folder button on the left panel. Rename the new page that will be added under the Hidden navigation list.
2. Create your listing page by going to Editor> Pages > +Add page. Choose Listing on the Page Template tab and hit the Next button.
3. Type the page name, you can use the neighborhood/city name.
4. Insert the new page into your Neighborhood folder by dragging the 3 lines.
5. Edit the page by clicking the pencil icon on the upper right. Go to the left panel option to add a custom listing filter then save.
Home Evaluation
The Home Evaluation page will be accessible on the site, but when a lead enters an address, they will not be able to automatically receive home value estimations. Instead, they will receive a message similar to the one below (with an actual headshot displayed, of course), letting the lead know that an agent will be reaching out. The lead address and contact information will be captured, allowing you to provide an accurate home evaluation and other information directly.
Learn more here:
Home Valuation Page (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038509091)
Home Valuation Block (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037923112)
Mortgage/Affordability Calculators
There are several different options available to add to mortgage or affordability calculators on the website. Currently, those calculators will be represented in US dollars.
Learn more here:
Calculator Block (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037923072)
Affordability Calculator (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360040092351)
Mortgage Calculator Page (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038509151)
30-Minute Time Zones
30-minute time zones are not supported at this time within the Lofty platform. This means that the Newfoundland Time Zone (NT) is
not
supported in Lofty in the present version.
Self-Service Lead Generation
If you are interested in purchasing lead generation services via Lofty, please contact your CSM or Lofty Support (
support@lofty.com (mailto:support@chimeinc.com)
). You can purchase lead generation in Canada, but the self-service options available via the Lofty Marketplace will not work to produce CPL estimates, etc. for Canada.
Listing Detail School Data
On listing detail pages of Lofty-built IDX webpages, school data is
not
available due to the fact that this is provided by the same provider as neighborhood data (see
above (#h_01EY9NHA94EVF6VW0C9XE4CDF4)
) and is not available in Canada at the present time.
Postcards
Currently, Lofty postcards
cannot
be sent to addresses in Canada. Please see
Self-Service Postcards (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360058318632)
for more information.
Geographic Farming
Similar to the above, this feature provides a postcard campaign. Lofty cannot send postcards to Canada, so this feature is not available. Please see
Geographic Farming (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/10099421190427)
for more information.
Lofty Bloom
This feature is not available in Canada. Please see
Lofty Bloom (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/32531151443995)
for more information.
CMA Tool Access
Lofty CRM Users in Canada who do have access to Sold Listing Data in their MLS (usually through a VOW connection) should have
FULL FUNCTIONALITY
of the Lofty CMA Tool.
Home Report
This feature is not available because the loan type and the mortgage calculations are different from those in the US. Please see the
Home Report (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/5604874589851)
for more information.
Google Local Service Ads
This feature is not available for Canadian clients. Please see
Google Local Service Ads (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/14427278320411)
for more information.
FAQs
Can users in Canada use the Listing Discovery filters to search by alpha-numeric-based postal codes? (#h_01EZ5EE6PVP15XJSWM66BFTVMZ)
As a user in Canada, can I send Market Reports and Market Snapshots? (#h_01EZQNV0W25TYRV08180GTVSYH)
Are zip code blasts available in Canada? (#01K5YD91NVRY26Q3EN5A5NJ8PM)
Can users in Canada use the Listing Discovery filters to search by alpha-numeric-based postal codes?
Yes.
As a user in Canada, can I send Market Reports and Market Snapshots?
Yes, as long as the data needed for these features is provided by the MLS--specifically, sold listing data. Not every MLS provides sold listing data.
A
re zip code blasts available in Canada
?
Service Type
Available in Canada?
Notes
Digital Zip Code Ads
Yes
Target Canadian postal codes for digital ads via the Lofty Blast platform
Direct Mail Blasts
No
Only available in the U.S.; not supported in Canada
Note: HomeOwner Shop is also not available for Canada clients.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Related term: Canada

- Article ID: `15574019928731`

- Section: `Help & Troubleshooting`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T00:33:08Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/15574019928731-Instagram-Connection-Troubleshooting

Introduction
This article is meant to assist you with connecting your Instagram profile to Lofty's Social Studio.
Summary
Important (#h_01H0R9PH9K6CYPAN76NPGQ351X)
How to identify your Instagram Account Type (#TroubleshootingInstagramconnections-Howtoidentifywhattypeofaccountyoucurrentlyhave)
Convert to Instagram Business Account (#TroubleshootingInstagramconnections-ConverttoInstagrambusinessaccount)
Via Instagram (#TroubleshootingInstagramconnections-ViaInstagram)
Via Facebook (#TroubleshootingInstagramconnections-ViaFacebook)
Troubleshooting Checklist (#TroubleshootingInstagramconnections-Troubleshootingchecklist)
Frequently Asked Questions (#h_01H0R9R1FYS7TC3XYJX3KDY29Z)
Q: How can I make sure that my Facebook page is connected to an Instagram business account? (#TroubleshootingInstagramconnections-HowtomakesureifyoufacebookpageconnectedaInstagrambusinessaccount)
Q: How do I connect to the Facebook page via Instagram? (#TroubleshootingInstagramconnections-HowtoconnecttheFBpageviaIG?)

Important
Please note the following key points:
Your Instagram account
must
be a Business account and it
must
be connected to a Facebook Page.
Your Facebook Profile
must
be an Admin for that Facebook Page.
If you have a Creator account, you
will not
be able to connect your Instagram to Social Studio. Instagram only supports publishing to business accounts at this time.
How to identify your Instagram Account Type
Unsure what type of Instagram account you have? Follow these steps to find out!
Open the Instagram app on your mobile device and go to your profile.
Tap on the hamburger menu (three horizontal lines) in the upper right corner of the app and select Settings and Privacy.
Select Account Type and Tools. Here, you will see the following options, depending on your current account type:
If you currently have an Instagram personal profile, you'll see these two options:
Switch to Professional account
Add new Professional account
If you currently have an Instagram business account, you'll see these two options:
Switch to Personal Account
Switch to Creator Account
If you currently have an Instagram creator account, you'll see these two options:
Switch to Personal Account
Switch to Business Account
Convert to Instagram Business Account
Via Instagram
Open the Instagram app on your mobile device and navigate to Settings and Privacy.
Select Account Type and Tools.
Tap Switch to Professional account.
Follow the on-screen prompts, ensuring you
choose the business account type
,
not
the creator account type. You'll also need to select a Facebook Page (or create a new one) to link your Instagram business account to. You will see a "Don't Connect to Facebook Now" option, but if you don't connect a Facebook Page to your Instagram account, you won't be able to connect your account to Lofty Social Studio.
Your Instagram account should now have been converted to a business account.
https://business.instagram.com/getting-started
Via Facebook
Head over to Facebook and navigate to the list of Pages you have access to (or click
this link (https://www.facebook.com/pages/?category=your_pages)
). Click on the Page that you'll associate with your Instagram account, or create a new Page if you don't already have one.
Once you're on your Page, click Settings in the left-hand sidebar.
Click Linked Account→Instagram on the left-hand side and then click Connect Account towards the top of the screen.
Enter your Instagram login credentials and click Log In. (If you're already signed into Instagram, or your login credentials are saved within your browser, you'll just need to click Continue.)
You'll see a pop-up window prompting you to set up your Instagram business account. Follow the on-screen instructions, be sure to enter your contact info, and then click Done.
Troubleshooting Checklist
Head over to Facebook and navigate to the list of Pages you have access to (or
click this link (https://www.facebook.com/pages/?category=your_pages)
). Click on the Page that is linked to your Instagram business account.
Once you're on your Page, switch to the page account and click
Settings
in the left-hand sidebar.
Once in settings, you should see your Linked Account connected to the Page. You should also see a section that says "Business contact information". In this case, please continue to the next step.
If you see a screen that differs from the image above, it means your Instagram account is either not connected to your Facebook Page, or it hasn't been converted to a business account. The following outlines some of the options you might see and the steps you should take.
If you see a button that says
Connect Account
, it means your Instagram account is not linked to your Facebook Page.
If you see a button that says
Get Started
, it means your Instagram account is linked to your Facebook Page, but it hasn't been converted to a business account.
Click Get Started and follow the on-screen prompts to convert your Instagram account to a business account. Then, try connecting your Instagram account again
If you see a button that says
Review Connection
, it means that the account must be confirmed before third-party applications are able to verify the connection.
Please click the button and follow the prompts to confirm. Note: If you encounter issues with this process, you may need to reach out to
Facebook Support (https://www.facebook.com/business/help)
in order to confirm the connection.
Finally, we need to check that Social Studio has all of the permissions required to access your Facebook account. Click on the small drop-down arrow at the top right of your screen and then click Settings & privacy > Settings. From there, click Business Integrations on the left-hand side (or
click this link (https://www.facebook.com/settings?tab=business_tools)
).
Find Social Studio in the list of integrations and click View and edit.
In the pop-up window, ensure that all Facebook Pages are checked in all sections.
Note: If you don’t see any individual Pages listed in the following screens, it means that you’ve previously granted Social Studio permissions to access all Pages, which is the ideal setup. In this case, you won’t need to check any Pages here, and instead, you’ll need to reestablish the authorization: on the same page above, click Remove Lofty Social Studio and complete the steps on the popup window.
Once that's done, try connecting your Instagram account to Social Studio again.
Frequently Asked Questions
Q: How can I make sure that my Facebook page is connected to an Instagram business account?
A:
You will need to log in to the
personal
Facebook profile that has the admin role on the Facebook Page connected to your Instagram account. If you log into a Facebook profile that does not have the admin role on the Page, or if your profile isn't correctly set up as an admin within Facebook Business Suite, you will not see your Instagram business account listed in the next step. For more information on how to see your Facebook page role or access, please visit:
https://www.facebook.com/help/510247025775149
Q: How do I connect to the Facebook page via Instagram?
A:
Follow the steps below:
Go to your Instagram profile.
Select Edit Profile.
Under Public Business Information, select Page.
Tap Create Facebook Page or Connect an Existing Page.
Choose a Page from your Pages that you'd like to connect to or select Create a New Facebook Page.
Tap Done after you've selected a Page or created a new Page.
For more information, please see:
https://help.instagram.com/570895513091465
Q: What if my Facebook page is not listed?
A:
First, verify that your personal Facebook profile has the admin role for the page. If you page is part of a Facebook Business Suite account, make sure that your permissions are fully set up.
In Facebook, open your page and check that you've logged in as your Facebook Page, not your profile.
Open the menu on the left and select
Professional Dashboard
Click
Page Access
When you select your name, a pop-up will appear. It should say "This person has full control."
Please note that you cannot connect a Facebook page if your profile is an admin via inheritance from a parent page. To check this visit your Facebook page, navigate to the Page Roles section within the settings, and look for your name under
Admin (inherited from parent Page).
If you see this, you will not be able to authorize the connection between the Facebook Page and Lofty.
Next, ensure that you have authorized all page permissions. If you have the correct page role, but the page is still not listed, it means that Lofty does not have the necessary permissions from Facebook. Here are the steps to check your permissions:
Log into the Facebook personal profile that has admin access with Full Control on the Facebook Page.
Click on the small drop-down arrow at the top right corner and select
Settings & Privacy > Settings
Head to Business Integrations in Facebook. Please note that these settings are found on your Facebook profile, not within the Facebook Page settings, so you must be using Facebook as your profile to access them.
Find Lofty in the list and select
View and Edit
Scroll down to the list of Pages and verify that ALL boxes are selected. You may need to click
See all pages
to expand the list of pages and see the ones that permissions to be granted. Here, tick all of the empty boxes.
After selecting all of your accounts, click
Save.
If you are connecting a
Facebook Page
, head back to Lofty and try connecting the page again.
If you are connecting an
Instagram account
, try connecting the account to Lofty. If it still doesn't work, please try the next steps.
Checking the connection between Facebook and Instagram
Once you have verified that your Instagram account is a business or creator account, next check that your Facebook Page is properly connected to Instagram within your Page settings and Meta Business Suite.
Log into the Facebook Page linked to Instagram
Click on
Professional Dashboard
Click
Linked Accounts
You should see your Instagram account connected:
If your Instagram account is connected properly, the options will be
View Details
and
Disconnect Account
, as shown in the screenshot above.
If you see a button that says
Connect Account
, your Instagram account is not linked to your Facebook Page
If you see a button that says
Get Started
, it means that your Instagram account is linked to your Facebook Page, but it has not been converted to a business or creator account.
Click
Get Started
and follow the on-screen prompts to convert your Instagram account to a business account. Then, try connecting your Instagram account again.
If you see a button that says
Review Connection
, it means that the account must be confirmed before third-party applications are able to verify the connection.
Please click the button and follow the prompts to confirm.
Note:
If you encounter issues with this process, you may need to reach out to
Facebook Support (https://www.facebook.com/business/help)
in order to confirm the connection.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 511: API Key Management

- Article ID: `47499531505179`
- Category: `Developers`
- Section: `Developers`
- Updated: `2026-03-06T20:59:50Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/47499531505179-API-Key-Management

Introduction
Lofty has transitioned from auto-generated API keys to a fully user-managed API key system. This update improves security, auditability, and user control over API access. Existing API keys have been migrated and labeled as legacy. Users must now explicitly create and manage all API keys going forward. While API keys can still be shared, OAuth is the recommended and documented method for all new vendor integrations (see
HERE (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4405826620571-Lofty-Open-API-and-Developer-Platform)
).
API Key Settings
API Keys are managed from
Personal Settings
>
Integrations
>
API Keys
:
How It Works
Legacy API Key Migration
All existing auto-generated API keys have been migrated into the new API Key list with an "Active" status. Each migrated key is labeled as a “Legacy Token” with no expiration date. Legacy keys remain available until manually revoked by the user.
API Key Auto-Generation Disabled
API keys are no longer auto-generated. After this update, users must explicitly create each API key through the UI by clicking
+ Create API Key
:
API Key Statuses
Each API key now carries one of three statuses:
Status
Behavior
Active
Valid and usable
Expired
Permanently invalid, preserved for history. Cannot be reactivated.
Revoked
Permanently invalid, preserved for history. Cannot be reactivated.
Maximum Active Keys
Users can have a maximum of 10 API keys in "Active" status at any time. Keys in Expired or Revoked status do not count toward this limit.
Creating an API Key
Users must provide the following when creating a new API key:
Name (Required)
Description (Optional)
Expiration Date (Optional) — API key status changes to "Expired" on the indicated date at 12:01 AM and access is disabled at that time.
API Usage Acknowledgment (Required) — Users must read and accept the terms via checkbox before the key can be created. The checkbox event is recorded in the database with IP address, device information, date/time, and linked to the API key.
2FA-Protected API Key Reveal & Revocation
Users are presented with the API key once at the time of creation. Any subsequent attempt to view the key requires two-factor authentication. Revoking an API key also requires the user to complete two-factor authentication before the action is processed.
Available Edit Actions for Active API Keys
Users can perform the following actions on any API key with "Active" status:
Change name
Add or edit description
Add or edit expiration date — Status changes to "Expired" at 12:01 AM on the expiration date. The expiration date and time are recorded in the database. Recovery is not permitted.
Revoke Access — Status changes from "Active" to "Revoked" immediately and API access is disabled. The revocation date and time are recorded in the database. Recovery is not permitted.
Expiration Reminder Emails
A reminder email is sent to the user at 30, 15, 7, and 1 day(s) before the API key expiration date at 8:00 AM. If the expiration date is updated, the reminder schedule adjusts automatically.
Why This Matters
Users now have full control over API key creation, visibility, and lifecycle instead of relying on auto-generated keys
2FA requirements for key reveal and revocation add a critical layer of security against unauthorized access
Legacy keys are preserved and functional, so existing integrations are not disrupted
Expiration reminders help prevent unexpected API access disruptions by giving users advance notice
Potential Issues
Users who previously relied on auto-generated API keys will now need to manually create new keys through the UI
Legacy API keys have no expiration date by default; users should review and set expiration dates on legacy keys if appropriate for their security requirements
If a user reaches the 10 active key limit, they must revoke or allow an existing key to expire before creating a new one
Expired and revoked keys cannot be reactivated; users will need to create a new key if access is needed again
FAQs
Q: What happened to my existing API key?
A: Your existing API key has been migrated into the new system as a "Legacy API Key" with Active status. It will continue to work as before until you choose to revoke it.
Q: Can I reactivate an expired or revoked API key?
A: No. Expired and revoked keys are permanently deactivated and preserved for audit purposes only. You will need to create a new API key.
Q: Why do I need 2FA to view or revoke my API key?
A: Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security to protect sensitive actions. This prevents unauthorized users from accessing or disabling your API keys.
Q: What happens when my API key expires?
A: At 12:01 AM on the expiration date, the key status changes to "Expired" and API access is immediately disabled. You will receive reminder emails at 30, 15, 7, and 1 day(s) before expiration.
Q: How many API keys can I have?
A: You can have up to 10 active API keys at a time. Expired and revoked keys do not count toward this limit.
Q: Should I use API keys or OAuth for vendor integrations?
A: OAuth is the recommended and supported method for all vendor integrations (see
HERE (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4405826620571-Lofty-Open-API-and-Developer-Platform)
). API keys are still available but OAuth provides better security and access control.
