#### Article 512: Getting Started with the Lofty Developer Platform

- Article ID: `4405826620571`
- Category: `Developers`
- Section: `Developers`
- Updated: `2026-03-14T00:13:08Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4405826620571-Getting-Started-with-the-Lofty-Developer-Platform

Introduction
The Lofty Developer Platform allows third-party vendors and partners to build integrations with Lofty using OAuth 2.0. This article walks through the full setup process, from creating an account to getting your application approved.
Once your application is approved, see
Lofty OAuth 2.0 API Reference (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/47801571926811)
for implementation details.
Summary
Step 1: Create a Developer Account (#h_01FE288990M81MHFPDBVGE2FSR)
Step 2: Complete Vendor Qualification (#h_01KKMRQSSZX6XYSV6DTDQ1XZW9)
Step 3: Register an Application (#h_01KKMRZD6A0YEZFCNGY7W0V385)
Information Tab (#h_01KKMS5G5C2AAVCY6PVB11G60C)
Permissions Tab (#h_01KKMS5Q3276X24CRNJ42X8QKJ)
Step 4: Wait for Application Review (#h_01KKMS7YFBVZ38JBSARMWD0AEH)
Review Process/Results (#h_01FE29NMBH4YE2X7S0VAAERDP0)
Under Review (#h_01HBH01MASY1N6WKGHTMMZ50CX)
Rejected (#h_01HBH01MAS1GCFNHWW2HTHK2XG)
Approved (#h_01HBH01MAS1AQTD4JQY081FQMB)
Step 1: Create a Developer Account
Go to the Lofty Developer Platform at
https://api.lofty.com/vendor/frontend/static/index.html#/login
Click Sign Up Enter your name, email address, phone number, and a password
A verification code will be sent to your email (valid for 10 minutes).
Enter the code to complete signup. After signing up, you will be taken to the My Qualification page.
Step 2: Complete Vendor Qualification
Before you can register an application, you must complete your vendor qualification. Navigate to the My Qualification tab in the left sidebar and fill out the Account Info form:
Name of Company
Company's Website
Company's Privacy Policy Link
Full Name of Person Completing Assessment
Title of Person Completing Assessment
Email Address
Phone Number
Click Save when finished.
The Save button will gray out and a yellow banner will appear confirming your submission is under review.
After submitting, you can email
t2support@lofty.com (mailto:t2support@lofty.com)
to let the team know your qualification is ready for review.
Please include a screenshot of your Account Info so the team can quickly find your submission.
Your qualification will be reviewed by the Lofty team. You will not be able to register an application until your qualification is approved. You will receive an email when a decision has been made.
Once approved, the My Authorization tab will become active.
Step 3: Register an Application
After your vendor qualification is approved, go to the My Authorization tab and click + Add More Authorizations.
A form will appear with two tabs: Information and Permissions.
Information Tab
App Name
Website
Authorized Redirect URL -- once the application is approved, Lofty will call the URL listed here
Description -- describe what your integration does
App Logo -- must be less than 3MB
Primary Contact Name
Primary Email
Primary Phone Number
Display Connection Option in Lofty -- controls whether your app appears as a connection option for Lofty users
Are you the team creator? -- select Yes or No
Team Creator Account (Email) -- the email address of a Lofty account owner that will be linked to your application for testing
Note
:
To begin building your integration, you are required to link a valid Lofty account to your application. This is specified through the
Team Creator Account
field, which must correspond to the Lofty account you will use to test authentication, token handling, and data synchronization.
The account must belong to a top-level Team Owner.
Submissions using email addresses associated with secondary users (e.g., team members or admins) will fail.
We recommend using a live Lofty account from a mutual customer sponsoring the integration.
This ensures the integration is tested in a real-world environment with appropriate context.
If you are unable to coordinate access through a mutual customer,
please reach out to discuss testing options. While not guaranteed, we may be able to support limited alternatives on a case-by-case basis.
You can repeat this process multiple times if you have multiple applications that you are connecting with Lofty.
Permissions Tab
Only request the permissions your application actually needs. Requesting permissions that do not align with your application's stated purpose may result in your application being rejected.
Click Submit when both tabs are complete.
Step 4: Wait for Application Review
You can monitor your application status in the My Authorization tab.
The table scrolls horizontally. Status and Operation are pinned/static columns on the right, while App, Website, Authorized Redirect URL, Client ID, Client Secret, Description, Primary Contact Info, and API columns scroll
You can update your application while it is under review. However, if you update an application after it has been approved, it will trigger a new review.
You can register multiple applications if you need separate environments (for example, sandbox, staging, and production). Each environment requires its own application with its own callback URL.
If you need to change application details after submission, contact your internal Lofty representative or email
t2support@lofty.com (mailto:support@lofty.com)
.
Review Process/Results
After submitting your application, you will be able to monitor the status via the Lofty Developer Platform. Simply log in access your authorization dashboard and review the
Status
column at the far right.
Under Review
Rejected
If rejected, the primary contact submitted with the application will receive an email with more details on why it was rejected. You can then click the
Resubmit
button to edit the information provided before submitting again.
Approved
If approved, you will see the client_id and client_secret in your account.
You will need this information for the next step
.
client_id
client_secret
Once your application is approved and you have your Client ID and Client Secret, you are ready to implement OAuth 2.0. See
Lofty OAuth 2.0 API Reference (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/47801571926811)
for the full implementation guide.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at support@lofty.com, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat through your Lofty CRM.
Related terms: Open API, Developer Platform, OAuth, API, SOC, Third party assessment

#### Article 513: Lofty OAuth 2.0 API Reference

- Article ID: `47801571926811`
- Category: `Developers`
- Section: `Developers`
- Updated: `2026-03-14T00:11:16Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/47801571926811-Lofty-OAuth-2-0-API-Reference

This article covers the technical implementation of OAuth 2.0 for vendors who have been approved on the Lofty Developer Platform. If you have not yet set up your developer account and registered an application, see
Getting Started with the Lofty Developer Platform. (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4405826620571)
You will need your Client ID and Client Secret from the My Authorization tab of the Developer Platform to proceed.
Summary
How OAuth 2.0 Works (#h_01KKMSZ7A6SZ3MTKDB5RF8FED0)
Step 1: User Authentication (#h_01KKMT148NB6K99QKMRGQ4CA1W)
Step 2: Exchange Authorization Code for Tokens (#h_01KKMTBE728MM7P7F0GXXSKQG5)
Step 3: Make API Calls (#h_01KKMTC1DK686MVKDEW4X9GC3W)
Refresh an Access Token (#h_01KKMTCAR6MHVD9G8QQE42TZ8W)
How It Works for Lofty Users (#h_01KKMTCR8VBWDNCR3G9SKY07FJ)
How OAuth 2.0 Works
OAuth 2.0 allows your application to access Lofty user data without requiring users to share their passwords. The flow works as follows:
Your application redirects the Lofty user to an authorization page.
The user logs in to Lofty and grants permission.
Lofty sends an authorization code to your Redirect URL.
Your server exchanges the code for an access token and refresh token.
You use the access token to call the Lofty API on behalf of the user.
Step 1: User Authentication
Redirect the user to the Lofty authorization page using your Client ID:
https://lofty.com/page/vendor-auth.html?clientId={your_client_id} (https://lofty.com/page/vendor-auth.html?clientId=%7Byour_client_id%7D)
The user will log in to their Lofty account and choose whether to authorize your application.
If the user grants permission, Lofty redirects to your Authorized Redirect URL with an authorization code:
https://yourapp.com/redirect?code=XXXXXXXXXXXXX
If the user denies permission, Lofty redirects with an error:
https://yourapp.com/redirect?error=access_denied
Step 2: Exchange Authorization Code for Tokens
Use the authorization code to request an access token and refresh token.
Endpoint:
POST
https://crm.lofty.com/api/user-web/oauth/token
Request parameters:
Parameter
Type
Description
code
String
The authorization code from the redirect
client_id
String
Your Client ID from the Developer Platform
redirect_uri
String
Your Authorized Redirect URL
grant_type
String
Must be set to authorization_code
Request header:
Header
Value
Authorization
Basic {Base64 of client_id:client_secret}
Content-Type
application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Sample curl:
curl --location '
https://crm.lofty.com/api/user-web/oauth/token?code=XXXXX&client_id=XXXX&redirect_uri=XXXXXX&grant_type=authorization_code
'
--header 'Authorization: Basic {Base64 of client_id:client_secret}'
--header 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
Response fields:
Field
Type
Description
access_token
String
Token used to authorize Lofty API requests
expires_in
int
Remaining lifetime of the access token in seconds
refresh_token
String
Used to obtain a new access token. Valid until the user revokes access or after 180 days.
token_type
String
Always set to Bearer
scope
String
Fixed value: openApi
Step 3: Make API Calls
Once you have an access token, include it in the Authorization header when calling Lofty API endpoints:
Header
Value
Content-Type
application/json
Authorization
Bearer {access_token}
Full endpoint documentation is available at
https://api.lofty.com/docs/index.html
Refresh an Access Token
Access tokens expire periodically. Use the refresh token to obtain a new access token without prompting the user again.
curl --location '
https://crm.lofty.com/api/user-web/oauth/token?refresh_token={your_refresh_token}&grant_type=refresh_token (https://crm.lofty.com/api/user-web/oauth/token?refresh_token=%7Byour_refresh_token%7D&grant_type=refresh_token)
'
--header 'Authorization: Basic {Base64 of client_id:client_secret}'
--header 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
The response fields are the same as the initial token exchange.
How It Works for Lofty Users
Once your application is approved, Lofty users can connect to your app as follows:
The user must be logged in to Lofty in their browser.
The user visits your authorization link:
https://crm.lofty.com/page/vendor-auth.html?clientId={your_client_id} (https://crm.lofty.com/page/vendor-auth.html?clientId=%7Byour_client_id%7D)
The user clicks Authorize to connect your app.
Lofty validates the user's account and your vendor ID, then sends an authorization code to your callback URL (not to the user).
Your server exchanges the code for a bearer token and can then access the user's data via the API.
Vendors cannot pull data from any Lofty user unless the user initiates the integration themselves. The bearer token is issued to the vendor directly. Users can disconnect at any time by clicking Disconnect in their Lofty account.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at support@lofty.com, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat through your Lofty CRM.

Introduction
*Please note that the features available to you on the
Lofty
platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. For any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.
PieSync Integration
Lofty
is excited to announce support for integration with PieSync. PieSync is a powerful platform that allows you to connect
Lofty
to countless other services. For information on how to use this integration, please review the following Help Center article on
Lofty
:

.

#### Article 517: Feature Updates for Chime 3.52

- Article ID: `8104007179035`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T02:11:12Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/8104007179035-Feature-Updates-for-Chime-3-52

Introduction
*Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons you have purchased and the account type you have (admin/agent user). For any questions related to your Chime package or feature availability, please contact Chime Support (
support@chimeinc.com (mailto:support@chimeinc.com)
).
Release Date
Tuesday, August 16th, 2022
Summary
Lender Updates (#h_01GAHCR0C05RRA8AABRS8S061F)
Chime CMA optimizations (#h_01GAHCR9QE9KYQ8QYPD5MGN3K2)
Custom Font (#h_01GAHCRHV0PZBXQS0QA5ED5H17)
Social Studio: Video Post (#h_01GAHCRR77NE0XE9G4CDCFDACQ)
Enterprise Lead Routing & Re-Routing (#id-8/15/22:FeatureReleaseTrainingforChime3.52-EnterpriseLeadRouting&Re-Routing)
Lender Updates
Agent Users Can Invite Lenders to Add Payment Cards
Every user now has the ability to trigger an email to a lender, who has already activated their lender-type Chime account, to invite them to add a payment method on file with Chime to prepare for cost-sharing.
This option will only be available for a lender if they do not already have a payment method on file with Chime.
Also, when inviting a lender for the first time, you can now check the box to have lenders add their payment information as part of the lender-type account creation process as well.
When the lender receives the invite and selects the option to add a payment method, they will be redirected to the Chime platform Billing Center to do so:
Learn More:
Billing Center: Invoice Management (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/search/click?%3D%3D--99fb789ec1003328bc79aafab4b2a4c350b4f4b7)
How to Invite a Lender (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/search/click?%3D%3D--9574a170940d113bda3003746609ffbf960439c0)
Limited Chime Marketplace Added to Lender-Type Accounts
When accessing Chime via a lender-type account, you will now have access to the Chime Marketplace. You will currently only see the following options:
Facebook Dynamic Ads
Google PPC Ads
Facebook Seller Ads
Clicking any of the options in the Chime Marketplace will create an internal ticket for the Chime Ads Team to reach out and provide more details on setting up cost-sharing on a lead generation campaign.
Chime CMA optimizations
User Interface Changes
Next time you access the Chime CMA, you will notice that the creation process has changed slightly. The overall functionality is the same, but the design has changed a bit with this new update.
Here are just a few samples of what the changes will look like, the biggest one being that the CMA steps are now to the left instead of across the top:
CMA Style Redesign
The CMA report style has been improved with this update as well. All the same, pages exist, but they have been cleaned up and made to present better to your leads when you send it to them.
Here is a sample of what these new designs look like:
Web CMA Sample (https://demo.chime.me/cma-report/120932?isPreview=1)
A few notes:
Any
existing
web CMAs will automatically be changed to match the new style
Any
existing
PDF CMAs will not be changed to the new style unless the PDF is regenerated
Learn More:
CMA Tool / Chime CMA (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/search/click?--2955df5c6e34f74eddc24ab77b941ce00658f044)
Custom Font
You can now upload custom fonts to use on your Chime website!
To find this new setting, navigate to
CMS
>
Editor
>
Style
>
Font
:
Use the primary
Font
option to select a font that you would like to use as a global font on your website:
Use the three drop-down menus to get very specific, if you would like to select a specific font in any of these locations and make it different from the rest:
Titles
Paragraphs
Buttons
To upload a custom font you can either hover over the "
?
" icon and select the hyperlink
or
when you are accessing any of the drop-downs on this settings page, click on the
Upload Fonts
button.
Before being able to upload, you must verify that you have the rights and permission necessary to use this font on your website. This is your responsibility to research.
Once you have uploaded custom fonts, they will be available to manage from this same location:
Before deleting a font, make sure that you are not using it anywhere on your website as deleting it could cause display issues. You will be prompted to confirm when deleting.
If you delete a font that is being used, the site will continue to use that font but it will no longer be displayed as an option to use elsewhere.
Any custom fonts that you have uploaded will be available under
My Fonts
:
Custom fonts can also be utilized directly in individual blocks once uploaded.
Social Studio: Video Post
You can now upload videos to your social channels using the Chime Social Studio.
When creating a post, you can only upload a video
or
photos, not both together. Only MP4 format is supported and the file can only be a maximum of 50 MB in size.
To upload a video on a post, simply choose the upload option and then browse for your video:
Learn More:
Social Studio (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/search/click?%3D--e27fc274999e594b63eefcc2209dffc349888129)
Enterprise Lead Routing & Re-Routing
We have optimized Enterprise lead routing to make sure that leads can be distributed within the customizable hierarchy that can exist within Enterprise accounts.
The main setting that has been optimized is found under
Settings
>
Lead Routing
>
New Leads
:
There are three tabs at the top:
Company Owner
Group Owners
All Others
Company Owner
Use these options to customize which leads are routed if they enter in via the Company Owner's integrations or the Company Website:
Group Owners
This is where the most significant changes take place with this release.
*IMPORTANT: Remember that setting changes made here apply to
all groups
on the account.
For all of the available options, you can now select between the following:
Company Routing
. Leads will be routed by Company Scope lead routing rules.
Group Routing
. Leads will be routed by Group Scope lead routing rules.
Advanced Settings
. See below.
For
Advanced Settings
, use this option if you would like to choose company vs. group differently for each of your groups:
All Others
Use this setting to customize whether leads from lead sources integrated by individual users should be routed via lead routing or not.
Leave it unchecked if these leads should just be assigned to the user who has the lead source connected. Check if those leads should also go through lead routing.
Remember, these settings apply to
all
users (other than the Company Owner and Group Owners).
*IMPORTANT
: As a reminder, only users with the
Manage Lead Distribution
permission can edit these settings.
Re-Routing Rule Optimizations
With this update, the display of re-routing rules will now look like this:
Permissions
Only users with the right admin permissions can edit re-routing rules. Prior to this update, anyone could edit re-routing rules.
Team Instances: "Team Features" permission is required.
Enterprise Instances: "Manage Lead Distribution" permission is required.
Those with access to edit lead distribution for "Entire Company" can edit all re-routing rules.
Those limited to editing only for "User's Group" will only be able to edit re-routing rules for their group/subgroups.
Learn More:
Team Permissions (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/search/click?--828db6c786d68791215f71c34c81e661917763fb)
All Distribution Methods
Re-routing now supports both
Round Robin
and
Next Up
. Prior to this release, only
Blast Alert
was supported. Detailed explanations of each of these have been added.
Enterprise Only "Available To" Setting
With Enterprise, an additional option called
Available To
allows you to segment which specific groups inside of the Enterprise hierarchy will have access to each re-routing group that is created.
With this setting, users in the selected groups will be able to see this specific Re-Routing Group as an option when re-routing via a lead's profile. If a user is not part of a selected group, they will not see this as an option to re-route in a lead's profile.
Learn More:
Enterprise Edition - Lead Routing (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/search/click?%3D--9319fa4207734759dacd32a0eae16091923a610c)
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@chimeinc.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Chime CRM.

#### Article 518: Feature Updates for CRM 2.8.6, Site 3.5.0

- Article ID: `360030336891`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T05:18:32Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360030336891-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-2-8-6-Site-3-5-0

Introduction
*Please note that the features available to you on the
Lofty
platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. With any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.
Release Date
The release date for this set of features is July 8th, 2019.
Summary
New Section: Campaigns (#h_0fb815d8-5a4f-4283-a5fb-a37e46ddc9de)
Customization for Vendor / Partner Feature (#h_e03c974a-3e8e-453d-912f-e6e35cc31c36)
Market Report for Subdivisions (#h_6ad819a7-8698-4414-840d-85b8ad584883)
Report Optimization: Source Analysis (#h_08b494c9-ea02-4d74-8d85-b384f6507af7)
Merge Optimization (#h_13dd0b6a-09c4-4cc6-a90e-eb095463f94b)
Export Optimization (#h_7fc5680b-ca1d-4d82-b282-df5cb3c8085f)
Mobile App Feature: Support Adding Unknown Numbers as New Leads (#h_a1c9a6c4-85b3-480f-9b10-e90a599b5e9e)
Live Transfer (#h_c83c05b8-1b7d-4060-9538-2b02507322da)
Landing Page Optimization (#h_38dc027a-8d6d-43be-8010-4334f3da7cd6)
New Section: Campaigns
We have built a brand new section -
Campaigns
in
Lofty
! In this section, you can manage all your lead capture channels available in
Lofty
, including
Lofty
Lead Generation, Landing Pages, and listing promotion tools such as the
Open House
and
Text Code
features. More tools to help you maintain a steady flow of leads will be available in the future.
When you enter this section, there will be a dashboard showing how many new leads are generating in each channel. You can click on the “View More Details” buttons to view the detailed data that feeds into these numbers.
Lofty
Lead Generation
If you purchase lead gen services with
Lofty
, you can view performance and funnel conversion data for your lead gen ads via the
Lead Engine
section. You can also request adjustments to your monthly lead generation budget as well as view and provide your feedback on the specific ads
Lofty
is managing for you.
Landing Pages
In the Landing Pages section, you can create landing pages to capture new leads via your preferred marketing channels. You can also view your landing page performance to evaluate their performance at capturing leads. This feature was previously located in the CMS Tool, but has now been moved to this new
Campaigns
section.
Once again, note that the Landing Page feature will be transferred to the new CRM “Campaigns” section and will no longer appear on the CMS Tool.
Single Property Promotions
Previously, what are known as "Property Promotion" pages were located in the CMS Tool > Settings > Property Promotion. Now, however, these are found as a template available under Landing Pages.
Note that the existing Property Promotion pages will not be affected and can still be accessed under the new
Campaigns
section of the CRM. This is a great change that will allow for you to have some feedback using the Landing Page "Overview" column as well as establish a specific lead source for a property promotion should this be desired.
Add / Edit Landing Page Blocks
Landing Page blocks can now be adjusted and added to other templates. This means that you can customize each landing page more in-depth than what was previously available. In the example below, we could create a landing page via the "Single Property (Promotion)" template, add a new section, and then reorder as necessary. This greatly increases the options available to
Lofty
users for customizing landing pages.
Listing Promotions
You can also access the
Open House
and
Text Code
tools on this
Campaigns
section as well. They
have been moved to this section for better access to all the tools used to generate leads.
Customization for Vendor / Partner Feature
Based on your feedback, we will now allow our users to add custom roles in the Vendor / Partner Feature.
The roles for Vendors / Partners can also be adjusted
after
adding them:
Also, the transactions now support being assigned to different vendors or partners with the same role at the same time. Previously, you could only assign one vendor/partner of the same role per transaction.
Market Report for Subdivisions
A market report can now be set for leads based on subdivision.
Report Optimization: Source Analysis
Have you ever wanted to know how each lead source is performing? You now have a report for that！
Here are some key notes regarding this feature . . .
The Team Owner/Admin and agents who have the “‘Manage Team” permission will have access to this “Source” report under the Marketing section.
Overview Tab: The “Lead Conversion” visuals in Overview show a comparison of the Total Leads and Closed Leads.
Table Tab: This displays a variety of different dimensions being tracked based on lead source.
Key Definitions:
Total Leads: This is the number of leads created in the timeframe selected.
Closed Leads: Leads in the Closed pipeline stage that correspond to the time frame selected.
Valid Leads: Either phone or email is valid
Potential Leads: Leads associated with active transactions (not including Closed and Cancelled), that correspond to the time frame selected
Merge Optimization
Based on this optimization,
Lofty
users can more easily know who has duplicate leads in their database.
A new warning will appear informing the user that “This lead may be a duplicate of [potential duplicate] who already exists in [agent]’s account.”
If the user confirms that the lead is different from the other, they can hide the notification by clicking the 'x' and confirming the dismissal of the duplicate reminder. As a note, two leads with the same email address are still not able to exist in the same database.
Export Optimization
Lofty
now supports the ability to export “property address.”
Lofty
will export the three newest buying property addresses and two newest selling property addresses from the “Properties” section of a lead profile (under Engagement).
Mobile App Feature: Support Adding Unknown Numbers as New Leads
Many clients have provided feedback indicating that it is difficult to add a new lead on the mobile app when an unknown number calls or sends a text to the virtual number. We have optimized the function so that when an unknown number calls the agent, there will be a push notification on the app. With just one click, the agent can add the number as a new lead.
As for the text messages from an unknown number, a text notification will be received (the “Forward Received Texts” option has to be toggled on under
Settings
>
Manage Dialer
) that will provide a clickable link to add a new lead.
Live Transfer
Clients currently on the Enterprise Edition
will now have access to use our Live Transfer feature. This only works on click-to-call functionality (not call lists) and will allow for a phone call to be connected to a third person. Once the call is connected to a third person, the first can leave the call.
Landing Page Optimization
1. Feature will be transferred to the new CRM “Campaigns” section and will no longer appear on the CMS Tool.
2. Landing Page - Optimization of Single Property templates:
Support adding new blocks
Support changing the order of blocks
Change name to Single Property (Standard)
3. Landing Page - New Template
The Property Promotion pages are now under Landing Page templates and the name of “Single Property (Promotion).” This template (and all others besides Multi Property (Grid)) supports the following features:
Add a new block
Change the order of blocks
Note that the existing Property Promotion pages will not be affected and can still be accessed under the new
Campaigns
section of the CRM. If the content needs to be modified, it needs to be modified using the landing page function.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

#### Article 519: Feature Updates for CRM 2.8.8, Site 3.5.2

- Article ID: `360031012091`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T05:18:21Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360031012091-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-2-8-8-Site-3-5-2

Introduction
*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. With any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.
Release Date
The release date for this set of features is July 18th, 2019.
Summary
Inbound Call Forwarding (#h_7e60243c-8811-45e9-b595-122c87eb8a91)
Support Purchasing Call/Text Packages on Teams Under Enterprise Package (#h_2d1639e9-e401-4421-8814-4741733e2cba)
Enterprise / Broker Edition IDX Website (Beta Testing) (#h_429e7fee-d524-4413-ba18-df7143ba9a47)
Team Lead Routing for Enterprise Edition (Beta Testing) (#h_f55f50a1-dd6b-4bb0-a6ba-ed131eeba975)
Bounced Email Timeline Optimization (#h_079cca70-ee2a-4938-bf9a-de5658de2710)
Search Optimization on Mobile Devices (#h_8c55d21b-9d45-410f-86c6-cf418d6630ba)
Landing Page Optimizations (#h_c578e2e3-8d94-42d7-bed9-55511b8e8f23)
More Lead-Related Settings in Landing Pages (#h_7704d498-f193-4eb1-bea0-17f1a116026a)
Inbound Call Forwarding
As a feature that has been requested by many of our users, Lofty now provides a solution for making sure incoming phone calls are not missed! Incoming calls to Lofty virtual numbers will be forwarded to a specific phone number if the agent is not unavailable or does not pick up the phone for a specified time.
Team Owners/Admins can easily apply all the calls to the same phone number (e.g. a company number) by applying the rule to all the team members using the switch at the bottom. Otherwise, this setting is managed by each individual user.
Want to know more？You can refer to this Help Center article:
Inbound Call Forwarding (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360030644952)
.
Support Purchasing Call/Text Packages on Teams Under Enterprise Package
Many Team Admins under Enterprise Accounts have requested the ability to purchase call/text packages in their CRMs. Lofty now supports this feature with this release. They can choose to use their own payment card (if on file via the Support Team or assigned CSM) or the Enterprise Account Admin’s card. If they want to use the Enterprise Account Admin’s card, an email will be sent to the Enterprise Account Admin requesting approval after the Team Admin submits the order. Once the Enterprise Account Admin approves the request via email, the requested call/text packages will be made available to the Team Admin for distribution among agents.
This is a screenshot of what the Team Admin would see when setting up the request to add call/text packages via
Settings
>
Manage Dialer
.
This is an example of the approval request email that the Enterprise Account Admin will receive and has to approve before billing is updated:
Enterprise / Broker Edition IDX Website (Beta Testing)
Lofty clients with the Enterprise Edition now have the ability to beta test a new "Broker" IDX Website which, when leads register, can distribute leads to individual teams. This website must be set up like any other IDX website (requiring MLS data integration, quality review of data, etc.). Here is a glimpse of what it will look like:
Team Lead Routing for Enterprise Edition (Beta Testing)
For clients currently using the Enterprise Edition (Broker Edition), we are releasing a feature for beta testing that allows you to set up lead routing rules to distribute leads from a main Enterprise/Broker IDX website to different teams. Lead routing from this top level website can only be assigned to teams, not individual agents, and is only able to use the "Round Robin" option.
Bounced Email Timeline Optimization
In order to better troubleshoot bounced emails, this update will allow for a more detailed description to be documented in the lead's profile. The bounced reason is defined according to the SMTP code in the bounced notification Lofty receives in our email server. Below are the main types that can be listed:
The email address does not exist
The email server does not exist
Rejected by recipient
Mailbox unavailable
Blocked due to spam content
Connection timed out
Unknown failure
The following is a screenshot of how this will appear (within the red box):
Search Optimization on Mobile Devices
This update provides some improvements on the "Listing" page on the mobile view:
Now you can search the listings by address directly
The filter now displays the number of applied filters
Searches can now be saved on mobile devices now
Landing Page Optimizations
As an additional Landing Page optimization, there are now seven new block types that can be added when adjusting the available content:
Lead Form
Call to Action
Listing Search (Address)
Listing Search (Advanced)
Header (Menu)
Header (Simple)
Footer
Some of the new block types can be adjusted in the following ways:
Lead Form
Users can edit the title, banner, field, and button action of the block in content.
The "
Lead Form" block supports adding the full name field and configuring the button action from one of the below options:
Jump Link: After clicking the button, the page jumps to the corresponding URL.
Thank You Message: After clicking the button, the page pops up the toast popup.
*Lofty will support additional custom fields in future planned releases.
Call to Action
Users can edit the title, banner, button number, and button link of the block content:
The "
Call to Action" block supports configuration for the number of buttons and the link destination of the buttons. However, only a total of three buttons can be added:
Listing Search (Address)
Currently, no content can be configured with this block.
Listing Search (Advanced)
Currently, no content can be configured with this block.
Header (Menu)
Currently, no content can be configured with this block.
Header (Simple)
Users can choose the agent to be displayed on the banner in the top-right.
Footer
Currently, no content can be configured with this block.
In addition, there is now a new option to create a "Blank Template" for Landing Pages so that users can create their own landing page by adding blocks of their choice. A total of 15 blocks can be added per landing page.
All templates also support the customization of URLs when they are created.
All templates also support the configuration of SEO tools including the commonly-used "SEO Cover Photo" which is the image that will appear when the link is shared on social media.
More Lead Related Settings in Landing Page
Lead Type
Users can now select the lead type that is going to come in via the "Lead Generation" type landing pages This is found under Landing Page Editor > Settings > Basic Settings.
Lead Privacy and Assignment
Users can control whether the leads registered on the landing pages are Team Leads or Private Leads. Only users given the "Add Private Leads" permission can choose the option for Private Leads.
You can also choose to Directly Assign leads or do so via Lead Routing rules in the Assignment Method section. If you choose Private Lead in Lead Privacy, you can only choose Directly Assign and the Assignee can only be yourself.
Add Tags and Notes for Leads Registered on Your Landing Pages
With this update, you can choose tags and add notes in Landing Page Settings > Additional Actions. All leads registered on this landing page will have these tags and notes added automatically.
Control Welcome Emails/Texts or not
In Landing Page Settings > Additional Actions, you can also choose whether to send welcome emails/texts to the leads who register via the landing pages.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

Lofty
Paid Lead Tags

from one of our marketing campaigns currently have the Source of “

users will be able to see whether they came from one of the following in addition to that source:

The tags can be added/removed manually if needed
Team Leads
Previously, we used three different terms (Shared Leads, Team Leads, and Public Leads) to refer to the same type of lead privacy in
Lofty
. Everything is now consistent and will be referred to as
“Team Leads”
in the CRM, CMS Tool, and all Help Center documentation.
*No functionality has changed with this update--only the language used.
As a review. . .
A “Team Lead” is any lead that is
not
a Private Lead. Just because it is a “Team Lead” does not mean that anyone can access that lead. Only those (a) listed in the “Assigned To” section of a lead profile or (b) given permission to “Access All Team Leads” can view Team Leads.
(a)
(b)
Mobile App Improvement: Duplicate Leads
Lofty
now supports the ability to more easily merge leads from the mobile app.
When a lead is a duplicate, a message will appear at the top of the lead detail page:
By clicking the “Merge” button, the following options will appear at the bottom of the screen:
Merge as Duplicates
Merge as Family Members
View Lead Detail
Ignore
Listing Discovery
Previously known as
Listing Management
.
Important changes include the following:
1. You can now search for ANY listings from the MLS database, not just new listings that
Lofty
recommended (Open House, Back on Market, Price Reduced, etc.)
2. You can easily save any search criteria you like as a hot sheet. The filters available are the same as those used for website searches and property alerts.
The top three hot sheets will be displayed on the dashboard page:
Landing Page Editors
Lofty
users with the “Manage Team” permission now have the ability to create and edit landing pages on subdomains for other users on the team.
The option to select the landing page site is found here:
Frequency Reduction for
Auto
Property Alerts
In order to improve email deliverability,
auto
property alert email frequency will be adjusted for leads who never open them.
Lofty
will now automatically adjust the frequency of
auto
property alerts by doing the following:
If auto alerts are set to “Daily” or “Instantly” frequencies, auto alerts will be sent out for 30 days daily/instantly per the settings.
If a lead who is set to receive these auto alerts does not open even one alert for 30 days, the frequency will be adjusted for that lead to “Weekly.”
If, after the auto property alert has been adjusted to a “Weekly” (per #2), a lead opens the auto property alert email, the frequency of their emails will revert back to the frequency set up in
Settings
>
Auto Property Alerts
, daily, instantly, etc.
*Note that this only applies to
auto property alerts
. Manual property alerts are not affected.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

Introduction
*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. With any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.
Release Date
The release date for this set of features is Tuesday, September 17, 2019.
Summary
Email Accountability Report (#h_b6b13b16-0da9-49a3-bd37-965a49564aab)
New Opportunity Notifications (#h_01889a2d-49d5-4ac7-a6c5-cd4aabc83c17)
New Message Notifications (#h_407da467-4937-4a76-9d65-b141ab23637d)
Additional Sold Listings Settings (#h_78c116fe-63d4-42fb-8b7a-a8d6b1e7d9c8)

Zapier Improvements (#h_a1165ff7-0598-4b9d-a890-ac3137adcb06)
Email Accountability Report
This new report will be found under
Reporting
>
Email Accountability
.
There are now options to view this report "By Email" and "By Lead." The "Unsubscribed" data can only be calculated based on the number of leads so will be the same whether you are looking at "By Email" or "By Lead."
Filters can also be applied for different time periods (e.g. this month, this quarter, etc.) as well as email type (e.g. property alert, Welcome Email, etc.). The main view is by chart but there is also a table view.
All reports include both Team Leads + Private Leads.
Team Owner/Admin View
The Team Admin/Owner and any users who have the "Manage Team" permission will have the report view for the whole team (see
Team Permissions (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360024023911)
). Three sections will display for these users: Overview / Email Performance / Email Performance by Agent.
Clicking on an a user's name in the "Email Performance by Agent" section will show a report for just that user.
Standard User View
Users without admin privileges will only have access to their data in these two sections: Overview / Email Performance.
Here is an example of what this report will look like:
New Opportunity Notifications
Currently, all Opportunities are outlined here:
Opportunities (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003018292)
. Additional opportunity notifications will be added to this list under the "High Interest" category with this update:
When a lead saves a search on your
Lofty
IDX website
When a lead uses the mortgage calculator 3+ times in one day
With each "Opportunity," a notification will be triggered in the Web App as well as on the Mobile App.
New Message Notifications
The
Lofty
Mobile App already has the notification for a new message being received--but this notification was previously unavailable on the Web App. With this update, when a lead sends either a text message to the
Lofty
virtual number or types a message into the chat box of the website, there will be a web notification as well so that no conversations are missed.
The notification title will vary depending on what type of message is received: "New Text Msg" or "New Chatbox Msg."
If this notification becomes annoying in any way, it can be turned off via the mobile app. Keep in mind that this setting adjusts both the Web App notification as well as the Mobile App notification:
Also, this is what the new message notification looks like on the mobile app:
Additional Sold Listings Settings
Lofty
now allows users to set up additional criteria for Sold Listings displayed on the
Lofty
IDX websites via the listing filters. These new options are available for the "Office" and "Agent" criteria as seen here:
The following are the new options that are opened for clients:
Co-Listing Agent Display
For
Lofty
users who are on teams and want to make sure the listing agent is displayed with their property on their
Lofty
IDX website, this is possible via the CMS Tool. With this update, co-listing agents can also be displayed as well.
To find this setting, access the
CMS Tool
>
Page Editor
>
Property Details
>
Listing Detail Agent
.
If "Yes" is selected here,
Lofty
will review all agent profile settings for their MLS Agent ID and License ID to attempt to match the agent with any active listings displayed on the
Lofty
website. If a match is found, the listing agent and any co-listing agent will be displayed on the listing detail page in the "Schedule a Tour" section as well as the "MLS Info" section.
*IMPORTANT: Please note that the displaying of the listing agent and co-listing agent does
not
affect the actual lead routing of the lead as it comes into the system nor any messages sent, etc. In other words, only the display of the listing/co-listing agent(s) are presented here but any leads that register would
not
be sent to the listing agent unless the lead routing was set up to assign to them.
Zapier Improvements
Lofty
's Zapier integration will continue to improve in future releases. One improvement made in this release is the support for more fields when
Lofty
is the "Trigger." All fields that were available for the "Action" are now on the "Trigger" menu as well. Here are the supported fields for
Lofty
as the "Trigger."

Group

Note

when

is triggering a corresponding action in another app.

#### Article 524: Feature Updates for CRM 2.9.8, Site 3.6.2

- Article ID: `360034145512`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T05:11:53Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360034145512-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-2-9-8-Site-3-6-2

Introduction
*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. For any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.
Release Date
The release date for this set of features is Wednesday, October 9, 2019.
Summary
Team Site and Subdomain Site Lead Login Credentials (#h_21176078-dd23-45c4-9fb2-2d47e24f5c32)
Zip Code/City Setting for Auto Alerts (#h_1aa83720-1117-4d53-9964-30dfc1e5305a)
Add/Edit/Delete Alerts from Mobile App (#h_0a71a7ed-dd56-478b-b31e-1873826772b6)
Team Site and Subdomain Site Lead Login Credentials
With this update, a lead can continue to browse the main website even if they are working with an individual agent who has their own subdomain and all their activity/triggers will go to that individual agent even if they have a subdomain that the lead is not looking at. Prior to this update, the only way for an individual agent to get notifications and records of a lead's website activity would be if (a) the team website was the only website being used or (b) the lead was browsing their individual websites.
If a lead registered on a subdomain website, he/she can now sign in on the main site using the same login credentials.
The only exception to this is with the website chat box. The website chat messages sent will go to the website's owner. If it is the team's website, the chat goes to the main seat on the account (Team Admin/Owner). If a subdomain website, the chat goes to the individual agent whose website it is.
Currently, the lead’s login credentials can be logged in both in main site and its related subdomains in one team. All lead’s activities can be recorded on to lead detail page in CRM and the assigned agent can receive the corresponding notification (except live chat, still sent to the site owner).
Lofty
will work on optimizing this in the future.
Zip Code/City Setting for Auto Alerts
This option will be located under
Settings
>
Features
>
Auto Property Alerts
>
Buyer Property Alert/Seller Property Alert/Auto Market Report
>
Location Criteria.
This update will allow you to set a default location setting for Auto Buyer/Seller Alerts/Market Reports. You can set the auto alert to only trigger based off of the "Inquired City" or "Inquired Zip Code." If you choose "Any," the system will trigger based on both city and zip code.
This information is typically gathered when the lead is imported via email parsing and the city or zip code are provided in the email or, if the lead registered on a
Lofty
website, their activity will be recorded for this purpose.
Add/Edit/Delete Alerts from Mobile App
After many client requests, the
Lofty
Mobile App (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360012545351)
will now allow
Lofty
users to add/edit/delete Buyer/Seller Property Alerts on their mobile phones. The filters available on the mobile app will be synced with the web app meaning if users have specific filters from their MLS set up on the mobile app and
Lofty
website, they will also be available on the mobile app.
Limitations
include the following:
We do not support the option to "plot" an area on a map when using the mobile app
The ability to send individual listings is not supported--only the creation of an alert using the available criteria. This can be done on the web app using Listing Discovery but is not currently available on the mobile app.
Market Reports cannot be created with this feature, only Buyer/Seller Property Alerts
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

#### Article 525: Feature Updates for CRM 3.0.0, Site 3.6.4

- Article ID: `360035298031`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T05:11:36Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360035298031-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-3-0-0-Site-3-6-4

Introduction
*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. For any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.
Release Date
The release date for this set of features is Monday, October 21, 2019.
Summary
Slybroadcast Integration (Web) (#h_c81fd91c-2620-4414-8027-c2eed7f6b0e6)
Undelivered Texts on Lead Profile Timelines (Web & App) (#h_ab9b47d5-6dbe-42b7-af0a-9475422dd1c8)
Landing Page Tag/Note Optimization (Web) (#h_31b468a2-d0b2-43df-9399-9b4e40525165)
Smart Plan Optimizations (4) (Web) (#h_a38119da-b0ba-45ad-b0cb-018419175c30)
MLS Agent ID Search (Web) (#h_342e1a9a-357a-4e82-87ac-c57f96d41724)
Direct Mail Text Code Feature (Print Product Only) (#h_0b2d0c69-cf44-4435-8cf6-156c91dff8d1)
Slybroadcast Integration
Lofty
now integrates directly with Slybroadcast! With this feature, users can send pre-recorded voice messages to leads individually, in batches, or via scheduled Smart Plans ("My Smart Plans" only). Voice messages that are sent will be documented in lead profile timelines.
Specific information on how this integration works can be found
HERE (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360034983832)
.
To subscribe to Slybroadcast, click
HERE (https://www.slybroadcast.com/signup.php?refer=chimeinc)
.
Undelivered Texts on Lead Profile Timelines
The delivery status of texts sent via
Lofty
will now be documented on each lead profile. Here is how it displays:
Also, a new filter is available on the
People Page
that can be used to search for leads where messages have failed to deliver so that an email or phone call can be completed instead:
Landing Page Tag/Note Optimization
When building landing pages via the CMS Tool, the "Lead Generation" template also provides settings to add a note and/or a tag to leads that register via that landing page:
With this update, this feature has been optimized so that tags and notes can also be added to existing leads already in the database if they complete the form again.
Smart Plan Optimizations (4)
(1) Excluding current leads in the database
Previous to this update, whenever "Auto Apply" conditions are set up on a Smart Plan, all
current
leads and
new
leads will BOTH be added to that Smart Plan as long as they match the criteria. With this update, however, the criteria for “whenever leads meet the specified conditions” will now have the following options to select from:
include current applicable leads
exclude current applicable leads
With the second option, all current leads that match the specified conditions can be skipped on this Smart Plan for situations when you have already been working those leads and do not want to start them on a new Smart Plan.
*Should you want to exclude more leads, the criteria can always be edited.
(2) Send
first
auto email/text during a specific time range
This option is available for "Immediately" and "Wait ___ hour(s), ___ minute(s)." When selected, if the Smart Plan is triggered
before
the indicated time range, the auto email/text will be sent at the first available time within that range. If triggered
after
the indicated range, the auto email/text will be sent the following day at the first available time within the range.
(3) Resubscribe leads to Smart Plans if lead has accidentally unsubscribed
To resubscribe for the lead, go to
Lead Profile
>
Smart Plans
> Click on the gear icon at the top right. This switch was previously locked. Now, it can be turned back on to resubscribe the lead to Smart Plans.
(4) New auto email Lead Variables
Lofty
has added two new lead variables to reference buyer-related property addresses in Smart Plan auto emails and auto texts. The new variables are the following:
buyer_inquired_listing_addr
. The address of the property that is associated with the lead's initial inquiry.
trigger_behavior_listing_addr
. The address of the related listing when the Smart Plan is triggered by leads requesting showings, saving listings, or viewing a listing multiple times.
Lead Variables can be found here when building an email template directly in a Smart Plan:
MLS Agent ID Search
Lofty
users can now find their "MLS Agent ID" by searching by listing address or MLS Listing ID. To do this, simply click on the "Need Help?" hyperlink under
Settings
>
User
>
Profile
> to the right of
MLS Agent ID
.  As a reminder, the MLS Agent ID is a requirement for certain features to work including certain Listing Discovery and Transaction Management features as it helps
Lofty
locate
your MLS listings
or
your MLS transactions
.
Direct Mail Text Code Feature (Print Product Only)
A brand new text code feature will be available for clients who have purchased
Lofty
's Direct Mail (or Print) product. For each client,
Lofty
assigns a virtual number and a unique code for each and every postcard that is sent out for geo farming. When homeowners text the text code to the number on the postcards, they will get a home evaluation report immediately. Meanwhile
Lofty
tracks and imports the homeowners’ info into the CRM.
When homeowners call the number on the postcard,
Lofty
will display the lead source on the phone and track and log inbound calls on the CRM.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

#### Article 526: Feature Updates for CRM 3.0.2, Site 3.6.6

- Article ID: `360035748791`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T03:29:42Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360035748791-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-3-0-2-Site-3-6-6

Introduction
*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. For any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.
Release Date
The release date for this set of features is Monday, November 4, 2019.
Summary
Import Reverse Option (#h_159499aa-3246-45ba-824a-a41322b85446)
Add a Lead / Edit a Lead Field Consistency (#h_93ba21d0-f6db-41ff-8724-a1d25cde013a)
Bounced Email Filter (#h_6d84fd80-e38e-4aa4-a506-0e67c1f82ef5)
Market Report Timing Optimization (#h_1d8b0095-461a-4d70-a687-26082a0f2a0b)
Open House Form Creation with MLS Data (#h_e0493e4b-67c3-44d2-8445-f13652e8504a)
Opportunity Notification for Additional Form Submissions (#h_780559de-c859-44f1-9168-ddf051a33f5c)
Transaction Customization (#h_f166e808-105e-4c8a-86d4-5e200d839f36)
Import Reverse Option
When importing leads, there is often a need to reverse the import and remove the leads that were created because the import was done incorrectly, etc.
Lofty
now allows users to reverse their import after one has already been processed
as long as it is within 24 hours of actually importing the leads
. This option is available under
Settings
>
Features
>
Lead Import
>
Import History
.
This will work regardless of whether the leads have been contacted, etc. The option will no longer be available after 24 hours of processing the import. The leads will be deleted completely from the system with this option--meaning they will
not
be sent to the "Deleted Leads" section of the
People
page.
*For merged leads, they will stay in the system just as imported.
Add a Lead / Edit a Lead Field Consistency
Prior to this update, when adding a lead and editing a lead, the options available were different. Now, however, they are the same in both situations in order to stay consistent.
Bounced Email Filter
An additional filter has been added on the
People
page that now allows
Lofty
users to filter their leads by those who have had an email address marked as "bounced." If that email is manually marked as "valid" by the
Lofty
user, it will no longer show up on the filter. This filter only applies to primary email addresses.
The filter option is available under the
People
page and "Contact Info" on the left side:
Market Report Timing Optimization
Lofty
has optimized the schedule that a market report is sent out in order to make sure the data is ready before sending out an email with incomplete information. The market report will now be sent out after the data from the prior month is available--typically on the 5th of each month.
Open House Form Creation with MLS Data
When creating an Open House form via
Lofty
, the details and images of that property can now be auto-populated directly from the MLS. The option to manually upload an image is still available.
*This feature is currently only available on the Web App but will also be an option via the Mobile App in an upcoming release.
Opportunity Notification for Additional Form Submissions
In addition to the Opportunity notifications mentioned in this Help Center article:
Opportunities (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003018292)
,
Lofty
now supports an additional opportunity push and email notification when a current client completes a form on the "Lead Generation" landing page template as well as on the lead form found on neighborhood pages of Templates 1 and 2 (currently not on 3 and 4 because the form disappears for current clients on those templates).
With each of these, a notification will be triggered like the following:
There will also be a note added on the lead profile indicating where the form was filled out on the website:
Transaction Customization
When adding/editing a transaction in
Lofty
, additional debits/credits can now be recorded per transaction. This is where each of them is recorded:
A summary of this information is also viewable on the Transaction Management page as seen here:

#### Article 527: Feature Updates for CRM 3.0.4, Site 3.6.8

- Article ID: `360036238411`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T03:28:27Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360036238411-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-3-0-4-Site-3-6-8

Introduction
*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. For any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.
Release Date
The release date for this set of features is Monday, November 18, 2019.
Summary
Market Snapshot (replaces Seller Alert) (#h_d8d1a4a2-68a1-4ac7-8d2d-173704f25857)
Smart Plan Improvements (#h_142918ea-3855-491f-b1b0-c78c133f0cb9)
Lead Pond Improvements (#h_3c252b9a-d4f9-489e-a5bf-7b2f360cd084)
Market Snapshot (replaces Seller Alert)
Two notable changes have been made with this update:
"Seller Property Alert" is now called "Market Snapshot." All current seller property alerts will be transferred to the "Market Snapshot" section.
Market Report (
by "subdivision" only
) has moved to the Market Snapshot feature. The main reason for this change is a noticeable lack of MLS data for the format of Lofty Market Reports at the subdivision level. In order to provide data for subdivisions, all current subdivision market reports will be transferred to the Market Snapshot feature.
A "Market Snapshot" can be seen as a simplified CMA (competitive market analysis). The fields available when setting up a Market Snapshot are the same as when setting up a Seller Alert previously. In the email received by a lead, listings are categorized by listing stats (sold, pending, etc). A Market Snapshot can also be added for buyer/renter leads.
Here is what the content of this email looks like:
After clicking on any of the "View More" or "Check More Details" buttons for additional information, a lead will be taken to a new Market Snapshot landing page which will display more information for the specific area they are looking at.
If the email is old, the Market Snapshot landing page will still display the newest information
. Here is the what page looks like:
Smart Plan Improvements
Support for Birthday Smart Plans for Family Members
When applying a birthday Smart Plan to a lead, it will be activated on all family members who have a birth date listed on their profile separately. The auto emails and auto texts in each Smart Plan will only be sent to the family member whose birthday it is. The variables in each of the Smart Plans will use the info of the family member whose birthday it is.
Manual Task Reminders
Lofty users can now set up a reminder for each
manual
task in a Smart Plan (with the exception of "Checklist") to remind the assignee of the task. The remainder can be sent via an automated phone call or automatic text message when/before the task is due.
*Please note that a call/text package is required in order for the reminder feature to work as the call/text will be made via the virtual number. If the Smart Plan is a "Team Smart Plan," the reminder call/text will come from the Team Admin/Owner's virtual number. If it is a "My Smart Plan," the reminder call/text will come from that specific user's virtual number.
This will count as call/text package usage
.
A call package (add-on) is required for call reminders
.
You can be reminded by call or text at
one
of the following times:
When the task is created
5 minutes before due
15 minutes before due
1 hour before due
1 day before due
Here is a sample of the content in the text message: "Hi, you have a new task for [lead name] at [task due time]. The task description is [task description]. Check your Lofty CRM for further details."
A sample phone call is attached at the bottom of this article.
Lead Pond Improvements
New Permission
A new permission has been added that allows the Team Owner/Admin of an account to determine who should have access to the lead pond. Access includes putting leads in the lead pond, taking leads out, and viewing leads in the lead pond. This setting is located under
Settings
>
Team
>
Agent
>
Agent Permissions
.
Clear Assignees
An additional setting has been added to those who have access to the lead pond settings (users with the "Team Management" permission). This setting will allow for an option to be selected to clear all "Assigned To" roles (except the lender role) when a lead is assigned to the lead pond. This setting is located under
Settings
>
Features
>
Lead Pond
.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

#### Article 528: Feature Updates for CRM 3.0.5, Site 3.6.9

- Article ID: `360036440852`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T03:28:16Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360036440852-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-3-0-5-Site-3-6-9

Introduction
*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. For any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.
Release Date
The release date for this set of features is Monday, December 2, 2019.
Summary
Lofty AI Assistant (#h_dc7d16ee-3281-4e49-bb5a-a8abeaf9ec6a)
SkySlope Integration (#h_4aa1a4a5-322f-4a41-a712-9fdce1a84d14)
Ability to Edit Notes (#h_6844f1aa-4075-45ac-95ee-e18f0fa360fe)
Partial Lead Permission (#h_c2d54330-6a26-449f-9b06-8f94d8b06b48)
User Activity Log (#h_c1cbdd02-0dc8-493b-a511-633b10471c7a)
AI Assistant
*The AI Assistant is an add-on feature and is not combined into any of the CRM/IDX package pricing.
Lofty
is proud to announce that we have developed a built-in AI Assistant to support you by responding to and engaging leads both from your
Lofty
IDX website (via website chat) and from other lead sources (via text message). This AI Assistant will benefit your real estate business in the following ways:
Shortening the time to first response and on a 24/7 schedule.
New leads and website visitors will be engaged by the AI Assistant via website chat and text message within one minute--drastically reducing the chance of losing a lead to a competitor when you aren’t available.
Help you focus on the most valuable leads first. The AI
Assistant takes over the task of qualifying new leads so that you will be notified when there are serious leads ready to engage. The AI Assistant will also update lead preferences based on their responses to improve long-term nurturing. Leads with the wrong number or who are not interested will also be tagged as such.
The AI Assistant can be set up by navigating to
Settings
>
Features
>
AI Assistant
. This section will guide you through the options to set up the
Lofty
AI Assistant.
For more information on how to add the
Lofty
AI Assistant, please refer to this Help Center article:
How to Add the AI Assistant / Chatbot to your Account (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037245571)
. More details on how it is used can be found here:
Lofty
AI Assistant / Chatbot (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360036957691)
.
SkySlope Integration
Lofty
now has an integration with
SkySlope (https://skyslope.com/)
for Transaction Management. Currently,
Lofty
supports
exporting
transactions to SkySlope, and additional features will be considered as they are made available in the SkySlope API. For more information on how the SkySlope integration works, please reference the following article:
How to Integrate SkySlope with Lofty (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360036580712)
.
Ability to Edit Notes
Users can now edit notes that were made on a lead profile and are available on the timeline. There will be an "Edit" icon to the right of the note. Only the note portion of the logs can be edited. The notes can be edited by anyone with access to the lead even if they did not make the note. Editing notes will not change the timestamp of the note.
Partial Lead Permission
A new permission has been added under
Settings
>
Team
>
Agent
>
Agent Permissions
>
Partial Lead Conversion
.
This permission will limit the users who can use the paid-for service to convert partial leads by searching for data associated with an address. Only those who are given this permission can convert the leads and charge the $0.30/partial lead conversion to the Team Owner/Admin's card on file.
Those without this permission can still convert a lead by manually adding information, etc.
User Activity Log
Users with the "Manage Team" permission (see
Team Permissions (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360024023911)
) can view a "Last Active" activity of team users under
Settings
>
Team
>
Agent
>
Agent List
. In this context, "Last Active" means the user's last operation time on
Lofty
when they opened a page or clicked a button in the CRM or mobile app. The system can only find data from two months ago. If users have not been active within the last two months, the "Last Active" section will be blank.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

#### Article 529: Feature Updates for CRM 3.0.6, Site 3.7.0

- Article ID: `360037452992`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T03:27:26Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037452992-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-3-0-6-Site-3-7-0

Introduction
*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. For any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.
Release Date
The release date for this set of features is Tuesday, December 17, 2019.
Summary
Completely Erasing Leads via Lead Profile (#h_81e705ab-8f40-49ca-9916-113d56641d05)
Company Information to Display in Automated Signatures (#h_dd28f83a-2757-4070-83c3-b7a818beaa6f)
Customize Property Alert Names and Subjects (#h_0b65128e-96a3-40ff-afd2-048fa5a28227)
AI Assistant Smart Plans (#h_62b4b343-e875-47b6-92d5-8202d74ef0e4)
Unique Agent Addresses Configuration via CMS Tool (#h_e3c33d1a-71db-4b72-95c6-7914413fdbb3)
Completely Erasing Leads via Lead Profile
Prior to this release, erasing leads was only accessible via the "Deleted Leads" section of the
People
page. Now, there is an option available directly on the lead profile for a lead that might have already been deleted. As a reminder, a lead that is "deleted" is sent to a recycle bin (Deleted Leads) and must then be erased before completely leaving the system.
If there is a specific lead that needs to be erased but is hard to find because of how long ago it was deleted, deleted leads will now show up when searched in the search bar at the top of the
Lofty
CRM. They can then be easily selected to navigate to their lead profile where the new "Erase" option is available.
Company Information to Display in Automated Signatures
For all automated emails that include a pre-built signature from
Lofty
, the signature will now include the Company Name from
Settings
>
Profile
. If left blank, it will not appear. Automated emails include Welcome Emails, Property Alerts, Market Snapshots, and Market Reports.
Customize Property Alert Names and Subjects
Lofty
users can now name each property alert and define a customized subject. This is a useful way to keep things organized as well as reference specific searches in discussions with clients to improve property alert open rates. For the subject, custom variables can be included. If not customized, it will continue to use the template found under
Settings
>
Email Templates
>
Automated Emails
.
Additional improvements in this area are on the roadmap including the ability to synchronize lead/client saved searches with
Lofty
user-created property alerts so agents and their clients can be on the same page with their searches.
AI Assistant Smart Plans
With this new release, the initial conversion power of the AI Assistant can be better combined with the benefits of
Lofty
Smart Plans for continuous conversations and lead nurturing. A described in the functionality of the AI Assistant (see
Lofty
AI Assistant / Chatbot (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360036957691)
), the AI Assistant will tag leads according to certain conversation patterns. These same tags will be used as triggers for pre-built Smart Plans.
A new notification will appear when accessing Smart Plans to show you how to configure and add these to your library:
After selecting the option to "Configure," the following are the options presented:
Additional prompts will also be available on the AI Assistant settings page that allow for the easy addition of new templates if they are added in the future.
Also, when importing AI Assistant Smart Plans, there is an additional "Auto Pause" trigger that can pause all other Smart Plans for leads when one of these plans is applied.
More information on the
Lofty
AI Assistant can be found here:
How to Add the AI Assistant / Chatbot to your Account (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037245571)
.
Unique Agent Addresses Configuration via CMS Tool
Users with access to edit team websites can now add a unique address for each individual agent in case it is different from the team address. An additional field is now available under
CMS Tool
>
Settings
>
Basic Info
>
Agent
>
Edit
.
After selecting
Edit
, here is the new field:
This will then display on their agent profile on the team website:
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

#### Article 530: Feature Updates for CRM 3.0.7, Site 3.7.1

- Article ID: `360038288051`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T03:27:18Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038288051-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-3-0-7-Site-3-7-1

Introduction
*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. For any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.
Release Date
The release date for this set of features is Monday, December 30, 2019.
Summary
Additional Insight Using Lead Phone Numbers (#h_51eb4597-ea2b-4886-9ac5-7b90154e81e1)
Additional Lead Import Fields (#h_43a78b88-efe4-4aba-905f-54c65a82e921)
Optimization to "Unsubscribe" (#h_deb5037f-05bf-4338-9b00-3067061bdf31)
Additional Insight Using Lead Phone Numbers
Lofty will now use a new API improvement to detect the number type when new leads enter the system from the Website, Zillow, Zapier, Open House, or Email Parsing (other sources). This integration will determine whether the number is a landline as well as whether the number is valid. Because this API improvement will not always be 100% accurate, users can still mark numbers as "Bad Numbers" to manually void that number.
There will also be a warning that displays when an invalid or landline number is selected. This will display on both the web app and the mobile app:
For mass text messages, the system will exclude the leads with invalid phone numbers.
For any auto texts scheduled in Smart Plans, the system will skip the texts if the lead’s number is marked as invalid or is a landline number.
For leads that are coming from Zapier/Zillow (no other sources), this new integration will work to detect the lead’s name as well (if unknown).
Lofty
will then update the lead’s name. There will be a system log left on the lead's timeline indicating what happened as an explanation to all users:
Additional Lead Import Fields
The lead import process has been improved to allow for the following:
1. Three buyer properties
2. Two seller properties
3. Four family members
Users can now click on the "+" button to add an extra set of data for those fields. Clicking on the "-" button will clear the fields.
For more general information regarding lead import, please reference
Import your Leads to Lofty (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001710831)
.
Optimization to "Unsubscribe"
Lofty
has now made the "unsubscribe" process more intuitive from a lead's perspective which is important when interacting with new prospective clients. When a lead clicks on the "Unsubscribe" button at the bottom of an email, it will unsubscribe from ALL Lofty-sent emails (those sent by the
@lofty.me (mailto:____@chime.me)
email address), not just that one.
*Currently, the "Welcome Email" is not supported in this request from a lead to unsubscribe but will be supported in the future.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.
