Site 5.29 (#id-12/23/21:FeatureReleaseTrainingforCRM3.41,Site5.29-Site5.29)
Personal Disclaimer (#id-12/23/21:FeatureReleaseTrainingforCRM3.41,Site5.29-PersonalDisclaimer)
Home Valuation Block Optimization (#id-12/23/21:FeatureReleaseTrainingforCRM3.41,Site5.29-HomeValuationBlockOptimization)
Buyer CMA (#h_01FR1GZRDVC1AVKDGPVDSMQP47)
Smart Listing Entrances (#h_01FR1H1QR9119DKRM9XXQJNYFX)
Guide Block (#h_01FR1H27ADXDF3JGGDSSD396YY)
CRM 3.41
AI Assistant Changes
New Package
A new AI Assistant package has been added. Similar to the
Premium AI
, the new
Enterprise AI
can work extra leads above and beyond the package limit for an additional cost. The only difference with
Enterprise AI
is that it includes additional coverage for engaged leads. This package is
not
limited to the Enterprise edition of our platform, users from all our packages can purchase.
New Engagement Triggers
The AI Assistant can now engage more effectively with
existing leads
in more scenarios. If a lead is marked "Back to Site" the welcome message will now include listings that they might be interested in. The AI Assistant will send a link so that they can see those listings. These recommendations are based on the lead's Search Criteria.
Learn More:
Adding the AI Assistant / Chatbot (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360040286211)
AI Assistant / Chatbot Billing (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360040286211)
AI Assistant / Chatbot Qualification Process (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360056783971)
Transaction Checklist Template Improvements
We have made some additional improvements to Checklist Templates so you can add more information:
Task Title
Task Description
Multiple Lines
Attachment (added as a link)
Require Attachment to Complete?
Assign To
Due Date
Learn More:
Transaction Management Checklists (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057001712)
Lead Timeline Optimization
In this release, every change made to a lead profile (i.e. name change, phone number change, new address, family members, etc.) will be recorded with the BEFORE and the AFTER clearly documented in the timeline. Also, these system-made logs will not be able to be deleted in order to provide a better audit within the system.
Learn More:
Lead Profile Page (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055290591)
Duplicate Leads Optimization
We now have a duplicate lead logic built in for our Multi-Team and Enterprise Accounts. This allows for duplicate lead emails to existing on our larger platforms.
Learn More:
Enabling Duplicate Leads (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4414013347995)
Duplicate Leads + Merging Duplicates (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360054872172)
Team Permissions (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360055290451)
Enterprise Edition - Permissions (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/4407530443291)
Zapier Integration: Mailing Address Support
The
Zapier Integration (https://zapier.com/apps/chime/integrations)
for
Lofty
can now support using a lead's mailing address.
Learn More:
Zapier Integration (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360054865532)
Smart Plans Improvements
We have made improvements to our smart plans technically and visually.
Auto Trigger Searching Optimizations
When configuring the auto application criteria for a Smart Plan, you can now
search
for pipeline stages, segments, or sources. Searching was already supported for tags. These are typically long lists so being able to search makes it easier to utilize.
(One example of using Pipelines, a similar Search field has been added to Segments and Sources)
Auto Trigger for "No Segment"
When configuring the auto application criteria for a Smart Plan, you can now choose "No Segment" as part of that criteria. This would be useful if you want to auto-apply a Smart Plan to leads that have NO SEGMENT at all.
New Action UI (User Interface)
The user interface for selecting a step action when creating a Smart Plan has been improved.
Learn More:
Smart Plans (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360054749892)
Enterprise Package Optimizations
We have made changes to our Enterprise package regarding managing Agent Permissions. The Company Owner or Company Admins have access to change a new setting that is specific to each group. This setting allows for the Group Owners/Admins to manage users as follows:
Invite new agents to their group or sub-groups
Delete agents from their group or sub-groups
Move agents within their group or sub-groups
Update existing agent information for agents within their group or sub-groups
This setting is located under
Settings
>
Organization Hierarchy
>
Select/add a group
>
Allow Group Owner & Group Admins to manage users in their group and all subgroups
.
Learn More:
Enterprise Edition - Permissions (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/4407530443291)
Lead Gen Optimizations
We have made some improvements to better assist you with your lead generation campaigns that are being run within
Lofty
.
Results Metrics
When accessing an active
Lofty
lead gen campaign, two new details have been added. Both of these have been added because the ads budget is also spent on retargeting ads and it is important to be able to measure the results of that spend.
Re-Engaged Leads
. The number of re-registered leads via remarketing ads.
CPR (Cost Per Re-Engagement)
. This equals the
Retargeting Ad Spend
÷ Retargeting Ads Landing Page Views. *NOTE* This feature is only available to
Lofty
users who purchased lead retargeting.
Re-Registered Lead Tagging
When a lead re-registers via
Lofty
marketing channels, we will tag that lead with one of the following depending on where they re-registered.
Re-registered (
Lofty
Paid-Google)
Re-registered (
Lofty
Paid-FB)
Re-registered (
Lofty
Paid-FB Form)
Re-registered (
Lofty
Listing Ads)
Re-registered (
Lofty
Postcards)
Re-registered (GeoFarm)
Default UTM Settings
Lofty
has supported the ability to capture UTM information for some time now. However, the settings for
utm_campaign
and
utm_content
to be captured as tags have been
disabled
by default. With this update, these will be
enabled
by default for all new
and
existing users. For more information on UTM Settings, please see
Lead Source Logic (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360041252272)
.
Learn More:
Lofty Lead Generation FAQ (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360037126792)
Lead Source Logic (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360041252272)
Site 5.29
Personal Disclaimer
Certain clients need to add a disclaimer to their websites specific to their state/MLS. For example, clients in Texas have to add a specific disclaimer. Now, users with Agent Subdomains can now add their own
Personal Disclaimer
that will display on their Agent Subdomain.
To add, navigate to
CMS
>
Settings
>
Team Info
>
Agents
>
Edit
>
Personal Disclaimer
:
Learn More:
Personal Disclaimer (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4413545419675)
Home Valuation Block Optimization
The Home Valuation Block has a new setting that allows for a specific agent's profile to be displayed.
Learn More:
Home Evaluation Block (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037923112)
Buyer CMA
A new CMA template has been created specifically for home buyers. The Buyer CMA has no additional content. Some of the existing pages have simply been tweaked to reflect the perspective of a buyer.
There are multiple locations to access a Buyer CMA:
Listing Discovery
Click on the new icon that has been added for Buyer CMA. When creating a CMA from this option, the property details for that property will be auto-filled as best as possible.
Lead Detail/Profile
In the
Properties
section of a lead profile, a new icon is available. When creating a CMA from this option, the property details for that property will be auto-filled if associated with an active MLS listing.
Campaigns > CMA
Just like when you create a CMA from scratch for a seller, you can also choose to create it for a buyer and choose that template.
Learn More:
CMA Tool (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408440387099)
Smart Listing Entrances
The Smart Listing (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4410497918107)
feature was released to all users in a previous release. With this update, we have added additional ways for our clients to access the Smart Listing Tool:
Dashboard
The
Listing Analysis
card has been replaced with the
Smart Listings
card instead. Most of the CTAs/buttons are the same, but more actionable steps are now provided to our users.
Listing Promotion Detail Page
If running a listing promotion via
Lofty
(see
Listing Promotions (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360055820611)
), the
Engaged
section will display suggestions that take the user to the Smart Listing page to use
Lofty
-built tools to capture more leads and promote listings.
Learn More:
My Vs. Team Dashboards (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360043278391?flash_digest=21060c8114a29d74201ce2cf0958aae6b34b90cd)
Guide Block
We have added a new block to the CMS called
Guide Block
. This block was designed as a way to capture additional leads that might be interested in getting access to download a home buying/selling guide if they submit their information in the form. It can be used for many other purposes as well–essentially allowing for the download of a file after the form submission.
Here is where you will find the
Guide
option in the "Block Library." There is only one style.
The title, description, background color, preview images, etc. can be edited to reflect whatever it is you want the site visitors to download.
More importantly, you can choose the file you want to have downloaded automatically.
You can pick from two built-in options within the "
Lofty
Library," or you can upload your own PDF.
When a lead fills out the form fields (which can be customized) and then submits their information, they will see a confirmation message (also customizable) and the file will download automatically.
Learn More:
Guide Block (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4414017421211)
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your
Lofty
CRM.

#### Article 561: Feature Updates for CRM 3.42, Site 5.30

- Article ID: `4415114034075`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T02:58:20Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4415114034075-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-3-42-Site-5-30

Introduction
*Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/agent user). For any questions related to your Lofty package or feature availability, please contact Lofty Support (
support@lofty.com (mailto:support@chimeinc.com)
).
Release Date
Friday, January 14, 2022.
Summary
CRM 3.42 (#h_01FSAQNCJVC8QT2EP7MF9EF6FV)
Group Company Numbers (#id-1/13/22:FeatureReleaseTrainingforCRM3.42,Site5.30-GroupCompanyNumbers)

Site 5.30 (#h_01FSAQNHGTPDH3D8RWBKMANPPH)
CMA Optimizations (#id-1/13/22:FeatureReleaseTrainingforCRM3.42,Site5.30,Finance2.09-CMAOptimizations)
Listing Discovery Optimizations (#id-1/13/22:FeatureReleaseTrainingforCRM3.42,Site5.30,Finance2.09-ListingDiscoveryOptimizations)

Smart Listings Optimization (#id-1/13/22:FeatureReleaseTrainingforCRM3.42,Site5.30,Finance2.09-SmartListingsOptimization)
CRM 3.42
Group Company Numbers
The Company Owner (no other roles at this point in time) can buy and assign Company Numbers (see
Company Number (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360059630312)
) to groups within their Enterprise organization. The cost is $27/month/company number.
To purchase, navigate to
Settings
>
Company Number
>
Buy New Company Number
:
Only
one
Company Number can be assigned to each group.
*IMPORTANT
: This feature is only available for the Enterprise package. As a reminder, a Company Number is simply a virtual number within the Lofty platform. In order to use the Company Number, individual users must have a call/text package associated with their seat.
Learn More:
Company Number (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360059630312)
Dialer Improvements
The following improvements have been made to the dialer functionality within Lofty.
Smart Call List Overdue Tasks Filter
The Overdue Scheduled Tasks
call list is generated automatically based on tasks that were labeled as a "call" type but were not marked as complete.
Those call tasks will then be added to this
Overdue Scheduled Tasks
Smart Call List.
An additional option has been added when editing the dialer settings (
Dialer Panel
>
Settings
>
Smart Call Lists
) that allows a new filter to existing and allows for overdue call tasks to be generated from the last 30, 60, 180, or all overdue tasks regardless of how long ago they were created.
*IMPORTANT
: Only a total of 150 will be part of this list–this will be the most recent 150. If the call list is finished, however, any overdue call tasks that are from before will be added to the list for the next time assuming the "All" option has been selected in the setting.
Call List Dialing Preference
One of the options available in the Dialer Settings (
Dialer Panel
>
Settings
>
Call List Dialing Preference
) called "Dial all of a lead's phone numbers" allows for the call list to dial all of a lead's phone numbers tied to their profile. One problem with this, however, was that if a lead answered the phone call or the call hit a voice message (which is recognized as the call is answered), the system would not continue dialing the other numbers.
With this update, you will be able to choose to continue calling other numbers by manually clicking on
Next Number
and choosing the number. If you would like to proceed with the next lead, click the
Finished
/
Next Lead
button instead.
Incoming Call + Auto-Lead Record Opening
Previously, when an incoming call would be received in Lofty, the current page would automatically jump to the lead's record which would lead to current work/notes in progress being lost. With this update, no page will auto-load and you must click on the lead's name in the top-right in order to navigate to their lead record which allows you to save any work before proceeding.
Learn More:
Smart Call Lists (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000314911)
Call List (Standard) (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000305252)
AI Assistant: Lead Profile Interaction Improvements
We have made improvements on seeing how the AI Assistant interacts with a lead, also we have now set the AI Assistant to have their own role. This will make it easier to mute the AI when needed.
AI Assistant Banner
When a lead is being worked on based on their specific behavior (saving listings, saving searches, requesting more information, etc.), the banner at the top of the lead profile will display the specific trigger context and what the AI Assistant is attempting to do next. Note: This same information will be presented if you hover over the new AI Assistant role. Clicking on the link within the banner will open up the most recent conversations that the AI has had or attempted to have with the lead.
Unmute Functionality
With this update, you can now
unmute
the AI Assistant. Previously, this was not possible. This means that if you would like the AI Assistant to engage with the lead again based on their existing lead behavior criteria, you can unmute the AI Assistant so that it will do so.
On the
Assigned To
section of a lead profile:
On the
Quick Action
menu within a lead profile:
Use AI's Virtual Number
A feature that has been requested for some time is the ability to respond as the AI Assistant in order to hand off the conversation. This is now supported! However, keep in mind that it should be used with exactly that purpose–to hand off the conversation and not to continue with an extended conversation.
*IMPORTANT
: Only 10 texts/day sent from the AI Assistant's virtual number is included at no extra price. Any additional messages will be $0.01/text.
Enable the AI Assistant for EXISTING LEAD qualification via text message
The AI Assistant will follow up with existing leads when they match any of the following conditions. During the conversation, the AI Assistant works to complete the lead’s info and will notify the assigned agent of the result.
Opens property alert emails but has not clicked properties/links in the emails.
Returns to the IDX website with incomplete search criteria.
Returns to the IDX website and makes a request that triggers an opportunity.
The lead profile has no "location" recorded in the search criteria (preventing auto alerts from being sent).
No site activity for 12 and then 28 consecutive days since the last time they were marked as "High Interest."
Saves a search on the IDX website
Views five different properties in a 24-hour period
Is marked as "Back to Site."
Learn More:
AI Assistant / Chatbot Qualification Process (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056783971)
Site 5.30
CMA Optimizations
The following improvements have been made to the
Lofty
CMA (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/4408440387099-CMA-Tool)
to make it more accessible.
The
Action
column has been split so that a separate
Report View
column is now more accessible. The "Online" and "PDF" options are easy to find in order to access the CMA.
A new
Incomplete
tag has been added to any CMA that has been started but the setup was not complete.
Clicking/hovering on the client's name will appear with their phone and email which can be clicked to email/text directly from this page. Clicking
View Details
redirects to the lead profile.
A label has been added depending on whether it is a
Buyer CMA
or
Seller CMA
as well.
Additional CMA Entrances
The following entrances have been added to the Lofty platform and give users quick access to the Lofty CMA Tool.
Matched Leads Pop-Up
When accessing "Matched Leads"
on
Listing Discovery
, you can select
one
lead, and then a "CMA" button is available to create a CMA for that specific property. This is only available when
one
lead is selected because a CMA is intended for an individual only.
Listing Discovery > Select One Listing
When selecting
one
listing on the
Listing Discovery
page, an action to "Create CMA" will be available for that listing. This is not available for multiple listings for obvious reasons.
Learn More:
CMA Tool / Lofty CMA (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408440387099)
Listing Discovery Optimizations
Matched Leads Pop-Up Window
The matched leads pop-up window now has different options based on the following categories:
All
Engaged
Leads that have viewed, registered on, saved, or left a message on a property
Requested
Leads that have requested a showing
Recommended
Recommended matches based on lead search criteria
A new
Engaged Type
column has been added to provide specific context on how the lead engaged with the property in question.
Learn More:
Listings Pages (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402568813723)
Desktop Photo Gallery Support
We have now optimized IDX Website's photo gallery views to be similar to the changes from mobile photo gallery views.
Smart Listings Optimization
We have made some additional optimizations for easier access to Smart Listing features.
No hover is required. Simply click on the
Manage Listing
button to access the detail page.
The actions
and
stats (with the exception of views) can be clicked to directly access that information or feature.
The statistics (with the exception of views) and buyer matches are now clickable.
Learn More:
Smart Listings (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4410497918107)
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

).

Friday, January 27, 2022.

CRM 3.43
Design Center Improvements
The following improvements have been made to the
Lofty
Design Center.
Brand Kit
Under
Campaigns
>
Design Center
, we have added a new page called
Brand Kit
. This page is intended for
Lofty
users to keep their company brand details and profile accessible in one place. Updates to these fields will automatically be implemented on all new template designs within the Design Center template gallery.  When new designs are added to the template gallery the images and information that matches what is in the
Brand Kit
will be added to the design automatically.
* Note: the logo can only be edited in the CMS tool.
Zero Edit Feature
This feature allows the
Lofty
user to select qualifying designs (currently only those that are listing-related) from within the template gallery, select listings from the MLS, and the property information will automatically be added to the design.
A pop-up window like the following will appear. Because this specific postcard depends on listing data and images to be added to utilize it, you can simply search for an address in the fields on the right side. In this scenario, there are four property spots on the card which is why you see  fields for "Property One" through "Property Four":
After searching for and adding the addresses, simply click on the
Refresh Your Design
button and you will see the preview at the left automatically update:
Once you have finished the "Zero Edit" process, you have the following options:
Download
. Use this to download your design to use elsewhere.
Advanced Edit
. Click here to go into the
Lofty
Design Center to customize every aspect of your design.
Send Mail
. This will take you through the process of sending postcards/letters via
Lofty.
Send Text.
This will take you through the text box to share your listings through the SMS option.
Learn More:
Design Center (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055290711)
Offer Management
We have improved the functionality of this newer feature.
When the Listing Agent (
Lofty
User) receives a new offer, they will receive a notification.
Transaction detail timeline logs will now reflect incoming offers.
Customizable notifications are now available for the
New Offer Alert
(see screenshot below)
Learn More:
Offer Management (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4412776507163)
Transaction Management: History Tab Improvements
The following improvements have been made within the
History
tab of the transaction detail page. This page typically reflects the changes associated with that transaction.
Notes
Users can now leave notes directly on the transaction detail page. This is a feature that has been requested for quite some time now by our users who have wanted to leave notes associated with a specific transaction instead of with the entire lead. Just like on the lead detail page, a note can be edited, pinned to the top, or deleted if necessary.
Also, we have created a "Quick Note" icon at the top-right of the transaction detail page. When clicked, it allows for a note to be added without having to navigate to the
History
page first.
History Filters
Within the
History
tab of a transaction detail page, you can now filter by all of the following (and a combination of any of them):
All
Notes
Tasks
Documents
Offers
System Logs (transaction edits, transaction owner changes, contact assignments, etc.)
Learn More:
Transaction Management Introduction (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057572991)
Site 5.31
CMA Optimizations
CMA Identity Verification
With this update, we have optimized the following:
Our system will recognize the
Lofty
user's log-in cookies via the browser so that when CMA reports are viewed, it will not trigger as a notification event even when logged in as a lead.
If a lead is logged into a
Lofty
-built IDX website and clicks on a CMA link intended for someone else, they will see a pop-up message informing them that the link is private and they do not have access to view it.
This optimization was done due to false-positive page reading views on CMA reports.
Learn More:
CMA Tool / Lofty CMA (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408440387099)
Domain/SSL Auto-Configuration
With this update, users who own their own domain and want to configure that domain to be tied to their
Lofty
IDX website can easily configure their own domains. This is specifically for users who select the option to
Use Your Own Domain
when setting up their website.
Learn More:
Domain Configuration Guide (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360054554712)
Listing Discovery Optimizations - Map Support
We now have a map feature for the following
Listing Discovery
pages. The functionality is the same as within a property alert or on one of our IDX websites–it allows for polygon searching, etc.
All Listings
Team Listings
Hot sheets (all)
Please note that it is not available for the My Listings page as that page utilizes the
Smart Listings (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4410497918107)
feature.
The map feature can be toggled off/on with the switch at the top of the page. If map criteria have been added (drawing on the map, etc.), switching the map view to off will keep the criteria input even though the page is now in list format.
Learn More:
Listing Discovery – All Listings & Hot Sheets (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002361751)
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your
Lofty
CRM.

#### Article 563: Feature Updates for CRM 3.44, Site 5.32

- Article ID: `4431034115867`

Introduction
*Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/agent user). Summary
3.44 (#h_01FWD6GQNV5B9TJ8NAW43KBBVA)

3.44
Tasks Calendar View
IMPORTANT:
This specific feature will be released later in the week. The current release estimate is February 28, 2022. Please check back here for more details upon release.
All
Lofty
-based
tasks and appointments can now be displayed on a calendar view within the CRM. Please note that this does not synchronize other calendar events from any integrated calendars at this point in time.
The calendar will show the Task and Appointment, but also the birthday of a lead.
In the top left corner, people with manage user permission can switch to view the calendars of other team members.
Learn More:
Task and Appointments (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/sections/360003073632-Tasks-and-Appointments)
Search by Notes
Another exciting feature added to
Lofty
in this release is the ability to search notes on lead profiles or transaction detail pages. Notes oftentimes contain valuable information that needs to be resurfaced later and with this feature, you can now do so.
The searching is done using the search bar located at the top of the
Lofty
platform (for leads and lead profile notes) or on the search bar within the
Transaction Management
page (for leads and transaction notes):
The following types of notes can be searched:
Manual Notes (including those made for calls, emails, texts)
System Logs
When searching there are now two tabs at the top for
People
&
Note
, or
Transaction
&
Note
:
The previous logic for searching leads has been optimized with this release as well:
Exact matches are prioritized above "fuzzy" matches
If exact/fuzzy matches are calculated equally, the most recent lead (based on registration date/time) will be displayed first on the list
If the search performed matches multiple results within a specific lead or transaction, that lead or transaction will be displayed multiple times on the search results. A summary of the search will be be displayed directly under the lead/transaction's name:
You can hover for a few seconds over the note content to see an expanded view:
Clicking on a specific result will find that specific note within the lead or transaction for easy access:
Transaction Management: Document Management Improvements
A basic improvement has been made to the
Documents
section of a transaction record. This makes documents easier to add, organize, and access. The following improvements have been made here:
(a) Folders are now listed in their own column down the middle and files are to the right.
(b) Documents can now be added to a transaction by dragging and dropping the document to the folder. This was previously not supported.
(c) Multiple files can be uploaded to a transaction at one time. Previously, each file had to be uploaded individually.
Learn More:
Lead Profile Page (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055290591)
Transaction Management Documents (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360061195871)
Design Center: Email & Text
Lofty
Designs
Designs made in the
Lofty
Design Center
can now be sent directly via a variety of locations in the
Lofty
itself.
Quick Edit Pop-Up
Design Center
Click on the three dots in the top-right corner and then choose to share via text or email:
All Image Insert Image Buttons
Anywhere in the platform where you can insert an image into a text or email (see examples in screenshots below), a new window will appear allowing you to choose your designs from the Design Center.
*NOTE:
When sending an image in a text, only one image can be added per text currently which means that only the first page of any design will be added to the text.
Images will automatically be compressed to fit the delivery method being utilized
Designs can, of course, be uploaded directly in this step to the text/email, and a checkbox is available to add that design to saved folders in the Design Center for future use if needed.
Learn More:
Design Center (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055290711)

CMS

Settings

Chat Mode
selected, the options below will populate specifically for that chat mode. This limits confusion for settings that do not apply to the chat mode being used. Facebook Messenger, for example, simply has one field now.

Choose Chat Agent

CRM 3.45
Transaction Management: Task Assignee Optimization
Oftentimes, when a task is generated by a
Transaction Checklist (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360057001712)
that is supposed to be assigned to a specific custom role, there is no one assigned to that custom role for the transaction. By default, that transaction task is assigned to the
transaction owner
. This update will make it easier to assign those tasks to the right person. Anyone that has access to see the transaction can change the contacts–not just the transaction owner.
Here is what has been updated:
#
Scenario
New Logic
1
A transaction task has unfinished tasks triggered by a checklist
Per the checklist, the tasks were originally supposed to be assigned to a custom role, not the Transaction Owner
The
transaction owner
is assigning a contact to the custom role
The
transaction owner
can choose to assign the unfinished tasks to the contact being added to the custom role.
2
Tasks have been generated by a checklist and they are
not
marked as complete
The
transaction owner
is removing a contact from a custom role
The
transaction owner
will see a prompt informing them that there are unfinished tasks. If they proceed, these tasks will be assigned to the
transaction owner
.
3
Tasks have been generated by a checklist and they are
not
marked as complete
The
transaction owner
is changing the contact currently assigned to a custom role
The
transaction owner
will be able to choose from two different options in this scenario:
(1) Assign the unfinished tasks to the new contact being added to the custom role
(2) Assign the unfinished tasks to the
transaction owner
Sending Email Address Setting
See
Sending Email Address (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/4402367904397)
for more information on the sending email address. This update gives account admins access to change the sending email address. This setting is available on all packages.
The following have access to control this setting:
Team Packages
Team Owner
Those with the "Manage User" permissions
Enterprise Packages
Company Owner
Group Owners/Admins who have been given access to manage their own groups/subgroups
When adding an agent user to the account or editing their agent profile, those with edit access can set the email
prefix
and
domain
for their sending email address.
The domain can be changed according to the following logic:
Team Packages
Can choose between the following
two
options:
Team Website Domain
@lofty.house
Multi-Team Packages
Can choose between the following
two
options:
Multi-Team Website Domain
Team Website Domain
@lofty.house
Enterprise Packages
Can choose between the following
two options
:
Company Website Domain (default only when doing CSV import)
Group Website Domain (default)
@lofty.house
These admins can also choose to give individual agent users on their account access to edit their own sending email addresses.
If the individual user has access, they will be able to edit this under
Settings
>
Preferences
>
Sending Email
.
Mobile App QR Codes
QR codes for the iOS and Android Lofty mobile apps are now visible under the
?
icon in the top-right of the CRM.
When hovering over either iOS or Android, the QR code for that platform will be enlarged:
Zapier "New Lead Created" Trigger Options
A new setting has been added to the Zapier integration:
Here is what the two options mean:
The option to trigger as a New Lead in Zapier "Before & after lead routing" means that when a lead enters the CRM, it will trigger the New Lead event twice: (1) when the lead first enters the system, it will be triggered for the user whose account brought the lead into the
Lofty
platform and (2) when the lead has finished going through lead routing, it will be triggered for the final assignee if they have a Zap set up.
This option is what was live by default for all users prior to this update.
Users with Zapier integrations already configured will continue to have this option selected by default to avoid causing issues. It can be manually changed if desired.
Alternatively, choose "After lead routing is finalized" to only have the Zap trigger after lead routing has been finalized.
This will be the default option for new Zapier integrations that are configured.
This setting only applies to leads where the user configuring the Zapier integration is the primary owner of the lead.
Design Center: Brand Kit Logo Syncing
This update to the Design Center allows for the logo to be changed (previously not supported).
*IMPORTANT
: If the logo is changed here, it will also change on the associated
Lofty
-built website.
Site 5.33
Social Studio: Official Release & Updates
Official Release
All users can now access the basic version of the
Lofty
Social Studio (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/4416954832795-Social-Studio-Beta-)
under
Campaigns
>
Social Studio
:
Updates
The following updates have been made to the
Social Studio (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/4416954832795)
tool
(1) Post Detail Pages
Each post has a post detail page that will look similar to the one below. The engagement data is only available from Instagram and Facebook.
(2) Blog Posting
Users can now select a blog post from their blog written on
Lofty
and share this to social media.
*IMPORTANT:
Only clients using the
Lofty
Blog Editor (see
here (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360039336851)
) can post via Social Studio. WordPress blog users will not have this option.
Only blog posts that have been published will be available to post via Social Studio
When posting a blog or a landing page, the preview/social images will
not
currently generate because the shortened URL is used. This will be optimized in the future.
Only one blog post can be posted at a time
The source for leads captured here will be "Social Studio"
Select the post that you want to share on social media. Only one post can be selected.
The social post will automatically have the blog post link embedded.
There will be new CTAs visible on the blog post options list to post directly from there to social media as well:
(3) Landing Page Posting
Users can now post a landing page directly via Social Studio.
*IMPORTANT:
When posting a blog or a landing page, the preview/social images will
not
currently generate because the shortened URL is used. This will be optimized in the future.
The source for leads captured here will be "Social Studio"
Search for and select the landing page that you want to post to social media.
The landing page URL will be added to the social post automatically.
Also, when clicking the
Share
button from the landing page list, you will now be directed to the Social Studio to post to social media:
Office Listing Filter Optimization
When having your listings filtered by office listings, another option is now available: Filter by User MLS Agent IDs.
Filter by. . .
MLS Office ID
Individual MLS Agent IDs that are part of your
Lofty
instance
CMA Tool: New Pages
The
Lofty
CMA (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/4408440387099-CMA-Tool)
has had three new pages added.
These two pages have been added to the seller template by default:
This page has been added to the buyer template by default:
Smart Listings: Sold Listings Supported
A new toggle has been added to
Listing Discovery
>
My Listings
to
Show Sold Listings
. Previously, sold listings were not recorded.
Please note the following:
Sold pocket listings will be displayed
Sold listing data will depend on the MLS sold feed. If that feed only displays sold listings during a certain time period, that same time period will be reflected with this feature.
The listings related to the
Lofty
user as either the
listing agent
or the
co-listing agent
will be displayed when the
Show Sold Listings
toggle is turned on.
The "Sold" Smart Listing pages will look similar to the active Smart Listing pages with the exception of the matched buyer list that is normally in the top-right not being visible. Campaign details/statistics for any tools utilized when the listing was active will be shown, but tools such as property promotions, open house tools, and text codes will not be active as they are not designed for sold listings.
Home Valuation Improvements
After a site visitor provides their information and triggers the home valuation results page, they will see the following improvements after this update:
(1) A new CTA to "Request a Comparative Market Analysis" has been added to this page.
(2) A new "Nearby Homes" section will be displayed showing nearby properties in the same price range and general location.
AI Assistant: Manual Triggers and Recommendations
This feature was previously released as part of a closed beta but is now live for all users with the AI Assistant.
Please see all details at
AI Assistant: Manual Triggers and Recommendations (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/4505323926683)
.
AI Assistant: Improved Cool-down Period
If the AI Assistant qualification process of a lead has finished but a lead continues to have activity on the
Lofty-built
website, the AI Assistant will not text the lead immediately. Instead, it will have a 24-hour cool-down period in order to not be too aggressive. For manual AI triggers, if users choose a specific objective for the AI, there is no cool-down period.

Introduction
*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. For any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.
Release Date
The release date for this set of features is Thursday, July 9, 2020.
Summary
CRM
Lead Import Reversal Timeframe Extension (#h_01EC8FTM1YXQPDESWX4FM37AEM)
New Team Admin/Owner Lead Privacy Option (#h_01EC8G514P5SSMWMKE80A1PVHS)
Transaction Management Improvements (#h_01EC8HHA9CS3JQS5Z78Q9MPNN1)

Lead Import Reversal Timeframe Extension
This update extends the timeframe in which a CSV lead import can be reversed from 24 hours to
three days
. More information on how this feature works can be found here:
Lead Import: Reverse Option (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360001710831#h_159499aa-3246-45ba-824a-a41322b85446)
.
New Team Admin/Owner Lead Privacy Option
The Team Admin/Owner can now change a lead from a team lead to a private lead without only being able to assign that lead to themselves. Prior to this update, if the Team Admin/Owner adjusted the lead privacy from team lead to private lead, the lead would be made private but assigned to them only. With this update, the lead will remain assigned to the person listed in the primary "Agent" slot in the "Assigned To" section.
This process can only be done one lead at a time, there is
currently
no option to do this in mass.
After changing the team lead to a private lead, the Team Admin/Owner will no longer have access to see that lead. For more information on lead privacy, see
Lead Privacy: Team Leads vs. Private Leads (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003544406)
.
Transaction Management Improvements
The following are the improvements that have been made to Lofty Transaction Management. For more information on how to use Transaction Management, please reference
Transaction Management (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003837652)
.
1.
General Appearance Change
. The overall appearance of the Transaction Management page has been changed slightly. Below are examples of the OLD and the updated version so you can see where things have moved.

OLD
:
NEW
:

OLD
:
NEW
:

OLD
:
NEW
:

. When adding a transaction in Lofty, you can now choose the option for "Lease" as a transaction type:

.
For each transaction type, the default stages are the following:
PURCHASE
LISTING
LEASE
OTHER
Pre-Contract
Under Contract
Pending
Closed

Pre-Listing

Under Contract

A few important notes regarding transaction stages:
The above stages are built-in, but you can rename/remove all of them besides "Closed" and "Cancelled" which are required
In addition to "Closed" and "Cancelled," you are able to create up to 15 stages in total for each individual transaction type
To edit the transaction stages,
click on the gear icon on the far-right side
>
select "Customize Transaction Stages
." You can then add new stages, delete/rename the ones you do not want, and drag/drop to reorder.
If you add additional stages so that it cannot fit on the screen, you will need to scroll to the sides using these buttons:
4. Additional Built-In Date Fields.
Previously, the only available date field for transactions was for "Expected Close" (or "Closed Date" if the status was closed). Now, however, the following fields are now available when adding/editing a transaction:
Each of these new date fields has a new column on the summary below that can be used to sort the transactions. Currently, no report or additional filtering can be done with these date fields, though future improvements will allow for these date fields to be connected to other features in Lofty.
Quick Search Block View Pattern Setting
*Only available on the New CMS
When adding Quick Search Links (see
Quick Search Block (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038293131)
), users can now select a specific "View Pattern" for each link. This will adjust how a lead views the listing pages when they click that specific quick search link,
not
how the quick search link displays.
Pocket Listings and Manual Address Support
*Only available on the New CMS
This update to the pocket listings feature allows for the input of an address
without
having to select from the populated suggestions. This is a field that appears when creating or editing a pocket listing via the New
CMS Tool
>
Filters
>
Pocket Listings
. This should auto-parse into the following format: [street address], [city], [state] [zip code] using the commas and spaces. We still recommend choosing from the address suggestions if available.
Renter Lead Identification
*Only available on the New CMS
Lofty now has the ability to automatically mark the lead type as "Renter" for new leads who register on rental listings on the IDX website.

Introduction
*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. For any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.
Release Date
The release date for this set of features is Thursday, July 23, 2020.
Summary
CRM
Facebook Integration Optimization (#h_01EDPPR65W8F13SBJGRV0T2E20)
Site (New CMS Only)
Search Bar Location Logic Optimization (#h_01EDPPRAQDG7EZ5N2ZMBK30WF1)
Search Bar Location Type Options (#h_01EDPPRJ424Z5NFRQZJN2BA9RB)
Facebook Integration Optimization
The process to connect your Facebook Ads to the
Lofty
CRM has now been optimized to more clearly outline the steps and to confirm that the appropriate access has been given to
Lofty
in order to receive the leads. A series of steps will now guide you through the process and system checks are in place to monitor the connection to confirm it is working.
Additional instructions are also given on how to connect additional fields and their data into
Lofty
.
To learn more about setting up the integration, please reference the following:
Facebook Lead Form Ads + Lofty Integration (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360046675051)
.
Search Bar Location Logic Optimization
*Only available on the New CMS
Lofty
has optimized our Search Bar to force the site visitors to choose from the provided suggestions in order to better narrow down their searches. This means that if a site visitor simply presses "Enter" on the keyboard or clicks the "Search" icon on the website, it will use the first suggestion as the default input value. When combined with the additional setting to determine what displays at the top (see
below (#h_01EDPPRJ424Z5NFRQZJN2BA9RB)
), this will increase the accuracy of listings shown when searching.
There are two ways to search listings via the Search Bar.
Exact Search
. If you choose one of the provided suggestions from the drop-down menu, the search will show listings based on the category chosen (city, zip code, etc.).
Fuzzy Search
. If you type in a value and press the “Enter” button on the keyboard or click the "Search" icon, listings will be shown without category restrictions (city, zip code, etc.).
With this update, there is now an option to switch between the two options in the
new
CMS Tool
>
Settings
>
Listings
>
Location Search Bar
:
Search Bar Location Type Options
*Only available on the New CMS
With this update, there is a new setting to customize what categories (city, neighborhood, zip code) appear when a site visitor uses the search bar on your
Lofty
IDX website.
The new setting is located under
CMS Tool
>
Settings
>
Listings
>
Location Search Bar
. With these settings you can do the following:
Hide/Display
Reorder (determines which one displays first, second, etc.)
Rename
Questions?

Dashboard Announcement Board

he new section appears directly below the "Today's Hot Listings" section on the Dashboard. For more information on how this new feature can be used, see

Microsoft Teams Incoming Webhook Connection
+
If you have a Microsoft Teams account, you can set up some initial connections by adding webhooks in Lofty. The webhooks need to be set up in Microsoft Teams first and then connected to Lofty.
To learn how to set up Microsoft Teams using Incoming Webhooks, please reference the following article:
Microsoft Teams Incoming Webhook Connection (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360046697572)
.
Currently, the webhook integration supports the following actions:
Share a Lead to Microsoft Teams (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360046697572#h_01EEGPDA5AANGANKCN9QHPJHBJ)
Share an Announcement to Microsoft Teams (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360046697572#h_01EEGPDDWTR5F1JDK9E1R1YGGB)
Resume System-Paused Smart Plans
With the release of this new feature, the Team Owner/Admin (no one else on the team) can now restart multiple Smart Plans that were paused
by the system
for a variety of reason in the last 30 days. More information on this feature is outlined in the following section:
If the system has auto-paused Smart Plans, is there a way to restart them? (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/115004827286#h_01EEY2EBT90HHXJSM7KCFJP1ZY)
.
Add to Group Option When Removing an Agent
As the Team Owner/Admin, you are the one responsible for adding/removing agent users from your team. When an agent is removed, this new feature allows for the leads who belong to that agent to be added to a specific GROUP in Lofty so that they can be easily located, redistributed, etc.
The group must have already been created
in order for it to populate on the list when removing the agent.
You will see this option appear when you go to remove an agent from your team:
Facebook Lead Form Integration: Import Info to Search Criteria
The Facebook Lead Form Integration now supports sending additional information from the Facebook Form to Lofty. When you create a lead form on Facebook, it might be built around a specific listing or market area and it would be a good idea to bring that information into Lofty to apply towards lead routing, auto property alerts, etc.
For more information on how to set this up, please reference the following:
How do I add search criteria using the Facebook lead form (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360046675051#h_01EEY36A9KN2W928FZ8BCMTD3Q)
?
Also, for your information, we have included an additional section that is related to the Facebook Lead Form Integration:
How do I set it up so that leads that register on Facebook lead forms do not have to sign up on my site after being sent there? (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360046675051#FeatureUpdatesforCRM3.7.0andSite4.12-HowdoIsetitupsothatleadsthatregisteronFacebookleadformsdonothavetosignuponmysiteafterbeingsentthere?)
.
Multiple Small Smart Plan Optimizations
(1) You can now start creating a new Smart Plan by double-clicking the "Standard Plan" option under
Settings
>
Features
>
Smart Plans
:
(2) When changing between task types (Auto Email, Auto Text, Call, etc.) in a Smart Plan, the system will now remember the content for each type if it was already added. Prior to this, the content would be lost when the task type was changed. Now, you can go back if you added something but wanted to see what another task type looked like.
(3) The default trigger time for the first step is "Immediately," but now the default trigger time for the next steps that are added will be "Wait 1 day(s)":
Form Block Auto-Tagging
*Only available on the New CMS
The Form Block (see
Form Block (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037923192)
) now has a new setting for adding tags to any leads who register via that form. This can be used to easily find the right leads post-registration on the
People
page but it is also extremely useful when triggering very specific Smart Plans (see
Smart Plans (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115004827286)
). All existing tags will be populated (see
Lead Organization with Tags (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038603951)
), but a new tag can also be added here as well.
Here is what that new feature looks like when editing a form block on the website using the New CMS:
When a tag is added, it will be available on a lead profile. Here is a sample tag called "form tag":
Note that this feature also works for existing leads. If an existing lead fills out the form on the website that has been edited to include tags, those tags will be added to the existing lead's profile.
Market Snapshot Page & Block
*Only available on the New CMS
A new "Market Snapshot" page and block template is now available to use on the New CMS. You can use this page/block to show local market trends and all related (sold) listings. In addition, site visitors can change the search criteria depending on what they are looking for which is a valuable way for them to compare local market results from different areas. This is especially useful for seller leads.
For more information on how the page and block can be set up and used, please reference the following articles:
Market Snapshot Page (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360046759392)
Market Snapshot Block (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047194971)
Along with this change, note that the "Market Snapshot" emails will be optimized
in an upcoming release
so that leads that receive these emails will be redirected to these pages when clicking on links. Currently, the Market Snapshot emails that are sent out (see
Property Alerts & Market Snapshots (Lead Engagement) (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/217764483)
) will have links that, when clicked, will go to the old Market Snapshot pages that are only accessible via the emails.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

#### Article 568: Feature Updates for CRM 3.8.0 and Site 4.13

- Article ID: `360047671172`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T03:22:21Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047671172-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-3-8-0-and-Site-4-13

Introduction
*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. For any questions related to your package, please contact our Support Team or your assigned Customer Success Manager for more information.
Release Date
The release date for this set of features is Wednesday, August 19, 2020.
Summary
CRM
AI Assistant: "Assigned Agent" Control (#h_01EFZ8WQT9RXXA1BZ0GMNDVFEH)
Smart Plan Last Modified Timestamp (#h_01EFZAN1FS208GZS7R5FEDDBPY)
Site (New CMS Only)
Market Snapshot Email (#h_01EFZAN74GKR1Y5WCA55C6QFZS)
Multiple Logos (#h_01EFZANBE8D2RAYJDKBYMTQ0YP)
Listing Map Optimization for Mobile Devices (#h_01EFZANGD5KGXKZQWJASKXHMM1)
AI Assistant: "Assigned Agent" Control
In this release, users who have purchased the AI Assistant can control whether or not the AI Assistant will work leads depending on who they are assigned to. If you do not want the AI Assistant to follow up on leads assigned to a specific agent, you can now deselect them on the drop-down list under the AI Assistant settings. This option is available for both NEW incoming leads and EXISTING leads as well:
Smart Plan Last Modified Timestamp
A new timestamp has been added under the "Plan Name" of each Smart Plan in both
My Smart Plans
and
Team Smart Plans
. The timestamp simply records the last modified date/time. Currently, you
cannot
sort by the last modified time.
Market Snapshot Email
*Only available on the New CMS
As mentioned in the previous release (see
Feature Updates for CRM 3.7.0 and Site 4.12: Market Snapshot Page & Block (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360046692712-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-3-7-0-and-Site-4-12#h_01EEGP29J0MD8CQ7E9Z6EMTX5Y)
), the Market Snapshot Email will now send any buyer/seller who clicks the blue "See More Details" button to the updated Market Snapshot page where it will populate the data based on the email they were looking at.
If clients have old market snapshot emails, those links will still go to old market snapshot pages that will display the data in the old format. The pages will not be dead.
Multiple Logos
*Only available on the New CMS
When using the CMS Tool to edit your website header, you now have the option to add a second logo. Simply double-click the header block and then scroll down to the "Logo2" section of the settings on the left where you can now add an additional logo. You can also customize the alt text, logo size, and even link when clicked. Note that you can only add one extra logo on the main website (via the Home page settings -
Header (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037923212)
), but you can add individual logos on any landing pages that are built (see
Landing Pages (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038228552)
).
Listing Map Optimization for Mobile Devices
*Only available on the New CMS
The map search pattern that displays when browsing your site listings on a mobile device has been optimized. It is now easier to zoom in on the map and the interaction with the map itself is more intuitive. Site visitors can also see where the properties are on the map more clearly. They can find the area they want to look and then click the "Search This Area" button to search that specific zone. Overall, the user interface is now more clear and buyers can find the location they are looking for and access the available tools (draw, schools, satellite view, etc.) more quickly.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

#### Article 569: Feature Updates for CRM 3.9.0 and Site 4.14

- Article ID: `360049022151`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T03:20:40Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360049022151-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-3-9-0-and-Site-4-14

Introduction
*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. For any questions related to your package, please contact our Support Team or your assigned Customer Success Manager for more information.
Release Date
All features in this update are scheduled for release on Wednesday, September 2, 2020 with the exception of "Improved Mobile Navigation for Listings" which is scheduled for Friday, September 4, 2020.
Summary
Menu Layout Change (#h_01EH5NZFTAZ0YF2EYTW5C7XKVM)
New Transaction Detail Page (#id-(INTERNAL)FeatureUpdatesforCRM3.9.0andSite4.14-NewTransactionDetailPage)
Transaction Checklists (#id-(INTERNAL)FeatureUpdatesforCRM3.9.0andSite4.14-TransactionChecklists)
Support for Searching Listings by Full Listing Address ( Original & New CMS ） (#id-(INTERNAL)FeatureUpdatesforCRM3.9.0andSite4.14-SupportforSearchingListingsbyFullListingAddress)
Improved Mobile Navigation for Listings ( New CMS Only ) (#id-(INTERNAL)FeatureUpdatesforCRM3.9.0andSite4.14-ImprovedMobileNavigationforListings)
Form Block Button Action Optimization ( New CMS Only ) (#id-(INTERNAL)FeatureUpdatesforCRM3.9.0andSite4.14-FormBlockButtonActionOptimization)
Landing Page Registration Rules Optimization ( New CMS Only ) (#id-(INTERNAL)FeatureUpdatesforCRM3.9.0andSite4.14-LandingPageRegistrationRulesOptimization)
Menu Layout Change
A quick change that is worth pointing out is that the layout of the main navigation menu has changed. The available options on the menu have
not
changed, but their order has been adjusted in order to provide more structured access to the most-used features on the platform.
Previous layout:
Updated layout:
New Transaction Detail Page
A new Transaction Detail Page has been built as the central location for upcoming Transaction Management improvements.
The transaction name is displayed directly at the top along with the transaction owner and the associated lead:
The transaction stages at the top are clickable to move the transaction through the transaction pipeline:
You can easily edit, delete, or send to an integrated platform (Brokermint, etc.) using the options at the top-right:
The available tabs in the main section include the following:
Checklists
. See below. This is a new feature with this release.
Accounting
. Includes the numbers of the transaction.
Vendors/Partners
. See
How to Assign a Vendor/Partner to a Transaction (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360004792091-How-to-Assign-a-Vendor-Partner-to-a-Transaction)
.
History
. Displays a log of all changes/actions to this specific transaction.
Transaction Checklists
Along with the redesign to the Transaction Detail Page, a new Transaction Checklist feature can be used to create tasks that are triggered at each stage of the transaction. This is done by creating templates that can then be applied to a transaction. These templates can only be edited by the Team Owner/Admin or those on the team who have the "Manage Team" permission (see
Team Permissions (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360024023911-Team-Permission)
).
For more information on this new feature, please reference the following Help Center article:
Transaction Management Checklists (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360048531872)
.
Support for Searching Listings by Full Listing Address
*Available on Original & New CMS
An improvement has been made to the buyer searching experience on your Lofty IDX website. Previously, searching for a specific address would not produce viable results. With this release, we have now made it possible to search a specific address without the obstacles that previously existed. If a visitor to your site has a specific address in mind that they want to find, they can easily use the search bar to find it:
Improved Mobile Navigation for Listings
*Only available on New CMS
With this release, visitors to the mobile version of your site will be able to more easily navigate between listing detail pages and the original list the were viewing. With the “down” arrow, visitors can go back to the property list (including map view and grid view), and they can use the "PREV" and "NEXT" buttons to go back and forth on the list.
Also, in order to better capture lead information, common actions be leads are presented/pinned to the bottom of the screen:
Form Block Button Action Optimization
*Only available on New CMS
Due to restrictions by some browsers (including Safari), an additional configuration has been added to the Form Block (see
Form Block (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360037923192)
) that will confirm the redirect prior to sending the site visitor to another page. Existing forms will have this functionality applied to them.
This is where the new settings are located when editing any form block:
When the "Toast" option is selected, it will not redirect the user and instead will display a pop-up with the wording that you choose:
When the "Destination URL" option is selected, there are a couple more options. You will choose the "Thank You Message" as well as the button description for the redirect option, and then you will select a destination URL. Leaving it with the "/" will send the user to the
Home
page when clicked.
The new option to "Turn on to Preview the Button Action" will show what the action will look like when the form is submitted. For example:
Landing Page Registration Rules Optimization
*Only available on New CMS
Landing page registration settings have been improved to make the transition to a redirected page work more smoothly. With this improvement, the registration rules of the landing pages will take effect on both the landing page and the pages after it redirects. This will allow users to better control the registration pop-up on this transition.
*IMPORTANT
: Please note that if you plan to test the registration rules (which is always a good idea), be aware that having the main IDX website and a landing page open at the same time and in the same browsing session, etc. will likely cause a conflict. Be sure to test using a new incognito window each time you test or be sure to clear the browser cache and cookies.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com> or by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557.

#### Article 570: Feature Updates for CRM Version 2.3.0

- Article ID: `115002771172`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T05:32:35Z`

Key Takeaways in Version 2.3.0
• Property Alert & Market Report Subscription Control (Web)
• New Duplicate Detection Function (Web)
• Improved Look for App Lead List(App)
• Task Management V2.0 (Web)
• New Smart Plans Features V2.0 (Web)
• Smart Plans (Web & App) - Open for all users
• Lender Assignment (Web & App)
• Dotloop Integration (Web)
• Task and Appointment page redesign  (App)
• New Showing Request page(App)
• New Dashboard (Web)
• Optimization of Open House (Web & App)
• Notification types added (Web & App)
•
Ticket submission direct from CRM  (Web)
Property Alert & Market Report Subscription Control (Web)
In a lead’s profile page, now users can disable/enable a lead’s subscriptions to Property Alert & Market Reports.
New Duplicate Detection Function (Web)
When a new lead is being created or users are viewing a lead’s profile, the system will detect if this lead is a possible duplicate.
Improved Look for App Lead List (App)
Leads’ pipeline and groups are shown on the lead list.
Task Management V2.0 (Web)
In the updated Task Management, admin users can notify team members to follow up with tasks. After clicking the
Notify Agent
button, the assignee will receive a notification in their
Lofty
CRM.
Smart Plans (Web & App) - Open for all users
Smart Plan feature will be open for all users.
• In the Settings page, you will find Smart Plans;
• In the lead details page, you can add smart plans and our smart suggestions feature to intelligently choose the best fit plans for your leads;
• In the people listing page, you are able to mass add smart plans.
Smart Plans V2.0 (Web)
You are able to assign tasks in Smart Plans to different roles, namely Agent and Assistant. When the task is assigned to an assistant, the task will go to the agent if the lead doesn’t have an assistant.
Also, you are able to edit all tasks from smart plans even after they have been generated. For auto emails and auto texts, you can edit the descriptions and scheduled time.
Lender Assignment (Web & App)
In this updated version, team members can assign another lender to their leads. This way, they can choose a lender they want to co-work with, and it’s time-saving for admin users.  All users are able to mass assign leads to a lender in the People Listing Page.
Dotloop Integration (Web & App)
Lofty
’s integration with Dotloop enables you to close deals faster. You can export leads to Dotloop and create a loop.
In the Settings>Integrations page, you will find Dotloop Integration available to connect.
After you connected with Dotloop, open a lead details page, and then you will notice the
Export
icon at the top.
After clicking, a pop-up window will appear. A lead’s full name, lead role, and email will be populated if the information is available.
After filling in the required fields and clicking C
reate
, you can find “View in Dotloop” in transaction module on the left corner. You will be directed to the loop in Dotloop.
Tasks and Appointments page redesign  (App)
We integrate task and appointment into one page with week/month view  calendar.
1.Agent filter
2.Week/month view  calendar selector
3.Weekly-view calendar with task/appointment quantity reminder
4.Tasks and appointment  filter
5.Optimization of list UI
6.New task edit entrance.
New smart month calendar with task/and appointment number reminder which can be changed along with the chosen filter combination.
Optimization of empty status.
Add new task/appointment by clicking the
plus sign icon
on the top right side of the page.
Fast return to current month by clicking the corresponding screen header.
New Showing request page (App)
1.New showing request will show when there's at least one showing request for the agent.
2.Optimization of the appointment and task UI
3.After clicking appointments or tasks, both go to "tasks and appointments" page, but with different default filter settings.
A new individual display page for showing request.
New Dashboard (Web)
We have finished a new design for
Lofty
Dashboard.
• Four kinds of data are displayed at the top of the Dashboard:
1. The number of Today’s New Leads (also with a Not Contact lead number)
2. The number of Today’s Opportunities (also with a number of leads with a lead score>70 among today’s opportunities)
3. The number of Incomplete Tasks (also with the number of tasks today and overdue tasks)
4.Business Goal process (same as the Business Goal by Volume in Reporting)
Team admins can see the entire team data when changing the dashboard to Team dashboard, members can only see their own data.
•
Get Started: For new users, a Get Started tutorial will guide them through
Lofty
basic settings.
•
Lofty
Activity: Activity within
Lofty
CRM will also be displayed in the dashboard (referral activity is now displayed).
• Account Usage: Users will now be able to see how much of their email and dialer (or virtual number) plan has been used.
• Training:We will now display online training to introduce functions to users.
Optimization of Open House (Web & App)
Open House is now editable, agents that create an open house will be marked. The leads created via this open house will be assigned to the open house creator directly (except in the case of team owners, whose leads created via open house will be assigned through lead routing rule).
Users can customize their own Open House Questionnaire.  The default questionnaire will contain previously used questions, users can now edit questionnaires as needed. Questionnaire results will be saved as notes in the lead’s details page.
Notification type added (Web&App)
When the
lofty.me (http://chime.me)
mail or integrated mail of users receives a new email from the lead, they will now get a New Email notification and Push with the lead’s name, email subject, and preview of email content.
When assigning leads to agents manually, the notification title is changed to Reassign Lead Alert.
Directly submit tickets in CRM  (Web)
We integrated the Zendesk contact form function with Lofty. Now, users can click ‘
Submit a Ticket’
and fill in the form with their questions. If they need face-to-face help, they can click ‘
Schedule a Meeting’
to schedule an online meeting with our support team.

#### Article 571: Feature Updates for CRM Version 2.3.4

- Article ID: `115003433231`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T05:32:24Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003433231-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-Version-2-3-4

Key Takeaways in Version 2.3.4
•
Redefined Tag Function
•
Improvements to Property Alert Function
•
Improved Buyer Lead Inquiries Algorithm
•
Privacy control for sync sent and received emails in integrated email
•
Email notification of authorization failure with integration email
•
Bounced status of lead’s email can be changed
•
Smart Plan - New Recurring Features
•
Zapier Optimization
Redefined Tag Feature
Tags are now divided into 2 types — ‘Private Tags’ and ‘Shared Tags’. Private Tags are for personal use and are invisible to other team members. Shared Tags are public to all team members, but can only be created and managed by team admins. Shared Tags will be marked with a ‘Team’ icon.
Improvements to Property Alert Function
‘ASAP’ Frequency of Property Alert has been renamed to ‘Instantly’
Added a ‘Send new property alert after saving’ option to send a property alert email immediately after setting up the property alert.
Lot Size field now supports both Sqft and Acre as unit types.
Property alerts created by a lead’s saved searches will be shown along with the ones created by agents. They will be marked as ‘Saved Search’. Property alerts like this can not be edited but can be deleted (the lead’s saved search will remain).
Improved Buyer Lead Inquiries Algorithm
Search activities of buyer leads are now factored into the algorithm that distributes property alerts.
Now the system will try to fill in the fields that are missing data in lead inquiries for leads imported from third-party sources, according to the lead’s activities on the agent’s website.
Privacy control for sync sent and received emails in integrated email
We set a privacy control for syncing emails. Now only the ‘Assigned To’ agents sent and received emails with corresponding leads will be synchronized and shown in the lead’s timeline.
Email notification of authorization failure with integration email
When users change the password of their integrated emails or Lofty’s access to their Gmail, the integrated email will be disconnected and they will receive a notification email like this:
Bounced status of lead’s email can be changed
The Bounced status of lead’s email can be changed now in detail page. After changing the status, you can send emails to this address as normal (however the email may still bounce).
Smart Plan - New Recurring Features
In this version, Smart Plans have been improved with recurring features. You are able to add a Smart Plan that triggers on New Year, Christmas, and Valentine’s Day with the option to set it to recur yearly. This way, the plan will automatically apply to specific leads every year on the date.
When adding a new recurring plan, you can apply to new incoming leads, reassigned leads, or existing leads for a greater degree of control over how you nurture your leads.
After setting a time, you can choose whether to send it on or before/after the holiday.
On the Smart Plans listing page, there are two more columns added: Category and For.
Zapier Optimization
When choosing Lofty as Action in a zap, “Update the Lead’s Info” has now been added. You have options to choose whether to create a new lead or update the existing lead’s info when triggered.
When choosing “Update the Lead’s Info”, it will update the lead’s chosen fields in Lofty. For fields with multiple values, like Phone or Email, the new data will be added instead of replacing the existing ones. You can also find the record in the timeline on the lead’s details page.
As for the matching fields, we have added three more fields: Source, Group, and Tag.

#### Article 572: Feature Updates for CRM Version 2.3.6

- Article ID: `115003958352`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T05:32:17Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003958352-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-Version-2-3-6

Key Takeaways
Custom Field (Web&App)
Smart Plan - Recurring Plans Optimization (Web&App)
Lead Routing Optimization (Web)
Optimization of email parsing (Web)
Optimization of email editor (Web)
Export Leads (Web)
Send welcome email to manually added leads (Web&App)
Support for lead import from Google Contacts (Web)
Custom Field (Web)
Team admins can add custom fields in Settings->Features->Custom Field, with data types of Text and Date. These fields will be added to the Details section of Lead Profile Page.
Smart Plan - Recurring Plans Optimization
1. In this version, we add Birthday and Specific Date plans to Recurring Plans. You are also able to add a plan triggered on leads’ Birthday or just a specific date. This way, the plan will be automatically applied to leads every year on Birthday or specific dates.
If you have set up a Recurring Plan for Birthday and the first step is to act on the day of Birthday, and apply to a lead whose birthday is Nov 8, 1991 (which can be added in the lead’s details page). Then the first step in this plan will act on Nov 8 yearly.
If you want to set up a Recurring Plan for Specific Date, you can simply select any date by clicking the Calendar icon. This way you will never miss any important events.
2. Besides in people listing page and the lead details page, you will know where each applied plan is from at a glance, so that you will never be misled by the similar plan name. In the lead details page, you will notice all plans are followed with a different description.
Team Plan:
The plan is a Team Plan which is created by Admins or the Team Owner as Team Plan.
Team Recurring Plan: The plan is of Recurring Plan type and created by Admins or the Team Owner as Team Plan.
My Plan-[Agent Full Name]: The plan is saved as My Plan, followed by its creator.
My Recurring Plan-[Agent Full Name]: The plan is of Recurring Plan type and saved as My Plan.
3. In some circumstances, the plan’s status will be changed and cannot keep running, like Paused or Terminated. In this update, we will tell the reason for each status. You can simply hover the plan name on the lead details page and the specific reason will display for you.
Lead Routing Optimization
1. Set longer time both for Reassign Rule and Default Rule. You have options to choose 1-59 minutes or 1-24 hours for Blast Alert and Round Robin rule. This way, you can decide the best fit time for lead distribution.
2. Be able to set the time separately for the first assignee and the remaining in the Reassign Rule. Specifically, If the first assignee does not make contact with the lead in a designated time, like 5 mins, then you can decide to route lead by Round Robin rule/Blast Alert rule and each assignee have 10 mins to follow up.
3. Empty or Match exactly
In this new vision, we make some adjustments to the “Empty or Match exactly” principle.
For “Location” field, when “Empty or Match Exactly” is chosen, a lead will match the “Location” field if either the lead has no location specified or the lead's city/county info is acceptable empty but nothing is contradictory with the "Location" field in the rule.
4. You can also choose any team member as the default assignee when all rules fail to route leads. For agent routing rule, you are able to choose any agent team member; for lender routing rule, you can also choose any lender.
5. The Cost Sharing Lender is also able to be added to a Routing Rule for Lender. This means, your cost sharing lender like other free plan lenders, can receive lead by the routing rules, too.
Optimization of email parsing
More third-party lead providers are supported by email parsing:
Agent Image, Agentology, Bold Leads, Dave Ramsey, Flipt, Geographic Farming, Homesnap, Homespotter, Home Value Leads, Instapage, Lead Pages, Listing to Leads, Offrs, Referral Exchange, Redfin, Re/Max LeadStreet, Street Easy, 55 Places
To set up email parsing auto-import, our users should make sure to that they are using their integrated email to receive lead notification emails directly from the lead providers above.
Optimization of email editor
The editor of email (single mail, mass mail, email template) has been optimized in this version.
Users can search for a template by template name when inserting email template.
Variable (such as #Lead_Name#) has been folded in Insert Variable.
Export Lead
Uses can export their leads now.
In Settings - Lead Export, they can export all of the leads in CRM or Base on search criteria which include Group, Pipeline, Lead Type, Tag, Source, Agent & Assistant.
After submitting the export request, it will take a few minutes to generate a .csv file. The user will receive an email when export is finished, and .csv file can be downloaded in this email.
Support for lead import from Google Contacts
Lead import function now supports Google Contacts. Visit ‘Settings’ - ‘Lead Import’ and you will see the option to import from Google Contacts.

If users bought our Lead Gen Package, the data of package (Visitors and Leads for Buyer Package, Addresses and Leads for Seller Package) will be displayed in Dashboard.

#### Article 575: Feature Updates for CRM Version 2.4.2

- Article ID: `360001945311`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
