Key Takeaways
IMAP/SMTP Email Integration (Web)
Lender - Invited by multiple Agent Teams (Web&App)
Smart Plan Recurring optimization (Web)
Allow Team Owner to Change Shared Lead to Private Lead (Web)
Open House Optimization (Web&App)
Grammarly setup guideline (Web)
New email template for Property Alert, Market Report and Welcome Email, with better compatibility (Web)
Improved appearance for Lead List Page (Web)
Exclusion by Pipeline for Auto Property Alert (Web)
Additional Fields on Lead List Page (Web)
IMAP/SMTP Email Integration (Web)
IMAP/SMTP email account can be integrated with
Lofty
now. We will support Godaddy webmail and Yahoo mail in this release. And more IMAP/SMTP email services will be available in the future.
Users can integrate their Godaddy webmails or Yahoo emails in Settings-Integration. All they need to do is to enter their email login credentials and server settings. We will have an article to instruct users in IMAP/SMTP server settings.
After integrating their IMAP/SMTP email account, they can send emails to leads directly from
Lofty
using their own email account.
Lender - Invited by multiple Agent Teams (Web&App)
One lender can be invited by multiple agent teams either as the Cost Sharing Lender or the Flex Plan Lender. In Lender CRM, lenders can check which agent teams they are collaborating with and how many leads have assigned to them. As well, each email notification will tell which agent team assigned the lead.
Lenders will also have the ability to check their agent partners and contact them directly in their app.
Smart Plan Recurring optimization (web)
Agents will have the ability to set the recurring repeat time to: Weekly, Monthly, except Yearly. This feature is only open for one recurring plan: the Specific Date.
Allow Team Owner to Change Shared Lead to Private Lead (Web)
Now team owner is allowed to change any shared lead to his/her own private lead. Before doing that, the owner needs to assign the lead to him/herself, clear the lender and assistant from the lead.
Open House Optimization (Web&App)
Users can choose whether to send Welcome Email or Text to Open House registered leads now. And also they can choose the Lead Privacy.
A lead can register on different Open Houses now. Their registered info will be updated in lead details page.
Grammarly setup guideline (Web)
We have added Grammarly, the writing optimization software to the Integration page. There you can learn how to add it to your browser.
New email template for Property Alert, Market Report and Welcome Email (Web)
New email template that works with dark logos and is more compatible with mobile devices.
Improved appearance for Lead List Page (Web)
Improved appearance for Lead List Page so you have a better experience with Mass Action. Feedbacks are appreciated.
Exclusion by Pipeline for Auto Property Alert (Web)
Set up ‘Excluded Pipeline’ before your lead import to avoid creating Auto Property Alert for past clients.
Additional Fields on Lead List Page (Web)
Pipeline column is now added to Lead List Page for fast switching of pipeline.

#### Article 576: Feature Updates for CRM Version 2.4.4 

- Article ID: `360002920972`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T05:29:32Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002920972-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-Version-2-4-4

Key Takeaways
Listing Management (Web) - Only for whitelist users
Allow Enterprise team admins to add multiple roles (Web&App)
Smart Plan - Custom Field - Date (Web)
Allow users to add multiple transactions to one lead (Web)
Market Report optimization (Web)
New Lead email notification optimization (Web)
Lead Routing optimization (Web)
Communications with leads that are not assigned to the user count in Accountability report (Web)
Listing Management (Web) - Only for whitelist users
If users have an IDX Website, they can enter Listing Management by hovering on the Website tab.
In Listing Management, users can view three types of recommended listings:
New Listing: These listings are new on market on their site.
Price Reduced: The prices of these listings have been  reduced recently.
Back on Market: The status of these listings became Back on Market recently. Note that some MLS don’t give us this status, so we only support this type of listing for a few MLS.
When viewing these types of listings, users can manage these listings by Filters(City, Type and Price) and Sort (by Price or Days listed).
For each listing, we will calculate the matched(best-fit) leads by Inquiries. They can view these matched leads and have a direct insights which tell users which leads may be interested in which properties. And also they can send the listing to interested leads via mass emails or texts.
Allow Enterprise team admins to add multiple roles (Web&App)
Allow team admins with Enterprise package to add multiple roles in Settings->Team->Role Settings. In this way, a lead can be assigned to multiple assignees.
Roles added by the admins have the same permissions as Assistant. Assignees on these roles have full access to the lead profile and can handle tasks and appointments.
Admins can change the role name and delete the role whenever s/he wants.
Smart Plan - Custom Field - Date (Web)
Agents can set up smart plans associated with Custom Fields (date type), like Close Date and Anniversary. This feature enables you to always apply relevant plans to leads. Additionally, you can choose to recur Yearly, Monthly and Weekly for this kind of plan.
Allow users to add multiple transactions to one lead (Web)
Now users are able to add multiple transactions to one lead in Lead Profile page. Still, for leads in Closed pipeline, the transaction data would be automatically collected and calculated in Business Reporting.
Market Report Optimization (Web)
Replace Median Price / Properties Sold / Sold Listings by Price Range data sources to Home Junction (More stable)
For the agents without an IDX website, they can use the (auto) market report
Optimize market report email sending time
New Lead email notification optimization (Web)
The New Lead Alert and Reassign Lead Alert Email will contain more details about this lead. You’ll see how our AI system evaluates this lead and what he has done since his date was captured.
Also, the new subjects of Round Robin reassign and Blast Alert reassign give you a clear look at what type of lead is coming through and what  you should do to get it.
Lead Routing optimization (Web)
When setting up routing rules for lenders, you are able to select “No lender” in the Default Rule.
The way that
Lofty
Paid Leads are routed is optimized. If the Cost Sharing Lender only pays for the Buyer Package, then Seller Package leads can be routed by routing rules to any lenders besides manually assigning.
Communications with leads that are not assigned to the user count in Accountability report (Web)
The Accountability report now includes all communications done by a user, even if the communication is with a lead that is not assigned to him/her (calculated based on communication logs). In this way, the system is able to show all communication work done by the agent.

4. In Matched Leads popup, users can filter leads by Pipeline, Registration Time and Agent & Assistant. Note: only admin accounts have this capability.

The names of leads’ family members are now searchable through the lead search function.

Ability to merge leads as duplicates or as family members(Web)
Now you can merge 2 leads if they are duplicates or are a family. If a lead is detected as a duplicate of another lead, you will see a tip on the top of the lead’s profile page, and an option to merge these 2 leads (when you have access to both). You can also merge 2 leads by selecting both of them on the lead list page, and click ‘Merge’ in the menu.
New Transaction Management (Web)  *Only available for beta users
Transaction management is a new tab for agents to manage all their transactions in one place. In this version, we will add Transaction Status to help them keep track of their transactions and visualize transaction value.
Listing Management - Team/My Listings(Web)  *Only available for beta users
Users in Listing Management Whitelist can view their own or their team listings now. They need to enter their

New Lead Routing with upgraded features (Web)
Here are several adjustments made in Lead Routing:
Directly send blast emails simultaneously to all assignees in one rule
Divide into three rules: namely, Directly assign to agent(s), Round Robin, and Blast Alert.
Route leads to the next matched rule, instead go to the Default Rule. In other words, if the lead does not match the plan's criteria or if the lead is not engaged with then the system will revert to the next rule in the lineup
Set a rule to be a default rule (with the same settings) for the last one listed above
Copy a rule by simply clicking the “Copy” icon
Smart Plan - hrs/mins delay time for steps (web)
Besides the options of Immediately and Wait xx days, we add hrs/mins delay when selecting a timing for the task to execute.
Export Optimization(Web)
You can export leads with Notes, Family Members Info and Custom Field now. You can also filter out leads to export by Reg Time now.
Ability to filter leads by whether they have email addresses or phone numbers (Web & App)
A new type of filter called ‘Contact Info’ has been added to the lead list page.
Ability to filter leads by whether they have a Market Report set up (Web & App)
A new type of filter called ‘Market Report’ has been added to the lead list page.
Ability to sort leads by last call (Web)
Now you can sort leads by the time they were last called in the ‘Last Touch’ column.
Ability to sort leads by last name (Web)
Now you can sort leads by their last name.
Remember Last Choices of Tasks and Appointment Settings (Web)
For task and appointment settings on lead profile page, the system will remember last choices of the user on the same browser.
Opt-out leads assignment
(Web & App)
You have the ability to manually assign opt-out leads to lenders if you are sure that the lead wants to share info with lenders.

Open for all users

New Lead Pond feature for lead sharing (Web)
A Lead Pond is a location for storing leads that are not assigned to a specific agent. All the agents in a team have access to these leads, so that they can follow up and claim leads as desired. With this feature, agent teams can achieve a better distribution of the lead resource for enhanced productivity.
Listing Management (Web) -
Open for all users
Open Houses on user’s site can be viewed in Listing Management now.
More MLS info such as Listing Agent info can be viewed in MLS Info column by clicking ‘view more’ icon
The sequence of properties list has been optimized.
Improvements for the family member feature (Web & App)
For the emails with a lead’s family member, records and notifications will show the family member’s name instead of the lead’s name. (Web & App)
When composing an email, names in the email template will change according to the recipient selected. (Web)
Caller ID now shows the family member’s name when receiving an inbound call from a lead’s family member. (App)
Open Transaction Management to Accelerator and Enterprise Users (Web)
Transaction management is a tab for agents to manage all their transactions in one place. In this version, we open transaction management to Accelerator and Enterprise users.
Plus, Accelerator and Enterprise users can add vendors & partners through Settings->Team->Vendor/Partner, and assign transactions to vendors & partners in Lead Profile page.
New Types of Text Alerts (Web)
There are more text templates available when leads are assigned to agents. Agents will be able to get text alerts from Lofty when one or multiple leads are assigned to you manually or by lead routing rules. In this way, you can nurture your leads faster and miss no opportunities.
Open Multiple Assistants to Accelerator Users (Web&App)

Open House Questionnaire Optimization (Web)
Pre-set six standard questions related with ‘Inquiries’ fields
，
such as FTHB
、
Pre-qual
、
Time Frame
、
House to Sell
、
With Agent and Price. If a lead fills in these questions, the answers will be imported into his corresponding ‘Inquiries’ fields.
Allow users to edit Name, Email, Phone question.
Only Show My Leads option for admins (Web)
Team admins can view all the leads in a team. Some may prefer to view only the leads assigned to them so that it is more convenient to follow up. Now a switch is available for them to control the default filter of the Lead List page and see their own leads only.
Zapier Optimization (Web)
In a Zap, you can choose the Lofty Trigger “Change Pipeline”, so when leads are moved to one specific pipeline in Lofty, they can be exported to another product.
Ability to filter leads by whether they have a Market Report set up (Web & App)
A new type of filter called ‘Market Report’ has been added to the lead list page.
Ability to sort leads by last call (Web)
Now you can sort leads by the time they were last called in the ‘Last Touch’ column.
Ability to sort leads by last name (Web)
Now you can sort leads by their last name.
Remember Last Choices of Tasks and Appointment Settings (Web)
For task and appointment settings on lead profile page, the system will remember last choices of the user on the same browser.
Opt-out leads assignment
(Web & App)

• Pocket Listing (Web)
• Smart Plan Summary in Dashboard(Web)
• Property Alert Summary in Dashboard(Web)
• Today’s Listing in Dashboard(Web)
• New Lead Type: Renter Lead(Web&App)
• Insert Listings into Email (Web)
• Integrate Cloud CMA(Web)
• Drag and Drop Images into Email Editor (Web)• New Training Video Entrance(Web)
Pocket Listing (Web)
Pocket listings can now be added in Listing Management. You can add your off market listings such as coming soon listing now!
To add pocket listings, upload listing pictures and fill out some basic information about the property. If you input your license ID in the listing information, your pocket listings will be displayed in ‘My Listings’ and ‘Team Listings’. Note that the pocket listing may take a few minutes to show up on your site.
Smart Plan Summary on the Dashboard (Web)
A Smart Plan summary will be shown on your Dashboard featuring the following data:
Yesterday’s Summary: This includes the number of Smart Plan auto emails that were sent out to leads, as well as the number of leads who read and replied to the auto emails.
Smart Plan suggestion: If you have set up the criteria for a smart plan in the ‘Applicable to’ field but you did not turn on the ‘Auto’ switch, the system will automatically identify the leads that match the smart plan criteria and create two smart plans with the most matches.
Property Alert Summary on the Dashboard (Web)
If you have an IDX website, a Property Alert summary will be shown on your Dashboard with the following data:
Yesterday’s Summary: This includes the number of Property Alert emails that were sent out to leads, as well as the number of leads who read and replied to the emails.
Lead website activity summary: This includes the number of leads who viewed and saved listings on your site.
Today’s Listing on the Dashboard (Web)
The number of current new listings, price reduced listings, and new open houses on your site will be shown on the Dashboard. Click on the listing type to view all listings categorized under each type, e.g., click ‘New listing’ to view all new listings.
Insert listings into email (Web)
You can insert listings into the email body when you send emails, mass mails, or create email templates. Search for the listings you want to include before inserting them into the email body.
New Lead Type: Renter Lead (Web & App)
Manually add/import leads and tag them as a renter type.
You can filter leads by renter type and view them on the People page.
Integrate Cloud CMA (Web)
You can now connect your Cloud CMA account in Settings->Integration.
2. Send a CMA report to seller leads by navigating to the Lead detail page->Lead Engagement.
Drag and drop Images into the email editor (Web)
When writing an email or creating email templates, you can insert images by dragging and dropping them into the pop-up window.
Please note that you can only insert five images at one time.
Transaction Management Optimization (Web)
Transaction management now features the following optimizations:
The page can now display more information so users will not have to keep scrolling down.
Users can now add transactions for each lead on this page.
A red bubble will identify new and unclaimed MLS transactions.
New Training Video (Web)
We have new training videos easily accessible on the Dashboard. Users can also view a series of training videos in our Help Center.

- Updated: `2025-11-12T05:24:53Z`

Key Takeaways
Door Knock(App) (#h_01GWN9ZF4VTYJV8JBN73TM11EF)
Lofty Learning Center(Web) (#h_01GWN9ZN2KM998QBMKJ8X38SK9)

Door Knock(App)
A brand new Door Knock feature has been released in our App. Agents can use our Door Knock map to visit leads near their neighborhood, and easily add the homeowners as partial leads or convert them to your leads.
Access the door knock map by clicking Door Knock in Lead List.
On the map, you can see your location and the partial leads nearby.  Check other locations and the number of partial leads(or called door knock target) from your CRM by zooming in and out of the map. You can add new door-knock targets based on your location by clicking the Add button. We recommend you do this while visiting homeowners.
Easily change door knock status, record contact info or make notes during or after visiting door knock targets. You can save their info and convert it into a full lead later. We also provide the ‘Reverse Search’ feature to help you look up the homeowner’s name and phone number associated with the address.
Lofty Learning Center(Web)
We created a new Learning System for our agent users. Access the Learning System in the Dashboard for the training videos. You are able to track your progress in the Learning Center.
Send Listing Optimization(Web)
The property link will be inserted when you’re sending mass texts under “Listing Management”.
You can send mass texts by using the “Send to Leads” feature.
Email attachments optimization(Web)
You can upload attachments via Mass Mail, My/Team Email Template, and Smart Plan's Auto Email.
Caller ID Optimization(Web)
Dialer users can choose to display their virtual number or phone number in the automatic email by filling in the ‘Phone Number’ under the User Profile page. If the automated email contains the variable "Agent_Phone",  it will display the numbers.
Under ‘Manage Dialer’, users can edit their cell phone number to be used by Dialer.
And they can choose to display their cell phone number or virtual number in outbound calls under the "Caller ID to Display” setting.
Multiple MLS Agent ID(Web)
You can input multiple MLS Agent IDs under the “Profile” setting.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 587: Feature Updates for CRM Version 2.6.6

- Article ID: `360020267092`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T05:23:55Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360020267092-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-Version-2-6-6

Key Takeaways
Agent Permission (Web)
Manage Team - Edit Agent's Profile (Web)
Manage Team - Delete Agent (Web)
Listing Management - Post to Social Media (Web)
Listing Management - Contact Listing Agent (Web)
Send Welcome Email (Web)
Suggestion in CC& BCC (Web)
Transaction - Time Filter (Web)
Transaction Optimization (Web)
Search Lead (Web)
Market Report UI Optimization - Only for Whitelist (Web)
Task Management Optimization (Web)
Agent Permission (Web)
The Team Permission system was updated, and now there is no “Admin” or “Member” in Lofty anymore.
We added the “Agent Permission” tab between “Agent List” and “Agent Role”.
In the “Agent Permission” page, you can turn on/off different switches to personalize each agent's access permission. The default permission setting is based on their role(admin or member) in the team.
Currently we have created 8 different access permissions for each agent:
1.Manage Team
- This is an important function that gives member the permission to manage the team, including control other member’s permissions, add or remove member and change member’s information.
2.Add Private Lead
- This gives member the permission to add private leads. When you turn it off, member will not be able to add private leads and any new leads imported from member’s subdomain will be converted to team leads, but existing private leads will not be affected.
3.Delete Lead
- This gives member the permission to delete leads. When you turn it off, member will not be able to delete leads. They can still access the “Deleted Leads” in People List page.
4.Access All Team Leads
- This is an important function that gives member the permission to manage all team leads from the team.
5.Export Lead
- This gives member the permission to export leads as csv file.
6.Team Filter
- This gives member the permission to edit or delete Source and shared Tag/Pipeline/Group.
7.Team Templates
- This gives member the permission to edit or delete shared emails, smart plan templates and open house questionnaire.
8.Team Features
- This gives member the permission to set up and manage Lead Routing, Lead Pond, Custom Field and Reporting Set Goal (Both Team Goal and individual member’s Goal).
Manage Team - Edit Agent's Profile (Web)
The agent with “Manage Team” permission can edit other agent’s information, including Profile and Email Signature. In the Profile tab, we added “Change Password” under “Email Address” where you can change the member’s password. Please note that this member may still recover the account from email if you change the password only.
Manage Team - Delete Agent (Web)
When you delete an agent, you can choose to delete all the assigned leads from this agent at the same time.
Listing Management - Post to Social Media (Web)
In the Listing Management page, you can post listings to Facebook, Twitter and LinkedIn through action bar.
Listing Management - Contact Listing Agent (Web)
1. In the Listing Management page, you can see the listing agent’s name and contact them by email, text or call.
2. Find out more info about listing agents by clicking their names.
Send Welcome Email (Web)
1. You can set Welcome Email preference in Lead Capture Settings.
When you turn on the switch for each lead provider, the welco
me email will be sent to the leads automatically when they are imported from corresponding provider.
2. Now you can manually send out welcome email to leads and their family members from the Lead Details Page.
Suggestion in CC& BCC (Web)
When you are sending a message to the lead, the CC& BCC sections will auto- suggest the team member’s and the lead’s family member’s email address based on the input.
Transaction - Time Filter (Web)
We now support time filtering in Transaction Management. This filter is available in every transaction stage.
Transaction Optimization (Web)
When adding new transactions, we have provided two new transaction status: Pending and Cancelled. In addition to the new transaction status, we added Expected Close for you to better manage the transactions.
Search Lead (Web)
You can search leads by property addresses now.
Market Report UI Optimization - Only for Whitelist (Web)
1. We have optimized the statistical indicators: ”Median Sale Price per Square Foot” and "Median Sale Price to List Price Ratio”.
2. We also optimized the chart display to make it easy for leads to understand the market.
Task Management Optimization(Web)
Now the type of non-auto task are displayed by default under Task Management.

Note: editing checklists in a smart plan template will not affect the checklists that have already been generated by this smart plan.
Smart Plan supports auto pausing when a lead is moved to another stage of the pipeline (Web)
When editing a Smart Plan, a new option “The lead’s pipeline changes” is available in the Auto Pause settings. If this option is checked, the smart plan will pause automatically when the lead is moved to a different stage of the pipeline.
Smart Plan auto pausing function improvements (Web)
In the Auto Pause setting: “a lead replies emails”, “lead texts a Lofty Number”, and “a lead calls” are combined into one option named “The lead responds/reaches out”. When selecting this option, you will see the extended option to move the lead to another pipeline, move the lead into a group or add a tag to the lead after the smart plan is auto paused because the lead responds.
In the Auto Pause setting, the option “agent calls the lead or logs a call” has been optimized to only trigger the pause when a call is marked as “Talked”.
Smart Plans support tasks that have a due date, but don’t have a specific time due (Web)
When editing a smart plan, steps of manual tasks now supports not having a specific time due.
Support pausing and resuming a smart plan on the App (App)
You can find the option to pause/resume a smart plan on the App by swiping the smart plan to the left on iOS or pressing it for a few seconds on an Android.
Team Routing (Only for Whitelist)
Team Routing is designed to help the broker distribute leads between different teams.
e.g: if a broker has an ISA team, then they can send all of their leads after an ISA has qualified these leads. They can use the “Team Routing” feature to distribute leads to different teams based on location or price.
You can set up triggers to automatically route leads to another team.
You can set up specific rules to route different leads to different teams
You can set up actions to remove all automated emails, once leads are routed to different teams
You can @ other team’s agent, once leads are routed to different teams
Text Code Optimization (Web)
Text code will not be case sensitive. For example, ‘home3’ and ‘Home3’ will be the same text code and these senders will get the same reply message.

#### Article 594: Feature Updates for CRM Version 2.8.2

- Article ID: `360029023572`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T05:20:48Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360029023572-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-Version-2-8-2

Key Takeaways
Cloud CMA Integration: When a report is not generated quickly enough, a link can be copied and pasted manually into
Lofty
.
The updated naming convention for Agent Lead Routing.
Filters: New support for searching leads that are either “Subscribed” or “Unsubscribed” to Smart Plans or Property Alerts.
Filters: Support for searching for only Team Leads
Filters: Support for searching by the criteria that match “Last Touch”
Cloud CMA Optimization
You can now manually input the report link if the Cloud CMA does not return the report in a timely manner.
Lofty
is already working with Cloud CMA to address this delay.
Updated Naming Convention for Agent Lead Routing
Lofty
has decided to update two lead routing rule names to be more consistent with standard CRM industry terminology:
What was previously known as “Direct Assign” has now been given the name of “
Round Robin
.”
What was previously known as “Round Robin” is now known as “
Next Up
.”
*The previous lead routing functionality has
not
changed. Just be sure to note that what you previously knew as “Round Robin” as related to
Lofty
has been changed to be directly assigned.
Filter Updates
Unsubscribed / Subscribed
A new filter supports the ability to search by subscribed or unsubscribed leads as related to Smart Plans and Property Alerts. These options are found under the corresponding filter (Smart Plan, Property Alert).
*Note: The options of “Subscribed” and “Unsubscribed” cannot be selected at the same time.
Searching by Team Leads
In “Saved Filters,”
Lofty
users can now filter specifically by Team Leads.
Last Touch Criteria
Filters now support searching leads by the type of last touch.
Lofty
users can select from three types of “Last Touch” by choosing one of the following: Emailed, Texted, or Called.
The type of last touch and date range of the last touch can be combined. For example, if a
Lofty
user chooses “Emailed” and “Called” and selects a date range of “Less than 5 days,” the result will display leads that were touched by email and call within the last five days.

#### Article 595: Feature Updates for CRM Version 2.8.4

- Article ID: `360029523492`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T05:20:11Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360029523492-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-Version-2-8-4

Key Takeaways
Team Admins can now purchase Text Packages via the CRM
Mass email/text for Listing Management
Enterprise Edition optimization for Team Management
Enterprise Edition Reporting
Team Admins can now purchase Text Packages via the CRM
Based on
Lofty
user feedback, we have released the ability for Team Admins to add Text Packages for their team members. Previously, this upgrade request had to be sent via the assigned Customer Success Manager. Now, with this update,
Lofty
users can add Text Packages on their own. If a team belongs to an Enterprise/Broker Edition account, call and text packages must be added via the
Lofty
Support Team or the assigned Customer Success Manager.
Lofty
offers two text packages: The “$15 Text Package” enables the agent to send 500 texts per day while the “$30 Text Package” allows for 1,000 texts to be sent per day.
*Please note that if you upgrade your text package that you will be charged the first month based on the previous package and the next month you will be charged according to the upgraded package.
Mass email/text for Listing Management
Lofty
users with access to the Listing Management feature can now send multiple listings to multiple leads directly from this page.
Enterprise Edition Optimization for Team management
If you are currently using our Enterprise Edition (Broker Edition), we have now added a variety of new features including operations like editing team names, deleting teams, etc.
Here are a few key optimizations you should know about:
The Team Admin no longer has access to change the permissions of the Enterprise Admin account on their team
The Enterprise Edition Team Management section now shows the following:
New Leads
Total Leads
Buyer New Leads
Buyer Total Leads
Seller New Leads
Seller Total Leads
B&S New Leads
B&S Total Leads
Team Management also shows the overview of office and seat usage
Offices Used: A/B
A: sum of active teams + sum of inactive teams
B: total number of offices purchased with the Enterprise package
Seats Used: C/D
C:
sum of active team seats used + inactive team seats used
D: total number of seats purchased with the Enterprise package
The Enterprise Admin can now set a limit for the number of seats that can be used on each team. This is done by clicking on the “edit” icon and entering in the limit to be established. The seat limit minimum is the number of seats already used by the team and the maximum is the number of seats still available at the enterprise level.
Seat Limit: E/F
E: The number of seats used by this team
F: The limit of seats for this team established by the Enterprise Admin
*Note that when adding a new team, the Enterprise Admin must input a “seat limit.”
The Enterprise Admin can edit team names by clicking on the “edit” icon:
The Enterprise Admin can delete teams by clicking on the “delete” icon.
The Enterprise Admin can log in to each team by clicking on the “go to” icon:
When an agent is invited to join a
Lofty
team and activates their account, a notification email will be sent to the Enterprise Admin.
Enterprise Edition Reporting
Lofty
has built a new reporting feature at the Enterprise level. This includes two charts to show the performance of the teams. One is for "Lead Conversion” and the other for “Business Reporting.”
The “Lead Conversion Chart” will allow you to view the number of newly assigned leads in the time frame selected in the filters at the top.
“Valid Leads” means that the lead either (a) has a valid phone or (b) has an email in their profile.
“Closed Leads” refers to the leads in the Closed pipeline stage.
“Potential Leads” are the leads associated with active transactions (not including Closed and Cancelled), that correspond with the selected time frame.
The “Business Chart” shows business data for each team within the selected time frame. This includes Closings, Volume, GCI, Team Revenue, Agent Revenue, and Potential Team and Agent Revenue. Potential Revenue is based on active transactions (not including Closed and Cancelled).

Multi-Team Edition: Team & Seat Quantity Display Optimization
We have made it a little clearer on the number of teams, and seats a Multi-Team admin has to work with.
Email Signature Optimization
The email signature tool has been optimized in a few different important ways to make it more useful within the Lofty platform. Such changes include -
Signature Previews, Variable Support, Default Format & Reset Links, and a much-requested feature, applying a signature to ALL outdoing emails (including welcome emails, property alerts, etc.)
Due to the number of exciting changes, please check out the
Complete your Lofty Profile, and Email Signature (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/218007123)
to learn more!
Calendar View Optimizations
We have also made some great changes to our new Calendar View feature which is located in the
Tasks > Calendar
section of the Lofty CRM. This includes improvements with interactions on the Mini Calendar to act similar to other popular Calendar Web Applications, such as,
If you are on the "Week" or "Month" views you can double-click a specific date on the mini calendar at the left and it will take you to that specific "Day" view instead.
We've also added a feature for a Visible Filter Count:
And also now incorporate your
Social Post (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4416954832795)
on the Calendar View, as well as, post new Social Posts from the Calendar View.

Social Studio Improvements
A number of changes have been made to make using the Social Studio more accessible. As mentioned previously, you can now view, access, and create
Social Post (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4416954832795)
from the
Calendar View. (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360017514112)

Would you like to learn more?
Social Studio (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4416954832795)
Mobile App: Long-Press to Copy
You can now easily copy and paste data from the mobile app by using a "Long-Press" on your smartphone. This is both usable by Apple and Android users.
Open House and Text Code Optimizations
The
Open House (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360023770952-How-to-Add-Edit-Open-House-Sign-in-page)
and
Text Code (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360018862672-Text-Code-for-Lead-Capture)
tools have had some optimizations made with this release as outlined below.
MLS Agent ID Connection
An MLS Agent ID Connection will be used when creating an open house form or text code in Lofty, the system will check to see if you have an MLS Agent ID on file first. If you do not, you will type the property address in like normal and then the system will prompt you to determine if that listing belongs to you or not. If you indicate that it
does
belong to you, then the MLS Agent ID associated with that listing will be added to your account automatically for future use within the Lofty platform.
Open House QR Code
The Open House form now has a built-in QR code! This will be the first thing that appears when the open house form is opened on the web or mobile app. Once scanned, the lead will see a sign-in page that has all of the questions available right on their own mobile phone.
*IMPORTANT
: The QR code functionality is
not
currently available on the
open house tablet apps (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360056122032)
. Tablet apps should be supported soon.
Would you like to learn more?
Open House Forms (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360023770952)
Text Codes for Lead Capture (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360018862672)
AI Assistant: "Drip Messages" & "Long-Term Campaign"
We have added the feature to help direct the AI in different ways.
Drip Messages
This consists of three messages that the AI Assistant sends out when the lead has stopped responding in the middle of a conversation. The AI will remember where the conversation left off and attempt to engage them again using that topic as the starting point. These drip messages will not engage existing leads unless the lead has performed some sort of action first.
Long-Term Campaign
This consists of attempts from the AI Assistant to get engagement from leads for a period of up to six months. This is specifically for leads that have no activity on the website and do not reply to the AI Assistant. This type of campaign will stop automatically if a lead has responded or has activity on the website that would normally trigger the AI Assistant to engage. Users can mute the AI Assistant at any time like normal. In this scenario, the AI Assistant will only reach out to leads who have met certain conditions like actively viewing multiple listings, saving searches and listings, etc
AI Assistant: Manual Triggers and Recommendations via Mobile App
You can now assign an objective for the AI Assistant to pursue in its contacts with a lead, the Assistant can also be muted from a lead page as well now in the mobile app.
If you choose to have the AI Assistant schedule a showing, it will provide you with different options. All AI-specific notes will be clearly logged in the lead timeline, and other suggestions on how to get the AI to engage will be available on mobile as well.
Would you like to learn more?
AI Assistant (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/sections/360007651672-AI-Assistant)

.

+ Add a New Landing Page
button at the top of the screen, the template selection process for landing pages has been improved with easier navigation and clearer labels to locate the available options.

Global Site Font Modification

White Label

Enterprise Permission Improvements
"Manage User" Permission
The "Manage User" permission can be applied to
any
permission profile regardless of whether they are an admin or not.
When this permission is enabled, there are two available options to limit the scope of the permission.
Depending on which one is selected, this permission gives the user the ability to. . .
Entire Company
Manage the organization's hierarchy
Manage agent roles
Manage permissions profiles
Add/remove users and change individual user details
User's Group
Manage their current group and all subgroup agent profiles
Advanced Permission Settings
A new setting is available under
Settings
>
Permission Profiles
>
Advanced Settings
. This new setting is intended to define limitations for how organizational groups are to interact with each other within the Enterprise account. Learn More:
How to Assign a Vendor, Partner, or Contact to a Transaction (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360004792091)
Lofty
Workspaces: My Workspace  - Beta Feature
*NOTE* This feature is currently in Beta access and may not be open to all users at this time. Features are subject to change.
This new tool has been added to your already powerful feature set. located at the
My Workplace
icon on the top navigation bar. When clicked, a new tab will open in your browser. This is intended to be an immersive experience that allows you to focus on responding to communication.
With this feature, you can see and communicate all in one place. This includes chat, text, emails, and missed calls. You can also use this tool to assign these to other teammates on your platform.
Learn More:
Lofty
Workspaces (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/5591212569371)
Smart Listings Optimizations
We have made some improvements to our
Smart Listings (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4410497918107)
feature. Now we offer this feature to associate with our Transaction feature. With both accessible on the Smart Listing itself, and the Transaction page of that listing as well.
Learn More:
Smart Listings (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4410497918107)
Transaction Management Introduction (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057572991)
AI Assistant Optimizations
Seller Call Consultations
In order to get better engagement from seller leads, the AI Assistant will attempt to schedule a phone call meeting when the following triggers occur:
The seller lead requests a home valuation on the associated
Lofty
-built website
1. The AI Assistant will ask the lead if they would like a CMA based on the property address submitted.
Seller lead views
five
unique sold properties in one day
If the lead has a property recorded on their lead profile (under the "Selling" label only), the AI Assistant will ask if they would like a CMA and to schedule a call. The most recent "selling" property will be referenced by the AI.
If the lead does
not
have a property recorded on their lead profile, the AI Assistant will ask for the property address first and then offer a CMA to schedule a call.
Compassionate Responses
With this release, the AI Assistant has been trained to respond more compassionately to messages from leads that may indicate some sort of sickness or tragedy.
Support for Scheduling Showings via Text
This feature has already been live when the AI Assistant is engaging leads on
Lofty
-built websites. With this update, however, the AI Assistant will also send out text messages to leads whose behavior matches the triggers:
Saving listings
Sharing listings
Viewing specific properties more than three times in a 24-hour period
Requesting showings
Please note that these triggering behaviors do have built-in "cooling conditions:"
The save/view/share trigger is triggered only once within 24 hours. For example, if you share a listing share the system will cool for 24 hours so if another property is shared within that period the AI will not trigger again.
Verification if the same property is saved/viewed/shared multiple times. If there are save/view/share behaviors for the same property (that has already triggered an AI conversation) after the cool-down period, the same property needs a cool-down period of 7 days before it would trigger again.
Learn More:
AI Assistant / Chatbot FAQ (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056322172)
Social Studio Optimizations
New Post-Creation Process
Users who have not yet connected to any social channels can still see the Social Studio Dashboard and Calendar View. Previously, these were
not
visible. Users can also click the button to
+ Create a Post
and they will be able to preview what the post creation process looks like and connect their social platforms directly from the new window.
Dashboard Redesign
The Social Studio Dashboard has been redesigned. Instead of being able to switch between the original list view and the calendar view, the default view now is the weekly calendar view and individual cards represent social posts. The weekly calendar view can be expanded to show the whole month if needed. When a user toggles between weeks on the calendar view, the cards list at the bottom will display that week's posts. Clicking on a post on the calendar takes the user to the card on the list and that card has all the associated information:
Content
Status
Image
Engagement data (leads count is clickable)
Social channels (clickable if the post is published)
Post date
Week and Card List View
Monthly Calendar View
Filter by "Post Type":
Settings Location
Link Post Image Previews
When publishing a link to any of the supported social channels via the
Lofty
Social Studio, the posts will generate an image preview for that link on all platforms other than Instagram.
Social Feed Website Block
*NOTE
: This feature is only available for users who have upgraded to
Social Studio Pro
.
A new block can be found in the
Lofty
CMS for
Social Feed
. This block will automatically synchronize your social posts to your
Lofty
-built website.
When a site visitor clicks on any of the posts, it will redirect them to the details on that social platform.
This
Social Feed
will show existing posts from connected social pages even if they were not published via the
Lofty
Social Studio (with the exception of LinkedIn).
Video posts will not display
Link-only posts will
not
generate a preview
Learn More:
Social Studio (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4416954832795)

Lofty Calendar
Previously, as part of
CRM 3.44 (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/4431034115867-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-3-44-Site-5-32)
, we released the "Tasks Calendar View." The goal moving forward will continue to be to make the calendar more useful within the Lofty platform. These updates reflect that.
You can now integrate your Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, and Calendly with the Lofty calendar. There are three different places you can do that:
(1)
Settings
>
Integrations
:
(2)
Marketplace
>
Productivity
:
(3)
Tasks
>
Calendar View
>
Integrated Calendars
>
+
:
Here are some important notes about how this works:
You can integrate more than one calendar into Lofty. For example, you can have 1 Google Calendar + 1 Outlook Calendar + 1 Calendly connection in place, but you
cannot
have 2 Google/Outlook calendars connected at the same time. This is on a per-user basis.
Google Calendar and Outlook Calendar support a
two-way
sync. This means if events are added to the third-party calendar, they will sync to the Lofty Calendar. There is a toggle for each integrated calendar that, when enabled, allows for events to continue to sync from Lofty to the third-party calendar as well.
Only "appointments" on the Lofty Calendar will be synced to the third-party calendars. If multiple calendars are integrated into Lofty then the appointment will be synced to all of them. Currently, if a Lofty appointment syncs to an integrated calendar,
all
of the integrated calendars will send a calendar invite to the lead via email.
Calendly only supports a
one-way
sync from Calendly to the Lofty Calendar.
All shared calendars on the integrated calendar will be connected and visible on the Lofty calendar. For example, if you have a personal Google Calendar shared with a work Google Calendar, it will be available to display within Lofty.
Only future events will be synced between calendars.
Events that are synced to the Lofty Calendar are only displayed in Lofty and cannot be edited/deleted.
When an event is updated/deleted on a third-party calendar, it will also be updated/deleted on the Lofty Calendar.
The following fields sync from third-party calendars:
Title
Description
Date
Participants
Location
Source
Smart Plan Logs
There are many reasons why a Smart Plan might have its status changed when applied to a lead. Sometimes a Smart Plan is paused or a step skipped, etc. This update provides a detailed log of what a Smart Plan is doing when applied to leads so that you can tell what happened without having to dig for it.
*IMPORTANT: This log will only be accessible when a Smart Plan is either active or paused, but not when it has been completed/terminated.
When you navigate to
Lead Profile
>
Smart Plans
and hover over the Smart Plan, there will be three options to the right. The middle action button is the
Plan Log
:
Once this has been clicked, a detailed window will appear that shows a log of everything that the Smart Plan has done as related to this particular lead. The log will look something like this one, with the name of the Smart Plan at the top and details for each of the events that have occurred with the Smart Plan.
10 DLC Brand & Campaign Self-Service Registration
In an effort to protect consumers, increase deliverability, and create a trusted ecosystem with high customer engagement, major U.S. carriers (AT&T, T-Mobile, etc.) are requiring companies that send SMS messages within the United States to register their messaging campaigns. With this particular release, we have enabled self-service registration to take place on
Enterprise
and
Multi-Team
Lofty packages only. Other packages will be supported in the future. Only the Company Owner/Admin (Enterprise Package) and Multi-Team Owner (Multi-Team Package) can edit this setting.
This option is available under
Settings
>
Manage Dialer
>
Register your Business Profile
:
You will then be required to fill out the information below to proceed with registration:
After submission, the application will be sent for review to the
Campaign Registry (https://www.campaignregistry.com/)
for review. Click on the button to register your information for an updated status on your application. The timeline for this can vary as it still requires manual intervention, but should be approximately 1-2 weeks at most.
Transaction Quick Add
In order to simplify the process to add a new transaction, whenever you click the button to do so it will open up a simplified view with only the required fields. If you are in a hurry and need to get a transaction added quickly then this option will make doing so easier so that you do not see unnecessary fields.
More detailed information can be added later or by clicking on the
Details View
. This view is similar to what was active prior to this update.
Also as part of this update, when saving a new transaction it will open up in a new tab so that you can reference multiple tabs of information if needed.
Design Center Optimizations
Create Designs Using All Listings
When creating designs in the Design Center, you can now select any listing from your connected MLS(s) to add to your designs. This does
not
change the fact that permission must be received before marketing a listing that is not your own–and the system will indicate this warning as well.
Google Ads Integration
You can now add your Google conversion code directly into your Lofty -built website via the
CMS
. Google will typically provide you with two codes but the only one you will need to use is the
event snippet
that looks like this one (use your own not this one!):
<!-- Event snippet for Website Lead conversion page -->
<script>
gtag('event', 'conversion',
{'send_to': 'AW-10853745497/upojCPH8s6EDENmGvLco'}
);
</script>
This can be added via
CMS
>
Settings
>
Integrations
>
Google Ads
. Paste your code into the field and then save it to begin tracking conversions.
Chat Support
Chat support is
available for all users
! You can access chat support by clicking on the
?
icon in the top-right of your CRM and choosing to
Chat with Support
. If a Support Rep is unavailable to chat with you at the time, you will see a form to submit a ticket and will receive a response via email as soon as possible.
CMA Optimizations
New Creation Process
When you click on the
+ Add New
button, you will now be asked to choose the presentation type before actually starting the CMA:
Once you click to
Create Presentation
, you can start the process of choosing a lead, a subject property, etc.
New CMA Type: Present Yourself
In addition to the
Seller
and
Buyer
CMA Presentations
, a new option to
Present Yourself
has been added with this release.
This presentation takes you right to the page selection process because (a) there is no subject property with this presentation type and (b) no lead has to be selected. The pages available to choose from will be those that present the value of an agent only–no comp data necessary.
New User Interface
A variety of UI aspects have changed in Step 2 of the CMA creation process including the following:
Map Search Tools are now more visible and floating on the top-middle instead of the top-left. Switching between "Neighborhood," "Radius," and "Polygon Draw" is now easier.
The applied criteria collapse and expand on hover instead of taking up a large part of the screen at the top.
The "Filters" and "View Selected" buttons have swapped locations.
The display of the "Subject Property" is slightly different now.
The Comps List is no longer separated by drop-downs for listing status and is now in the order of "Sold," "Pending," and "Active" instead of the reverse
Before Update
After Update
Add By MLS Listing ID
You can now add listings to a CMA by using their MLS Listing ID on the "View Selected" menu and at the bottom of the comps list in step 3.
Adjust Specific Comps
Add Remarks
Click on the
Add Remarks
option and type in any notes that you would like to display for your lead:
Adjust DOM (Days On Market)
The DOM should sync from the MLS but if for whatever reason you need to manually override this, you can do so with this option:
Make Pricing Adjustments
If the comps you have selected are perfect matches for the subject property besides for only a small number of things, you can apply adjustments to each individual comp to show why it should be higher/lower than what it currently shows as. You may also consider adding a pricing adjustment for a comp that sold some time ago and you want to account for what it would be worth today vs. what it sold for a long time ago.
New Form
At the end of each CMA, there is now a quick drop-down form that is to be completed by the lead. This action is equivalent to the lead leaving a message on your website and the notifications will behave the same (opportunity notifications) when sent to you as a user.
PDF Improvements
The downloadable PDF has now been improved. A sample of what this PDF looks like can be downloaded
here (https://help.lofty.com/hc/article_attachments/6092534699931)
.
Google My Business Integration
You can now integrate
Google My Business
with Lofty to power your website reviews.
Navigate to
CMS
>
Settings
>
Integrations
>
Google My Business
:
Follow the steps to integrate and it will ask you which business profile you want to connect to Lofty:
Once connected, your
Google My Business
profile information will display in the CMS:
Currently, the only place you can actually use this integration is in the
Reviews Block (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360038293251)
. Instead of choosing the source of the review as Zillow or manual reviews that you have added (Default), you can sync in your Google reviews.
All
reviews will be synced and you are unable to pick and choose the ones you would like to display.
Reference these links for Google My Business access:
https://www.google.com/business/
https://support.google.com/business/answer/6300717
Social Studio Improvements
Link Previewing
The
Lofty
Social Studio (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/4416954832795-Social-Studio-Beta-)
has had yet another improvement! Now, when you create a post that has a link associated with it (typically a listing detail page), you can choose between displaying the photos from that listing on a carousel or simply using the link preview image. The platform samples displayed at the right side will update based on this selection as well–but keep in mind that Instagram does
not
support showing a link preview so it will just be displayed as normal text on that platform.
This can be toggled back and forth here in the post-creation process:
More Auto-Posting Variables
In the auto-post settings, previously only listing-type variables (merge fields) were supported. Now, agent-type variables are also supported:
Before Update
After Update
Listing Sharing Method
Once the Social Studio was released, its social posting feature took over all locations in Lofty where you could share to social channels. For example, with
Listing Discovery
, the ability to simply share directly to Facebook, etc. was replaced by the Social Studio. With this update, you can now choose whether you want to use Social Studio or if you want to simply open Facebook and post to share a listing:
Lofty -Purchased Domain Auto-Renewal
If you have purchased a domain for your website using Lofty, this will auto-renew prior to expiration. You will receive a notification email informing you that it has auto-renewed and that you have been billed or if payment failed for whatever reason. These emails will look like the following:
AI Assistant Improvements
Manual Triggers for Seller Leads
As part of
CRM 3.45 (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/4643782120603-Feature-Updates-for-CRM-3-45-Site-5-33#id-3/14/22:FeatureReleaseTrainingforCRM3.45,Site5.33-AIAssistant:ManualTriggersandRecommendations)
,
the ability to manually trigger the AI Assistant to pursue a specific objective with a buyer lead was supported. Now that additional seller lead scripts have been added to the AI's toolbox, the same feature will be enabled for seller leads as well.
For seller or buyer leads, the following actions are available to select from:
If the lead is marked as Buyer & Seller, there will be tabs with both sets of options available:
AI Smart Plan Action
The AI Assistant can now be triggered (or muted) using a Smart Plan action. Some key benefits of enabling this include the following:
This will help ensure that every lead (even those that are added manually to the CRM) can have the AI Assistant triggered.
Mass muting of the AI Assistant will be easier to accomplish

currently, you can only use the mute/unmute action once in a Smart Plan. So you cannot constantly unmute/mute at different stages of the same Smart Plan.
Neighborhood Page Optimizations
Multi-Level Neighborhood Selection
The data used to produce data and boundaries for neighborhoods oftentimes has multiple levels. What this means is that there are multiple definitions for a neighborhood using the exact same name. With this update, you can toggle between them using the icon next to their name and this will result in the boundary displaying at the left adjusting accordingly. This icon will only appear when there are multiple options for that same neighborhood name.

#### Article 599: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.49

- Article ID: `6561911156763`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T02:19:42Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/6561911156763-Feature-Updates-for-Lofty-3-49

Introduction
*Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons you have purchased and the account type you have (admin/agent user). For any questions related to your Lofty package or feature availability, please contact Lofty Support (
support@lofty.com (mailto:support@chimeinc.com)
).
Release Date
Tuesday, June 14th, 2022
Summary
Calendar Improvements (#h_01G5FPH2XVGM8BBW9QGHKK50V2)
Mobile App Redesign: Lead List and Lead Detail Pages (#id-6/13/22:FeatureReleaseTrainingforChime3.49-MobileAppRedesign:LeadListandLeadDetailPages)
White Label Login Page Supports Forgotten Passwords (#id-6/13/22:FeatureReleaseTrainingforChime3.49-WhiteLabelLoginPageSupportsForgottenPasswords)
Transaction Management Optimizations (#id-6/13/22:FeatureReleaseTrainingforChime3.49-TransactionManagementOptimizations)
Pocket Listing Updates (#id-6/13/22:FeatureReleaseTrainingforChime3.49-PocketListingUpdates)
New Home Valuation Template (#id-6/13/22:FeatureReleaseTrainingforChime3.49-NewHomeValuationTemplate)
Home Report Optimization (#id-6/13/22:FeatureReleaseTrainingforChime3.49-HomeReportOptimization)
AI Assistant: New Group for Lead Handoff (#id-6/13/22:FeatureReleaseTrainingforChime3.49-AIAssistant:NewGroupforLeadHandoff)
Neighborhood/Featured Area Optimization (#id-6/13/22:FeatureReleaseTrainingforChime3.49-Neighborhood/FeaturedAreaOptimization)
Landing Page Recommendations Optimization (#id-6/13/22:FeatureReleaseTrainingforChime3.49-LandingPageRecommendationsOptimization)
Calendar Improvements
Calendar Privacy
Users can now make their integrated calendar private.
Calendar Working Hours
Also accessible under the "My Calendar" settings, a new option for
Working Hours
is now available.
Enable working hours to let people know what times you're working and when you're available for meetings. This will warn people if they try to invite you to a meeting outside of these hours.
Scheduling Link
The
Lofty
Calendar
now has support for a scheduling link similar to what you may be familiar with from other third-party apps.
*IMPORTANT
: In the current version, the Lofty Calendar Scheduling Link does
not
check your calendar for appointment conflicts. This functionality will be added in upcoming releases.
Website Settings
You can now add both a scheduling block and page to your website wherever you see fit or create a scheduling landing page where you can send your leads for scheduling needs. Keep in mind that there is only one booking form that is used to schedule appointments so you will not currently be able to create different versions
Learn More: Lofty
Calendar (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/6582612402715)
Mobile App Redesign: Lead List and Lead Detail Pages
This feature is now delayed until 6/15/2022
The mobile app user interface has been improved with this update. With this release, only the lead list and lead detail pages have been optimized, but more changes coming to the App very shortly!
Learn More:
Download Lofty CRM Mobile App (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360012545351)
White Label Login Page Supports Forgotten Passwords
For our clients using our White Labeling services for login, you now can reset your password from the front page!
Learn More:
White Label (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/5584384821275)
Transaction Management Optimizations
We have made some optimizations to our Transaction Management Page.
User Interface Changes
We have made several changes to the UI to make it easier to navigate your Transaction page. This includes pinning the names of Transactions, moving the search bar and filter bar, and consolidating the add button.
One example - is the pinning of the Transaction Name section.
All Tab
As requested by many of our users, we have created an "All" tab for Transaction Management. This shows all transactions instead of having to access them by transaction type and add them manually.
The top summary row shows the following:
Total Count
Total Volume
Total GCI
Total Team Revenue
Total Agent Revenue
New Filters
The following new filters have been added under the "More Filters" option:
Basic Info
Dates
Contacts
Accounting
Learn More:
Transaction Management Introduction (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057572991)
Manual Listing Updates
We have improved the process to create a pocket listing on your website to make the process more intuitive. Pocket listings can be added from the website or by accessing the
Listing Management
page and clicking
+ Add Manual Listing
:
We have even added a feature that lets our users decide who sees your Manual Listings.
You can choose "Display Listing On. . ."
(1) My Website - is not visible on other websites on your team.
(2) My Team/Group's Websites - visible account-wide.
(3) No Websites - only visible for your account.
There is a lot more to this certain update, so please check out the rest of the
Pocket Listings (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/6586244604699)
guide on the Help Center.
New Home Valuation Template
We have added a new Home Valuation template with the following components:
Registration form
Video (editable)
Text content (editable)
Home Report  sample images (
not
editable)
Learn More:
Home Evaluation Block (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037923112)
Home Report Optimization
The
Home Report (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/5604874589851--BETA-Home-Report-)
is still in beta but if you are interested in giving it a try, you can find it in the
Lofty  Marketplace,
THIS IS STILL LIMITED TO ONLY A FEW USERS
. You can also now create them without a Lender assigned to the lead.
Learn More:
(BETA) Home Report (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/5604874589851)
AI Assistant: New Segment for Lead Handoff
The AI Assistant will now add leads to a segment called "Need to Contact (from AI)" when they need attention from you. The AI Assistant will not remove any leads from this segment–so make sure that when you have done the necessary work on contacting the lead you remove them from that segment to avoid future confusion.
Learn More:
AI Assistant / Chatbot Qualification Process (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056783971)
Neighborhood/Featured Area Optimization
We have optimized the way that neighborhoods/featured areas are configured on your website. These improvements will help with the following:
Simplify the configuration process
Allow for the same featured area/neighborhood to be added multiples times with ease
When featured areas/neighborhoods are added under
Settings
(explained below), they will automatically be added to the sitemap without having to be added to the navigation menu which is great for SEO.
Learn More:
Add / Edit Neighborhood Pages or Groups (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037816512)
Featured Areas Block (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037923152)
Landing Page Recommendations Optimization
A quick change has been made to how we recommend landing pages.
Learn More:
Landing Pages (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038228552)
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Thursday, July 7th, 2022

API Nation Integration
We now have a variety of contact integrations supported by API Nation. These are accessible via the
Lofty
Marketplace and can be identified by the "API Nation" tag.
Mobile App: Search Leads by Notes
*
This feature will be published to the app stores on 7/15/2022
Users can now use the mobile app to search for leads by the information stored in their notes. This search capability was already supported in the Web App as part of
Feature Updates for CRM 3.44, Site 5.32 (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/search/click?%3D--56369eb8bb3407db5c0b21558d52bd50c3d2ee67)
, and will be supported on the mobile app.
Learn More:
Download the LOFTY CRM Mobile App (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/360012545351)
Lofty Calendar: Custom Events Categories
We made a quick change to the Lofty Calendar that allows you to see more specifics related to custom dates in the Lofty platform.
After this release, you will see two separate options for "Transaction Dates" and "Lead Profile Dates."
This helps to avoid confusion between custom lead/transaction dates.
Learn More: Lofty
Calendar (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/search/click?data=BAh7DjoHaWRsKwgbIkai%%3D%3D--b73898d8fbfa6b12a51da99f299fb95dc42e2f5e)
Smart Listings + Offer Management
A few improvements have been made within the Smart Listings pages to facilitate access to Offer Management.
If a listing has still not made it to the "Under Contract" stage, there will be a suggested action to
Create an Offer Link
:
In order for an offer to be created, a transaction must exist. If one already exists, a quick process will be available to create an offer link. Otherwise, it will ask for a transaction to be created first.
You can easily access a transaction via the Smart Listing page if associated with your listing. You can also create offer links, copy an existing offer link, and manage existing offers directly from this section as well:
Learn More:
Smart Listings (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/search/click?%3D%3D--c24f5aa00a704a35c59d11ad910b5ac03b695e5b)
Reporting Page: Manual Updates
For the reporting page, you can now manually update all reports instead of having to wait for scheduled periodic updates. This will help avoid delays and give you control over the last sync for your reports. Access the
Reporting
page and then click the "update" icon in the top-right:
You will see a message indicating that the report is being updated. You can leave the page and return later if you would like to work on other tasks while it is updating:
Once updated, you will see the last time it happened in the top-right corner:
Learn More:
Agent/My Accountability (Reporting) (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/search/click?--91c32265f9c9cc61f86b04a7b0bc15f81d8d8760)
Billing Center: Invoice Management
Instead of having to contact
Lofty
Support, you can now access all of your
Lofty
invoices directly from the CRM. Previous invoices will only be available from January 2021 until now so if you require anything older than that please contact
support@lofty.com (mailto:support@chimeinc.com)
.
Access the
Billing Center
by clicking your profile picture in the top-right and then selecting "Billing":
Here is what you can do on this page:
Pay an overdue bill
Download detailed invoices from January 2021 and forward
Adjust payment information
Review payment method, payment date, and the amount charged
Here is what an invoice will look like:
You can also adjust the name and address that should be listed on the invoice and this will be reflected on all invoices moving forward:
Lead Generation Reporting Optimization
If you run lead generation with Lofty you may notice a simple optimization that was made.
Before this update, the total leads generated via a campaign could potentially be inaccurate when a lead was reassigned, deleted, or converted to a private lead.
With this release, the total count will now cover those scenarios so that you can accurately measure the performance of each campaign.
Profile Picture Frames
You may have noticed a profile picture frame that you could apply within the CRM when you logged in during Independence Day weekend. You may see these as future options within the platform!
A few things to note when applying these frames to your profile image in the CRM:
This frame is only temporary and will be automatically removed a few days after the holiday ends
The frame will
not
be visible on any of your customer-facing emails, email signatures, etc. It is currently only intended to be visible for you as a
Lofty
user to celebrate the holiday.
Auto Home Report (BETA)
*This feature is still only in beta. If you are interested in participating, please reach out to
support@lofty.com (mailto:support@chimeinc.com)
to have these features made available.
Though this feature remains in closed beta, the
Home Report (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/5604874589851)
has been improved with this update to provide more automation and settings.
Access Home Report settings under
Campaigns
>
Home Report
:
At the top, you will see the package you are on, the maximum number of active reports you can have, and your partner lender (if applicable).
On the top row you can review performance for the current month:
Active Reports
- The total number of homeowners who have at least one active Home Report applied
Emails Sent
- The total number of emails sent during this month
Emails Viewed
- The total number of emails viewed during this month
In the table below, you can do the following:
See and access every individual lead
See estimated home value, equity, mortgage balance, the date for the last email that was sent to them, and the total number of emails sent to that lead
Perform actions such as viewing the Home Report, sending one immediately, pausing the Home Report, and deleting the Home Report
If a Home Report is paused then it will
not
count towards the next month's report total.
If you are close to reaching the maximum number of active Home Reports you will see a banner at the top of the page indicating that this is the case and you will also receive an email notification.
You can also now edit settings for an
Auto Home Report
on this tab.
By editing these settings, leads that match and have all the necessary information in their lead profile will automatically have a Home Report added.
The "Partner Lender" option allows you to choose a lender to automatically be assigned if one has not already been added to a lead. If you have a cost-sharing lender they will be added by default here and cannot be removed.
This feature is available for all Home Report packages (including the free trial).
Learn More
(BETA) Home Report (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/search/click?data=BAh7DjoHaWRsKwibFo%--b505c09e6a3bc34cb228e471a4752839c8b3ab15)
AI Assistant Improvements
Rate Responses
We have made it easier to provide feedback on AI Assistant responses. You can do so in three locations within a lead profile:
(1) Assigned To Section
Hover over the AI Assistant and click on the option to provide feedback. This will allow you to provide general feedback on how the AI Assistant is performing.
(2) Lead Timeline
Click on the hyperlink to "Rate AI Response." This will allow you to provide feedback on that specific AI Assistant response.
(3) Chat Panel
When you are reviewing an AI conversation in the chat panel, you can click the link at the top to provide feedback as well.
Your feedback will be documented and reviewed by our team for implementation within the AI Assistant logic if appropriate. You will receive an email informing you of what action has been taken for your AI Assistant feedback so that you are aware that your feedback is valuable.
Enterprise Settings
If you are on Lofty's Enterprise product, Group Owners can now add their own AI Assistant and extend its functionality down to the members of their group/subgroups.
Previously, they were unable to share the AI Assistant functionality with those underneath them in the hierarchy.
Please note that the AI Assistant will currently still use the Enterprise "Company Name" when introducing itself to leads, though this will be optimized in the future to reference the group name if possible.
Manual Assignment of Seller Objectives
We released an update as part of Lofty
3.48 (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/6071299038619#id-5/19/22:FeatureReleaseTrainingforChime3.48-AIAssistantImprovements)
that allows you to identify a specific seller objective for the AI Assistant to take when interacting with leads. With this update, the feature is now live for the mobile app in addition to the web app.
Learn More:
AI Assistant / Chatbot Qualification Process (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/search/click?%3D--4f15e7138d1f4a159554c620a77c5fecfe7d02e0)
Social Studio Optimizations
We have added a new
Quick Post
block to the Social Studio. The post content can be shuffled to generate new ideas if you would like. This section will generate suggested post content using the following scenarios:
Listing Post
"My Listings" that have never been posted via Social Studio
"Team Listings" that came to market in the last seven days
Landing Page Post
Landing pages that have been created in the last seven days
Blog Post
Blog posts that have been created in the last seven days
Holiday Posts
Any upcoming holidays (that post content is available for) within the next seven days
Clicking on the option to use the
Quick Post
will automatically populate default content that you can then edit before posting to your social channels:
Auto-Post Team Listings
With this update, you can also auto-post team listings if you are subscribed to the
Social Studio Pro
solution (add-on). Access it by clicking on the
Social Auto-Post
button in the top-right and then clicking on the tab for
Auto-Post Listing Rules
.
The column for "Team Listings" is new and will allow you to auto-post if your Lofty teammates have listings that you can also use to drive traffic to.
You will be asked to confirm that you have their permission to promote their listings before you can enable this setting.
Engaged Leads
The reporting page for each individual social post will now show "Engaged Leads"
and
"New Leads" instead of just new leads. This is good information to track because a social post can be intended for existing leads instead of just for new lead capture.
Both of these numbers are clickable and will take you to the leads who have engaged with your post or were newly captured.
Learn More:
Social Studio (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/search/click?%3D--0eaa1630d243cd76aacc867921eef15e42dec76e)
Landing Pages: Neighborhood Template
You can now create a landing page using the neighborhood/featured area functionality. You can customize the forced registration pop-up content and trigger rules.
Learn More:
Landing Pages (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/search/click?--5bd16ea9343bbcf3aa159b8221b6b3defa40bf51)
Lofty
Blog Tool Optimizations
The
Lofty
Blog Tool has been improved in a few different ways with this update.
First, on the website, your blog posts will display in the same order they appear within the posts list within the CMS settings.
With this release, you can pin one post to the top or you can sort the posts by
published date or updated date to have those appear in that order automatically.
Next, when creating a new blog post, you can now edit the line spacing
and
schedule a specific time for your post to be published:
Finally, when adding a blog block to a specific page on your website, you can now choose which categories you want to display within that block. These categories are assigned when creating blog posts.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Introduction

Lofty
package or feature availability, please contact

).

Tuesday, July 26th, 2022
Summary

Enterprise White Label: Company/Brand Name (#id-7/25/22:FeatureReleaseTrainingforChime3.51-EnterpriseWhiteLabel:Company/BrandName)

Seller Report (#id-7/25/22:FeatureReleaseTrainingforChime3.51-SellerReport)
Lofty
Calendar Scheduling Link: Conflict Checking
An update you have all been waiting for! The scheduling link will now check your calendars for conflicting events to ensure you are not double-booked.
To access this setting, navigate to
Tasks
>
Calendar View
>
My Calendar
>
Settings
:
You will then see the Lofty Calendar and all integrated calendars that you can toggle on and view details to select specific calendars from within that integration.
All selected calendars with appointments will have those time slots removed from available options on your scheduling link.
Learn More: Lofty
Calendar (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/6582612402715-Chime-Calendar)
Enterprise White Label: Company/Brand Name
*Please note that this feature is only available for Enterprise accounts.
In addition to existing white label settings, you can now choose the company/brand name and this will sync to display on the mobile app along with your logo.
Here is where it will be changed on the mobile app:
Learn More:
White Label (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/5584384821275)
Smart Plans: Last Touch Optimizations
We have improved how specific you can get when you use "Last Touch" to trigger a Smart Plan. Instead of having to select all email, text, or call conversation types, you can now get specific as to what type you want to be considered as "Last Touch" for Smart Plan triggering criteria.
With this update, "Last Touch" can be broken down as follows:
Not Contacted
All
Emailed
Property Alerts
This includes Property Alerts, Market Reports, and Market Snapshots sent via
Lofty
.
Smart Plan Auto Emails
Welcome Emails
Manual Emails

Lofty
.
Texted
