Lofty
Private Instance Team Add-On
The Private Instance Team Add-On is an option available to Lofty users on an Enterprise account, which allows them to set up their own lead organization, such as the Pipeline and Segments, as well as set up their own lead routing rules. The Private Instance owner may invite other users to collaborate, as long as they are already members on the primary Enterprise account. Please see our article,
Private Instance Team Add On (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/13759365053339)
, for more information.
Language and Currency Add-On
The Language Translation and Currency Conversion add-on will allow you to automatically translate the language and convert the currency shown on your Lofty website and in your CRM. This is especially helpful if you service an international client base. The feature is a paid add-on that can be found in the Lofty Marketplace. This article will show you how it works and what it looks like for visitors to your Lofty website. Please see our article,
Language Translation and Currency Conversion Add On (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/13764506865947)
, for more information.
Rename Appointment Organizer to Owner
We have renamed the "Organizer" on the appointment to "Owner". This allows another Lofty user to "Organize" the appointment, without being the "Owner" of the appointment. For example, an assistant might be contacting leads and setting appointments, but the agent will be the owner of the appointment.
Default Lead Routing Rule Optimization
This update allows for the Default Lead Routing rule to assign leads to the Company Owner, Group Owner, Specific Agent, or Lead Pond. The options available will depend on the scope for which the lead routing rule is set. Reminder, Lofty users must have the Enterprise platform "Manage Lead Distribution" permission or the Team platform "Team Features" permission enabled to access the Lead Routing Rules.
Increase Lead and Transaction Note Fields
When adding notes to the lead profile or transaction, the notes field will expand for longer notes. Previously, a user could add 3 lines of text before needing to scroll to read more. With this optimization, the note field will expand to show 7 lines at once.
Company Number Source and Tag Addition
This new feature adds a Source and Tag that will display when an unknown number calls the account's Company Number and will list that Source and Tag for new leads who are captured via incoming call to the Company Number. An unlimited amount of Company Numbers may be purchased, but only one (1) Source and Tag may be added to the Company Number. This feature also allows the Ads team to create a Company Number to service Google Ads.
Adding a Source and Tag to the Company Number
To add a Source and Tag to the Company Number, first edit the Company Number
When a phone number that is not associated with a lead calls the Company Number, and is not answered by the Agent, the notification will have the following information:
Source: (Source added to Company Number)
Phone Number:(Phone number that called)
An option to click to add as a new lead or associate with an existing lead
If this is being added as a New Lead, the lead's Source will be the Source applied to the Company Number and the Tag will be added to the lead's profile
If this is being associated with an existing lead, which already has a Source, the Source applied to the Company Number will be added to the lead's profile as a Tag and the Tag will be also be added to the lead's profile as a Tag
Reminder:
A Lead may have many Tags, but only one (1) Source
Please see
Company Number (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360059630312)
for more information on the Company Number.
Google Local Service Ads (Google LSA)
When a Lofty user purchases Google Local Service Ads, they need a company number to receive calls. Lofty will provide a company number for free with the purchase of the LSA service. After purchasing the ad service, Lofty will apply the Company Number to the account. Each user may only purchase one (1) Google LSA Ads package at a time.
When the Company Number is added, there are certain limitations on that Company Number in the User's CRM:
Any
Lofty
user may purchase the Google LSA service. However, only Admins have access to navigate to Settings → Dialer → Manage Dialer. Once the Company Number has been added for the user in Admin Backend, the Company Number interface will be visible, but the list will show only the applied Company Number, not any other Company Numbers, and this Company Number will only be visible to this user.
If the
Lofty
user can see the Company Number interface (i.e. is an Admin), the Google LSA Company Number will be at the bottom of the list of all visible Company Numbers, and this Company Number will only be visible to this user.
The Source and Tag applied on the admin backend will be :
Source:
Lofty
Paid Lead
Tag
: Google LSA
When the Source and Tag are filled in the Admin Backend, they cannot be edited by the user.
AI Blog Assistant (Beta Release)
We are excited to announce the launch of our latest feature, the ChatGPT-powered AI Blog Assistant, specifically designed for real estate professionals. This powerful tool harnesses the capabilities of ChatGPT to help you create engaging blog posts to promote your listings and reach your target audience.
Effortless Blog Generation
With this new feature, you can effortlessly generate a blog post to promote a listing by simply selecting a property. The AI Blog Assistant will create a well-crafted blog post with a title, emphasizing the property's key features and appealing to potential buyers.
Tailor-Made Content
If you prefer a more customized approach, you can request Blog Assistant to write a blog post by providing a title, tags, and bullet points. Our AI system will use the information you provide to create a professional and engaging blog post that resonates with your target audience.
Continuous Development
This is the first feature we've released that utilizes ChatGPT, and our team is actively researching and developing additional tools to further enhance your real estate efforts. Keep an eye out for updates and improvements as we continue to innovate in this space.
We are offering
10 free trial uses
for every website owner. This limited-time offer allows you to experience the benefits of AI-driven content creation and evaluate the tool's effectiveness in promoting your listings.
There are two (2) ways to access this feature:
CMS Overview
Blog Page
We offer two (2) different types of blogs:
Feature a Listing
The user selects a listing to market and the related listing information will be used to generate a blog post.
General Blog
The user provides a title and a few keywords, and the AI will write a blog post based on that information.
For both blog types, the user will select a length. The lengths are rough estimates, not an exact number of words:
Short = ~ 300 words
Medium = ~ 500 words
Long = ~ 700 words
Important:
The window cannot be closed while the blog is being written. It takes 15-20 seconds to generate a blog post. If the user closes the window before it is complete, the blog will not be written and they will have used up one of their ten (10) allowed blog posts
Note:
For WordPress Blog users we are not offering AI Blog Writing Assistant service so we encourage our users to try
Lofty
Blog.
Vimeo and Facebook Video Integration
This update supports Vimeo and Facebook videos in the Lofty website video block.
New
Lofty
Website Template
Lofty's 7th website template was launched on March 7. This template is a simple black-and-white theme.
This template features new Home and About pages and is largely the 5th template, re-done in black and white. Editing this template is the same as any other website template.
Radius Search on Maps
This feature will allow a Lofty user or a visitor to a Lofty website to select a search area by radius, in addition to the polygon search. When "Radius" is selected, the user provides an address and a 1-mile radius will appear by default. The radius may be expanded up to 10 miles.
The radius search is also available in the Listings Discovery page:
As well as on the Lofty website listing pages:
Auto Property Alert Source Settings
The new setting allows users to deactivate Automated Property Alerts, Market Snapshots, and Market Reports, based on the lead's Source.
Checking the box next to the source will deactivate that Source for these automated alerts. That is, leads from that Source will not receive the alert emails. The user can select different Sources for each of these three types of alerts. That is, if a Source is excluded from Property Alerts, it will not automatically be excluded from Market Snapshots or Market Reports.
Improved Home Report Cost Splitting
This update allows Lofty users to split the cost of Home Report with a lender via the marketplace when the Lofty user has already bought the package on their own.
Splitting Costs with a Lender
When the cost split request is made, the Lender has 2 days to approve of the cost split. If the Lender does not approve, the agent will be charged the full amount.
If the agent is upgrading the package and inviting a Lender to split costs, the package will be upgraded immediately and the agent will pay the difference themselves. For example:
If the Agent is on the Starter Home Report package and paying themselves, they are currently paying $59/month
If this Agent wants to upgrade to the Basic Home Report package and split the cost with a Lender, the Agent will pay $40 now to upgrade ($99 - $59)
Next pay period (the first of the next month), if the Lender has approved, the Agent and the Lender will each pay $49.50
Lofty
Support Lead Import Improvement
This update allows all
Lofty
users to request
Lofty
tech support assistance with Lead Import for the first 30 days they are a member of their
Lofty
account.
Zapier Transaction Integration
This update supports Transaction-related synchronization with third parties via Zapier.
Lofty
→ Zapier

as a Trigger

can synchronize the following fields to other third-party providers:

Logic
Parsing is supported for the following date format：
yyyy-mm-dd：2001-08-24
mm/dd/yy：08/24/01
mm-dd-yy：08-24-01
dd/mm/yyyy：24/08/2001
Apr 11, 2022
dd.mm (http://dd.mm/)
.
yyyy ：24.08.2001
Sync Logic:
First, find whether the transaction owner's email is an existing team member
If not, the transaction sync will fail
If yes, then check to see if the same lead (by email) is assigned to the transaction owner.
If yes, then the transaction will be created for this lead, or if this transaction already exists on this lead, update the transaction.
If not, Lofty will create the lead as a team lead, assign it to the transaction owner first, and then create the transaction for the lead.
Questions?

Do Not Contact Updates
We have released several updates to
Lofty
's Do Not Contact settings, outlined below:
Terminate Call Recording
Lofty
users are able to stop recording a call that is in progress when using a
Lofty
calling package. If the recording is stopped, it cannot be turned on again during that call. Call recording will be enabled again for the next call.
Disclaimer Pop-Ups
Voice Message Disclaimer
For new
Lofty
users, the Default Outbound Voice Message will be removed:
When a Voice Message is added, a pop-up will disclose the mandatory disclaimer language:
Slybroadcast Disclaimer
When you connect to Slybroadcast, a pop-up will disclose the mandatory disclaimer language:
Multi-line Dialer Disclaimer
When you dial a call list with 2 or 3 lines, a pop-up will disclose the mandatory disclaimer language:
Text Subscription Message
Toggling this setting on will add the following copy to the
first text message
(manual or automated) sent to any lead:
"If you’d rather not communicate by text message, reply with “unsubscribe”"
Text Unsubscribe Logic
The lead will be unsubscribed from receiving text messages and they will be opted out of receiving text messages if the lead responds at
any time
with the following in a message alone (i.e. not if these words are contained in a sentence):
Unsubscribe
Stop
Cancel
End
Quit
The lead can be manually opted back into receiving text messages by the
Lofty
user.
Unsubscribe Confirmation Text
Once the lead has unsubscribed, the following confirmation message will be auto-sent:
"
You have successfully been unsubscribed. You will not receive any more messages from this number. Reply START to resubscribe.”
If the lead responds with "Start", they will be opted back into receiving text messages.
Call/Text/Email Opt-In Status in Lead Capture and API Integration Settings
Navigate to Settings → Lead Capture → Lead Capture Settings
This setting will allow you to decide if leads coming from certain sources should be opted in or out of calls, texts, and emails:
Note: This setting is not verifying that the leads' information is valid. By default, this setting will be toggled On for all sources. If there is a source that is not providing reliable lead data, we recommend toggling Off for that source.
Direct access to MLS information in the CRM
Several UI updates have been made to the Listings Discovery Page. You can view the listing details directly in the CRM without jumping to a new webpage.
When clicking on a listing, the listing details will slide out from the right side, rather than redirect to the Lofty website:
You may click through Media, Details, Map, History, and Mortgage to see all of the listing information.
Click the Computer icon to open the listing page on the
Lofty
website:
Click the arrow icon in the middle to create a social media post:
Click the "..." icon to send the listing to leads, create a CMA, or create a text code:
When clicking the listing agent name, the user may email, call, or text the agent directly through the Lofty CRM, or click the agent's name to see additional information:
When checking the box next to a listing, the options menu will now open on the top, rather than replacing the side menu:
Lead Source Customization
This feature allows you to customize the Source for lead capture providers. To access, navigate to Settings → Lead Capture → Lead Capture Settings:
Here, the Source that appears on the lead profile can be updated to any source that has been created in the CRM:
When changing the Source, you must confirm on the pop-up:
Zillow and Realtor lead capture is set up in Settings → Lead Capture. Custom sources may also be set for both:
Personal Lead Routing
Lead Routing has been redesigned to support a personal lead routing option. This means that all Lofty users, regardless of lead routing permission, now have access to some level of lead routing.
New Lead Options
First, the New Leads button has been relocated, and the settings within the button have been updated:
A
ll
Lofty
users
regardless of permission level will have access to lead routing settings. However, anyone without the Manage Lead Distribution (Enterprise)/Team Features (Team) permission enabled can only set up lead routing rules for leads coming from his/her personal lead capture sources. This allows them to assign leads from their own lead capture source to another agent on your account.
The New Lead Options have been redefined by the scope of the lead:
Company/Team Source:
Company/Team website
By default, leads will be routed at the Company/Team level
Group Source (Enterprise):
Group Website
You have the option to route leads at the Company level, the Group level, or access the advanced settings:
Within the Advanced Settings, leads from a Group's website may be routed either at that Group level or at the Company level:
Personal Source
Agent Website
Third-Party Providers
Open API
Zillow
Zapier
Open House Form（Only Team Owner has this option, all other member's open house leads will be assigned to themselves directly)
Facebook Ads-Lead Form
Leads from the above sources may be routed via the Personal, Group (Enterprise), or Company/Team Level
How To Set Up Lead Routing Rules
Every
Lofty
user, regardless of permission level, now has the ability to set their own personal lead routing rules.
Lofty
users with Manage Lead Distribution (Enterprise)/Team Features (Team) permission enabled can set up the Company and Group level lead routing rules.
What users with
Lead distribution-Entire Company
permission can set:
New lead options：
Company Source
Group Source
Personal Source
Routing Rules：
Company-Level Routing Rules
Group Level Routing Rules
Personal Routing Rules
What users with
Lead distribution-User's Group
permission can set:
New lead options：
Personal Source
Routing Rules：
Group Level Routing Rules
Personal Routing Rules
What users with
no
Lead distribution permission can set:
New lead options：
Personal Source
Routing Rules
Personal Routing Rules
Third-Party Providers and Open API
By default, new lead options for third-party providers and open API will be set to your personal routing. That is, leads from these sources will automatically be assigned to you. If you want these leads to process through lead routing to be assigned to another user, you may click "Click to Set" to send these leads through either the Company/Team or Group level:
Lofty
users who do not have any lead routing permissions enabled are still able to set up lead routing rules. In order for these rules to allocate leads to other
Lofty
users on your account, you must set the scope for that lead source to either Company/Team or Group. The process for setting up lead routing rules is the same as any other
Lofty
account:
For more information on Lead Routing Rules, please see our Help Center article:
Lead Routing Rules (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055177831)
Smart Plan Reassignment Group Action
You can now add a new Smart Plan step, "Reassignment Group":
This is a great option for any Lofty users who want to mass reassign their leads. As a refresher, the Reassignment Groups Help Center article is here:
Reassignment Groups (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360061564771)
Note:
When the Reassignment Group Action is applied to multiple leads, the New Lead notification for each Lead is queued and sent to the Reassignment Group Assignee in turn. That is, if you are re-routing hundreds of leads to an agent, that agent will get hundreds of "New Lead" notifications.
If multiple Smart Plans have Reassignment Group actions, they will be executed in chronological order.
The Reassignment Group action is
not available
for Private Leads. If a Private Lead reaches a Reassignment Group action in a Smart Plan, that step will be skipped and recorded in the Smart Plan Log.
There will be Smart Plan Logs for the following:
The Reassignment Group action starts
The Reassignment Group action ends
When the lead gets to the Reassignment Group action, but the Reassignment Group has been deleted
When a private lead gets to the Reassignment Group action and that smart plan step is skipped
Domain Configuration Optimization
This changes the flow of configuring a
Lofty
website domain.
Before: Select domain → Configure Domain or save for later → Apply MLS
After: Select domain → can only save for later → Apply MLS
When you are ready to configure their domain, they will navigate to CMS → Settings → Domain and click Configure:
Please see our Help Center article on Domain Configuration for more details on configuring your website domain to your Lofty website:
Domain Configuration Guide (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360054554712)
GoDaddy Direct Integration
If the vanity domain is hosted on GoDaddy, we can directly connect without navigating to GoDaddy and manually configuring the records. The system will detect if the domain is hosted on GoDaddy, and if so, an authorization pop-up with begin the configuration:
Website List Export
If you have a Lofty website, you will have the ability to download all of the websites that you can see to a CSV file. To access this setting, navigate to the CMS tool:
The CSV file will have the following columns:
Domain
Type
Owner
Template
Create Time
If there are subdomains, the spreadsheet will also have a column for the parent website.
Auto-Post Social Profile Management
If you have a paid version of Social Studio (Pro or Team) you can select which social profiles will be involved in the auto-post. Previously,
all
connected social profiles would have the post auto-posted.
To access this setting, navigate to Campaigns → Social Studio → Settings → Auto-post Settings → Auto-Post Listing Rules
When a listing status is toggled on for either "Team Listings" or "My Listings", all social profiles that have been connected to the Lofty account will automatically be applied to the auto-post:
Click the edit icon to remove any of the social profiles:
Checking the box next to "Apply to All Auto-Posts" will set these social profiles for all enabled auto-posts:
Boost Post Promotion Optimization
A few features have been added that are designed to encourage you to utilize our Boost Post feature. As a refresher, the Help Center article on Boost Post is here:
Boost Post (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/10989407456283)
Notification
A new email notification has been added to the notifications section, located in Settings → Notifications. When
this is enabled, you will receive an email notification when your social media post has a below-average impression score
:
Promotion
When a landing page is published, a pop-up will encourage you to boost the landing page:
Google Local Service Ads Self-Purchase
Important:
This feature will be available on Friday, April 14
Important:
Google Local Service Ads are not available in Canada
Google Local Service Ads are now available for purchase in the
Lofty
Marketplace:
The button on the pop-up window will vary, based on if the user has purchased LSA before:
If they have never purchased LSA:
Button = Buy Now
You will be guided to the purchase page
If they have purchased LSA:
Button = View Data
You will be guided to the report page
Purchase Page
A new page will be added to the Campaigns section, which includes an introduction to the feature and the purchase options.
Purchasing Google Local Service Ads:
Lowest Budget = $600 with a 20% service fee
Set up fee for first-time purchase = $99
Company Number and AI Assistant included
Once the ads are purchased, you will continue to the settings page
Settings Page
Step 1: Connect your Google Business Page
Step 2: Select a Company Number
Step 3: Submit Your Information
Step 4: You may click Save and come back later or click Buy Now to complete the purchase
Once submitted, the information cannot be changed, as it is submitted to Google for review
LSA Report
All leads that contact the Google LSA phone number will be available in the LSA campaign page. If the lead name is not available, the Customer Name field will be "LSA Unknown Lead" and the lead's source will be "
Lofty
Paid Lead".
To add these leads to the CRM People Page, click "Convert to Lead"
If the Customer Name field is blank, it must be filled to convert the lead.
Clicking the down arrow next to a lead will allow you to see that lead's activities:
Google Local Service Ads IVR Service
Important:
This feature will be available on Friday, April 14
When a potential lead calls the Company Number that is associated with Google Local Service Ads, they will encounter an IVR service to welcome to lead and collect information.
Initially, we will offer three (3) options to the lead:
The lead is looking for more information about buying or selling a property
The lead is an agent with questions about listings
The lead has questions about administrative issues.
Once the lead has made their selection, the phone call will be automatically transferred to your phone. If you are unable to answer, the lead may leave a message, which will be recorded in the
Lofty
CRM.
Geographic Farming UI Update
Important:
Geographic Farming Homeowner Shop is not available in Canada
This moves the Homeowner Shop to step 1 when starting a new Geographic Farming campaign:
If you do not want to purchase homeowner data, and instead create a campaign using homeowner data you already own, you may click "Skip" to move on to building the campaign:

#### Article 612: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.63

- Article ID: `14964770201755`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T01:55:02Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/14964770201755-Feature-Updates-for-Lofty-3-63

Introduction
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time. Please see our Learning Center course on this update
HERE (https://learningcenter.chime.me/courses/chime-v363)
. Having trouble accessing the course? This article will show you how to access the Lofty Learning Center:
How to Access the Lofty Learning Center (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/13857197513115)
Release Date
Friday, May 5th, 2023.
Summary
Transaction Custom Field Update (#h_01GZM3TK6Q50AZNF18GHYAZQMV)
Transaction Forms (#h_01GZM3TWG6FS0DEABFXKYSYTTS)
Creating a New Form (#id-5/3/2023:FeatureReleaseTrainingforChime3.63-CreatingaNewForm)
Viewing the Form on a Transaction (#id-5/3/2023:FeatureReleaseTrainingforChime3.63-Viewingtheformonatransaction)
Lead Pond Task Optimization (#h_01GZM40XN500X3HHWN4W39DHTE)
Featured Listing Tag on Lofty Websites (#h_01GZM4A3PCRF386CPRZ3E51WD0)
Lofty Website Footer Update (#h_01GZM4M7YV58TMVH3ZV114NKD8)
Home Report Email Template Update (#h_01GZM4S7DWPEGNA5AE6W4AKRSZ)
Bilingual Feeds for Centris MLS (#h_01GZM4SHSW6ZZE53CJP1FT66RB)
Canadian Census Subdivision Addition (#h_01GZM52Y1N5FVPYH6N9A0D40GH)
AI Assistant: Listing URL Recognition (#h_01GZM5J7N1A32KP3E8MNPGSG29)
AI Assistant: Chat Message UI Update (#h_01GZM5JG62H0TC3J1HQRZXFF5V)
Enterprise Lead Routing: Hierarchy Group Assignment Level (#h_01H01D8F0BRSKZY07NMFWXVB6Z)
Enterprise Lead Routing: Add a Step (#h_01H01D8TM64ZMJM2EG79JH4NST)
AI Email and Text Generator (#h_01H01D933GCHVA86W7GANTCM37)
Transaction Custom Field Update
Available To:
All
Lofty
Account Types
Permissions Required:
Company/Team Features
This update allows for for additional transaction custom fields, beyond just date-based custom fields. Transaction custom fields have been moved. To access this feature, navigate to
Settings → Transaction Forms → Transaction Custom Field Management
You must have either the Company Features (Enterprise accounts) or Team Features (Core/Premier accounts) permission enabled to access this feature.
There are two (2) options for Transaction Fields, Standard Fields and Custom Fields.
Standard fields are pre-built into
Lofty
and cannot be edited. These fields can be hidden. If hidden, they will not display in
Lofty
Transaction Forms.
Custom fields may be added by selecting the "Custom Fields" tab and clicking "+ Add New".
When added a customer field, the following types of data are available:
Date
Text
Number
Percentage
Currency
Dropdown
To add a field, give the field a name and select the data type. Click "Confirm" to save the field.
Once the field has been added, it may be edited or deleted. The full list of custom fields will be available, along with the Lofty user who created the field and the Lofty user who last modified the field.
To add these custom transaction fields to a transaction, they must be added to a transaction form.
Transaction Forms
Available To:
All
Lofty
Account Types
Permissions Required:
Company/Team Features
This feature allows
Lofty
users with the Company/Team Features permission to create custom forms that will apply to their account transactions. Users without this permission cannot see the Transaction Form section in account settings. The forms will apply to the entire account, there is no separate permission or setting for Group level transaction forms.
To access this feature, navigate to
Settings → Transaction Forms
Forms may be created for the four (4) different types of transactions:
Purchase
Listing
Lease
Other
There are two (2) default forms that have already been created.
Dates
Property
Fields can be deleted from these forms by clicking the Trashcan icon. The field order can be changed by clicking and dragging the three lines icon. The default forms can be edited by clicking the Setting cogwheel icon.
Creating a New Form
First, select the type of transaction and click "+ Add New Form". Remember, Transaction Forms are specific to the type of transaction:
Next, the transaction form may be created within the pop-up. Any transaction fields that are not currently on a transaction form will be available to add to the form, and each transaction field can only be on one (1) transaction form. This is because, when a transaction is created, all available transaction forms will automatically be added to a transaction. If the same field is on multiple forms, then you would need to fill out redundant information.
To add a field to the form, click the "+" icon next to the field. To remove a field from the form, click the red circle icon next to the field.
Name the form and select the transaction type, then click "Confirm" to create the form.
Now, the form will be available in the list of forms for that transaction type.
Viewing the Form on a Transaction
When a transaction is created, any forms created for that transaction type will automatically be added for you to input the information. This includes the default forms for Dates and Property. Click "Edit" to complete the form. The Settings icon will take you back to the Transaction Forms section, and allow you to edit the form.
Lofty users without the Company/Team Features permission enabled will still have all available transaction forms automatically populate on their transactions, but they do not have the option to alter the form.
Lead Pond Task Optimization
Available To:
All
Lofty
Account Types
Permissions Required:
Lead Pond/Team Features
Previous Lead Pond Logic:
When a lead was assigned to a Lead Pond, any remaining tasks on that lead were assigned to the Team/Company/Group owner by default.
Optimized Lead Pond Logic:
When a lead is assigned to a Lead Pond, any remaining tasks on that lead are assigned to the Lead Pond owner by default.
Note:
When a lead is assigned to a Lead Pond, only tasks that are generated by Company/Group/Team Smart Plans will be retained and assigned to the Lead Pond owner. All other tasks will be automatically deleted.
That is, if a task was added manually or created as part of a private Smart Plan, that task will be deleted from the lead profile.
Featured Listing Tag on
Lofty
Websites
Available To:
All
Lofty
Account Types that have a
Lofty
Website
Permissions Required:
Manage Website/Manage Team Website
This feature displays an "Exclusive Listing" tag on company/team listings on the
Lofty
website. The setting is located in
CMS → Settings → Listings → Listing Tag
Users with permissions will be able to customize the tag name (the words on the tag) and decide if the tags appear or are hidden on all
Lofty
websites under the Company/Team website. The color of the tag is Green and is not customizable. By default, the tag will be
hidden
.
The tag is visible on both web and mobile versions of the
Lofty
website.
This setting is only available on Company/Team level websites. It is not available on Agent or Group websites. If the setting is enabled for the Company/Team website, the tag will be visible on all Team Listings on every website under the Company/Team website.
Lofty
Website Footer Update
Available To:
Enterprise
Lofty
Accounts
Permissions Required:
Manage Website
This update allows Enterprise Lofty accounts to customize the company name in the footer of their Lofty company website. The dropdown menu will display the company name and all upper-level group names, as well as provide the option to enter a custom name.
Home Report Email Template Update
Available To:
All
Lofty
Accounts
Permissions Required:
None
This is an update to the Home Report email template. The following changes have been made:
The color of the header of the Home Report email will be pulled from the website settings, to better match your brand.
The design is more mobile-friendly.
Bilingual Feeds for Centris MLS
Available To:
Centris MLS Members
Permissions Required:
None
Centris MLS is based in Quebec, Canada. This update automatically enables an option for
Lofty
website visitors to switch between Centris MLS's original French and English language feeds.
Please Note: There is no setting for this feature, it will automatically be enabled on the
Lofty
website for users who are members of Centris MLS.
y
ou can check it by going to the listing detail page, when you switch language, the property description will be switched, and so are the other fields.
Canadian Census Subdivision Addition
Available To:
All Canadian
Lofty
Accounts
Permissions Required:
None
This feature is a new area type for Canadian Lofty websites' Featured Areas. You may now search for areas by "Census Subdivision".
To access this feature, navigate to
CMS Tool -> Settings → Featured Areas
AI Assistant: Listing URL Recognition
Available To:
All
Lofty
AI Assistant Users
Permissions Required:
None
With this feature update, the AI Assistant will be able to check listing URLs that are sent by leads and be able to recognize listing details, such as the address, listing status, and open house schedule. You will be notified when a lead is sending a URL via chat on the
Lofty
website. The AI Assistant has two (2) scripts to follow, depending on if the listing is active or inactive:
Active Listing
Okay, I'll let my colleague know that you're interested in {listing_address}, this listing is currently {listing_status}, and the next open-house is {openhouse_time). Are you interested in seeing it? Do you have any questions about the listing or the buying process? My colleague is available any time by calling {agent_phone}. Also, you can book a time when you are available {calendar link}. We are looking forward to hearing your voice!
Inactive Listing
Is {listing_address} the property you want to know more about? The listing is currently {listing_status}. My colleague is happy to find something similar for you! Do you have time for our agent to call you? Please schedule some time at this link{calendar link} or call {agent_phone} anytime.
Notification
Note:
The lead has sent a listing URL. Please contact the lead ASAP.
There is no setting to turn this off, as leads rarely send URLs to the AI Assistant. However, when they do, the AI Assistant will be able to take action.
AI Assistant: Chat Message UI Update
Available To:
All
Lofty
AI Assistant Users
Permissions Required:
None
This is an update to the lead timeline UI, which helps clients distinguish between AI Assistant text messages and chat messages on the Lofty website.
Any messages sent between the lead and the AI Assistant chat box on the Lofty website will be labeled in the lead's timeline as "Site Message".
When a text message has been delivered, a status of "Delivered" will be added to the lead's timeline.
Enterprise Lead Routing: Hierarchy Group Assignment Level
Available To:
Enterprise
Lofty
Accounts
Permissions Required:
Manage Lead Distribution - Entire Company
Can assign leads to all Groups and Sub-Groups in the Hierarchy
Manage Lead Distribution - User's Group
Can assign leads to all users in their Group, but not Sub-Groups
This feature allows Enterprise
Lofty
Accounts to assign leads directly to all of the agents within a Hierarchy Group, without sending the leads through that Group's lead routing rules. When a user is added or removed from the Hierarchy Group, they will simultaneously be added or removed from the lead routing rule rotation.
To access this feature, navigate to
Settings → Lead Routing → + Add New
. This feature is located in the
Assignment
section of the lead routing rule.
New leads will be assigned directly to the Agents, so select
Agent
as the
Assignment Level
. Next, to assign new leads to all users within the Hierarchy Group, select
Assign to all users in selected groups
and add the Groups and Subgroups you want to include. All Groups will have the same assignment percentage. That is, you cannot allocate more leads to users within one Hierarchy Group.
The
Assignment Rules
are the same as any other lead routing rule. Leads may be assigned via the following ways:
Round Robin
Selecting Round Robin will assign new leads in the order of users in the Hierarchy Group
That is, leads will be assigned, one by one, to the users at the top of the list, starting with the selected Hierarchy Group at the top of the list.
If a new user is added, and they are between two users who have already received a lead, the next lead will go to that new user and the next new lead will continue where the list left off.
Next Up
Next Up is similar to Round Robin, except that users must contact the lead within a certain time period or the next user in line gets the opportunity to claim the lead.
New leads will progress through the order of users, exactly the same as the Round Robin rule, each user will have equal opportunity to claim leads.
Blast Alert
Blast Alert sends an opportunity to claim the lead to all users at the same time.
Enterprise Lead Routing: Add a Step
If the Assignment Rule is either Next Up or Blast Alert, we have added the option to add up to nine (9) additional steps to assign the lead. This is
only available for Enterprise lead routing
, but is available for all lead assignment levels, not just the Hierarchy Group assignment level outlined above.
Next Up and Blast Alert assignment rules require a user to claim the lead. Previously, if no users claimed the lead, the lead would continue through lead routing, either matching with another rule or being assigned via the default rule.
Opting to "Add a Step" allows the user setting up the rule to send the new lead through another round of lead routing. Up to nine (9) additional steps can be added to each lead routing rule. This option is
not available to Team packages
, this is only an Enterprise feature.
Clicking "Add a Step" will provide the user another
Assignment
section, to send new leads that qualify for this lead routing rule through another round of lead routing. "Add a Step" is only available for Next Up and Blast Alert assignment rules, as there is the possibility that the new lead will not be claimed on the first round.
AI Email and Text Generator
Available To:
All
Lofty
Users
Permissions Required:
None
This feature is similar to the AI Blog Writing tool, released in
Feature Updates for Lofty 3.61 (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/13661723058843)
With this update, all
Lofty
users can utilize AI to help them write emails and text messages. The feature can be found in the email editor, text editor, and the Workspace. A small icon that looks like a pencil with magic dust will open the AI writing assistant.
We offer three (3) pre-built generation options:
Schedule a Call
Follow up with the lead
Self Introduction
As well as a custom generation, based on prompts provided by you.
An option will also be built into email replies, where the AI will help write a response to the lead.
This is a Beta release. All
Lofty
users will have the following limits on use, which will
reset weekly
:
50 AI-generated text messages
25 AI-generated emails
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 613: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.64

- Article ID: `15782457365787`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T01:54:15Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/15782457365787-Feature-Updates-for-Lofty-3-64

Introduction
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time. Please see our Learning Center course on this update
HERE (https://learningcenter.chime.me/courses/chime-v364)
.
Having trouble accessing the course? This article will show you how to access the Lofty Learning Center:
How to Access the Lofty Learning Center (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/13857197513115)
Release Date
Wednesday, May 31st, 2023.
Summary
Enterprise Permission Update (#h_01H1QE3AXF1H40V7TDZ78A9EMX)
Transaction Commission Optimization (#h_01H1QE3KAQ7X56DY63BR4M3ACX)
Google Local Service Ads - Call Package Adjustment (#h_01H1QE3YP8QSB2QKP8MZ25CJEC)
Google Local Service Ads - AI Assistant Adjustment (#h_01H1QE48846MR6D4XXXMRGRDB0)
Reporting Section - Lead Privacy Filter (#h_01H1QE4H2XXCBVYG8KDZSHXFJ3)
Reporting Section - Data Update Alert (#h_01H1QE4V1TY8G6FKPR77Q2D52S)
Listing Detail - Schools Tab (#h_01H1QE54TA8JVC317GVV7CN1VC)
Lofty Mobile App - AI Email and Text Generator (#h_01H1QE5DMK6F689YS3RHA09Q8V)
Social Studio - Coming Soon Listing Auto Post (#h_01H1QE5NJTHM2QYT4FYD8W4TFD)
Social Studio - YouTube (#h_01H1QE5X2KKVQ969Q7A8RKQWYV)
Listing Showing Management and Showing Invitations (#h_01H1QE665NGBMS9Z18KJV28MFT)
AI Assistant Chat Box Logic Update (#h_01H1QE6DQPSNRRS71927P57G1W)
Enterprise Group Owner - Group Website Purchase (#h_01H1QE6QDZE403KY4RFGEKQB9N)
Enterprise Company Website - Custom Registration Disclaimer (#h_01H1QE6Z3Y9E6RS7RTRZ0MQ3HN)
Enterprise Permission Update
We have updated Lofty Enterprise account permissions so there are more options when setting up permission profiles.
Manage User
Previously, several features were included in one single "Manage User" permission. Now, permission may be individually enabled for the following:
Organization Hierarchy:
Allows the user to edit the organization hierarchy, either for the entire company or just their own group and sub-groups
Permission Profile:
Allows the user to edit/add/delete permission profiles for the entire company
User Management:
Allows the user to add/edit/delete users, either in the entire company or just their own group and sub-groups
System Configuration
Previously, several permissions were included in the single "Company Feature" and "Company Filter" permissions. Now, permission may be individually enabled for the following:
Custom Fields:
Allows the user to create Custom Fields for the lead profile
Transaction Forms:
Allows the user to add/edit/delete transaction forms, as released in
Feature Updates for Lofty 3.63 (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/14964770201755)
AI Assistant:
Allows the user access to the AI Assistant settings
Reporting Goals:
Allows the user access to Reporting Goals for either the entire company or their own group and sub-groups
SSO Setting:
Allows the user access to the Single Sign On settings for the entire company, as released in
Feature Updates for Lofty 3.56 (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/10337984035355)
Lead Privacy Permissions
All lead privacy settings have been moved to the same section. Previously, 'Access All Company Leads' was at the top of the list and other lead privacy settings were towards the bottom.
The permissions themselves have not changed, but there is additional options for the 'Delete Leads' and 'Export Leads' permissions:
Visible by User:
This allows the user to delete or export any leads they can see.
That is, they may not own these leads, if they have permission to view the leads
Owned Only:
This allows the user to delete or export and leads they are assigned to, as the primary agent.
Private Only:
This allows the user to delete or export and of their own private leads.
Website Permissions
Similar to Lead Privacy Permissions, the Website Permissions have been grouped together at the bottom of the permissions list.
Transaction Commission Optimization
This feature builds in commission splits to the Lofty transaction section. When a transaction closes, there are three (3) stages of commission splits:
Pre-Split Adjustments:
These are additions to or deductions from the total amount anyone is paid, before the commission split.
Pre-split adjustments affect the amount everyone is able to be paid.
Split:
This is where the commission splits are entered.
Post-Split Adjustments:
These are additions to or deductions from the total amount paid to those included in the commission split.
Post Split Adjustments only affect those outlined in this section.
This features comes into play when a transaction is closed. Navigate to the Transaction section and mark the transaction stage as
closed
. A form will pop-up to fill in the Close Price, calculate GCI and enter the Splits:
A GCI (Gross Commission Income) calculator has been added, to quickly calculate the amount for the GCI field:
Next, add the Pre-Split Adjustments by clicking
+ Add/Deduct
. Up to ten (10) may be added. Here, you have the opportunity to add or deduct other expenses from the GCI. Here, see that we added $50, which then added that $50 to the total GCI:
When Deduct is selected, note that the total GCI has been reduced by $50:
Scroll to the bottom at any time to see the current state of the commission payment. After the Pre-Split Adjustment, here is the current commission payment:
Next, add the commission Splits by clicking
+ Add/Deduct
. Up to ten (10) may be added. In the Paid To section, you may select the Team, and Agent on the account, or any Vendor/Partner who has been added to the account. Note, the calculator assists with percentage splits:
Scroll to the bottom to see the updated state of the commission payment. After the Commission Split, here is the current commission payment:
The final section is the Post-Split Adjustments. Up to five (5) post-split adjustments may be added for each Commission Split. Since we only included the Test Agent in the Commission Split, we only have the option to make Post-Split Adjustments to their commission amount. In this example, we will say that fellow agent Group Owner owes them $5 for coffee:
Scrolling to the bottom, we see that Group Owner's payment decreased by $5 and Test Agent's increased by $5, while the Team Net Commission remained unchanged:
Google Local Service Ads - Call Package Adjustment
Google Local Service Ads, released in
Feature Updates for Lofty 3.61 (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/13661723058843)
, requires a calling package to function. If you do not have a calling package, you will be required to select one when self-purchasing Google Local Service Ads:
Google Local Service Ads - AI Assistant Adjustment
This update provides a free AI Assistant to Google LSA users, which will work to qualify new leads from these ads. When a new lead registers via the Google Local Services Ads, the AI Assistant will reach out with the following message:
Hi there! I am {Assistant_name} from {company_name}. Thanks for reaching out from our Local Service Ads! We are happy to help you! Do you mind if I ask about your needs? Are you looking to buy or sell a home?
Reporting Section - Lead Privacy Filter
This update adds a filter for lead privacy, which will allow you to better calculate agent performance and reporting goals, while still obscuring details on lead privacy. The lead privacy filter has been added to the reporting tab:
Reporting Section - Data Update Alert
If you have a large amount of data in your Lofty account, you may experience delays when updating the Reporting page. This update adds a warning when data is taking some time to update, and informs you that you may leave the page while the data loads.
If you close the window and close the pop-up, the data will not load, so you may exit the page without refreshing the data.
Listing Detail - Schools Tab
This update adds a "Schools" tab on the listing detail page, as well as ratings provided by greatschools.org. We currently only support this feature for US based MLSs.
Lofty Mobile App - AI Email and Text Generator
This is an update to the AI Email and Text Generator, released in
Feature Updates for Lofty 3.63 (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/14964770201755)
. This feature is now available in the Lofty mobile app. The functionality is the same, and the weekly quotas are also the same. That is, all Lofty users will have the ability to draft 50 AI-generated text messages and 25 AI-generated emails, regardless of whether they are using the web or mobile app.
The icon and AI options for this feature are the same in the mobile app as in the web app:
Social Studio - Coming Soon Listing Auto Post
This update provides a new Social Studio Auto Post; Coming Soon Listings. Auto Post listings are available to all Lofty users who have purchased
Advanced Social Studio (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/14483489366427)
Currently, "coming soon" listings are treated as "new listings", however, some MLSs prohibit the promotion of "coming soon" listings. With this update, you can enable or disable auto-posts for listing with a status of "coming soon". By default, this type of auto-post will be toggled OFF.
This auto-post option may be enabled and the default content may be edited in the "Auto-Post Settings":
Social Studio - YouTube
YouTube is now an available social media option for all Social Studio users. To connect a YouTube profile, navigate to
Campaigns → Social Studio → Settings → Manage Profiles
YouTube only supports video posts and there is a 50 MB file size limit. When creating the YouTube post, the following settings are available:
Title
Tag
Category
Privacy
When a YouTube post fails to upload, you will receive an email notification. Typically, posts will fail due to the account not meeting YouTube's requirements or the authorization has expired.
Listing Showing Management and Showing Invitations
The Listing Showing Configuration tool is a new feature that allows Lofty and non-Lofty users to configure showing times, schedule showings, and manage to show requests and appointments.
Lofty User Listing Agents
Listing Showing Configuration
To configure the showing options for your listing, first, navigate to
Listings → My Listings → Manage Listing:
If this is the first time setting up the Showing Configuration for this listing, click the
Showing Configuration
button in the upper right corner. If you are editing the showing configuration, click
Actions → Showing Configuration:
Here, you may set up the showing details, such as the available times, whether approvals are done manually or automatically, and any information the buyer's agent will need to access the property:
When complete, click
Save
to confirm the showing details.
The scheduling link is located in the upper right corner of the Showing Configuration page. Click the icon to copy the link. This link may be shared in the
MLS private notes
for interested buyers' agents to access. When clicking the showing request link, all agents, whether they are Lofty users or not, may request to show the listing. Here is an example showing the request page:
Managing Showing Requests
You may approve or deny any showing requests on the Smart Listing page for the listing:
Scheduled showings can also be viewed in the Lofty Calendar, on the Tasks view:
Non-Lofty User Listing Agents
Listing Showing Configuration
When non-Lofty users request a showing time via the link, they will be prompted to sign up for Lofty's property showing feature:
Once an account has been created, non-Lofty users can create their own showing links, by clicking
+ Create Showing Link
:
Next, they may add the listing details and set up the showing details, just like the feature for Lofty users:
Managing Showing Requests
Non-Lofty users also have a dashboard to approve and deny showing requests, as well as track their own scheduled showings:
Lofty User Buyer Agents
Scheduling Showings
When requesting a showing,
Lofty
users will be prompted to sign in to their
Lofty
account to continue:
Managing Showing Requests
Lofty
users may access their requested showings via the Calendar Tasks view:
Non-Lofty User Buyer Agents
Scheduling Showings
Non-
Lofty
users will be prompted to create an account to log in to the showings tool. If they have previously created an account, they may sign in to request a showing and view their other requests.
Note: This is not a log-in to a
Lofty
account. This only allows them to manage their showings and showing requests.
Managing Showing Requests
Non-
Lofty
users may access their requested showings via the link they will receive via email after registering on a
Lofty
user's showing request link.
AI Assistant Chat Box Logic Update
With this update, the AI Assistant chatbox on the Lofty website can only be disabled in the CRM. In the CMS chatbox settings, you will see the following message, if the AI Assistant has been enabled:
The setting is located in the CRM
Settings → AI Assistant → Live Chat on Website:
If you do not own the AI Assistant, you will see the following message in the CMS chatbox settings, which directs you to reach out to the AI Assistant owner:
Enterprise Group Owner - Group Website Purchase
This update allows Enterprise Group Owners to purchase Group Websites for their own Hierarchy Group and any Sub-Groups within that Hierarchy Group.
Enterprise Company Website - Custom Registration Disclaimer
This update allows up to three (3) custom disclaimers to be added to the Lofty website lead registration pop-up. This is a setting on the Company website and, when enabled, will also be enabled for all group/agent/subdomain websites on the account. Leads will be required to check the box next to the disclaimer
to complete registration on the
Lofty
website.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Introduction
Important:

These features are subject to change at any time. Please see our Learning Center course on this update
HERE (https://learningcenter.chime.me/courses/chime-v365)
.
Having trouble accessing the course? This article will show you how to access the Lofty Learning Center:
How to Access the Lofty Learning Center (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/13857197513115)
Release Date
Monday, June 26th, 2023.
Summary
Agent List Page Optimization (#h_01H3G0JH2K1VNFSFG83ZFATN8Z)
Agent Tag Management (#h_01H3G1A5KSPYXGPG18AND8BJVT)
Lead Appointment Optimization (#h_01H3G4D1WNAG3DC6N9ETRQPP61)
Calendar Optimization (#h_01H3G4D94Y7AJYSEHG0T1DVQG5)
Enterprise Agent Filter on People Page Optimization (#h_01H3G4DGQJW1D7A332GSAK8BZJ)
Lead Pond Mobile App Optimization (#h_01H3G4DQXJE25H55EAJBGDA14W)
Multilingual URL Structure (#h_01H3G4DYQBP4GJK6F0P5VW1D95)
AI Social Post Writing Assistant (#h_01H3G4E68NW14K659X9EKZ0PH5)
New Onboarding Dashboard (#h_01H3G4EFZN9Q7D9YWNWA6GHTS6)
Enterprise API Optimization (#h_01H3G4EQ0WVCG7GWXNVYZQQJK5)
Agent List Page Optimization
A number has been added next to the Agent List, representing the total number of agents, both users and display only, in the
Lofty
account's agent list. If a filter is applied, the number will update to reflect the number of agents available in the filtered list.
In order to see the number of Agents in the list, you must have the Manage User permission enabled for Team accounts or the User Management - Entire Company permission enabled for Enterprise accounts.
Agent Tag Management
This update
adds a tab to both Team and Enterprise Lofty accounts to view/add/edit the Agent Tags.
In order to access this tab, the user must have the Manage User permission enabled for a Team account or User Management - Agent Tag enabled or an Enterprise account.
Within this tab, the user can see the list of Agent Tags, the number of agents with that tag applied, the user who created the tag, the last modified date, and the option to edit or delete the Agent Tag.
Lead Appointment Optimization
With this update, if the
Lofty
user can see the lead, they can edit or delete an appointment on the lead's profile. If the user has Access All Team/Company Leads permission enabled, they do not have to be assigned to the lead in any role.
Here, the assigned assistant has the option to edit or delete the appointment scheduled by the primary agent assigned to the lead.
Calendar Optimization
If you have integrated a third-party calendar, such as Google or Outlook Calendar, into your
Lofty
account, appointments scheduled via the Meeting Link will now sync to your third-party calendar.
Enterprise Agent Filter on People Page Optimization
For Enterprise
Lofty
Accounts, when filtering by Agents on the People Page:
For Company Owner/Admin, Group Owner/Admin, and users with "Access All Company Lead" permission:
The users themselves will always be displayed at the top of the list
All users within their own group and sub-groups will be shown in the list
For other members:
The users themselves will always be displayed at the top of the list
All users within their own group will be shown.
Note:
Any
Lofty
user can search for another
user within the company, and those users' names will appear, but only the users in their own Hierarchy group will appear by default
Lead Pond Mobile App Optimization
With this update, we are adding Lead Pond functionality to the Lofty mobile app. If you have access to a Lead Pond, you can filter by the lead pond on the app Lead page:
This also supports claiming a lead from the lead pond, via the mobile app:
Phone Number Country Code
With this update, the country code will automatically display with your phone number on your Lofty website. The country code is provided in the profile settings. There is no option to disable this update.
Multilingual URL Structure
If you have enabled the
Language Translation and Currency Conversion Add-On (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/13764506865947)
, the website URL will include the parameter "lang=**" when website visitors switch to a non-English language on the Lofty website. This allows you to set a default language for your website through the URL when promoting the website externally.
AI Social Post Writing Assistant
This is an expansion on the other AI-generated content features we have released recently. This update adds the AI Writing Assistant to the Social Studio, so Lofty users can utilize AI to write and edit social media post captions.
Screenshot
Description
All social studio users will have access to this feature:
Freemium: 10 credits per week
Credits are applied when selecting "Generate" or "Continue Writing"
Pro/Team/Free Trial: Unlimited
Actions:
Generate
Rephrase
Summarize
Expand
Simplify
Change Tone
Professional
Casual
Straightforward
Confident
Friendly
Continue Writing
New Onboarding Dashboard
An Onboarding Dashboard will be available to all
new
Lofty
users for the first 90 days of their account being opened.
Screenshot
Description
When a new
Lofty
user logs in to their CRM, they will be automatically redirected to this page.
They can exit the Onboarding Dashboard page at any time by clicking "Explore CRM"
They can navigate back to the Onboarding Dashboard for the first 90 days of their account being opened.
Onboarding Dashboard Entrance：
The Onboarding Progress can be accessed via the account's Avatar menu
New
Lofty
account owners are prompted to complete an Onboarding Questionnaire.
This questionnaire allows the
Lofty
Onboarding Team to get to know you and your business goals.
Stage 1: Digital Brand
The first section will help you set up the following features:
Company Number： This is only available for the Account Owner. The Company Number is the virtual phone number used by all members on the account.
Email Integration：Prompts you to connect your email account
Social Media：Prompts you to connect your social media accounts, which will sync to your agent detail page
Stage 2: Leads Database
The second section will help the you set up the following features:
Lead Import： You will be directed to the lead import page via this CTA button. If you have already imported your leads or requested assistance to import leads from the onboarding questionnaire, this section will be marked as complete.
Zillow Integration：You will be directed to Zillow to connect your Zillow account.
Lead Capture Settings: You will be directed to the Lead Capture section to connect your third-party leads.
Stage 3: Automations
Import Smart Plan Templates：You will be directed to the Smart Plan section to create a Smart Plan
Set Transaction Checklist：You will be directed to the Transaction Checklist section to create a Transaction Checklist
AI Assistant：If the CRM package comes with an AI Assistant, you will be directed to the settings. If not, you will have the option to start a Free Trial and review the order page.
Stage 4: Marketing Profile
Strategy to Accomplish Goals:
Based on the your choices, we will suggest different marketing plans.
Commission-driven lead closure: Lead generation
Enhance CRM leads Nurturing: Remarketing ads
Dominate the Market: Seller ads and Geofarming
Here, you can confirm the suggested plan now, but you will not be charged until your website has been set up and a member of
Lofty
's Marketing Team has contacted you.
Team Dashboard
The Team Dashboard allows the account owner to review the onboarding progress of all the users on the account.
New users can be added directly on this page.
Reminders can be sent to users who have not completed the onboarding process.
Enterprise API Optimization
The API has been updated to reflect the following optimizations for Enterprise
Lofty
Accounts:
Module
Optimization
Get member information interface
The following four API endpoints can be used to obtain the Group ID and Group Name of enterprise users.
5.6.1. Get current user’s info
GET /v1.0/me
5.6.2. Get team members
GET /v1.0/members
5.6.3. Get member by account
GET /v1.0/members/{account}
5.6.4. Get user by Id
GET /v1.0/users/{userId}
Create lead interface
Add "
assignGroupId
" field which is used to d
esignate the lead to follow the routing rules of the specific scope.
Our API documentation can be found here: https://api.lofty.me/docs/index.html
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

#### Article 615: Feature Updates for Lofty 3.66

- Article ID: `16923046848667`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T01:52:33Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/16923046848667-Feature-Updates-for-Lofty-3-66

Introduction
I
mportant:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user). These features are subject to change at any time. Please see our Learning Center course on this update
HERE (https://learningcenter.chime.me/courses/chime-v366)
.
Having trouble accessing the course? This article will show you how to access the Lofty Learning Center:
How to Access the Lofty Learning Center (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/13857197513115)
Release Date
Wednesday, July 12th, 2023.
Summary
Lead Sharing Link (#h_01H505VVZQDCV8X8PBXKGPT2T1)
Enterprise Group Level Transaction Checklists (#h_01H5065DVH0CKWGY7179T98YD2)
Commission Optimization (#h_01H506BZYG2A5H3EQFHKJ14WS5)
Book a Meeting Link Optimization (#h_01H507MV4W2DAD2S01R6PRFEJ8)
Lead Pond Email Signature Optimization (#h_01H507WZD3C7EF5ZNMFZNQY24W)
Calendar Alert Optimization (#h_01H5096C43ATBQZ3DP2R1Q35B1)
AI Writing Assistant Optimizations (#h_01H509STNHNPSHS7W33Z02DEKV)
Closely App Login Update (#h_01H50D77537YK2D836K5C5SWG3)
Enterprise Agent Page URL Update (#h_01H50DPDFMZBEK0WH1WDBKWBEH)
Onboarding Dashboard Optimization (#h_01H50EA687VHJ48SV47KAPT0WN)
Listing Showing Management Update (#h_01H50F45ETDC5W5FAJ65P8S5Y8)
Social Media Account Status Update (#h_01H50FBHNE48HAP317YFSDXPHM)
Lead Sharing Link
This new feature allows you to quickly share a lead with another
Lofty
user on your account, by sending them a link to the lead. In order to view this lead, the user the link is shared with be able to view this lead.
To share a lead, click the "..." icon on the lead's profile and click "Share Lead"
Next, a pop-up window allows you to copy the link to share
This functionality is also available in the Lofty mobile app
Enterprise Group Level Transaction Checklists
This update allows for group-level Transaction Checklists on Enterprise Lofty accounts. If a Lofty user has Company Templates - Entire Company, they can create a Transaction Checklist for any group. If they have Company Templates - User's Group, they can create a Transaction Checklist for their own group.
The type of Checklist (Company or Group) will be listed next to the Transaction Checklist name. Checklists may be filtered by Company or Group by clicking
Scope
.
When applying a Transaction Checklist to a transaction, you will have tabs for both Company and Group transaction checklists. Here, you may select a transaction checklist from either the Company level or your own Group level.
Commission Optimization
This update allows Vendors, or anyone who is not a member of the
Lofty
account, to be included in the commission split on a transaction.
When clicking the "Paid To/From" box, the dropdown menu will display some suggestion, which includes the following:
The transaction owner's Team
The party that was Recently searched (displaying a maximum of 6)
A “Temporary Entity” that can be added to this transaction
If the party who should be included in the Commission split is not a Team member or a Vendor on the account, they may be added:
A summary has been added after each Split, so you can see the commission split results in real time, as you are closing the transaction.
Book a Meeting Link Optimization
Several Optimizations have been made to the Book a Meeting link.
We have added a "Meeting_Link" variable, that can be added to an email or signature, which will automatically add a link to your
Lofty
meeting booking page.
This variable will add a clickable link to your personal
Lofty
booking page.
When viewing the appointment on the Lofty Calendar, the following fields will be visible:
Location
Participants
Email
Phone
The default prefix logic for Meeting Link has been updated to the
Lofty
user's own website. If you do not have your own website or subdomain, the meeting link will show either your Group website, Team website, or Company website.
Within the Meeting Link settings, you have the option to automatically create new leads if a non-lead books a meeting via your Meeting Link. All meetings scheduled by the lead will be displayed on the lead's Appointments section.
When the lead books a meetings, the calendar will automatically offer the first available time.
Lead Pond Email Signature Optimization
The lead pond was recently updated so that emails were sent from the lead pond owner, rather than the required virtual agent. With this update, all automatic emails can be sent from a customized email signature.
If the switch is turned off, all automatic emails sent to leads in the lead pond will use the email signature of the Pond Owner
If the switch is turned on, the Lead Pond owner can set a custom email signature for the Pond. All automatic emails sent to the pond lead will use this custom email signature instead of the Pond Owner's email signature
Calendar Alert Optimization
We have made an optimization to third-party integrated calendars.
The following notes are added to the Integrated Calendar section on the Calendar page.
Google Calendar Note:
If the LoftyAppointment's owner or participant includes you, the appointment will be synced to your Google Calendar
When the Lofty Appointment participant's email is Gmail, Google Calendar will automatically recognize and sync the appointment to this participant's Google Calendar.
Outlook Calendar Note:
If the Lofty Appointment's owner is you, then the appointment will be synced to your Outlook Calendar
If you do not have any third-party calendar integrated:
If the participant is a Lofty user, this appointment will automatically be displayed on their Lofty calendar and they may choose to accept or reject this appointment.
The LoftyAppointment invitation email can be sent to all participants by either Google Calendar or Outlook Calendar if connected. Go to Settings->Integrations to connect either of them.
If you have integrated your Google Calendar or Outlook Calendar:
If the participant is a Lofty user, this appointment will automatically be displayed on their Lofty calendar and they may choose to accept or reject this appointment.
The Lofty Appointment invitation email will be sent to all participants, per #OwnerName's calendar notification settings. T
he reminder will only be sent to the owner.
When the appointment is saved, if you have integrated your Google Calendar and turned on the setting sync appointments to your Google Calendar:
This appointment
will automatically sync
to the Google Calendar of any participant who uses Gmail. This is Google's automatic recognition mechanism, which may be adjusted in your Google Calendar settings.
AI Writing Assistant Optimizations
The next time you utilize the AI Writing Assistant, you will be prompted to acknowledge a disclaimer pop-up. If you do not click "Okay", the AI writing assistant features will be disabled.
We have also optimized the AI Writing Assistant so that you can highlight a section of content and prompt the AI Writer to assist with that specific content.
Closely App Login Update
The login options for the Closely app have been updated.
We have added the “Email Verification Code” login method.
Leads whose agents did not have a website were unable to log in to the Closely app. Now, if the agent does not have a website, the Closely app will utilize the agent's group, team, or company website.
The "Select Agent" step has been updated.
This update supports leads from non-website sources in the CRM to use the Closely app.
I
f the user is a website registered lead, after entering their email, the login options will be provided.
Logging in with the password (Default)
The login process is split into two steps:
Step 1: User enters their email address to match with an agent.
Step 2: The matched assigned agent is displayed and the user is prompted to enter the corresponding password to log in.
If there are multiple assigned agents for this user, the "Not Your Agent" entry will be displayed in the upper right corner, and users can click here to switch to other agents.
If the matched assigned agent does not have a website, the upper-level websites will be used instead.
Other Login Methods:
Email Verification Code: Click “Email Verification Code” to use this login method
Step 1: The user enters their email address
Step 2: If they are matched an agent and the agent has a website, the verification code email will be sent to the user's email address.
Step 3: Enter the verification code to log in.
Login with Facebook
Login with Google
If the user is not a website-registered lead, but they are a CRM lead, they will enter the account creation process. They only needs to fill out the password during this process. After confirming the password, the user will automatically be logged in.
If the user does not exist in the CRM, the user will be prompted to contact their agent to create an account.
If the user needs to change their agent, they may do so via the menu on their profile in the Closely app.
Enterprise Agent Page URL Update
For Enterprise account users, we are providing the option for both a short and long URL to direct to the user's Agent Detail page. T
he short URL redirects to the long URL, so they may use the shorter, simplified URL for marketing materials.
These fields will be empty by default.
Onboarding Dashboard Optimization
When a new
Lofty
user completes all the steps in the Onboarding Dashboard, they will be directed to set up the automated Welcome Email. Since they have imported their leads, as part of the Onboarding process, they will also have the option to send a Welcome Email to these leads.
Next, if the user's account includes the AI Assistant, Text Message Qualification will be
disabled
. The user has the option to turn this feature on now. If the user has the AI Assistant Free Trial or is utilizing the AI Assistant with a Lead Gen package, Text Message Qualification will be
enabled
already.
On the Team Dashboard, a green icon will appear next to team members who have completed Onboarding. For users who have not completed the onboarding process, the icon will be grey.
Listing Showing Management Update
Note: This feature will be released on Friday, July 14.
We have made some UI modifications to the
Listing Showing Management tool (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/4410497918107-Smart-Listings-#h_01H1W3N5WYK9408H1SAF9P2B63)
.
The Requested Showings will appear on the same dashboard as the Pending, Approved, Completed, and Rejected showing requests.
A new category has been added to the filter by Showing Appointments in the Lofty calendar.
Social Media Account Status Update
A status will be added next to your connected social media profiles. If the social media account has expired, for example if you have changed the password or other account details, you will be prompted to reauthorize the account.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by a chat with us through your Lofty CRM

.

Release Date
Wednesday, August 2nd, 2023
Summary
Print Center (#h_01H6Q80PV5W90PAS0MZAR6AWH3)
Lead Groups Renamed Segments (#h_01H6Q80XM7G69GG7VJHQ9H2786)

Print Center
The Print Center is located in
Campaigns > Print Center
. Here, you have the option to create a One-time, Monthly Recurring, and Smart Plan campaign. Your "Personal Info" can be added/edited by clicking the button in the top right corner. Personal information for the mailers will utilize variables and gain their information from this section.
Click "Print Mailers" to start the purchase process.
STEP 1: Select the Mailer Type.
We currently offer Postcard or Letter. Click "Discard" to exit and "Next" to continue to the next step.
STEP 2: Select the Design.
Note:
Postcards have a Front and Back design, while Letters only have a Front design.
Click upload to add your own photos
Click "Edit Design" to adjust the design
Select different themes to see all available designs
STEP 3: If sending Postcards, choose the back design and set up the tracking tool.
STEP 4: Set up the Recipients.
Here, you can select leads from the CRM, upload a mailing list, or purchase homeowner data from Geographic Farming.
STEP 5: Review the order and pay:
Lead Groups Renamed Segments
With this update, we are renaming the Lead Group feature "Segment". This change will be universal through the CRM. The API will have both Group and Segment available for a period of time, and we will notify all Lofty clients utilizing the API before we discontinue the use of Lead Group in the API.
The functionality is not changing, just the name.
Schedule a Meeting Optimization
This optimization allows you to require information from a lead, or potential lead when the lead is scheduling a meeting through your Lofty Meeting Link.
By default,
Lofty
will require the First Name and Email Address of the lead booking the meeting. The client can also opt to require the following information:
Last Name
Phone Number
Description (A reason for booking the meeting)
Showing Appointment Optimization
Showing appointments in the Lead Detail page are optimized to give more options when a lead has requested a showing.
For Requested Showings, you have the option to schedule the showing or delete the request:
For Schedule Showings, you have the option to view the showing details or cancel the appointment:
Showing Appointment Automated Reminders
Automated reminder text messages will be sent to agents and leads before the showing appointment starts. These messages are automatic, there are no settings to disable or edit these messages. The message is sent both 24 hours before and 30 minutes before the scheduled appointment.
Buyer Tour Reminder:
Hi! Just a friendly reminder that we have a buyer tour appointment scheduled for #date# at #time#. Our first location is #meeting location or listing street address#
Showing Appointment Reminder:
Hi! Just a friendly reminder that we have a showing appointment scheduled for #date# at #time#. The listing is #street address#
View Support Tickets in the CRM
You will be able to view your support tickets directly in the CRM and see the ticket status. The "My Tickets" entrance has been added to the "? " menu in the CRM:
Updated MLS Application Dashboard
The MLS application setting has been moved to the Listings tab in the CMS. The current MLS status will be displayed, so you can quickly see what is needed for the MLS application.
Lead Routing: Open API Lead Options
This is an optimization to the Open API source leads in the Lead Routing Lead Options. Your Open API Lead Routing Lead Options will not change, but you may have additional lead sources available, where you may customize the Lead Options. To update the Open API Lead Options, navigate to
Settings → Lead Routing → Lead Options:
Next, click
Click to set
next to Leads Imported from Open API:
Here, you can set specific lead routing for each source, rather than one option for all Open API source leads:
AI Assistant Free Trial Upgrade
With this update, we are notifying
Lofty
users when the AI Assistant Free Trial Allotment has been met, and also giving them the option to upgrade to the paid version of the AI Assistant, so the AI Assistant can continue to engage new leads for them.
When you are on the Free Trial AI Assistant, you can see how many days are left on the trial, as well as the lead allotment and how many leads have been engaged.
In this screenshot, the user has an allotment of 200 leads. That means that once the AI Assistant has engaged 200 leads, it will continue to work those 200, but will not engage any leads beyond that.
The user can click "Upgrade Package" to purchase the AI Assistant end the free trial period, and allow the AI Assistant to engage additional new leads.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM
