#### Article 627: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.16

- Article ID: `30317251444251`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T01:11:03Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/30317251444251-Feature-Updates-for-Lofty-4-16

Introduction
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user).
These features are subject to change at any time.
Release Date
Monday, October 28, 2024
Summary
Service Bot Update (#h_01JAX62V5YRKZTXAZR5RNC0MCG)
Lofty Present: Team and Personal Spaces (#h_01JAX6350BEJ2F56M613BFKFJ9)
Transaction Variables (#h_01JAX63KN264BGCNZT3RHTXMV6)
Transaction Checklist Updates (#h_01JAX63XPV58BEQ2Y4ENPVMM8D)
Add a Lead in a Transaction (#h_01JAZY483ZSJMJJ6AHKBQ4BQMY)
Document Management Update (#h_01JAZYEV0SWQX6NFDJ617TP4PR)
Inbound Voicemail Update (#h_01JAX672HG16SHK4ZM258JBZJH)
Company Number Unknown Inbound Routing Optimization (#h_01JAX67VT7AVSNTJ87Q2616QH4)
Mass Create Mailing Labels (#h_01JB06MX831F4Y06WNFXZJJQRC)
SEO: AI Generated Meta Data (#h_01JB06NMPP3Z67SRADH8FVX66P)
Service Bot Update
The Service Bot has been updated so you can clearly see who is assisting you in the chat.  This will make it easier for you to know when it's the Service Bot, and when it's one of Lofty's support team members. In many cases, the issue can be resolved with just the Service Bot. You will see "Service Bot" at the top of the chat. It isn't perfect, so it can make mistakes, but it is getting better all the time.
Learn more about Service Bot here:
Service Bot (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/21970705527579)
Lofty Present: Team and Personal Spaces
Lofty Present (formerly the CMA Tool) has been updated to support Team and Personal spaces to enhance collaboration and Listing Presentation management.
Account/Office/Group Owners have the option to buy
Lofty Present Team
, which will allow them to create Listing Presentation templates for their team. If you already purchased the Listing Presentation add-on, you have access to Lofty Present Team.
Everyone will also have access to their own Personal space, where you can track your own CMAs and Listing Presentations.
Still have questions? Learn more in the Help Center Article:
How to Create a CMA and Listing Presentation (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/26265328610075)
Transaction Variables
When sending an email, text, or drafting a Smart Plan, you can now use transaction related variables in those messages. This will work just like using other Variables in messages, whether it's an email or text message.
Automated Emails, Mass Emails, Text Messages:
When sending a mass email, mass text, smart plan email/text, or a single text, by default, the transaction variable will pull data from the most recently created transaction. We'll show you a disclaimer when sending one of these messages or creating one.
No Transactions
If you're sending a one-off email, and your lead does not yet have any transactions, you can add one right from the email that you are drafting. Once it the transaction is added, you can continue drafting the email using transaction variables.
Want to know more about variables?
Learn about Email and Text Variables (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055270071)
Transaction Checklist Updates
Look for NINE updates to Transaction Checklists in this update:
1. Private Transaction Checklists
You can now create, edit and delete your own private Transaction Checklists.
Limit: 20/user
Visibility: Only visible to the checklists' creator.
2. Kanban Layout
Transaction Checklists now have a "Kanban" (card) layout.
Transaction tasks can be dragged and dropped to a new place in the checklist.
Tasks will display a bell icon when a due date is applied to the task.
This update is permanent and the list view has been retired.
3. Assigning Tasks to Vendors
Transaction Tasks can be assigned to one assignee per task. The assignee can be:
Transaction owner
Another agent involved in the transaction
Any available vendor or lender
4. Multiple Checklists added to a single transaction
There is now no limit to the number of transaction checklists that can be added to a transaction. This means you can have a standard checklist template, and one specific to a particular situation that comes up regularly.
Note:
An individual task can be added to a transaction, and, if not already added to the system, the assignee can be added manually.
5. Updates to the Task View
Search -
Users can search for tasks by task name or by assignee.
Add Filters -
Filters have been added to tasks to make finding them easier.
Filter by Task Status
Filter by due Date (Due Today, Due in 3 days, Overdue. These are not editable.)
Task Ordering
- Within each stage, tasks are displayed in the following order:
Undetermined Due Date (A due date linked to a transaction date that hasn't been set.)
Specific Due Date
Tasks with no Due Date
Assignee -
Assignee can now be changed directly from the task list
Overdue Tasks -
A notification will be displayed for overdue tasks
Reminder Icon -
Just like in the Kanban view, a bell icon will appear on tasks with a due date set.
Checklist Template -
The name of the checklist template for each task will be displayed in the list.
6. New Kanban view for tasks in a
single transaction
.
You can view the tasks for a single transaction using a Kanban view.
7. Send Emails and Texts to any contact associated with the transaction.
Previously, emails and texts could only be sent to the lead.
Now, all contacts associated with the transaction can be texted or emailed.
When you click the text or email icon, the message will be directed to the lead associated with the transaction, by default, and all associated contacts can also be included.
8. Update Tasks in the Calendar
Before, clicking on an unfinished task would automatically mark the task as complete. This is an issue if you were trying to look at the task or if you clicked it accidentally.
Now, clicking the task name will give you the option to mark the task as Done or Not Applicable.
Clicking the due date allows you to manually update the task status.
9. Task Ownership Display
If the assignee on the task does not have an active Lofty account (a Vendor, for example), the task will appear on the transaction owner's calendar.
Want to do a deep dive on Transaction Checklists?
Learn more in the Help Center in
Transaction Management Checklists (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057001712-Transaction-Management-Checklists)
Add a Lead in a Transaction
Previously, the lead would need to be added before a transaction can be created for them. Now, you can create the lead at the same time you create the transaction.
Learn how to create a transaction here:
Transaction Management Introduction (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057572991)
Document Management Update
Look for four (4) updates to documentation in the platform:
1. Transaction Document Folders
You can now organize transaction documents in folders and add new document folders. Each transaction will have a Default folder that cannot be deleted. This folder CAN be renamed.
2. New ways to Upload Documents
Drag and Drop
- You can now drag and drop single or multiple documents to Transaction Document Folders.
Upload from email attachments -
You can email attachments directly to a Transaction Document Folder. Copy the provided email address and send the document to the copied email address. After sending the email, refresh the documents page and the document will have been added to the appropriate folder.
3. Bulk Actions
You can now perform bulk actions on Transaction Documents.
Check the box next to one document to access these actions:
Preview: This allows you to peek at the document without downloading it.
Rename: This allows you to change the name of the document in the folder
Check the box next to one or more documents to access these actions:
Download
Delete
Move: Moves the document(s) to another folder.
Send Email: Attaches the document(s) to an email for sending
Send to Docusign: Send the document for signature directly from the transaction. Requires an integrated DocuSign account.
4. Integrate DocuSign directly in the transaction documents page
You can now integrate with DocuSign directly in the transaction documents page, keeping you in one spot so you don't have to navigate to the integrations page to connect.
Inbound Voicemail Update
This update adds two default Inbound Call Voice Messages (one male, one female) and the option to record (Add) your own inbound call voicemail greeting message.
Learn more about setting up your voicemail box and checking your messages here:
Inbound Voicemail (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/30358772627611)
Company Number Unknown Inbound Routing Optimization
This is an expansion on the call routing for unknown inbound numbers originally introduced in v4.15.
Routing Rules
Like
Lead Routing (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055177831-Lead-Routing-Rules)
for non-call lead sources, you can create custom rules to decide how to route inbound calls and texts from numbers that are not associated with any lead in the platform. You can add up to
10 custom rules
. Rules can be numbered Rule #1, Rule #2, Rule #3, etc. Rules will apply to the first rule for which the call/text meets the criteria. If no rule's criteria are met, the call/text would be routed to the Default Rule, which is set to catch any remaining call/text.
Learn more about routing unknown inbound calls to the Company number here:
Company Number (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360059630312)
Mass Create Mailing Labels
Ever wanted to turn your Lofty leads into mailing labels? You can do that from the People page of the platform now! This one is really easy. Just select the leads (up to 250) you are planning on mailing. Then, click the "More" option, and select Mailing Label.
Learn more here:
Print House: Mailers (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360058318632)
SEO: AI Generated Meta Data
This update allows you to automatically generate page Meta titles and Meta descriptions using AI. The content generated meets keyword inclusion, brand name requirements, and character limits, all while saving the time that would be used writing these yourself.
Learn more about Lofty's SEO tools here:
SEO Checklist and Page Report (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/28406739481499)
Questions?
There's a lot in this update, so you might need to refer back to it as you use these features. If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

Introduction
Be sure to

to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user).

Release Date
Monday, November 11th, 2024
Summary
Office Add-On (#h_01JBZ0E1TAZEWAN7R0CN20ZSMA)
Platform Design Standardization (#h_01JBZ17E5PG62C57632PG7KAS7)
Website Block Reorganization (#website-block-reorganization)

Office Add-On
Lofty's Office Add-On empowers account owners and admins to transform their individual Lofty platform into a cohesive, team-driven solution with enhanced marketing and management tools.
Why is this great?
The Office Add-On offers a more cost-effective solution for smaller accounts compared to Enterprise.
The Office Add-On includes all of the features that will help an Office brand and market themselves, in addition to enhanced management tools.
Lofty has standardized its platform design so that both single-Team and Enterprise packages share the same structure, simplifying the learning curve.
Check out our Help Center article to learn more about how the Office Add-On can help maximize your business:
Office Add-On (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/29980632097691)
Platform Design Standardization
Lofty has taken strides to standardize our platform across all account types. This means our internal teams are better able to support you, and your data is compatible as you grow.
Permission Profiles for Team-Type Accounts
Permission Profiles have been loved by our Enterprise customers since we launched them. This update brings Permission Profiles to Team-Type accounts, so you can easily manage permissions across your Lofty users.
Learn more about permission profiles here:
Permissions (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055290451)
Replace "Team" with "Company"
On single-Team accounts, all “Team” verbiage will be replaced with “Company”.
Website Block Reorganization
We have recategorized our website blocks to make it easier for you to find the blocks that you want to use. The 6 categories are:
Custom:
Any Custom blocks you have created
Company:
Company Intro (used to be Team), Agent Blocks (Featured or All), Contact, Reviews, Logo Wall (used to be Partners), Vendor, Featured Area, and Group
Content:
Hero, Media (video or photo content), Content, CTA
Listings:
Listings (Featured or All), Search Bar, Quick Search, Market Snapshot, Market Trends, List Your Home
Lead Capture:
Form, Home Valuation, Guide,
Tools:
Tools (Calendar, Calculators), Embed, Blog, Social Feed
Previous UI - No categories
New UI - Blocks are grouped by category
Learn more here:
Lofty Website Block Library (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/sections/360007590131-Block-Library)
Multiple Websites per User (Available November 25)
Drumroll, please! This has been one of our top-requested features since the dawn of Lofty's time. With this update, Lofty users can purchase multiple Agent Websites, allowing for combinations like a Group Website alongside one or more Agent Websites. However,
multiple Group Websites cannot be purchased by one user
at this time. Learn more here:
Agent Websites – Lofty Help Center (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055173711)
Why would someone want multiple websites?
You might be a Lofty Account or Office Owner and want your own branded sales website, separate from the Company branded site.
You might be an Agent who works under multiple brands and wants to enhance your marketing.
You might be an Agent who works in multiple states and wants to focus your online presence on key distinct areas.
More information is coming soon!
BETA - Lofty AI New Features
This beta version of the AI Assistant was aunched to a select group of users on November 4th.
Inbox Prioritization
Lofty AI will analyze your inbox and summarize the highest-priority messages, making it easy for you to identify what you need to do to start your day off successfully.
Call Summary
Lofty AI can provide a call summary and next steps, as long as the call is made using the AI Voice Prompt ("Hey Lofty, call Jacob") AND call recording is turned on.
Email and Text Writing
The AI Assistant consolidates the AI Writing Assistant and the Lofty AI Assistant. With this update, the AI can draft emails and texts specific to your leads' communication history and past activities.
Product Guidance
Ask the AI how to use certain features in Lofty and it will guide you through the process.
Learn more here:
Service Bot (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/21970705527579)
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

#### Article 629: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.18

- Article ID: `31322114969883`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T01:06:56Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/31322114969883-Feature-Updates-for-Lofty-4-18

Introduction
Lofty's v4.18 release is packed with useful updates designed to enhance usability, improve workflows, and empower you! Highlights include the introduction of the Standard Agent Website, Bulk task removal for canceled transactions, enhanced transaction search capabilities, and a new drag-and-drop option to create stunning email templates! Read on below as this release offers powerful tools to elevate your experience across the platform.
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user).
These features are subject to change at any time.
Release Date
Monday, December 2, 2024
Summary
Standard Agent Websites (#h_01JDPWGSBGFDMYBZ4AC2EKTZJ0)
Bulk Transaction Task Actions (#h_01JDPWHF513DZ7TY7RYEBD9NAF)
Transaction Search Optimization (#h_01JDPWHWF6805DCHS9MTEBBS1B)
Lead Types in the CMS Match the CRM (#h_01JDPWS84E6F1963S7VR8YMQ8H)
Drag and Drop Email Templates (#h_01JDPWJK4PJA19G1ERFS8QW59Z)
Account User Status (#h_01JDPWPC54TNXTFY7ZHT0Q9FAS)
Show Co-Listings Agents on Listing Pages (#h_01JDPWTQHJ02JY4W0GF34NGH88)
Updated Cookie Policy (#h_01JDPWN1CDM3N3XR39MWZGMH3H)
Standard Agent Websites
Lofty is adding a new agent website package called “Standard Agent Website”. The Standard Agent Website does NOT replace any Agent Websites. The Standard Agent Website looks and feels like an Agent Subdomain with one simple difference: It allows for the configuration of a vanity/branded domain WITHOUT the need for a Lofty User to complete an additional MLS Application.
A Standard Agent Website costs $19 per month, and can be paid for by the account owner or the website owner.
In the CMS, this website will be listed as an Agent Website Standard. It is effectively the same as an agent subdomain, but has the benefit of having it's own customized vanity domain. Learn more about the types of website Lofty offers here:
Agent Websites (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055173711)
Bulk Transaction Task Actions
If you have a transaction that ends up getting canceled, this can result in unfinished transaction tasks remaining on your calendar and task list. Removing the tasks from the calendar and task list has until now, been a manual process. With this update, if a transaction is cancelled and there are tasks attached to the transaction that are still in a status of “To Do” or “Doing,” a pop-up window will appear.
This pop-up both notifies you that there are outstanding tasks associated with this cancelled transaction and allows you to either change the task status to "Not Applicable", which will remove the task from your task list or remove the tasks due date, which will remove and reminders and remove the task from your calendar. Removing the due date will still keep the task in your task list.
Learn more about Transaction Checklists here:
Transaction Management Checklists (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057001712)
Transaction Search Optimization
You are always able to view the transactions that are associated with leads that you are assigned to in the primary “Agent” role. With this update, as long as you are assigned to the lead in any of the available Role Types, you can search for their transaction on the Transaction Dashboard by selecting the option “Include Unowned Transactions”.
This makes it simple for Assistants, Transaction Coordinators, Co-agents, etc. to find transactions. Learn more about Transaction Management with Lofty here:
Transaction Management Introduction (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057572991)
Lead Types in the CMS Match the CRM
In
Feature Updates for Lofty 4.8 (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/24940685804955)
we added several new Lead Type options and the ability to combine Lead Type options as needed. With this update, the CMS (Website Editor) has been update to align with the CRM. This means that lead capture forms and registration pop-ups can now be set to label a lead with any of the available lead type options.
Learn more about lead capture forms on your Lofty website here:
Form Block (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402562066971)
Drag and Drop Email Templates
With this update, when creating email templates, you will be given the option to create one of two types of templates:
Plain Text
Rich Text
Plain Text will look familiar, as it uses the old editor
The Rich Text editor is an all-new interface that allows for more dynamic, modern designs. You can now add text, images, buttons, social media, dividers, tables, and listings to your templates.
When adding a new template, you will now be offered a choice between two types: Plain Text and Rich Text.
If you choose to create a Rich-Text template, you will be able to build a template with many more formatting options and elements like buttons, tables, social media, etc.
Learn more about email templates here:
Email Templates (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055290611)
Account User Status
Lofty offers both Platform Users and Display Only users. Platform users occupy a seat on the platform and can log in to their account. Display Only users are exactly that - they can be displayed on your website but do not have any Lofty account to log in to.
Platform users can have the following statuses:
Active:
Account setup complete. The user has chosen their login email and password.
Pending Activation:
A welcome
email has been sent, but the agent has not activated their account.
Invitation Scheduled:
mm/dd/yy: The agent's welcome email is scheduled to be sent.
Pending Opt-in
:
This status only applies to teams who choose the Agent Opt-in Process whose agents have not yet opted in.
Inactive:
This status is limited to active users that have been deactivated.
Deactivating a user allows you to temporarily pause a user's Lofty account. That user's leads will need to be transferred to another user and their Lofty account is effectively disabled. They can be reactivated at any time and their account information is retained.
Learn more about managing your account here:
Add or Remove Team Members on Lofty (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/218038783)
Show Co-Listings Agents on Listing Pages
Lofty websites will now be capable of displaying multiple “co-listing” agents on Listing Detail pages.
Agents who are listed as the 2nd or 3rd agent on a listing can be made visible, if that setting is enabled. Learn more about listing management with Lofty here:
Listing Pages (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402568813723)
Updated Cookie Policy
Lofty has updated the cookie preferences that visitors to your website have access to. Cookies are the trackers that remind a website visitor's device that they've visited a website previously. Visitor to your Lofty website will see one of the following options, depending on their location.
Learn more about website cookies here:
Website Cookies (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/31337234468123)
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

#### Article 630: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.19

- Article ID: `32022661377819`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T00:58:49Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/32022661377819-Feature-Updates-for-Lofty-4-19

Introduction
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user).
These features are subject to change at any time.
Release Date
Monday, December 23, 2024
Summary
Team Add-On (#h_01JFE0YZDNVWAE74AYQBQ01XJW)
Send a Business Card via a Smart Plan (#h_01JFE1XWBDHZDJ4T8B3T8HFRP6)
Transaction Checklist Optimizations (#h_01JFE24M2Y5FHRT20K73CC9RFV)
Agent Photo Optimization (#h_01JFE2HNX6DAR6FD5GBYZCWHEA)
Team Add-On
The Team Add-On is the newest addition to Lofty’s product suite that enables you to turn your Lofty account into a cohesive, team-driven solution with enhanced marketing and management tools.
To learn more, navigate to
Marketplace > Account Upgrades > Team Add-On.
Learn more about organizing your team with Lofty here:
Office and Team Add-Ons (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/29980632097691)
Send a Business Card via a Smart Plan
This update adds the ability to send a Virtual Business Card via text in an Auto-Text Smart Plan step.
It's important to note that the business card is not a variable. The Agent's business card that is selected will be the one that is sent as an auto-text in the Smart Plan.
Learn more about virtual business cards here:
Virtual Business Cards (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/27353952007579)
Transaction Checklist Optimizations
We’ve added four optimizations to transaction checklists that have already been implemented!
First, the task status has been changed from a click to a hover, reducing the number of clicks needed to change the task status!
Next, when setting a due date, we now support a four-digit long number, meaning the due date can now be over 1000 days out! While we're on the topic of due date, you can now select a specific date, rather than a transaction related due date.
Finally, if you apply filters to a transaction tasks page, those filters will stay applied, even if you navigate elsewhere around the Lofty platform. When you come back, your filters will still be applied!
Learn more about transaction checklists here:
Transaction Management Checklists (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057001712)
Agent Photo Optimization
Note: This feature will be available on December 30, 2024
Say goodbye to blurry photos on your website! With this update, we have optimized the agent headshot photo uploader to ensure that the photo you provide always fits the website block style you select.
We've got you covered for square shape, landscape, and portrait photos! This tool will automatically select the photo that is appropriate for the website block. The Life Gallery Photos is a new place to upload your personal photos of the Agent page on your website.
Learn more the Lofty website here:
Home Page Overview (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037816492)
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

Call/Text and 10DLC Optimizations
With this update, you will be able to start registering your virtual phone numbers on a 10DLC campaign. Please see this article for instructions on registering:
A2P 10DLC Registration (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/17141883940379)
If you are a new Lofty user,
or have never had a virtual phone number on your Lofty account before, you will need to register an A2P 10DLC campaign when you select your virtual phone number. New Lofty users will also have access to Voice Over IP (VOIP) for both inbound and outbound calling.
If you are an existing Lofty user
and already have a virtual phone number, you have until February 2024 to register 10DLC. We recommend the team leader or account owner registers the brand and campaign for all users on the account, but each Lofty user can register their own 10DLC brand and campaign if necessary.
Once your virtual number has been registered to a verified A2P 10DLC campaign, you will be able to make and receive calls over VOIP. Our Bridge calling method will also be available.
Lead Referrals
This update optimizes the Lofty free user experience and optimizes the ability for all Lofty users to share leads, even if they are not on the same Lofty account.
Free Lofty User Lead List
With this update, free Lofty users can add leads to their account.
Lead List Page:
The Lead List will only display the lead's name, email address, and phone number
Where do the leads come from?
Free Lofty users can accept leads from others. There is
no limitation
on the number of leads that can be shared with a free Lofty user.
Free Lofty users can create a
maximum of 10 leads
. They can upgrade to a paid Lofty account to add more leads.
Free Lofty User Lead Detail Page
Lead Detail Page:
The Lead Detail Page has the same UI structure as paid Lofty user.
Free Lofty users do have some limitations, and they do not have access to the Engagement, Smart Plan, or Transaction sections.

Source

How To Sell/Buy a House
With Buyer/Listing Agent

Task & Appointment
Activities:
The Activities section will allow the following:
A record of when the lead was shared and accepted
A record of when another Lofty user accepted a lead that you shared with them.
New Lead Sharing Method
Previously, Lofty users could share leads via a Share Link with other users on their Lofty account. With this update, you can send your lead Share Link to anyone, whether they are currently a Lofty user or not, or if they are on your Lofty account or not.
Note:
If the person you share the lead with is not a Lofty user, they will need to create a free Lofty account to view the lead details.
Invite via Email
Enter an email to share leads directly with others.
The email will display the lead card but the email and phone will only be partially displayed.
Click
Accept Lead
to open the lead detail page.
Share via Chat
This is only in the Mobile App (the web does not currently have the chat functionality)
Share the lead card directly in the Lofty app.
Clicking on the lead card will open the lead detail page.
Permissions
If you are on a paid Lofty account, you must have the
Share Leads
permission enabled on your account in order to share your leads with other. When sharing a lead, you can decide
RateMyAgent Integration
This update allows Lofty users to pull reviews from RateMyAgent to display on their Lofty website.
For more information on RateMyAgent, please see
https://www.ratemyagent.com/
N
avigate to
Website/CMS Tool → Settings → Tools → Integrations
to connect to RateMyAgent
Note:
You
can connect
one
RMA account. This integration requires a RMA Pro or higher subscription.
Navigate to your RateMyAgent account to obtain your AgentCode. Input that AgentCode in the field and click Save.
After integrating, click
Edit
to update the integration.
Navigate to the
Website Editor
to add RateMyAgent reviews to the Review Block.
Note:
This update also allows you to add reviews to your Lofty website from multiple sources. Previously, you had to select one source of reviews. Check the box next to the review source you want to appear.
Note:
Reviews from third party sources (RMA, Zillow, Google) cannot be edited and you cannot pick and choose which reviews are visible, however you can choose to not show reviews from a source.
Adwerx Integration
This feature is designed for agents using Adwerx advertising. With this feature, you can directly add Adwerx's retargeting pixel to your Lofty website in the CMS. This integration is available for all Lofty websites, including subdomains. For more information on Adwerx service, please see
https://www.adwerx.com/
N
avigate to
Website/CMS Tool → Settings → Tools → Integrations
to connect to Adwerx
To complete the integration, fill in the retargeting pixel, provided by Adwerx, and the Lofty website URL of a specific page that you want to add the retargeting pixel to.
Note:
The Lofty website URL will be auto-filled as the website whose setting you are currently in. The empty field after the URL is to add the pixel to only one specific page. If you leave the website URL field empty, the pixel will apply to all pages on this Lofty website by default.
After integrating, click

to update the integration.
Lofty App Listing Detail Page Update

his update includes some optimizations to the Lofty mobile app Listing Detail page.
Click

to view the list of leads who are a good fit for this listing.
The

and

icons have been relocated to the upper right corner. Click the

icon to send the listing link to another agent, a lead, or generate a showing link.
When sharing with a lead, you have the option to filter by leads who are

or by
All Leads.
Showing Tool Available in the Mobile Browser
With this update, we have optimized the Showing Tool to be functional in a mobile browser. Now, you can utilize all the Showing Tool features from your phone. Here, you can request a showing and manage your showing schedule.
Open API Update
If you have your Lofty website, as well as an external website, this feature update is for you! We have added an option to our Open API for Lofty users who want to retrieve a lead's website login link. This is helpful for anyone who want to guide leads
to their Lofty website, without having to log in to the Lofty website.

he URL with a login token

#### Article 632: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.20

- Article ID: `32847401426075`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T00:58:17Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/32847401426075-Feature-Updates-for-Lofty-4-20

Introduction
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user).
These features are subject to change at any time.
Release Date
Tuesday, January 21, 2025
Summary
Toggle Between Lofty Accounts (#h_01JHP5X299NMWBXKDB7N8FYB2D)
Social Studio: Filter Office Listings in Auto-Posts (#h_01JHP6MX65ZDX64KBX3WBB9RXY)
Training Calendar Update (#h_01JHP73N88RJNYGFDDP279JNE5)
Lofty Mobile App: Listing Search Enhancement (#h_01JHP7AXM3FPW9QH7KXVVV6JNW)
Transaction Checklist Library (#h_01JHP7KVYG1H2KHTF806WS0PJH)
Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) Platform Enhancements (#h_01JHP7PQ65RJ8AR4CFDJPA6R51)
Toggle Between Lofty Accounts
You can now link Lofty accounts together to easily switch between accounts, without needing to log out and log in each time.
To get started, navigate to the Avatar menu and click Add Account. This will open a new log in page. Once you log in to the other account, it will be available under the Switch Account option.
Click Switch Account to switch between the accounts you have linked. Click the X next to an account to unlink.
This functionality is also available in the mobile app by navigating to the app settings and selecting Add Account. Click the Add Account button to link another account. Click on the username to switch to that account. Click Manage to access the trash can icon to unlink accounts.
Important Note
: When accounts are linked, they are linked both ways. This means that if you can switch to their account, they can also switch to your account!
Social Studio: Filter Office Listings in Auto-Posts
If you have Social Studio Growth or Social Studio Elite, navigate to Marketing → Social Studio → Settings → Auto-Post Settings → Auto-Post Listing Rules. Here, you can decide which listings are automatically posted to your linked social media feeds. Office listings will pull from the office listings on the Listing Discovery page.
This isn’t new, but here’s the update:
You may only want to post some agents’ listings from your office, not all the agents’ listings. This update adds a filter to allow you to select which agents from your office will have their listings auto-post to your social media channels.
This filter functions the same as in the CMS listing filters, which determines which listings appear on your website. Learn more about the features available with a Social Studio add-on here:
Introduction to Social Studio Pro (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/23376022978203)
Training Calendar Update
We've added entrances to our live training calendar throughout the platform so you can find trainings on the topics you want to learn how to use! Entrances can be found on the Smart Plan page and in the Lead Routing Rules settings.
Clicking the banner or button at the top of the screen will redirect you to the live training calendar. We offer training for both admins and agents in many different categories.
We've also added a view to the Lofty calendar, so you can fit daily trainings into your work schedule.
View our full Live Training Calendar here:
Lofty LIVE Training (https://lofty.com/training)
Lofty Mobile App: Listing Search Enhancement
This update enriches the listing search experience by bringing it your mobile device! On the Lofty app listing page, filter for your search criteria, save the search, and see new matched listings each time you come back to that saved search.
Searches can be saved on map view as well, by selecting a location or drawing a custom map. Learn more about the Lofty mobile app here:
Lofty Real Estate App (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/17801017502491)
Transaction Checklist Library
We've created a library for transaction checklists, similar to the Smart Plan library. Navigate to Settings > Checklist Templates to access the Library. The checklist library is available to you, whether you are in the Company, Office, or Personal settings page. However, any checklists that you import will automatically correspond to the respective setting scope.
Click the Import icon to add a checklist from the library to your available transaction checklists. Once imported, you can further edit the checklist to fully customize it to your process!
Learn more about transaction checklists here:
Transaction Management Checklists (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057001712)
Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) Platform Enhancements
We've made several enhancements to the Lofty platform in our response to the recent changes to TCPA and one-to-one consent. Please see an overview of those updates here:
Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) Guide (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/32764090351899)
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

Introduction
Be sure to

#### Article 634: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.22

- Article ID: `34891049026715`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T00:56:49Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/34891049026715-Feature-Updates-for-Lofty-4-22

Introduction
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user).
These features are subject to change at any time.
Release Date
Monday, March 17, 2025
Summary
Lofty WordPress Plugin Optimizations (#h_01JP6BA7KFMDBFX8B6N3J3E37F)
Website Animation (#h_01JP6BZSHYREW64H0NNHN41MJT)
More Email and Text Message Variables (#h_01JP6C53M9CJT8DC2ZF5G5CRHF)
Drag & Drop Email Editor Updates (#h_01JP6CM2CN09C9EEPFKEKH70H4)
Privacy Regulation: DSAR (#h_01JP6CSQ6KTTW7P4PJ42AX2GB6)
Sales Tax Update (#h_01JP6D4Y91ZJF0NVJB3A6B12E6)
New People Page UI (#h_01JP6D7APR5SXWFDK94QW0ESNZ)
Lofty WordPress Plugin Optimizations
We've made some exciting optimizations to our WordPress plugin. The newest version allows you to customize your lead capture and registration form as well as set up property alerts.
The WordPress IDX Plugin is available to purchase in the Lofty Marketplace. Learn more here:
WordPress + Lofty IDX Plugin (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/26466256969371)
Website Animation
Your Lofty website has been improved with stunning animation on some of the blocks. See an example here:
Qualified website blocks will already have the animation applied. Navigate to the block style setting to toggle the animation off. Learn more about the website blocks available with your Lofty website here:
Lofty Block Library (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/sections/360007590131-Block-Library)
More Email and Text Message Variables
We've added new variables that can be used to automatically personalize your emails and text messages. Under General Variables, we've provided variables to identify the time of day, day of the week, month, and season.
Under Lead Variables, we've added a variable for a lead's family member's first name. Under Agent Variables, we've added a variable for the agent's sending email address.
Learn more about personalizing your messages here:
Email and Text Variables (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055270071)
Drag & Drop Email Editor Updates
Our drag & drop email editor has new formatting options! Add pre-built templates for agent details, listing information, and graphs. Also, the text box now supports emojis!
Learn how to use this email editor here:
How to Use the Drag-and-Drop Email Editor (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/32655105062171)
Privacy Regulation: DSAR
DSAR stands for Data Subject Access Request. DSAR is a request that individuals (data subjects) can make to an organization to access the personal data that the organization holds about them. DSARs are a key part of data privacy laws.
If you are based in California, you will see a DSAR button at the bottom of your Lofty built website.
Learn more about what your website visitors can request here:
Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/34891569535643)
Update to Cookie Preferences Default Settings
The cookie settings on your Lofty built website allow your website visitors to decide what data is collected from them and how that data is used. By default, website visitors will be opted out of all non-essential cookies. This does not affect lead registration rates or the data that is collected from your website visitors that you can see in your Lofty CRM. This may, however, show decreased event counts if you use Google Analytics.
Learn more here:
Cookie Preference Settings (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/34736360933915)
Sales Tax Update
Starting April 1, 2025, applicable sales tax will be charged on all Lofty packages and add-on purchases, in compliance with local tax regulations. This means that if sales tax is applicable, the sales tax amount will be added to your total at checkout, based on your location and the nature of the product or service. Sales tax will also be able to be viewed on your invoices. Please verify that your billing address is up to date by visiting your Lofty Billing Center.
Learn about this change here:
Sales Tax (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/34571596158107)
New People Page UI
Over a year ago, we make a significant update to the Lofty People Page UI. We have allowed you to switch between the old and new UIs since this change. However, we have not updated the old UI and it is now out of date and can no longer be supported. If you have been using the old UI, you will see that only the new UI is available now.
Learn how to use the new People Page UI here:
Updated People Page UI (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/21282508051227)
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

Mass Pause and Resume Smart Plans
If you've ever wanted to hit the pause button on all your automations while you're away from work, we have a solution for you! Lofty now allows you to mass pause and mass resume all of your Smart Plans, both for all leads that are subscribed to a specific plan, or for all the plans subscribed to a specific lead.
A report is available so you can see the results and verify that your Smart Plans were successfully paused or resumed. Learn more here:

Transaction Management Checklists (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057001712)
Unlink or Update MLS Claimed Listings on a Transaction
If you've ever selected the wrong MLS transaction when creating a transaction in Lofty, you know the pain of needed to start your transaction over from scratch. With this update, the MLS transaction can be easily unlinked or updated.
Learn more here:
Transaction Management Introduction (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057572991)
AI Blog Generation
We have added new blog capability to AI Copilot! Copilot can help draft a Listing or General blog post. Access the blog writer via the AI chat box or in the CMS tool.

#### Article 636: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.24

- Article ID: `36317317769371`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T00:56:30Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/36317317769371-Feature-Updates-for-Lofty-4-24

Introduction
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user).
These features are subject to change at any time.
Release Date
Monday, April 28, 2025
Summary
Task and Appointment Updates (#h_01JSN3TBC0A9ED54VKR6GSAGR1)
Update to Viewing Automated Tasks (#h_01JSN0FXYDHVQD7HTN5JHX9V47)
Task & Appointment Reminders (#h_01JSN1KFRGMMS9GZB95W2A6ND8)
Appointment Location Optimization (#h_01JSN22VXFMM6MAX12YKF6WHZ4)
Changes to the AI Sales Assistant (#h_01JSN3K1497ZV1RQAH1FVDR86P)
Task and Appointment Updates
We've made several optimizations to make your task management and appointment scheduling processes more efficient! Learn more about task and appointment management with Lofty here:
Tasks and Appointments (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/sections/360003073632-Tasks-and-Appointments)
Update to Viewing Automated Tasks
Automated tasks, like auto emails and auto texts, will no longer overload your task list. Moving forward, here is how your tasks will be displayed:
Today:
Will display manual and auto tasks that are due today.
This Week & This Month
: Will only display manual tasks that are due in this time period. If auto tasks are due today, they will be visible here.
Overdue
: Will only display overdue manual tasks.
Finished
: Will only Display finished manual tasks.
On the lead detail page, click the settings icon in the tasks box to hide automated tasks. This will help you see your manual tasks, without the auto task fluff.
Task & Appointment Reminders
When scheduling an appointment, we've added the option to send several reminders. This means that multiple reminders can go out to remind you and other participants of an upcoming appointment. Simply check the box next the reminders you want to apply.
Appointment Location Optimization
When scheduling an appointment, if a lead is added to the appointment, the lead's address will automatically populate as the location when scheduling the appointment. Lofty has also optimized the location setting on the appointment scheduling tool to auto-populate a typed address. This simplifies the appointment scheduling process and ensures the location is accurate!
Changes to the AI Sales Assistant
Lofty v4.24 introduces a massive update to the language model that powers the AI Sales Assistant. You will notice that the AI Sales Assistant will be more flexible and will engage in natural sounding conversations with your leads. It can answer common questions like "What is an FHA loan?" or "How do I raise my credit score?" More importantly, it can express empathy and understand context. For example, if a lead mentions their in-laws visiting to watch their kids, the AI can naturally understand that they'll need extra bedrooms and space for hosting family.
Assistant Profile
We are also introducing an Assistant Profile, where you can more easily manage the way the AI presents itself.
The Assistant Profile makes it simple to fully customize your AI Sales Assistant.
Learn more here:
AI Sales Assistant / Chatbot FAQ (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056322172)
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Release Date
Tuesday, May 27, 2025
Summary
Smarter & More Reliable Lofty AI Copilot (#h_01JVWJW1YQHH5RRQC149AHA0N7)
AI Sales Assistant Updates (#h_01JVWJX367QFX4VV7P9VGM7Q3C)

Smarter & More Reliable Lofty AI Copilot
Your Lofty Copilot has been upgraded! Copilot now adds new insights to lead summaries, including website activity, messages you haven't replied to, upcoming birthdays, and holidays.
While beta testing this feature, we found that agent task completion increased by 25%! Learn more here:
AI Copilot (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/33090360187675)
AI Sales Assistant Updates
We are upgrading the AI Sales Assistant's language model. This means that the assistant's conversations will be more natural and it can support up to 50 languages! We have been migrating all Lofty Sales Assistants to the model, so you may have seen this update already.
From those who have already gotten access to this upgraded assistant, the average text message per lead has increased by
127.27%
and average captured leads has increased by
107.69%
!
Learn more here:
AI Sales Assistant / Chatbot FAQ (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056322172)
New AI Marketer Automatic Post Feeds
When the AI Marketer launched, we supported two (2) automatic social media posts: My/Team Properties and Holidays. With this update, we support four (4) new automatic post types: Market Insights, Buyer & Seller Guides, Investment Insights, and Home Staging & Design.
Learn more here:
AI Marketer (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/34581906540955)
Transaction Document Templates
We know that real estate transactions often use the same documents. This feature lets you add those documents into Lofty and use them over and over on your transactions. While everyone can use the document templates, you have to have permission to create or edit a template.
Once a transaction document template has been created, you can upload as many documents from the template to your transaction with just one click.
Learn more here:
Transaction Management Documents (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360061195871)
Email Template Optimizations
We have a few updates to optimize your email notifications. When editing an automated email, you now have the option to edit using the
drag and drop email editor (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/32655105062171)
. Now, automated emails like the Welcome Email can be more customized and dynamic!
This update also adds a checkbox to save a newly written email as a template. Have you ever written the greatest email of your life and wished it could be a template to send to everyone you know? Now you can without recreating the content!
Learn more here:
Email Templates (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055290611)
Mobile App Task Management Update
We know you're always on the go and living off your phone. This update creates a new task widget in the Lofty mobile app, so you always know what you need to get done! Tasks are organized by their due date and more closely mirror the experience in the Lofty web app.
Learn more here:
How to Set Task/Appointment Reminders in the Lofty Mobile App (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002625986)

Search Lead

AI Copilot (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/33090360187675)

When you receive a notification, you will see more details about the message at a glance, so you can decide if you need to act on it now, or if it can wait until later.

Activity Leaderboard
This feature is currently being beta tested. You may or may not see this in your account.

Learn more about this reporting tool here:
Agent Accountability Activity Leaderboard (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/39194478318875)
Send a Landing Page via Mobile or Web Chat
When chatting with a lead, in either the web or mobile app, we’ve added a simple option to send the lead a landing page. Click the LPs icon to see a list of all the landing pages that the user has access to. There’s also a search bar and filters to find the page quickly.
Learn more about Landing Pages here:
Landing Pages (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038228552)
Sales Assistant Listings Updates
We're introducing some enhancements to the Sales Assistant's listing interaction abilities to deliver a higher-quality experience for leads by:
Encouraging them to stay longer on the Lofty website and chat with Sales Assistant
Making it easier to engage with listings in a natural, intuitive way.
Helping them revisit and compare their favorite homes.
Empowering agents with actionable insights into their clients’ preferences, enabling more targeted and meaningful follow-ups.
Sales Assistant already helps leads discover homes by understanding their preferences and recommending listings.
Now, it can close the loop by saving those listings directly to the lead’s search portal.
Learn more about the AI Sales Assistant here:
AI Sales Assistant / Chatbot FAQ (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056322172)

Customizable Agent Website

Virtual Phone Number
Maintain a professional presence and build brand recognition when calling or texting clients directly from the platform.
Call Package
Ensures every conversation is automatically recorded and logged on the lead’s profile, giving you a clear view of their last touchpoint and helping them stay organized and responsive.
Text Package
(Elite Branding Bundle only)
Share listings and keep conversations going, with every message saved to the lead’s profile for easy follow-up.
Lofty Present
A dynamic, custom-branded CMA tool that delivers detailed market insights, property comparisons, and a polished presentation experience for clients.
AI Marketer
A fully automated social media marketing tool that boosts brand awareness, promotes listings, and generates high-quality, low-cost leads.

to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

Release Date
Monday, August 18, 2025
Summary
AI Sales Assistant Official Relaunch - Launching August 25th (#h_01K2DDP3R70QZS5GD2436W4KAV)
Copilot Call Summary (#h_01K2DDM4KZJF45AEB38PAD7BFA)
AI Smart Notifications (#h_01K2DDM4KZJF45AEB38PAD7BFA)

DNC.com Integration Enhancements (#h_01K2DC1S56YM4G5P55EF0VVCV0)
AI Sales Assistant Official Relaunch - August 25th
We’re thrilled to announce the official relaunch of
Sales Assistant
, a massive leap forward in AI-powered lead engagement. After months of development, migration, and listening to your feedback, we’ve rebuilt our Sales Assistant from the ground up to be smarter, more human, and incredibly effective — and it’s now available to
every Lofty user
.
What's New?
Now Powered by Leading-Edge AI Engines!
We've changed the brain behind Sales Assistant, integrating it with the world's most advanced Large Language Models (LLMS), including the latest from ChatGPT and Claude. This ensures your Sales Assistant is always operating at peak intelligence, resulting in more natural and responsive conversations that genuinely connect with your leads.
Building on the foundation you know, the new Sales Assistant is now:
Feature
Enhancement
More Flexible
Engages in fluid, dynamic conversations—no more rigid scripts.
More Human
Replies with genuine empathy to build trust and real connections.
More Intelligent
Grasps the underlying intent of a conversation, not just keywords.
More Insightful
Acts as a true expert, offering deep market knowledge and advice.
More Context-Aware
Remembers past interactions for smarter, more proactive follow-ups.
Speak your Client's Language: Multilingual Support!
Break down communication barriers and connect with every lead in your community. The new Sales Assistant can now
automatically detect the lead's language and communicate fluently in multiple languages
.
Whether your lead prefers to text in their native tongue or you're expanding into diverse markets, your AI is now your personal translator and engagement expert, ensuring no opportunity is lost in translation.
Industry-Leading Performance you can Measure
Don't just take our word for it. The new Sales Assistant is already delivering incredible results. With a
text message reply rate of 59.4%
, it significantly outperforms industry averages, ensuring more of your leads are engaged and qualified—24/7.
Sales Assistant for Everyone!
No more limited trial periods. We believe every agent deserves a powerful AI Partner. That's why
every Lofty user
now gets access to Sales Assistant with a
quota of 10 leads
, included with your Lofty account. It’s the perfect way to experience how AI can help you nurture leads and boost conversions from day one.
Enhanced Setup Experience
We’ve redesigned the setup process so you can configure Sales Assistant through a conversational interface and see it in action immediately, right from your Marketing dashboard.
New Overview Page
The updated Sales Assistant dashboard gives you clear insights into how AI is helping your business:
Total Engaged
: Number of leads contacted via text, chat, or email
Total Contacted
: Total outreach messages sent
Saved Time & Cost
: See how much time and money you’ve saved
Lead Handoffs
: Track when Sales Assistant flags leads for your attention
Lead Management
: View and mute leads directly from the reporting page
You can also see all leads Sales Assistant is actively working and mute them directly on this page.
AI Smart Notifications
We're thrilled to announce the official launch of
Smart Notifications
, a powerful new feature that's now available to all users for free!
What's different about Smart Notifications?
Intelligent Summaries, at a Glance:
Smart Notifications automatically summarizes your leads' website behavior and new email or message activity. You can instantly grasp the key details without having to manually review a ton of information.
Actionable Suggestions:
Beyond just providing information, Smart Notifications offers suggestions for your next step. This helps you quickly decide on and take the most effective follow-up action.
Check out
AI Smart Notifications (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/40142262428059)
for more information!
AI Call Summary
Copilot can summarize key points from call recordings and suggest next steps after a call ends! This was a highly-requested feature from multiple users. This is available to all Lofty users in both the unlimited and freemium version of Copilot.
Check out
AI Call Summary + Transcript (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/40141859532699)
for more information!
Mobile Dashboard
The dashboard on the Lofty mobile app has been updated to more closely match the dashboard in the web app. If you've enabled notifications for the Lofty mobile app, expect to see a new notification at 8am daily with that day's top priorities.
We've also added quick actions. Swipe left to quickly text, email, or call a lead or to mark an appointment as completed or postponed.
If the daily priorities notification isn't for you, navigate to your app settings to disable this notification.
Learn more about the Lofty Mobile App here:
Lofty Real Estate App (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/17801017502491)
DNC.com Integration Enhancements
If you utilize DNC.com to manage your Do Not Contact list and Business Relationships, we have an enhancement for you! This update will allow you to sync your Lofty Internal Do Not Contact list with the Internal DNC list that is hosted in your DNC.com account. We also allow you to link a specific DNC.com project to Lofty, which will help you stay organized.
Learn more about this integration here:
DNC.com (Contact Center Compliance) Integration (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/35209288678555)

Mass Email

Navigate to the CMS tool -> Listings -> Listing Settings -> Open House to decide if you want to show or hide open house dates for listings on your Lofty built website. By default, this setting will be set to

When using the Social Studio to post content on Instagram, you now have the option to select a sub-channel.
The default channel is set to "Post,"

Regular Post:

Story:
Content Limitations: One image or one video without text.

Reels:
Content Limitations: One video with optional text. Supports editing the video name and thumbnail.
Display: Reels are featured in a dedicated section on Instagram.

- Article ID: `40489981379099`

Introduction
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user).
These features are subject to change at any time.
Release Date
Monday, September 8, 2025
Summary
Lead Ownership Simplification (#h_01K3RVCDJEPNRVN3Q0821BGY0V)
PandaDoc Integration (#h_01K3RVY7T8EX1VBAFKDM412ZTK)
Sales Assistant Chat Box Update (#sales-assistant-chat-box-update)
AI Marketer Update - September 24th Release (#h_01K4MX2QHA7X0PKSAX1SX97XHJ)
AI Copilot Generated Multi-Step Tasks (BETA) (#ai-copilot-generated-multi-step-tasks-whitelisted-feature)
Lofty Bloom Self-Purchase (#h_01K3VEMJQQZEWZVYN7ED2K8T6B)
Lead Ownership Simplification
We’ve simplified lead ownership for accounts with the
Only allow Company-Owned Leads
advanced setting enabled. When this setting is enabled, all leads are automatically company-owned, and ownership fields are hidden across the platform (lead profiles, people pages, and imports. This reduces complexity and confusion for agents that manage leads at the company level.
If your company needs individual lead ownership, it can be enabled anytime under
Settings → Permission Profiles → Advanced Settings
. Existing ownership data is preserved and will reappear if Flexible Lead Ownership is turned back on.
Learn more here:
Lead Ownership (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003544406)
PandaDoc Integration
Lofty now supports
PandaDoc
for electronic signatures. Connect your existing PandaDoc account or create a new one directly from Lofty via the
Marketplace
,
Personal Settings → Integrations
, or the
Transaction Detail Page → Documents → E-Sign
. Once connected, documents (PDF, DOCX, RTF) can be bundled, sent for signature, and tracked in Lofty, while edits and signature setup are completed in PandaDoc.
The
Send for E-Sign
menu now shows all connected providers, giving users flexibility to choose between DocuSign and PandaDoc. Please note: PandaDoc does not support passing email subject or message content from Lofty, and you must allow browser pop-ups for the editor to open.
Learn more here:
PandaDoc Integration (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/40537199314587)
Sales Assistant Chat Box Update
The Sales Assistant website chat box now supports common markdown formatting, making conversations clearer and more professional. Messages can include line breaks, bold text, lists, hyperlinks, and other frequently used styles, improving readability and presentation compared to the previous plain-text format.
Learn more here:
Getting Started with AI Sales Assistant (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/39659584983067)
AI Marketer Update - September 24th Release
The following features will release on
September 24th
.
AI Marketer's capabilities are expanding to include an AI Competitor Analysis that informs your personalized Social Strategy.
AI Social content will be generated 1 week at a time and does not require email authentication to post any more.
We've improved the post list and engagement timeline so you can be better connected with the activity that takes place across your connected channels!
We now support AI-generated captions for listing auto-posts! These unique captions are optimized for engagement and social media algorithms.
For more information on AI Marketer, visit
AI Marketer (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/34581906540955-AI-Marketer)
.
AI Copilot Generated Multi-Step Tasks (BETA)
AI Copilot can now create multi-step task plans to help you stay on top of lead follow-ups. When viewing a lead or asking Copilot to handle multi-step actions (like sending weekly emails), it will generate a suggested plan with emails, texts, and call reminders. Once you review, adjust, and activate the plan, it will show up in the new “Lofty AI” calendar view as well as on the Lead Detail Timeline.
If a lead replies while a plan is running, Copilot automatically stops the remaining tasks and notifies you to take over. This makes follow-ups more consistent and less manual, while still giving you full control!
This feature is currently being BETA tested. Learn more here:
Using AI Copilot Multi-Step Tasks (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/40528908682907)
Lofty Bloom Self-Purchase
Bloom self-purchase is available, allowing you to purchase directly from the Bloom intro or zip code check page. The guided flow allows you to select up to 6 zip codes and configure the campaigns yourself. Each service area requires its own Property Monitor setup, along with postcard approval and lead capture settings.
This update eliminates the need for manual assistance from Lofty, giving you full control to purchase and launch Bloom campaigns quickly and independently. Learn more here:
Lofty Bloom (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/32531151443995)
Questions?

Introduction
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user).
These features are subject to change at any time.
Release Date
Monday, September 22, 2025
Summary
AI Sales Assistant Can Now Email! (#sales-assistant-can-now-email!)
Appointment Time Schedule Optimization (#appointment-time-schedule-optimization)
Goal Module Update (Available Sept 25) (#goal-module-update-(available-sept-25))
Activity Reporting Log: Beta Test (Available Sept 25) (#h_01K5CHG4MNCWESYGQ1F59YW78V)
AI Sales Assistant Can Now Email!
The AI Sales Assistant now supports email in addition to text and chat, with replies sent in about 15 seconds.
Sales Assistant can monitor and respond to both new lead emails and ongoing threads using the email address set in Email Settings, ensuring seamless conversations across channels. We've also updated the AI Sales Assistant settings, so it's now easier to share the assistant across all users on the account. Learn more here:
Getting Started with AI Sales Assistant (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/39659584983067)
Appointment Time Schedule Optimization
Appointment scheduling is now smarter: times adjust automatically when the start time changes, and all entries snap to 15-minute increments to prevent errors.
Appointments now default to the next 15-minute interval, with a one-hour duration that can be adjusted. The start time will always be before the end time and the ending time moves when start times change. This reduces errors and ensures smoother scheduling. Learn more here:
Appointments (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/216290543)
Goal Module Update (Available Sept 25)
A new Business Goal Contribution Breakdown chart helps leaders track production by office and sub-offices. Activity goals are now optional when setting up goals with only Business Goals being required.
Starting September 25, account admins with user management permissions can view contribution breakdowns across offices and sub-offices for clearer performance insights. Goal setup has also been simplified: Business Goals remain required, while Activity Goals are now optional. Learn more here:
Goal Setting Portal (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/38585284533531)
Activity Reporting Log: Beta Test (Available Sept 25)
A new Activity Log helps agents track performance, log custom metrics, and view leaderboards. Company admins can configure up to 10 metrics, with the option to make some mandatory. This feature is available only for accounts with the
New Reporting Page Layout beta feature (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/37938213977499)
enabled on their account.
The Activity Log includes:
My Activity
: Agents can view performance, complete reporting tasks, and log custom metrics.
Leaderboard
: Shows rankings across default and custom metrics, visible by team hierarchy.
Custom Metrics
: Admins can configure up to 10 metrics in Company Settings, with mandatory options that trigger daily 6:00 PM reminders and submission pop-ups.
This structured reporting reduces errors, standardizes metrics, and ensures compliance where required.
Learn more here:
Agent Activity Metrics (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/41238866625051)

Company -

, and all new templates must be created within a folder. Your existing checklists are automatically migrated:

Introduction
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user).
These features are subject to change at any time.
Summary
Social Studio Auto-Post Logic Optimization (#h_01K9X1M7E8116HDN4565SXZ994)
Goal Setting Optimization (#h_01K9X1W5X06TXG32Q7M3FV0ZK3)
Transaction Page Update & New Offer Page (#h_01K9X20Z8BQ7GVW0PEM83NTDAS)
Revamped Dotloop Integration (#h_01K9X285DGTY4VT2V3DNVJZHD7)
Canva Integration (#h_01K9X2FAF4MEDY5KN13PNQXQSS)
New Lofty AI Assistant Layout (#h_01K9X2HXVB5VJK7DRJ9SRWD6TG)
Lofty AI Assistant - Web Search & Deep Research (#h_01K9X2QHS0SR2BEVYSSW24TPF2)
Lofty SEO Agent - AI Visibility (#h_01K9X3PBMJRZ988WK6HB9JA5YT)
Social Studio Auto-Post Logic Optimization
Redesigned auto-post controls make “My/Team/Other” toggles the single source of truth.
Prevents unwanted or duplicate social posts.
Each category toggle (My, Team, Other) now independently determines whether listings in that category auto-post on status change based on your triggers. Turning a toggle
OFF
stops future auto-posts regardless of existing feed records; turning it
ON
allows auto-posts when conditions match. “Clear All” still resets feed records, triggers, and connected profiles.
Actions for You
Review and set desired toggles. Use
Clear All
to restart setup if needed. Learn more here:
AI Marketer (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/34581906540955)
Goal Setting Optimization
Activity Goals are now separate from Business Goals.
New
Activity Goal
report under Reporting → Agent Activity.
You can set call/appointment objectives without creating transaction goals. Reporting adds a dedicated Activity Goal view for tracking progress, improving clarity for roles such as inside sales agents.
Actions for You
No action required. Optionally review goal configurations and use Reporting → Agent Activity →
Activity Goal
. Learn more here:
Goal Setting Portal (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/38585284533531)
Transaction Page Update & New Offer Page
Refreshed Transaction UI with clearer navigation.
New Offer tools: shareable link, manual entry, and per-offer management.
In Listing-type Transactions, the
Offer
tab supports link-based submissions from buyer agents and manual entry by listing agents. You can mark, edit, delete, and note offers. The
History
page is now called
Activities
; controls for type switching, List/Board view, and Stage Settings are streamlined.
Actions for You
Go to Listing-type Transaction →
Offer
tab to create/manage offers. No other action required. Learn more here:
Offer Management (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4412776507163)
Revamped Dotloop Integration
Modern two-way sync via OAuth2 and webhooks.
Manual claim/mapping of Dotloop loops to Lofty transactions.
Connect Dotloop in Personal Settings to enable real-time updates both directions. Send to Dotloop from Lead/Transaction, map existing loops, choose data precedence during claim, and view synced documents in a dedicated folder. Disconnecting does not remove historical data.
Actions for You
Reconnect Dotloop via
Personal Settings → Integrations
to activate the new sync. Learn more here:
Dotloop Integration (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/40544307298459)
Canva Integration
Note: This feature is expected to be available by the end of the year.
Lofty × Canva app lets you design with live listing/agent data.
Export finished designs back to Lofty for centralized storage.
Install the Lofty app in Canva to drag-and-drop Listings or Agent details into templates. Exports are saved to
Design Center → My Designs → Canva Designs
(auto-created). Works with free Canva accounts.
Actions for You
Install “Lofty” from the Canva App Marketplace and sign in to connect. No further setup required. Learn more here:
Canva Integration (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/43313315817499)
New Lofty AI Assistant Layout
Note: This updated is expected to be available on Wednesday, November 19.
AI Copilots
is our new Lofty AI brand and consists of two key components:
AI Assistant
– This is the chat feature accessible via the right-side menu bar.
AI Agents
– This page showcases all the AI agents we currently support or plan to support
The Assistant centralizes chat, email/SMS, reminders, and web search, while domain-specific Agents execute tasks (e.g., sales follow-up, marketing). Users interact with one Assistant that coordinates underlying automations.
Actions for You
No action required. Access the Assistant where Copilot previously appeared. Learn more here:
AI Copilot (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/33090360187675)
Lofty AI Assistant - Web Search & Deep Research
Note: This updated is expected to be available on Wednesday, November 19.
Real-time web search with citations.
Multi-step research and report generation in chat.
The Assistant can fetch current facts from public sources and compile concise, sourced reports (executive summary, findings, charts when available). Designed to extend beyond internal CRM data for market intel and presentations.
Actions for You
No action required. Ask the Assistant questions that need current data or request a research report.
Lofty SEO Agent - AI Visibility
Note: This is a beta released feature. You may or may not have access to this feature.
New dashboard for AI Engine Optimization (AEO) performance.
One-click “Boost Visibility” drafts optimized content.
See Mention Rate, Traffic from AI, and top platforms (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude). Review real AI response samples about your brand/listings. Use Boost Visibility to generate SEO/AEO content ideas and drafts via the Assistant.
Actions for You
Visit AI Visibility to review metrics and use
Boost Visibility
to publish optimized content.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
