#### Article 647: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.34

- Article ID: `44046711120411`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-12-08T16:26:59Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/44046711120411-Feature-Updates-for-Lofty-4-34

Introduction
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user).
These features are subject to change at any time.
Summary
New Navigation Bar (#new-navigation-bar)
Lead Detail Page Update (#lead-detail-page-update)
Transaction Management & Offer Comparison (#transaction-management-offer-comparison)
Buyer Lead Offer Management (#buyer-lead-offer-management)
Sales Tab Offer Management (#sales-tab-offer-management)
New Marketing Tab → Email (#new-marketing-tab-%E2%86%92-email)
New Marketing Tab → Text Messages (#h_01KBNPB9TEVV56ERAJNGBP80BW)
New Navigation Bar
Overview
Lofty’s navigation bar has been redesigned for faster access and an easier onboarding experience.
Core product functionality remains unchanged; only menu locations have been updated.
Release Details
The updated navigation bar reorganizes features into clearer, more intuitive menu groups, helping you move through the CRM with fewer clicks. All existing tools and capabilities are still available, but several items have been moved to new locations. Notably, the
Settings
page has been removed from the main navigation and is now located in the
Avatar
menu.
Lead Detail Page Update
Overview
The Lead Detail Page has been redesigned to better match real-world lead management workflows.
New tabs, streamlined note types, and reorganized data make it easier to manage properties, searches, transactions, documents, and automations.
Release Details
The updated Lead Detail Page introduces new tabs: Seller Properties, Buyer Searches, Transactions, Documents, and Automations to provide clear separation of lead activities. Insight data now appears above the Details section, and all search-related history has been moved into
Preference Profiles
under the Searches tab. New note types support faster showing logging and document uploads, each creating a corresponding timeline entry. All existing smart plans and alerts remain unchanged, and historical Search Criteria data has been migrated automatically to the new structure.
Learn more here:
Lead Profile Page (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055290591)
Transaction Management & Offer Comparison
Overview
New AI-powered tools now enable you to search, create, and update transactions using natural language.
A new Offer Comparison feature provides side-by-side offer reviews with an auto-generated summary.
Release Details
AI Transaction Management allows you to manage transactions through conversational inputs, including searching by criteria such as stage, property address, associated lead, and close dates; creating new transactions with basic details; and updating existing transactions through natural language commands.
The new Offer Comparison feature lets you compare multiple offers from a listing or transaction. AI generates a summary and a visual side-by-side report to help sellers understand key differences between competing offers. Learn more here:
Offer Management (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4412776507163)
Buyer Lead Offer Management
Overview
Create and manage buyer-side offers directly from the Lead Detail Page.
All offers tied to a lead are centralized for easier review, editing, and transaction creation.
Release Details
A new offer workflow is available in the
Searches
tab of the Lead Detail Page, where you can manually add offers and track the status (Submitted, Accepted, Declined, Lost, or Withdrawn). Each offer includes actions such as deleting, adding notes, viewing details, or creating a transaction. When a transaction is created from an offer, the property information from the offer is automatically applied. All offers created in this area are buyer-side only, and associated lead and transaction type settings remain fixed for data consistency.
Sales Tab Offer Management
Overview
A new
Offer List
view in
Sales → Offer
centralizes all listing-side and buyer-side offers.
Offers are automatically grouped based on how and where they were created, reducing duplicates and simplifying review.
Release Details
The new Offer List view provides a unified location for managing offers created from listings, transactions, or buyer leads. Listing-side offers are grouped when they originate from the same listing or listing-side transaction, while buyer-side offers are grouped by lead. Each row displays key information such as address, offer count, and highest/lowest offer amounts. Open any offer group to view or edit individual offers. This update streamlines offer organization and improves visibility across all active and historical offer activity.
New Marketing Tab → Email
Overview
Note: This feature is being beta tested. You may or may not have access to this feature.
The
Marketing → Email
module now provides a centralized view of all mass-email activity.
Three updated sections—Overview, Campaigns, and Templates—deliver clearer analytics, improved campaign management, and enhanced template organization.
Release Details
The new Email Overview Dashboard consolidates performance metrics, including sends, opens, replies, bounces, and time-based trends. Campaigns now feature improved filtering, clearer audience details, and a two-tab Campaign Detail page for email previews and analytics. Sent campaigns include recipient-level behavior with export options. The Templates area has been redesigned with folder navigation, search, card/list views, and bulk actions. Users can create templates using either the Classic Email Editor or the Drag-and-Drop Email Editor. Learn more here:
Email Templates (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055290611)
New Marketing Tab → Text Messages
Note: This feature is being beta tested. You may or may not have access to this feature.
Overview
The new
Marketing → Text Messages
module provides centralized analytics and management for all text-message activity.
The module includes
Overview, Campaigns, and Templates
sections, with tools for performance tracking, compliance alerts, and text-package monitoring. Text sending will be added in a future release.
Release Details
The Overview Dashboard consolidates metrics such as texts sent, delivered, delivery rate, replies, and historical trends. A
My Text License
panel shows package usage with alerts when limits are exceeded. The Campaigns section lists all text campaigns with search, filtering, delivery insights, and detailed engagement data. Templates remain consistent with existing text-template functionality. New system notifications alert you when required compliance settings—such as 10DLC registration or quiet hours—are missing. Learn more here:
Text Templates (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402878822285)
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

- Article ID: `44690730372507`

- Updated: `2025-12-24T21:45:49Z`

Introduction
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user).
These features are subject to change at any time.
Summary
Lofty AI Assistant New Features (#h_01KD3HZ0V355F40XXH3QQSD3KP)
New AI Assistant Welcome Message (#h_01KD3H4NYERFSW2NQ8HHPDCKNR)
Personal Disclaimer Update (#personal-disclaimer-update)
AI Listing Search (#h_01KD3H5HG4HVX7934V0JWNJAEX)
Smart Plan UI Updates (#h_01KD3H5HG5CWC3TZD055VVG0HY)
VoIP on Mobile (iOS Only) (#h_01KD3H41CTR1EM50SAJGFQWTCZ)
Lofty AI Assistant New Features
Introducing new Lofty AI Assistant features that improve research, file-based work, and long-running requests.
Enhancements focus on transparency, productivity, and flexibility, and are available to all AI Assistant users.
The Lofty AI Assistant now includes an enhanced Web Search experience, file uploads, and offline tasks. Web Search allows the Assistant to retrieve up-to-date information and clearly display clickable source links, improving transparency and trust. File uploads are now supported on web and mobile, enabling you to ask questions and complete tasks using your own documents, images, or data files. For complex or time-consuming requests, the Assistant can run tasks in the background and notify you when they are complete.
Learn more here:
AI Assistant (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/33090360187675)
New AI Assistant Welcome Message
Introducing a new, context-aware welcome message in the Lofty AI Assistant to help you get started faster.
Provides one-click suggested actions tailored to the specific page that you are on.
The Lofty AI Assistant now displays a welcome message the first time it’s opened on each page. This message adapts to your current location—such as the Dashboard, People page, Lead Detail pages, Calendar, or Transactions—to offer relevant guidance and suggested next steps. Below the message, you'll see a short list of recommended, high-value actions. Selecting one automatically starts the AI conversation, while you can still enter your own requests at any time.
Personal Disclaimer Update
Added an additional personal disclaimer.
You can now add more than one personal disclaimer to your profile. The disclaimers added here will automatically sync to your website's footer. Learn more here:
Personal Disclaimer (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4413545419675)
AI Listing Search
This feature is being beta tested. You may or may not have access to this feature. Please reach out to
support@lofty.com (mailto:support@lofty.com)
to request access.
AI Listing Search is a new natural language search experience for finding listings faster.
Automatically converts plain-language requests into structured search filters.
AI Listing Search allows both you and visitors to your website to search for listings using natural language instead of manually setting filters. Switch to
AI Search Mode
and describe what you're looking for. The system automatically interprets the request, applies relevant filters, and updates results in real time. Manual filters remain available and can be adjusted after the AI search is applied. This feature is available on both the
Listing Discovery
page and on your Lofty website listing search.
Smart Plan UI Updates
Redesign of the Smart Plan experience with a cleaner layout and improved organization.
Makes it easier to browse, manage, and preview Smart Plans and templates.
The Smart Plan experience has been updated with a modern, streamlined interface. Personal, office, and company Smart Plans are now combined into a single page, with a new
Scope
filter to quickly switch views. Smart Plans and library templates can be displayed in a card-based layout, making them easier to scan and compare, while the updated list view offers a cleaner design with filters moved to the top for faster access. As part of this update, the legacy Smart Plan Report has been temporarily removed while more detailed, plan-level performance insights are being developed. No Smart Plans or templates were removed as part of this change.
VoIP on Mobile (iOS Only)
We've added an Enable VoIP Calls setting in the Lofty iOS app to manage how incoming calls are delivered.
Helps prevent duplicate incoming call notifications when receiving calls through bridge mode.
This update introduces an
Enable VoIP Calls
setting for Lofty mobile app (iOS) users. When turned
on
(default), incoming calls are shown using Apple’s native call screen. When turned
off
, notifications are suppressed, allowing calls to be handled through bridge mode only.

#### Article 649: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.36

- Article ID: `45511206213403`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2026-01-16T21:49:30Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/45511206213403-Feature-Updates-for-Lofty-4-36

Introduction
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user).
These features are subject to change at any time.
Summary
Transaction Page Update (#transaction-page-update)
New Marketplace and Integration Center (#h_01KF1XHNB93JTW9H6CA5W27Y13)
Property Alert Optimization (Beta Release) (#h_01KF1XRJTS4QZD1G6W81PN8HCC)
Updated Smart Plan Builder (Beta Release) (#h_01KF1Y3J24Y2RQ53ZN2FY1Q3TN)
Transaction Page Update
Updated the Transaction List Page layout to improve visibility and ease of use.
Enhanced filtering behavior to make transaction counts clearer and more interactive.
The Transaction List Page has been updated with layout and interaction improvements designed to make managing transactions more intuitive. The Transaction Type switch is now centered on the page for better visibility, and the Dashboard Number remains prominently displayed at the top of the Kanban view for quick reference.
Filtering behavior has also been refined. When you first open the page, all transaction stages are selected by default, and the “All Transactions” count reflects the total across all stages. If you deselect one or more stages, the “All Transactions” number is greyed out and updates to exclude those stages. You can also click the Dashboard Number to toggle selection on or off, which stays in sync with the stage filters below.
New Marketplace and Integration Center
Separated the Marketplace and Integration Center to clearly distinguish Lofty products from third-party integrations.
The Marketplace and Integration Center are now split into two distinct destinations to improve clarity and navigation. The Marketplace displays only Lofty products and retains the existing layout, excluding third-party offerings. Users with customized Marketplaces will see their pages preserved as much as possible.
Property Alert Optimization (Beta Release)
Note: This feature is being beta tested. You may or may not have access at this time.
Property Alerts now automatically adjust sending frequency based on real lead engagement.
Property Alert emails have been refreshed to highlight key search criteria and improve click-through to listings.
Property Alerts now use Automatic Frequency Control to optimize how often alerts are sent to each lead. Leads who do not open or click alerts over time will automatically receive them less frequently (for example, daily to weekly or monthly), helping prevent inbox fatigue and protect email deliverability. Engaged leads who regularly interact with alerts will automatically receive them more frequently, ensuring timely delivery of relevant listings when interest is highest. Alert frequency also stays in sync with saved search changes to keep recommendations accurate.
In addition, the Property Alert email design has been updated to surface core search details, such as location, price, bedrooms, and bathrooms, directly in the email body. Listing cards now better highlight key property features, and quick links make it easier for leads to jump from the email to the website. Alert frequency is visible on each lead’s profile for added transparency.
Updated Smart Plan Builder (Beta Release)
Note: This feature is being beta tested. You may or may not have access at this time.
Introduced a new flow-based Smart Plan builder that makes creating and managing automation easier and more visual.
Added powerful new condition logic, including advanced timing and branching, to support more complex automation.
The Smart Plan builder has been redesigned from a segmented, multi-step setup into a flow-based canvas. You can now start from scratch or from a template, choose a plan scope up front, and immediately begin building your automation visually. A new expandable settings panel allows you to rename plans, adjust scope, update target lead type, and manage auto-apply and auto-pause settings without leaving the canvas, reducing interruptions during setup.
The new flow introduces major upgrades to conditions and triggers. Timing is now controlled through dedicated condition nodes, such as waiting a period of time, waiting until a specific date, or waiting for an event, rather than being embedded in actions. Multi-path branching supports AND/OR logic with fallback paths, enabling more precise automation. Existing Smart Plans with time or date-based delays will be migrated automatically to the new structure. All existing actions remain available and now run immediately when reached in the flow. Learn more here:
Smart Plan Builder – New Flow Guide (Beta) (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/45537578767643)
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!

Be sure to

to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user).
These features are subject to change at any time.
Summary
AI Copilots (#h_01KGNTGE4RPKEW20WH22RP4JDE)
AI Lead Analysis (#h_01KGJQDFSAF1FRGWYCKQV9TBNB)
Sales Agent Task Notifications (#h_01KGJQK5N89WBRCC97X84K79XV)
Sales Agent AI Suggestion Optimization (#h_01KGJQSZ8PDY98ZXW8KM55281D)
Property Alerts: Automatic Frequency Control (#h_01KGJQT4FMNBQHBCT1S3T2RQB7)
Group Text, Now More Flexible (#h_01KGJQVQ6D814X972TRHHABEJK)
AI‑Powered Filters and Segments (#h_01KGJR0ZW26GWEQ5TQEYD2EEPN)
Zapier Optimization (#h_01KGNSZ03SMJQHZW4MHJT64W9H)
AI Copilots
We've launched a fleet of AI Agents to help you work smarter by automating everyday tasks, surfacing timely insights, and keeping data organized across your workflow. By handling repetitive actions, like lead updates, follow‑ups, and data syncing, these tools free you to focus on building relationships and closing deals. The result is faster response times, better visibility into client intent, and a more efficient, consistent experience from lead to close.
Navigate to the Copilots tab to launch the agents that you have access to and request access to those in beta. Learn more about these AI Agents here:
Lofty AI Copilots (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/sections/25326537258011-AI-Copilots)
AI Lead Analysis
AI Lead Analysis gives you a fast, AI-powered way to understand the health and quality of your lead database, identify high-priority opportunities, and take action immediately. With clear segmentation, data health insights, and built-in next steps, you can focus on what matters most.
Highlights:
Analyze imported or existing leads directly from your AI Assistant
Clear lead segmentation to prioritize high-value opportunities
Data health checks that surface missing or incomplete information
One-click actions to activate Sales Agent or continue with the AI Assistant
Learn more here:
AI Lead Health Analysis: Understand and Prioritize Your Leads (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/44068001384603)
Sales Agent Task Notifications
The Sales Agents now sends immediate, AI-powered notifications when important tasks are created, ensuring calls, appointments, and follow-ups happen at the right moment. These notifications and reminders include AI-generated context and direct actions, helping you quickly understand what matters and prepare more effectively—so no opportunity is missed.
Highlights:
Instant notifications when Sales Agent creates a call, appointment, or task (via push, SMS, and/or email)
AI-generated reminders before scheduled calls and meetings with task-specific guidance
One-click access to actions like generating a tailored call script or reviewing appointment insights
Available to all sales agent users
Learn more here:
Getting Started with AI Sales Agent (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/39659584983067)
Sales Agent AI Suggestion Optimization
When the Sales Agent recommends that you call a lead, the call script is now created in just one click!
Click
Call with AI Script
to generate a call script and have the lead's number ready to dial! This is only available with the Sales Agent beta version. Learn more here:
Sales Agent Smart Leads & Playbook Settings (Beta) (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/45951611704603)
Property Alerts: Automatic Frequency Control
Property Alerts are now smarter and more personalized. With
Automatic Frequency Control
, Lofty adjusts how often alerts are sent based on each lead’s real engagement—helping you reach clients at the right time without overwhelming them.
What’s new:
Alert frequency automatically adjusts based on opens and clicks
Highly engaged leads receive updates more frequently when interest is high
Less‑engaged leads receive fewer emails while staying subscribed
This update helps improve engagement, protect email deliverability, and create a more relevant experience for every lead—without requiring any manual setup. Learn more here:
Property Alerts: Automatically Send Relevant Listings to Your Leads (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/46283225611291)
Group Text, Now More Flexible
Group Text has been enhanced to support richer conversations with multiple agents and leads in the same thread. These updates make it easier to collaborate, reply seamlessly, and understand who’s involved—without breaking text workflows.
Highlights:
Add multiple agents (using virtual numbers) and multiple leads to one group
Agents can reliably reply in Lofty chat
Clear ownership and text usage rules
Role labels for better visibility of group members
Learn more here:
Texting via Lofty (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057630352)
AI‑Powered Filters and Segments
You can now use AI to build filters and segments faster across People Lists and Segments. These updates make it easier to turn your ideas into accurate filters and segments with less manual setup.
Highlights:
Use natural language to find and apply filters on the People List
Create and edit segments with AI‑generated filter suggestions
Review and confirm filters before applying them
Learn more here:
Lead Organization with Filters (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055290571)
and
Lead Organization with Segments (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038401831)
Zapier Optimization
Two new fields have been added to the configuration forms for the
Create Lead
and
Update Lead
actions in Zapier:
TimeFrame (Buyer)
TimeFrame (Seller)
When values are entered into these fields, the mapped data will sync directly to the corresponding Lofty lead. This enhancement improves Zapier integration flexibility by allowing buyer and seller timelines to be accurately captured and kept in sync.
These new TimeFrame fields are available in both the
Create Lead
and
Update Lead
Zap actions. Learn more here:
Zapier Integration (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/40541430822043)

#### Article 651: Feature Updates for Lofty 4.38

- Article ID: `47438279273243`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2026-03-13T16:48:57Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/47438279273243-Feature-Updates-for-Lofty-4-38

Introduction
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user).
These features are subject to change at any time.
Summary
Sales Agent Updates (#h_01KJZG8F9B303T39EH3017EVQW)
AI Assistant Updates (#h_01KJZGK17SAHQ22STMH10H3HQC)
Personal Number Variable (#h_01KK20V4RR2F71WQ8FDSFWY0K5)
Custom Date Filter Optimization (#h_01KK2139YZGPD3DKSN5Z1KG2E2)
Hyperlocal Website (#h_01KK21JN1CZS5BXCMKH71S83Z4)
API Key Enhancements (#h_01KK2GB8XBFN6F1HHWFB12ZQRC)
Sales Agent Updates
The Sales Agent has received a series of updates this release covering expanded access, smarter automation, a cleaner interface, and more control over your account. The Playbook and Smart Leads view are now open to all users, quota alert emails have been reduced to once every 7 days, the Lead Timeline has been streamlined with new activation and stop messages, unnecessary Playbook Call Tasks have been reduced, and you can now cancel or opt out directly in the platform. New users will also find activation faster with no credit card required and a one-step setup with smart defaults pre-configured.
The Sales Agent was initially being beta tested, but is now available to all!
Highlights:
All Sales Agent users now have access to Playbook settings and the Smart Leads view on the People Page, no special access needed
The Lead Timeline now hides low-value system events by default and shows clear messages explaining when and why Sales Agent activated or stopped on a lead
The "Call Task Assigned" Playbook Goal default has been turned OFF; existing accounts were updated automatically, and the setting can be re-enabled at any time
Activating Sales Agent no longer requires a credit card, and setup now takes one step with smart defaults already configured
Learn more here:
Sales Agent Smart Leads & Playbook Settings (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/45951611704603)
AI Assistant Updates
The AI Assistant has received two significant updates this release. It now understands which page you are on and remembers your past conversations, making responses more relevant to your current workflow. If you are using the free trial version of the AI Assistant, the daily conversation limit has been removed. Upgrade to the AI Assistant Pro version to access Deep Research searches.
Highlights:
Page context awareness: the AI Assistant detects your current page and can reference it in responses
All conversations are automatically saved and organized by date (Today, Yesterday, and earlier)
A redesigned Prompt Library helps you discover what the AI Assistant can do, organized by task type
A Back button lets you return to the welcome screen and start a new chat at any time
Learn more here:
AI Assistant (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/33090360187675)
Personal Number Variable
A new message template variable, #agent_personal_number#, lets you automatically insert your Personal Virtual Number (PVN) into any email or text template. No more manually updating templates when your number changes.
Highlights:
Add #agent_personal_number# anywhere in a message template to insert your PVN at send time
If your PVN changes, all templates using this variable update automatically
Works across both email and text message templates
Learn more here:
Email and Text Variables (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055270071)
Custom Date Filter Optimization
The "is less than X days ago" condition in the Custom Date filter has been updated to use the current time as the end of the date range instead of midnight. Activities from earlier today are now included in your filter results.
Highlights:
"Is less than X days ago" now counts from the current moment, not from midnight
Today's activity is included in results, eliminating the previous "one day behind" issue
Existing saved filters using this condition update automatically, no reconfiguration needed
All other date filter conditions are unchanged
Learn more here:
Lead Organization with Filters (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055290571)
Hyperlocal Website
A new website package is now available in the Lofty Marketplace, designed to position you as the go-to expert in your local market. The Hyperlocal Website package pairs a premium hyperlocal website with a done-for-you design service, so your site is built and ready to generate leads without the heavy lifting on your end. Once purchased, Lofty's team will reach out within 24 business hours to kick off your setup.
Highlights:
Purchase your new Hyperlocal Website directly from the Marketplace under Branding and Marketing, where it's now featured as the top website option
Your site is built by AI using your marketing profile and includes a premium homepage, in-depth neighborhood area pages, and an interactive click map that drives engagement and captures leads
Three SEO-optimized blog posts are automatically generated for your farm area to help establish your local expertise from day one
Learn more here:
Hyperlocal Website (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/47502661499547)
API Key Enhancements
You now have full control over your API keys directly from your Lofty account settings. The API key management system has been updated so you can create, name, and manage keys with built-in security protections, expiration reminders, and a clear audit trail. Your existing API keys have been automatically migrated and will continue to work without any action required on your part.
Highlights:
Create and manage API keys from Personal Settings > Integrations > API Keys, with the ability to add a name, description, and optional expiration date to each key.
Your existing API keys have been migrated automatically and remain active with no disruption to existing integrations.
Set optional expiration dates on any key and receive email reminders at 30, 15, 7, and 1 day(s) before it expires so you can plan ahead and avoid unexpected access disruptions.
Keep up to 10 active keys at a time. Expired or revoked keys are preserved in your history for reference and do not count toward the limit.
Learn more here:
API Key Management (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/47499531505179)
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

- Article ID: `47785431664923`

- Updated: `2026-03-20T19:19:23Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/47785431664923-Feature-Updates-for-Lofty-4-39

Introduction
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user).
These features are subject to change at any time.
Summary
Docusign Room Integration (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/48043688743067)
Vendor/Partner Management (#h_01KKM535RCW61QQAN25K9QGFE0)
Add Contacts into Transactions (#h_01KKM52VR91Y1Q5RG5980XT5NS)
Source, Segment, and Tag Optimization (#h_01KKM52KDJ59A2CK0K9J28DWQN)
Sales Agent: Smarter, More Coordinated Lead Outreach (#h_01KM6ARPVD7F24M22TW8KWYZ91)
Sales Agent: Updates for Ads Clients (#h_01KKM5265V05GFDMXXZKHHS4Q4)
Sales Agent: AI Task Notification Optimization (#h_01KKM50M55B7VZTY01BDFPDD63)
DocuSign Room Integration
Lofty now integrates with DocuSign Rooms, allowing agents to link their DocuSign account directly to Lofty and keep transactions in sync between both platforms.
For more information, see
Docusign Room Integration (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/48043688743067)
Vendor/Partner Management
Your vendors and partners in Lofty are now organized by visibility level, giving you control over who can see each one. You can set a vendor to be visible across your entire company, within your office, or just for yourself, so your list stays relevant and easy to manage regardless of how large your team is.
Highlights:
Three scope levels: Company (all users), Office/Team (your office and sub-offices), and Personal (only you).
A new Scope field is available when adding or editing a vendor or partner.
The scopes available to you are based on your permission profile.
Existing vendors and partners are automatically migrated to the new scope system at release based on who created them. No action is required.
Learn more here:
Vendor and Partner Management (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360004792091)
Add Contacts into Transactions
You can now add multiple Leads, Agents, Vendors/Partners, and Lenders all to a single transaction, giving you a complete picture of everyone involved in a deal from one place. The associated lead is automatically added when you create a transaction, and any other leads you add will have the transaction linked to their profile.
Highlights:
Add any contact type to a transaction's Contacts panel by clicking the "+" button and searching by name or email.
Vendor/Partner Contacts can hold multiple roles within the same transaction. Leads can only hold one role.
Add a new lead directly from the transaction without navigating away.
Add a vendor or partner from a transaction and choose whether to save them to your system for future use or link them to this transaction only.
Learn more here:
Transaction Management Introduction (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057572991)
Source, Segment, and Tag Optimization
Managing sources, segments, and tags in large databases just got easier. You can now transfer or bulk-delete lead sources, control who can see your saved segments, and filter tags by creation level. For accounts with thousands of records, these updates make your CRM significantly easier to maintain.
Highlights:
Transfer leads from one source to another in bulk, with a simple popup flow. Requires the Lead Sources permission.
Sources with associated leads cannot be deleted until leads have been transferred, protecting your data.
When saving a segment, choose who can access it: just you, your office, or your entire company.
Filter your segment and tag lists by Personal, Office, or Company level for faster navigation.
Your five most recently used sources and tags now appear at the top of selection lists, labeled for easy identification.
Learn more here:
Lead Organization with Sources (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360041252272)
,
Lead Organization with Segments (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038401831)
,
Lead Organization with Tags (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038603951)
Sales Agent: Smarter, More Coordinated Lead Outreach
The Sales Agent has been updated to make more informed decisions about how and when it reaches out to your leads. It now has full visibility into each lead's complete history and recent activity before taking any action. This means it can better determine:
Whether a lead needs follow-up — the Sales Agent won't continue outreach to a lead it has already recently engaged, preventing the experience of receiving back-to-back messages that feel disconnected or repetitive
Which channel to use — email, text, or call selection is based on the lead's history and behavior, not just a fixed sequence
What to say — message content is informed by what the lead has actually done recently, making outreach more relevant
Previously, the Sales Agent could send a follow-up without awareness that the lead had just been responded to through another channel. This could make the experience feel disjointed — more like automated blasts than a real, attentive conversation. With this update, the Sales Agent maintains a coherent, context-aware thread of communication with each lead.
Sales Agent: Updates for Ads Clients
If you currently use the Sales Agent with your Lofty ad services, the Sales Agent is moving from an automatic, unlimited model for ad leads to an opt-in, quota-based model that works across all your leads, not just advertising leads. This change gives you more flexibility and a clear quota you can manage.
Highlights:
Ads clients who have never activated Sales Agent will receive a notification with their Sales Agent quota to claim. Complete the Onboarding to activate.
Ads clients who already have Sales Agent active will receive an automatic +100 quota increase. No action needed.
Sales Agent can now follow all leads in your database, not just your ad leads.
Learn more here:
Getting Started with AI Sales Agent (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/39659584983067)
Sales Agent: AI Task Notification Optimization
Notification channels for AI-generated tasks are no longer controlled by a single shared setting. Each task type - AI Call Created, AI Appointment Created, and AI Other Task Created - can now be configured independently within Notification Settings. Enable or disable Push, SMS, and Email notifications for each task type separately, allowing more precise control over how you receive alerts.
Highlights:
Notification settings for AI-generated tasks can now be configured independently by task type.
Agents gain more control over how they receive alerts for AI Calls, Appointments, and Other tasks.
Learn more here:
Lofty Notifications (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360016101752)
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)

Be sure to

to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!
Important:

Summary
Sales Agent Dedicated Email Address & Updated Unsubscribe Logic (#h_01KMPF698WNZ49NYRD55FXF25G)

Smart Plan Updates (#h_01KMPFZH7G7SC7RCZF8QWCCQ4H)
Sales Agent Dedicated Email Address & Updated Unsubscribe Logic
Note: This update has been delayed.
Your Sales Agent now has its own dedicated email address, ensuring the sender name and email address always match when reaching out to leads. Every Sales Agent email also now includes an unsubscribe option, giving leads a clear and compliant way to opt out if they choose.
Highlights:
The Sales Agent uses a dedicated email address that is separate from your own sending address. If you have a custom email domain, the Sales gentA automatically uses it.
The sender name and email address always match, eliminating the confusion that can come from a mismatch.
Every Sales Agent email includes a footer unsubscribe link. Leads who unsubscribe are removed from Sales Agent email only; the Sales Agent can still reach them via text and chat.
You can edit the Sales Agent email prefix in Settings under the Profile tab. You will see a warning if changing the prefix would break ongoing reply threads.
Learn more here:
Getting Started with AI Sales Agent (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/39659584983067)
Exclude Do Not Contact Pipeline Leads from Sales Agent Communications
The Sales Agent now fully respects the Do Not Contact pipeline. When a lead is moved into DNC, the Sales Agent immediately stops all follow-up across email, text, and chat. DNC leads also cannot be re-activated by the Sales Agent by any method, ensuring your Do Not Contact list is always honored.
Highlights:
The Sales Agent stops all outreach (email, text, chat) the moment a lead is moved to the Do Not Contact pipeline.
DNC leads cannot be re-activated by the Sales Agent through any method, including auto-enrollment rules and bulk activation.
Moving a lead out of DNC restores their eligibility for the Sales Agent. You can then manually re-activate them when ready.
A timeline entry is logged whenever the Sales Agent is stopped due to a DNC pipeline change, so you always have a clear record.
Learn more here:
Sales Agent Smart Leads & Playbook Settings (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/45951611704603)
Smart Plan Updates
If you have the new Smart Plan UI, we've added back the option to add due dates to Smart Plan manual tasks, like
Email, Text, Call, Other, and Checklist
actions. Due dates can be set to trigger immediately, after a defined number of hours or minutes, or after a defined number of days at a specific time.
The limit for date-based Smart Plan triggers has been increased from
10
to
50
, and six new United States holiday triggers are available for annual campaigns. Holidays with variable dates, including Easter, Memorial Day, and Thanksgiving, are calculated automatically each year.
Highlights:
Smart Plans now support due dates for all manual task types in the new experience, and recurring date-based triggers now support up to
50
recurrences.
Smart Plans also include
six new holiday-based date triggers
to help automate annual outreach: St. Patrick’s Day, Easter, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Halloween, and Thanksgiving.
Learn more here:
Managing Smart Plans (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/7626737520923)

- Article ID: `21768514663323`
- Category: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Section: `Lofty Feature Updates`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T01:47:22Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/21768514663323-Feature-Updates-for-Lofty-4-4

Introduction
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user).
These features are subject to change at any time.
Please see our Learning Center course on this update
HERE (https://learningcenter.lofty.com/courses/lofty-v4-4)
. Having trouble accessing the course? This article will show you how to access the Lofty Learning Center:
How to Access the Lofty Learning Center (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/13857197513115)
Release Date
Tuesday, January 16th, 2024
Summary
Lofty System Tags and Sources Update (#h_01HKTSADMBR10V7AZ7J3EC13Y9)
Call Package Optimization (#h_01HKTSADMBQKJR9M7YT5MVMHNY)
Character Limit Increases (#h_01HKTSADMBY52VZRGRGV7NYGRA)
Website Block Optimizations (#h_01HKTSADMBNKXJJ49M6RAQFEBN)
SEO Tool Beta Feature (#h_01HKTSCRJVJAN835SNXYVSDS20)
Lofty Assistant Beta Feature (#h_01HKTSCCZ5GKTGNGB721MHC37G)
Lofty System Tags and Sources Update
Automatic changes happening on January 16th:
Due to Lofty's recent rebranding, system tags and sources will automatically be updated from "Chime" to "Lofty." This includes all lead data (tags, sources, etc.), reporting, Smart Plans, and lead routing rules associated with these tags and sources. We are ensuring that this change is seamless,
and no action is required on your part
.
Updates required for third-party integrations:
If you have integrated third-party systems (like Zapier) with our platform, you may need to update those configurations by adding the new Lofty system tags and sources. Some specific changes to look for on this one:
Sources
"Chime Paid Leads" will change to "Lofty Paid Leads"
"Chime Listing Ads" will change to "Lofty Listing Ads"
"Chime Postcard" will change to "Lofty Postcard"
Tags
"Chime Nurturing Ads" will change to "Lofty Nurturing Ads"
"Chime Email Lead" will change to "Lofty Email Lead"
"ChimePaid-FB" will change to "LoftyPaid-FB"
"ChimePaid-Google" will change to "LoftyPaid-Google"
"Re-registered (Chime Paid-FB)" will change to "Re-registered (Lofty Paid-FB)"
"Re-registered (Chime Listing Ads)" will change to "Re-registered (Lofty Listing Ads)"
"Re-registered (Chime Paid-FB Form)" will change to "Re-registered (Lofty Paid-FB Form)"
"Re-registered (Chime Paid-Google)" will change to "Re-registered (Lofty Paid-Google)"
"ChimePaid-Microsoft" will change to "LoftyPaid-Microsoft"
"ChimePaid-Remarketing Lead" will change to "LoftyPaid-Remarketing Lead"
"ChimePaid-FBform"will change to "LoftyPaid-FBform"
*Important Note:
Only the system tags and sources originally provided by us (formerly under the Chime name) will change. Any tags and sources you have created yourself will remain unaffected.
Call Package Optimization
On the
Call/Text Settings
page, you have the option to delete or transfer a package.
The
Delete
logic is not changing. When a package is deleted, it can only be used by its current owner until the expiration date, when the package is deleted.
The
Transfer
option will allow you to transfer a package to another user on your account.
Packages that can be transferred:
All active call and text packages, including any packages that have been deleted but have not reached their expiration date.
Who can the package be transferred to?
Depending on the user management permission:
Team package: can transfer to any other user on the account
Enterprise package: can transfer to users in their hierarchy group or to any user in the entire company
Multi-team package: Call and text packages cannot be transferred among sub-teams
Who can transfer a package?
Only the user who is paying for the package
Character Limit Increases
Lead Source
The character limit for a Lead Source is increasing from 30 characters to 100 characters.
Lead Notes
The character limit for Notes on the lead's profile is increasing from 4,020 to 20,000 characters. You will also be able to export the most recent 100 notes on a lead's profile.
Website Block Optimizations
Two (2) optimizations are available to Company, Team, Group, and Agent websites. We have added an option to copy and paste or save a customized version of the following website blocks:
Agent
Banner
Content
Call to Action (CTA)
Embed
Form
Gallery
Team
Video
The option to customize a block is only available if your website is built on a Custom Template. If you are using one of the provided templates, you will not have this option.
SEO Tool Beta Feature
This addition to Lofty's CMS tool will help you evaluate and improve your website's search engine optimization. If you have a Company, Team, Group, or Agent website and you would like access to this feature, please reach out to our support team to request to have it added to your account.
Our Help Center article on this feature is available here:
Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Tool (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/21967062975515)
Lofty Assistant Beta Feature
We are beta testing two assistants, one for the web CRM and one for the Lofty mobile app, that can help you navigate the CRM and mobile app, answer your questions, and help you realize your potential. Please see our Help Center articles on these Lofty Assistants here:
Lofty Web Assistant (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/21970705527579)
Lofty Mobile App Assistant (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/21971931688859)
If you would like to have the Lofty assistant added to your account, please submit a request to our support team. Please specify if you would like to try the web assistant, the mobile assistant, or both Lofty assistants.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Introduction
Be sure to
subscribe here (https://share.hsforms.com/11bl-93iKSf-XqeagmqL3vQ21onw)
to stay up to date on all Lofty product news!
Important:
Please note that the availability of certain features outlined in these release notes will vary depending on the package and add-ons that you have purchased as well as the account type that you have (admin/standard user).
These features are subject to change at any time.
Summary
Transaction Role Default Person Setting (#h_01KNSKRBB4J6WVSBD7W34TEAZ2)
Vendor/Partner Optimization (#h_01KNSKT9HS6WJJ8BC4EFPA0ECN)
Transaction Lead Portal (#h_01KNSKVXHVXT9XGQE0B39VBMVC)
Sales Agent: Digital Employee (#h_01KNSKWPDQ61R45H2RYB6WY57Q)
Sales Agent: Smarter AI Conversations (#h_01KNSKXE2QY7V12W38E05SWQDP)
Smart Plan Performance (#Smart-Plan-Performance---@Dafu-Zheng)
Transaction Role Default Person Setting
You can now save time on every transaction by pre-configuring default contacts for specific roles. Once set up, designated contacts are automatically added to every new transaction you create, in the role you specify. Company admins can set defaults for the entire team, and individual agents can also configure their own personal defaults.
Highlights:
Set default contacts for Vendor/Partner, Agent, and Lender roles at the company or personal level.
Defaults are applied automatically to every new transaction, eliminating repetitive manual setup.
Tasks are automatically assigned to the default person in a role (when only one exists), reducing unassigned tasks.
Learn more here:
Transaction Management Introduction (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057572991)
Vendor/Partner Optimization
Managing vendors and partners in your transactions is now easier. You can assign multiple roles to a single vendor or partner in Settings, and when you add them to a transaction, their roles are automatically pre-filled for you.
Highlights:
Assign multiple roles to a single vendor or partner in one step (for example, Inspector and Contractor).
Roles are automatically pre-filled when adding a configured vendor or partner to a transaction.
Pre-filled roles can be modified before saving.
Learn more here:
Vendor and Partner Management (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360004792091)
Transaction Lead Portal
A new Transaction Lead Portal lets you share real-time transaction progress with your leads through the Closely app. You choose exactly which stages and documents are visible, and leads can view their transaction status, review and e-sign documents, and upload files directly back to you.
Highlights:
Activate the Lead Portal from the Transaction detail page and choose which leads can see the transaction.
Control which transaction stages and individual documents are visible to leads.
Leads can view progress, e-sign required documents, and upload files from the Closely app.
Lead-uploaded documents sync automatically to the Transaction Documents module.
Receive email and push notifications when a lead uploads or deletes a document.
Learn more here:
Transaction Lead Portal (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/48972164737435)
Sales Agent: Digital Employee
Sales Agent has been redesigned as a Digital Employee you can hire. Browse a Marketplace of specialized AI agents, choose one that fits your business, and hire them with a single click. Three pre-built agents are available, or you can build your own.
Highlights:
Browse three pre-built Digital Employees: Anna (Speed-to-Lead), Lucas (Buyer Specialist), and Lily (Seller Specialist).
Each agent has a unique profile showing their role, skills, and performance stats.
Hire your chosen agent in one click with an automated setup that takes about 4 seconds.
Prefer something custom? Use "Build Your Own" to create a personalized agent with your own name, description, and channel preferences.
The Sales Agent Digital Employee utilizes your existing Sales Agent quota.
Learn more here:
Sales Agent: Meet Your Digital Employee (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/48973695962523)
Sales Agent: Smarter AI Conversations
Sales Agent's underlying AI has been significantly upgraded to deliver smarter, more adaptive lead conversations. The AI now evaluates the full context of each lead before deciding when and how to reach out, coordinates with your own outreach to avoid overlap, and changes strategy when a lead stops responding.
Highlights:
Sales Agent now decides when to wait rather than send, reducing the chance of over-messaging leads.
The AI tracks your calls and texts and adjusts its outreach to avoid redundant contact.
Lead preferences, constraints, and intent signals are identified and used to personalize conversations in real time.
When a lead stops responding, Sales Agent shifts strategy rather than repeating the same messages.
Learn more here:
Sales Agent Smart Leads & Playbook Settings (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/45951611704603)
Smart Plan Performance
Smart Plan Performance adds analytics directly to the Smart Plan edit experience so agents and admins can monitor the results of automated follow-up communications. Switch between Email and Text views, review status trends over a selected time range, and use filters such as time range and email subject to narrow results. The edit view now includes two tabs: Builder for the existing workflow canvas and Performance for analytics.
Highlights:
Open any Smart Plan, select Edit, and click the Performance tab to view analytics
See how automated emails and text messages are performing, with chart and table views plus filtering options.
Learn more here:
Smart Plan Builder (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/45537578767643)
Questions?

Introduction
Important:

These features are subject to change at any time.
Please see our Learning Center course on this update
HERE (https://learningcenter.lofty.com/courses/lofty-v4-5)
. Having trouble accessing the course? This article will show you how to access the Lofty Learning Center:
How to Access the Lofty Learning Center (https://help.chime.me/hc/en-us/articles/13857197513115)
Release Date
Monday, January 29 and Wednesday January 31, 2024
Summary
Available on Monday, January 29, 2024 (#h_01HN3EY70TPNFN3YSVNXH0N1FM)
Transaction Page UI Optimization (#h_01HN3F092M5D0ZYH8HTAPX1JKX)
Transaction Owner Optimization (#h_01HN3HRRH1W33XSJYZVX703FPH)
Commission Updates (#h_01HN3JK2YKT38ESD97AV8CD4K5)
Available on Wednesday, January 31, 2024 (#h_01HN3ES02Z7JV6F1BVKKZG8BHW)
Lead Mailing Address Optimization (#h_01HNDS888X7DTWVBQFX83C6FW6)
Showing Notification Improvements (#h_01HNDSM5AGZTHX1J2A6ZB1MFJW)
Social Studio Pro Auto-Post Listing Filter (#h_01HNDTF8SWHQE0Y9CTVDA9HF0X)
Available on Monday, January 29, 2024
Transaction Page UI Optimization
We have made some updates to the CRM Transaction Detail Page UI. Overall, the functionality is not changing, but the UI will look a bit different.
Before
After
Please see our Help Center article
Transaction Management Introduction (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057572991)
for more information.
Transaction Owner Optimization
We have optimized transaction ownership so that the primary owner of the transaction no longer has to be the primary agent who is assigned to the lead.
As a reminder, each transaction must be assigned to a lead, and each transaction must have an owner. The update here is that the transaction owner can be any agent on the team, and not just the lead's primary assigned agent.
Lofty Enterprise Accounts Only
If you are on a Lofty Enterprise account, you will have an additional permission added to the permission profiles advanced settings.
Transaction Roles
:
By default, Enterprise accounts will be set to "
Allow users to assign transactions to any other user within the account."
These settings will allow you to limit Transaction ownership to only users within that user's own Hierarchy group.
You can also set an exception, where certain agents or groups can assign transaction ownership to other agents or groups.
Commission Updates
We have made some general updates to the commission portion of a transaction. Please see those details in the Closing a Transaction section of our Help Center article:
Transaction Management Introduction (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057572991)
We have also updated our Commission Disbursement Authorization (CDA) form. Please see our Help Center article:
Commission Disbursement Authorization (CDA) Generation (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/18252204443547)
Available on Wednesday, January 31, 2024
Lead Mailing Address Optimization
Previously, the lead's entire mailing address was stored in the same field on the lead detail page, as seen below:
We have separated the lead's mailing address into different fields, so you can be confident that the lead's mailing address is correct when you want to send them a letter or postcard via the mail.
Existing leads with a mailing address will be updated automatically. We do recommend that you double check the mailing address before sending a letter or postcard, to ensure that the mailing address format is correct.
Showing Notification Improvements
We have made some improvements to showing notifications, so you never miss a showing request. The notifications tab in the web CRM now has a section for Showing Request related notifications:
We have also implemented email notifications that will be sent when a request has been pending for a few days, as well as notifications in the Lofty mobile app.
Please see our Help Center article on the Showing Tool for more information about scheduling your showings with Lofty:
Listing Showing Management (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/18596161600027)
Social Studio Pro Auto-Post Listing Filter
The following update only applies if you have Social Studio Pro or Social Studio Team. Please see our Help Center article on this premium add-on:
Social Studio Pro (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/14483489366427)
We have added filters to the Automatic Listing Posts. These are social media posts that will post to the selected channels automatically when the listing status changes. More information on this feature can be found in the Social Studio Pro Help Center article, linked above.
With this update, you can decide exactly which listings are posted automatically. Click the Filter icon to filter out some listings from being posted automatically.
Here, you can decide to only automatically post updated listings of a certain price range, location, property type, or even from a specific MLS, if you are a member of multiple MLSs.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

A2P 10DLC Registration Updates
Starting in March, we will begin enforcing the A2P 10DLC regulations. For more information on this topic, please see our Help Center article:
A2P 10DLC Registration (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/17141883940379)
As a reminder, A2P 10DLC will only apply to you if you send text messages to United States based phone numbers. If you
do not
send text messages to US phone numbers, you will not need to register.
If you are a new Lofty user or have acquired your virtual phone number since December 2023, your virtual number needs to be registered to a 10DLC campaign in order to send text messages to US based phone numbers.
If your Lofty account and virtual phone numbers were acquired before December 2023, you have been able to send text messages without registering. Starting this month, we will be enforcing 10DLC registration and you will soon lose your ability to send text messages to US based phone numbers.
Please begin your A2P 10DLC registration as soon as possible to avoid any outage in your ability to send text messages.
As long as you have submitted registration, you will be able to continue sending text messages.
Mobile App Lead Assignee Optimization
This update allows you to assign a lead to another agent, any other role, or to a lead pond via the Lofty mobile app.
Learn more about managing your leads in the Lofty app here:
Managing Leads in the Mobile App (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/23344667318171)
Mass Action Upgrade 2.0
This update increased the limit of leads that mass action can be taken on from 200 leads to 5,000 leads for the following actions:
Send Postcard
Send Letter
Delete
Erase
Recover
Remember, you can see the results of your mass actions by checking the
Actions
notification in the notification bell. Learn more about notifications in the CRM here:
Lofty Notifications (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360016101752)
Agent Import Optimization
Enterprise Lofty accounts can add agents to their account via a csv file import. We have made three improvements to this process.
The Hierarchy Groups can be assigned on agent import
The users' account types can be set on import:
Full users with a seat should have one of the following fields:
Blank Field/No data
Normal
Standard
Display only users, who do not occupy a seat, should have one of the following fields:
Display Only
Roster Only
Display
Roster
Inactive
Learn more about setting up your Enterprise Lofty account here:
Enterprise Organization and Hierarchy Overview (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4407349639067)
Listing Ads Call to Action
The Listings Promotion Dashboard UI has been updated and we have added a notification to let you know when one of your listings has been active for 24 hours.
Learn more about Listing Promotion Ads here:
Listing Promotions (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055820611)
Customize the Payer on Smart Plan Steps
This update allows Lofty users, other than the Smart Plan creator, to pay the fees for Smart Plan steps that incur a cost, like mailing a physical letter or postcard.
A payer setting is available on Smart Plans that include a paid for step in the Smart Plan Actions that allow the responsible payer to be either the Smart Plan creator or the Lofty user who is applying this Smart Plan to their leads.
Learn more about sending mailers here:
Print House: Mailers (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360058318632)
Landing Page Form Optimization
By default, when a form is filled out on a landing page, the provided details are saved and the person who completed the form is now logged in to your website.
With this update, you can have a form on a landing page reset after each time is it completed, without keeping the person logged in. This is useful if you want to have leads or other contacts provide their information via a landing page form at an open house or other networking event.
Learn more about Landing Page here:
Landing Pages (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038228552)
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please contact our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.

Optimizations to the Beta People Page UI
We have made some optimizations to the beta-release People Page. These updates will apply to anyone who is currently on this beta. Learn more about the beta released People Page here:
Beta Feature - Updated People Page UI (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/21282508051227)
Lead View Updates
It is now easier to see which filters have been applied to the People Page.
We have also added view templates, to simplify the process of creating a new custom view.
Segment View Updates
With this update, the Segment view is much more functional. The
Action
column, which previously only allowed you to edit the Segment name and reminder period, change the Segment order, or delete the Segment, now allows you to also send a mass email to the leads in a segment, send letters and postcards to all the leads in the Segment, and pin a Segment to the top of the list.
When creating a new Segment, you will immediately be asked if you want to add leads to the Segment right away. If so, you can add filters to select the appropriate leads for the segment.
A new section called
Automation
simplifies the process of contacting and seeing data on all the leads in a Segment. Here is an example of the email automation for a Segment:

Quick CMA
This update simplifies CMA creation and allows you to get started with one click. The quick CMA option will automatically retrieve property information and conduct a search for comparable properties.
Auto CMA criteria include radius, property type, ±50% square footage, bedrooms (0 or more), and sold date within the last 183 days.
Learn more about Lofty's CMA tool here:
CMA Tool / Lofty CMA (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408440387099)
Image to Code Embed Block
This new website 'Embed' block will allow you to upload a static image that will be converted to HTML code that allows you to adjust the image.
Note: This is a beta released feature that can be made available by request.
This block allows you to upload an image, and AI technology will rebuild that block on your Lofty built website. After the image is uploaded, you can adjust the code manually or prompt the AI to update the image for you. Learn more about this block here:
Embed Block (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4407612265499)
Lofty mobile app showing request optimization
This update to the Lofty mobile app adjusts the Showing tool so that it is more consistent with the web CRM showing tool.
This update gives you the full functionality of the Lofty showing tool, from the convenience of the Lofty mobile app. Learn more here:
Lofty Real Estate App (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/17801017502491)

Group Texting
A group text is a text message that is sent to multiple recipients, and all the recipients can see and reply to each other.
Group texting will allow you to send a text message to both a lead as well as another agent, another lead, or the lead's family member. Up to 9 numbers can be added to a group text, for a total of 10 numbers, including the original sender.
IMPORTANT!
Group texting access will be rolled out gradually. If you want to get access quickly, please follow these steps:
Complete your
A2P 10DLC (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/17141883940379)
registration.
Lofty will need to port your virtual phone number to Twilio. This is a manual process that could take a few weeks. We cannot port your number until your 10DLC campaign is verified.
Note:
If you
do not
send text messages to United States based phone numbers, you do not need to register for 10DLC. If this is the case, please send a request to
support@lofty.com (mailto:support@lofty.com)
to have your virtual phone number ported to Twilio.
Learn more about texting via Lofty here:
Texting via Lofty (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057630352)
Expanded Lead Type Options
Lofty now supports selecting multiple lead types for a single lead and we have introduced new lead type options. Check each box by the lead type that you want to apply to the lead.
Learn more about the lead profile page here:
Lead Profile Page (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055290591)
Lead Pond Add-On
Enterprise Lofty accounts can add up to 5,000 lead ponds. Now, Lofty team accounts can purchase additional lead ponds, beyond the one (1) pond that is included with their package.
There are three (3) Lead Pond packages available:
One (1) additional lead pond for $50/month
Five (5) additional lead ponds for $125/month
Unlimited (5,000) additional lead ponds for $225/month
Learn more about Lofty lead ponds here:
Lead Pond (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038382872)
Social Studio in the Lofty mobile app
Basic Social Studio functionality is now available in the Lofty mobile app! The mobile app supports the following functionality:
Connecting your social media accounts
Creating, posting, and scheduling posts
Tracking engagement
Learn more about the Lofty mobile app here:
Lofty Real Estate App (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/17801017502491)
Realtor.com Market VIP Integration
Lofty now integrates with
Realtor.com Market VIP (https://www.realtor.com/marketing/real-estate-lead-generation/market-vip/)
leads via API! Please contact your Realtor.com Account Manager for help setting up your integration.
Learn more about Lofty's integration with Realtor.com here:
Realtor.com Integration (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/115001411906)

Design Services
Introducing an innovative solution to elevate your marketing game! With Design Services, you can unlock the power of professional postcard, letter, and flyer designs without committing to a full mailer package.
Simply navigate to
Marketing -> Design Center
and click
Need a Better Design?
select the design format and let us know what your needs are. Lofty's design team will create the designs along with two (2) rounds of revisions. Once you are satisfied, the designs will be added to your Design Center library and sent to you as a pdf file. Don't miss this opportunity to level up your promotional efforts with ease and efficiency!
Learn more about Lofty's Design Center here:
Design Center (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055290711)
Automatically Re-apply a Smart Plan
We've rolled out a significant improvement to Smart Plans: the option to automatically re-apply a Smart Plan to a lead, without manually deleting the Smart Plan from the lead's profile first.
This setting has been added to the
Trigger
settings for all Smart Plans. As long as the lead meets the Smart Plan's conditions, the Smart Plan will automatically re-apply to that lead. Say goodbye to the manual effort of deleting and re-adding the Smart Plan individually!
Note:
The Auto Apply setting must be enabled in order to enable the Auto Re-apply setting.
Learn more about Smart Plans here:
Smart Plans FAQs (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419016941083)
Export Transactions
Lofty now allows transactions to be exported to a csv file!
In order to export transactions, you will need to have the new permission
Export Transactions
enabled. When enabled, you can easily extract the transactional information you need for analysis and reporting.
Note:
Please reach out to your account admin if you need access to export transactions.
Learn more about transaction management with Lofty here:
Transaction Management Introduction (https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057572991)
New Beta Released AI Features
The following 3 features are available in a beta release and will be available on some Lofty accounts. If you do not have these features and would like to try them out, please complete
this request form (https://forms.monday.com/forms/9e9d086d6662a3f21e128a85b5aad663?r=use1)
.
Requesting access to beta features does not guarantee access to these features. All beta released features are in the testing phase and may contain bugs or errors.
Voice Bot Inbound Call Handler
Say goodbye to missed opportunities and hello to seamless communication! The Voice Bot Inbound Call Handler will answer incoming calls from unknown numbers and leads that you have not communicated with yet. It's like having a dedicated team member who works tirelessly to ensure that no lead goes untouched.
The Voice Bot Inbound Call Handler will be available on May 15.
Service Bot
The Lofty Service Bot has been improved to seek answers to your questions, solutions to your issues, and now includes an option to live transfer your chat session to a Lofty support representative. Whether you are seeking information or troubleshooting, the Service Bot is here to provide efficient support every step of the way.
Mobile App Voice Command
The Lofty mobile app voice-activated AI assistant is a game changer in client communication. With this update, effortlessly summon the AI Writer to compose emails and texts using just your voice. Plus, find leads quickly by speaking to the Lofty mobile app Voice Command. Make typing a thing of the past!
Mobile App Voice Command will be available on May 17.

Introduction
*Please note that the features available to you on the Lofty platform will vary depending on the package you have purchased. For any questions in this regard, please reach out to your assigned Customer Success Manager or our Support Team for more information.
Release Date

#### Article 663: Buyer Lead Generation Playbook: Maximizing Lofty’s Tools for Client Acquisition

- Article ID: `34837474203291`
- Category: `Lofty Playbooks`
- Section: `Done For You`
- Updated: `2025-11-12T05:35:28Z`
- URL: https://help.lofty.com/hc/en-us/articles/34837474203291-Buyer-Lead-Generation-Playbook-Maximizing-Lofty-s-Tools-for-Client-Acquisition

As a real estate agent primarily working with buyers, generating and converting leads is essential to growing your business. Lofty’s CRM offers powerful tools that allow you to manage, and nurture leads more efficiently. This playbook will walk you through the process of setting up automated lead capture forms, running targeted ads, and utilizing CRM tools to engage and convert potential buyers into clients.
1. Setting Up Landing Pages for Specific Property Types or Buyer Demographics
Why It Matters:
Landing pages are a powerful tool for attracting and converting leads. By tailoring your landing pages to specific property types or buyer demographics, you can target the right audience and collect their contact information, which feeds directly into your Lofty CRM.
Steps:
Log into Lofty CRM
and navigate to the
Landing Pages
section.
Create a New Landing Page
:
Title the landing page according to your target audience (e.g., "Dream Homes for First-Time Buyers," or "Luxury Properties in [Area]").
Add high-quality images and detailed property descriptions that match the interests of your targeted buyer demographic.
Promote the Landing Page
:
Use Lofty’s
social media integration
tools (like
Social Studio
) to share the landing page on your social channels.
Run ads or use
email campaigns
to drive traffic to the landing page.
2. Using Zip Code Blasts to Target Buyers in Specific Areas
Why It Matters:
Zip Code Blasts allow you to run hyper-targeted ads to potential buyers within specific geographic areas. This ensures that you’re reaching people who are actively interested in homes within those areas.
Steps:
Navigate to the Zip Code Blast Tool
within Lofty CRM.
Select Your Target Area
:
Choose the
zip code(s)
or neighborhoods you want to target. You can use Lofty’s data tools to select high-demand areas or neighborhoods you specialize in.
Create Your Ad Campaign
:
Set the budget and duration for your ad campaign.
Craft a compelling message like, “Looking for Your Dream Home in [Area]? Contact Me for Exclusive Listings!”
Add a
Lead Capture Form
(same as in Step 1) or direct users to your
landing page
.
Monitor and Optimize
:
Use Lofty’s analytics to track the effectiveness of your ad campaign.
Adjust targeting or messaging based on the performance data (e.g., high CTR in certain neighborhoods means you can further narrow down your audience).
3. Automating Email Campaigns to Follow Up with Leads
Why It Matters:
Staying in touch with leads is crucial to building a relationship and keeping them engaged. Automating your follow-up emails saves you time and ensures that no lead slips through the cracks.
Steps:
Set Up an Email Campaign
in Lofty CRM:
Go to the
Email Marketing
section of Lofty and select
Create New Campaign
.
Choose a campaign template focused on
buyer leads
or start from scratch.
Craft Your Email Sequence
:
Welcome Email
: “Thank you for inquiring about homes in [Area]. Let’s schedule a consultation to discuss your needs!”
Follow-Up Email
: “Did you find the perfect home yet? Here are some homes that might interest you.”
Value Email
: Provide insights into the buying process, market trends, or tips for first-time buyers.
Set Automation
:
Choose when emails should be sent based on lead behavior (e.g., 1 day after initial inquiry, 3 days after a showing, etc.).
Personalize the emails using CRM tags like
first name
,
property preferences
, and
location
.
Track Engagement
:
Monitor open rates, click-through rates, and responses to your emails.
Adjust your email copy based on lead interactions.
4. Setting Up Property Alerts and Market Reports to Provide Valuable Updates
Why It Matters:
Buyers appreciate up-to-date information on the market. By setting up property alerts and automated market reports, you can keep your leads engaged and encourage them to return to your website regularly.
Steps:
Set Up Property Alerts
for Leads:
Go to the
Lead Profile
in Lofty CRM and click on
Property Alerts
.
Set the criteria for the alerts based on your buyer’s preferences, such as
location
,
price range
, and
property features
.
Enable automatic alerts to notify buyers when a new property that matches their criteria is listed.
Set Up Automated Market Reports
:
Go to the
Marketing
tab in Lofty and select
Auto Market Reports
.
Choose the
area
or
zip code
for the reports and select the
frequency
(e.g., weekly, bi-weekly).
Include useful data like
average home prices
,
inventory trends
, and
property appreciation rates
.
Deliver Value
:
Send regular updates about homes in their target area.
Share insights about the local market that could influence their decision to buy.
Monitor Engagement
:
Track how often buyers open and engage with these alerts and reports.
Use this data to refine your approach or follow up with leads who are actively engaging.
Conclusion
By following these steps, you can fully leverage Lofty CRM to generate and convert more leads, nurture your buyer pipeline, and ultimately close more deals. From landing pages and Zip Code Blasts to automated emails, property alerts, and AI-powered engagement, Lofty’s tools will help you stay organized, engaged, and on top of your business.
Stay consistent with your marketing efforts, monitor results, and continuously optimize your approach to ensure long-term success.
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding this topic or any others, please reach out to our Support Team via email at <support@lofty.com>, by phone at 1 (855) 981-7557, or by chat with us through your Lofty CRM.
